verses.hindi: कर्महीन गृहस्थ और गौ आदि पशुओंसे हीन वैश्यकी शोभा नहीं होती, वैसे ही पिताके बिना पुत्र सुशोभित नहीं होता। जैसे सत्यरहित वचन, साधु पुरुषोंसे रहित सभा तथा दयाशून्य तप व्यर्थ

verses.sanskrit: आत्मवत्सर्वभूतानि पश्यतां शान्तचेतसाम् । अभिन्नमात्मनः सर्वं को दाता दीयते च किम्
verses.transliteration: ātmavatsarvabhūtāni paśyatāṃ śāntacetasām / abhinnamātmanaḥ sarvaṃ ko dātā dīyate ca kim
verses.translation: Visnu that Soul of the Universe began to grow in size till he reached the abode of Brahma. Hari who contains the Universe in his own person measured the world in two paces.
verses.hindi: है, वही दशा पिताके बिना बालककी होती है। जैसे वृक्षके बिना वन, जलके बिना नदी और वेगहीन घोड़ा निरर्थक होता है, वैसी ही पिताके

verses.sanskrit: पृथ्वीयं क्षत्रियवशा इति शास्त्रेषु निश्चितम् । तदाज्ञायां स्थिताः सर्वे लभन्ते परमं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthvīyaṃ kṣatriyavaśā iti śāstreṣu niścitam / tadājñāyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve labhante paramaṃ sukham
verses.translation: On seeing this miraculous phenomenon, gods of whom Brahma was prominent, the sages and the Manus were over¬ whelmed with ecstatic delight and they eulogised him.
verses.hindi: बिना बालककी दशा होती है। माँ! जैसे याचक मनुष्य-लोकमें अत्यन्त लघु समझा जाता है, उसी प्रकार पितृहीन बालक बहुत दुःख उठाता है। पुत्रकी यह बात सुनकर रानी लंबी साँस

verses.sanskrit: दातव्यो मुनिभिश्चापि षष्टांशो भूभुजे बले । महीयं ब्राह्मणानां तु दातव्या सर्व यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: dātavyo munibhiścāpi ṣaṣṭāṃśo bhūbhuje bale / mahīyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu dātavyā sarva yatnataḥ
verses.translation: "Obeisance to the great Ila (The Ruler of the Uni¬ verse) whose form is the Supreme Self; Salutations to him who transcends the transcendents; bow to him that assumes the highest form; salutations to the Atman of Brahma. Obeisance to him whose Soul and Intellect take delight in the Brahman; bow to him whose activities are invariably unobstructed.
verses.hindi: खींचकर दुःखमें डूब गयी। उसने सगरके पूछनेपर उसे सब बातें ठीक-ठीक बता दीं। यह सब वृत्तान्त सुनकर सगरको बड़ा क्रोध हुआ। उनके नेत्र लाल हो गये। उन्होंने उसी समय प्रतिज्ञा की,

verses.sanskrit: भूमिदानस्य माहात्म्यं न भूतं न भविष्यति । परं निर्वाणमान्पोति भूमिदो नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: bhūmidānasya māhātmyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / paraṃ nirvāṇamānpoti bhūmido nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O great Isa, the highest bliss, O Supreme Atman, greater than the greatest. Obeisance to you the indwelling soul of all; O embodiment of the Universe, who are beyond the pale of valid means of knowledge, we bow to you.
verses.hindi: “मैं शत्रुओंका नाश कर डालूँगा।' फिर ओर्व मुनिकी परिक्रमा करके माताको प्रणाम किया और मुनिसे आज्ञा लेकर वहाँसे प्रस्थान किया। और्वके आश्रमसे निकलनेपर सत्यवादी एवं पवित्र

verses.sanskrit: स्वल्पामपि महीं दत्त्वा श्रोत्रियायाहिताग्नये । ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: svalpāmapi mahīṃ dattvā śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye / brahmalokamavāpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabham
verses.translation: Obeisance to you who (being immanent in the Uni¬ verse ) have eyes all round; salutation to you who have arms and heads all round; bow to you who course everywhere.
verses.hindi: राजकुमार सगरको उनके कुलपुरोहित महर्षि वसिष्ठ मिल गये। इससे उन्हें बड़ी प्रसन्नता हुई। अपने कुलगुरु महात्मा वस्िष्ठको प्रणाम करके सगरने अपना सब समाचार बताया; यद्यपि वे ज्ञानदृष्टिसे

verses.sanskrit: भूमिदः सर्वदः प्रोक्तो भूमिदो मोक्षभाग्भवेत् । अतिदानं तु तज्ज्ञेयं सर्वपापप्राणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmidaḥ sarvadaḥ prokto bhūmido mokṣabhāgbhavet / atidānaṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ sarvapāpaprāṇāśanam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by Brahma and others, the great Visnu granted the boon of fearlessness to the heavendwellcrs
verses.hindi: सब कुछ पहलेसे ही जानते थे। राजा सगरने उन्हीं महर्षिसे ऐन्द्र, वारुण, ब्राह्म और आग्रेय- अस्त्र तथा उत्तम खड़्ग तथा वज्रके समान सुदृढ़

verses.sanskrit: महापातकयुक्तो वा युक्तो वा सर्वपातकैः । दशहस्तां महीं दत्त्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: mahāpātakayukto vā yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ / daśahastāṃ mahīṃ dattvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Due to Bali's inability to grant land for one more step, he imprisoned Bali, the son of Virocana. Thereafter, knowing that he was dedicated unto him, he (Visnu) gave him (Bali) the dominion in the nether world called RasStala for his residence. The Lord who is ever under the control of his devotees, became his (Bali's) doorkeeper.
verses.hindi: मुनिकी आज्ञा ले उनके आशीर्वादसे समादृत हो उन्हें प्रणाम करके तत्काल वहाँसे यात्रा की। शूरवीर सगरने एक ही धनुषसे अपने विरोधियोंको पुत्र-पौत्र और सेनासहित स्वर्गलोक पहुँचा दिया।

verses.sanskrit: सत्पात्रे भूमिदाता यः सर्वदानफलं लभेत् । भूमिदानसमं नान्यत्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते
verses.transliteration: satpātre bhūmidātā yaḥ sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet / bhūmidānasamaṃ nānyatriṣu lokeṣu vidyate
verses.translation: "What diet was assigned by Mahavisnu to the son of Virocana, in the terrible region of Rasatala which is dangerous due to the fear of serpents?"
verses.hindi: उनके धनुषसे छूटे हुए अग्रिसदृश बाणोंसे संतप्त होकर कितने ही शत्रु नष्ट हो गये और कितने ही भयभीत होकर भाग गये। शक, यवन तथा अन्य बहुत-से राजा प्राण बचानेकी इच्छासे तुरंत वसिष्ठ

verses.sanskrit: द्विजाय वृत्तिहीनाय यः प्रदद्यान्महीं बले । तस्य पुण्यफलं वक्तुं न क्षमो ऽब्दशतैरहम्
verses.transliteration: dvijāya vṛttihīnāya yaḥ pradadyānmahīṃ bale / tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na kṣamo 'bdaśatairaham
verses.translation: In this way god Visnu gave the nether world called Rasatala to Bali along with all his Asuras. Offering fearless¬ ness (a secure place) to all gods, Visnu granted them heaven.
verses.hindi: मुनिकी शरणमें गये। इस प्रकार भूमण्डलपर विजय

verses.sanskrit: सक्ताय देवपूजासु वृत्तिहीनाय दैत्यप । स्वल्पामपि महीं दद्याद्यः स विष्णुर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: saktāya devapūjāsu vṛttihīnāya daityapa / svalpāmapi mahīṃ dadyādyaḥ sa viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Witnessing this great deed, the sages, the expounders of the Brahman smiled at one another and bowed to the Supreme Person {Punifottama ).
verses.hindi: धर्महीनो यथा जतन्तुः कर्महीनो यथा अझत्यहीनं यथा वाक्य साधुहीना यथा

verses.sanskrit: इक्षुगोधूम तुवरीपूगवृक्षादिसंयुता । पृथ्वी प्रदीयते येन स विष्णुर्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: ikṣugodhūma tuvarīpūgavṛkṣādisaṃyutā / pṛthvī pradīyate yena sa viṣṇurnātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Visnu, the Soul abiding in all living beings, who had assumed the state of a Dwarf (Vamana) fascinated the entire world and repaired to forest for performing penance.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करके बाहुपुत्र सगर शीघ्र ही आचार्य वसिष्ठके समीप आये। उन्हें अपने गुप्तचरोंसे यह बात मालूम हो गयी थी कि हमारे शत्रु गुरुजीकी शरणमें गये हैं। बाहुपुत्र सगरको आया हुआ

verses.sanskrit: वृत्तिहीनाय विप्राय दरिद्राय कुटुम्बिने । स्वल्पामपि महीन्दत्त्वा विष्णुसायुज्यमान्पुयात्
verses.transliteration: vṛttihīnāya viprāya daridrāya kuṭumbine / svalpāmapi mahīndattvā viṣṇusāyujyamānpuyāt
verses.translation: Whoever reads or listens to this narrative of the glory of the Gahga, in a temple or on the banks of the river, shall obtain the fruit of the performance of a horse-sacrifice (Aivamedha).
verses.hindi: सुनकर महर्षि वसिष्ठ शरणागत राजाओंकी रक्षा करने तथा अपने शिष्य सगरकी प्रसन्नताके लिये क्षणभर विचार करने लगे। फिर उन्होंने कितने ही राजाओंके सिर मुँड़वा दिये और कितने ही

verses.sanskrit: सक्ताय देवपूजासु विप्रायाढकिकां महीम् । दत्त्वा लभेत गङ्गायां त्रिरात्रस्नानजं फलम्
verses.transliteration: saktāya devapūjāsu viprāyāḍhakikāṃ mahīm / dattvā labheta gaṅgāyāṃ trirātrasnānajaṃ phalam
verses.translation: A Puranic paraphrase of thp Purufa-sukta PF.X.90.12 & 13. The mantras are repeated in.dKXIX.6.6-7 Vdj.Sam. 31.11-12. The Sikta has been para¬ phrased in other Puraias also, vide Bh.P. II.ch.6.
verses.hindi: राजाओंकी दाढ़ी-मूँछ मुँडवा दी। यह देखकर सगर हँस पड़े और अपने तपोनिधि गुरुसे इस

verses.sanskrit: विप्राय वृत्तिहीनाय सदाचाररताय च । द्रोणिकां पृथिवीं दत्त्वा यत्फलं लभते शृणु
verses.transliteration: viprāya vṛttihīnāya sadācāraratāya ca / droṇikāṃ pṛthivīṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ labhate śṛṇu
verses.translation: The notes of the Indian musical scale or gamut are seven. They are inumerated in the Amara Kola as follows:
verses.hindi: सगरने कहा--गुरुदेव ! आप इन दुराचारियोंकी व्यर्थ रक्षा करते हैं। इन्होंने मेरे पिताके राज्यका अपहरण कर लिया था, अतः: मैं सब प्रकारसे इनका संहार कर डालूँगा। पापात्मा दुष्ट मनुष्य

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गातीर्थाश्वमेधानां शतानि विधिवन्नरः । कृत्वा यत्फलमान्पोति तदाप्नोति स पुष्कलम्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgātīrthāśvamedhānāṃ śatāni vidhivannaraḥ / kṛtvā yatphalamānpoti tadāpnoti sa puṣkalam
verses.translation: The six accessories (of the Vedas) are as follows: ikfd (phonetics), Kalpa (rules of rituals), Vydkcvreofa (Grammar), nirukta (etymology), Chandas (prosody), jyotifa (astronomy).
verses.hindi: तबतक दुष्टता करते हैं, जबतक कि उनकी शक्ति प्रबल होती है। इसलिये शत्रु यदि दास बनकर

verses.sanskrit: ददाति खारिकां भूमिं दरिद्राय द्विजाय यः । तस्य पुण्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि वदतो मे निशामय
verses.transliteration: dadāti khārikāṃ bhūmiṃ daridrāya dvijāya yaḥ / tasya puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi vadato me niśāmaya
verses.translation: Here Kaiyapa bows to the previous incarnations of Vamana (Vifnu), viz. the divine tortoise, the boar-incarnation who while uplifting the earth from the bottom of the ocean, killed demon Hiraiiyaksa and the Man-Lion who tore up Hiraiyakasipu with his claws. The MP. wrongly names Hirayaka whom Varaha killed, but the adjective vidHrakSya implies the Man-Lion incarnation, who killed Hiranyakasipu with his claws.
verses.hindi: प्रकट करें तो कल्याणकी इच्छा रखनेवाले पुरुषोंको उनपर विश्वास नहीं करना चाहिए। क्रूर मनुष्य पहले तो जीभसे बड़ी कठोर बातें बोलते हैं, किंतु जब निर्बल पड़ जाते हैं तो उसी जीभसे

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधसहस्राणि वाजपेयशतानि च । विधाय जाह्नवीतीरे पत्फलं तल्लभेद्धुवम्
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca / vidhāya jāhnavītīre patphalaṃ tallabheddhuvam
verses.translation: The author of the NP. makes Kasyapa to pay obeisance to the future incarnations of Vi?nu, viz. Parasurama, Rama and Krsna.
verses.hindi: बड़ी करुणाजनक बातें कहने लगते हैं। जिसको अपने कल्याणकी इच्छा हो, वह नीतिशास्त्रका

verses.sanskrit: भूमिदानं महादानमतिदानं प्रकीर्त्तितम् । सर्वपापप्रशमनमपवर्गफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmidānaṃ mahādānamatidānaṃ prakīrttitam / sarvapāpapraśamanamapavargaphalapradam
verses.translation: The gift of land has been highly praised as the most meritorious, from
verses.hindi: कभी विश्वास न करे। नम्रता दिखाते हुए दुर्जन,

verses.sanskrit: अत्रोतिहासं वक्ष्यामि शृणु दैत्यकुलेश्वर । यच्छुत्वा श्रद्धया युक्तो भूमिदानफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: atrotihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu daityakuleśvara / yacchutvā śraddhayā yukto bhūmidānaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: According to Vasisfha.ymr.29.19 gifts of cows, land and learning
verses.hindi: करनेवाला पुरुष मृत्युतुल्य खतरेमें ही है। अतः गुरुदेव! आप इनकी प्राणरक्षा न करें। ये रूप तो

verses.sanskrit: आसीत्पुरा द्विजवरो ब्राह्मकल्पे महामतिः । दरिद्रो वृत्तिहीनश्च नाम्ना भद्रमतिर्बले
verses.transliteration: āsītpurā dvijavaro brāhmakalpe mahāmatiḥ / daridro vṛttihīnaśca nāmnā bhadramatirbale
verses.translation: Cf. ati-ddndni sarvdji prihividdnam ucyate f
verses.hindi: गौका-सा बनाकर आये हैं, परंतु इनका कर्म व्याप्रोंके समान है। इन सब दुष्टोंका वध करके मैं आपकी कृपासे इस पृथ्वीका पालन करूँगा। वसिष्ठ बोले--महाभाग! तुम्हें अनेकानेक

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतानि सर्वशास्त्राणि तेन वेददिवानिशम् । श्रुतानि च पुराणानि धर्मशास्त्राणि सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: śrutāni sarvaśāstrāṇi tena vedadivāniśam / śrutāni ca purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: According to Apastamba Dharma S. 11.4.9.9-10 the donor has to pour water on the hands of the donee—
verses.hindi: साधुवाद है। सुब्रत! तुम ठीक कहते हो। फिर भी मेरी बात सुनकर तुम्हें पूर्ण शान्ति मिलेगी। राजन्! सभी जीव कर्मोकी रस्सीमें बंधे हुए हैं, तथापि जो अपने पापोंसे ही मारे गये हैं, उन्हें

verses.sanskrit: अभवंस्तस्य षट्पत्न्यः श्रुतिः सिन्धुर्यशोवती । कामिनी मालिनी चैव शोभा चेति प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: abhavaṃstasya ṣaṭpatnyaḥ śrutiḥ sindhuryaśovatī / kāminī mālinī caiva śobhā ceti prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: फिर किसलिये मारते हो ? यह शरीर पापसे उत्तपन्न हुआ और पापसे ही बढ़ रहा है। इसे पापमूलक जानकर भी तुम क्‍यों इसका वध करनेको उद्यत हुए हो? तुम वीर क्षत्रिय हो। इस पापमूलक

verses.sanskrit: आसु पन्तीषु तस्यासञ्चत्वरिंशच्छतद्वयम् । पुत्राणामसुरश्रेष्ठ सर्वे नित्यं बुभुक्षिताः
verses.transliteration: āsu pantīṣu tasyāsañcatvariṃśacchatadvayam / putrāṇāmasuraśreṣṭha sarve nityaṃ bubhukṣitāḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: शरीरको मारकर तुम्हें कौन-सी कीर्ति प्राप्त होगी ? ऐसा विचारकर इन लोगोंको मत मारो। गुरु वसिष्ठका यह वचन सुनकर सगरका क्रोध शान्त हो गया। उस समय मुनि भी सगरके

verses.sanskrit: अकिञ्चनो भद्रमतिः क्षुधार्त्तानात्मजान्प्रियाः । पश्यन्स्वयं क्षुधार्त्तश्च विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: akiñcano bhadramatiḥ kṣudhārttānātmajānpriyāḥ / paśyansvayaṃ kṣudhārttaśca vilalāpākulendriyaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: शरीरपर अपना हाथ फेरते हुए बहुत प्रसन्न हुए। तदनन्तर महर्षि वसिष्ठने उत्तम ब्रतका पालन करनेवाले अन्य मुनियोंके साथ महात्मा सगरका राज्याभिषिक किया। सगरकी दो स्त्रियाँ थीं--

verses.sanskrit: धिग्जन्म भाग्यरहितं धिग्जन्म धनवर्जितम् । धिग्जन्म धर्मरहितं धिग्जन्म ख्यातिवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: dhigjanma bhāgyarahitaṃ dhigjanma dhanavarjitam / dhigjanma dharmarahitaṃ dhigjanma khyātivarjitam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: केशिनी और सुमति। नारदजी ! ये दोनों विदर्भराज काश्यपकी कन्याएँ थीं। एक समय राजा सगरकी दोनों पत्नियोंद्वारा प्रार्थना करनेपर भृगुवंशी मन्त्रवेत्ता ओऔर्व मुनिने उन्हें पुत्र-प्राप्तिक लिये वर दिया। वे

verses.sanskrit: नरस्य बह्वपत्यस्य धिग्जन्मैश्वर्यवार्जितम् । अहो गुणाः सौम्यता च विद्वत्ता जन्म सत्कुले
verses.transliteration: narasya bahvapatyasya dhigjanmaiśvaryavārjitam / aho guṇāḥ saumyatā ca vidvattā janma satkule
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: मुनीश्वर तीनों कालकी बातें जानते थे। उन्होंने क्षणभर ध्यानमें स्थित होकर केशिनी और सुमतिका हर्ष बढ़ाते हुए इस प्रकार कहा। और्ब बोले--महाभागे! तुम दोनोंमेंसे एक

verses.sanskrit: दारिद्याम्बुधिमग्नस्य सर्वमेतन्न शोभते । प्रियाः पुत्राश्चपौत्राश्च बान्धवा भ्रातरस्तथा
verses.transliteration: dāridyāmbudhimagnasya sarvametanna śobhate / priyāḥ putrāścapautrāśca bāndhavā bhrātarastathā
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: रानी तो एक ही पुत्र प्राप्त करेगी; किंतु वह वंशको चलानेवाला होगा। परंतु दूसरी केवल संतानविषयक इच्छाकी पूर्तिके लिये साठ हजार पुत्र पैदा करेगी। तुमलोग अपनी-अपनी रुचिके

verses.sanskrit: शिष्याश्च सर्वमनुजास्त्यजन्त्यैश्वर्यवार्जितम् । चाण्डालो वा द्विजो वापि भाग्यवानेव पूज्यते
verses.transliteration: śiṣyāśca sarvamanujāstyajantyaiśvaryavārjitam / cāṇḍālo vā dvijo vāpi bhāgyavāneva pūjyate
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: अनुसार इनमेंसे एक-एक वर माँग लो। और्व मुनिका यह वचन सुनकर केशिनीने वंशपरम्पराके हेतुभूत एक ही पुत्रका वरदान

verses.sanskrit: दरिद्रः पुरुषो लोके शववल्लोकनिन्दितः । अहो संपत्संमायुक्तो निष्टुरो वाप्यनिष्ठुरः
verses.transliteration: daridraḥ puruṣo loke śavavallokaninditaḥ / aho saṃpatsaṃmāyukto niṣṭuro vāpyaniṣṭhuraḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: माँगा तथा रानी सुमतिके साठ हजार पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। मुनिश्रेष्ठ! केशिनीके पुत्रका नाम था असमझस। दुष्ट असमझस उन्मत्तकी-सी चेष्टा करने लगा। उसकी देखा-देखी सगरके सभी पुत्र बुरे आचरण

verses.sanskrit: गुणहीनो ऽपि गुणवान्मूर्खो वाप्यथ पण्डितः । ऐश्वर्यगुणयुक्तश्चेत्पूज्य एव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: guṇahīno 'pi guṇavānmūrkho vāpyatha paṇḍitaḥ / aiśvaryaguṇayuktaścetpūjya eva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: करने लगे। इन सबके दूषित कर्मोंको देखकर बाहुपुत्र राजा सगर बहुत दुःखी हुए। उन्होंने अपने पुत्रोंके निन्दित कर्मपर भलीभाँति विचार किया। वे सोचने लगे--अहो ! इस संसारमें दुष्टोंका

verses.sanskrit: अहो दरिद्रता दुःखं तत्राप्याशातिदुःखदा । आशाभिभूताः पुरुषा दुःखमश्नुवते ऽक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: aho daridratā duḥkhaṃ tatrāpyāśātiduḥkhadā / āśābhibhūtāḥ puruṣā duḥkhamaśnuvate 'kṣayam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: सज्ग अत्यन्त कष्ट देनेवाला है। तदनन्तर असमझसके अंशुमान् नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, जो बड़ा धर्मात्मा, गुणवान् और शास्त्रोंका ज्ञाता था। वह सदा अपने पितामह राजा सगरके हितमें संलग्र रहता था।

verses.sanskrit: आशयादासा ये दासास्ते सर्वलोकस्य । आशा दासी येषां तेषां दासायते लोकः
verses.transliteration: āśayādāsā ye dāsāste sarvalokasya / āśā dāsī yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ dāsāyate lokaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: सगरके सभी दुराचारी पुत्र लोकमें उपद्रव करने लगे। वे धार्मिक अनुष्ठान करनेवाले लोगोंके कार्यमें सदा विघ्न डाला करते थे। वे दुष्ट राजकुमार सदा मद्यपान करते और पारिजात आदि दिव्य

verses.sanskrit: मानो हि महतां लोके धनमक्षयमुच्यते । तस्मिन्नाशाख्यरिपुणा माने नष्टे दरिद्रता
verses.transliteration: māno hi mahatāṃ loke dhanamakṣayamucyate / tasminnāśākhyaripuṇā māne naṣṭe daridratā
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: वृक्षोंक फूल लाकर अपने शरीरको सजाते थे। उन्होंने साधु पुरुषोंकी जीविका छीन ली और सदाचारका नाश कर डाला। यह सब देखकर इन्द्र आदि देवता अत्यन्त दुःखसे पीड़ित हो इन

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशास्त्रार्थवेत्तापि दरिद्रो भाति मूर्खवत् । नैष्किञ्चन्यमहाग्राहग्रस्तानां को विमोचचकः
verses.transliteration: sarvaśāstrārthavettāpi daridro bhāti mūrkhavat / naiṣkiñcanyamahāgrāhagrastānāṃ ko vimocacakaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: सगरपुत्रोंक नाशके लिये कोई उत्तम उपाय सोचने लगे। सब देवता कुछ निश्चय करके पातालकी गुफामें रहनेवाले देवदेवेश्वर भगवान् कपिलके समीप गये। कपिलजी अपने मनसे परमानन्दस्वरूप

verses.sanskrit: अहो दुःखमहो दुःखमहो दुःखं दरिद्रता । तत्रापि पुत्रभार्याणां बाहुल्यमतिदुःखदम्
verses.transliteration: aho duḥkhamaho duḥkhamaho duḥkhaṃ daridratā / tatrāpi putrabhāryāṇāṃ bāhulyamatiduḥkhadam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: आत्माका ध्यान कर रहे थे। देवताओंने भूमिपर दण्डकी भाँति लेटकर उन्हें साष्टाज्ञ प्रणाम किया और इस प्रकार स्तुति की।

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा भद्रमतिः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः । अन्यमैश्वर्यदं धर्मं मनसाचिन्तयत्तदा
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā bhadramatiḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ / anyamaiśvaryadaṃ dharmaṃ manasācintayattadā
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: सम्पन्न हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप सांख्ययोगमें रत रहनेवाले हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप नररूपसे छिपे हुए नारायण हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। संसाररूपी वनको भस्म करनेके लिये आप

verses.sanskrit: भूमिदानं विनिश्चित्य सर्वदानोत्तमोत्तमम् । दानेन यो ऽनुमन्ताति स एव कृतवान्पुरा
verses.transliteration: bhūmidānaṃ viniścitya sarvadānottamottamam / dānena yo 'numantāti sa eva kṛtavānpurā
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: दावानलके समान हैं तथा धर्मपालनके लिये सेतुरूप हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। प्रभो! आप महान् वीतराग महात्मा हैं, आपको बारम्बार

verses.sanskrit: प्रापकं परमं धर्मं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् । दानानामुत्तमं दानं भूदानं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: prāpakaṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam / dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ bhūdānaṃ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: नमस्कार है। हम सब देवता सगरके पुत्रोंसे पीड़ित होकर आपकी शरणमें आये हैं। आप हमारी रक्षा करें।

verses.sanskrit: यद्दत्त्वा समवान्पोति यद्यदिष्टतमं नरः । इति निश्चत्य मतिमान्धीरो भद्रमतिर्बले
verses.transliteration: yaddattvā samavānpoti yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ naraḥ / iti niścatya matimāndhīro bhadramatirbale
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: कपिलजीने कहा--श्रेष्ठ देवगण ? जो लोग इस जगत्में अपने यश, बल, धन और आयुका नाश चाहते हैं, वे ही लोगोंको पीड़ा देते हैं। जो सर्वदा मन, वाणी और क्रियाद्वारा दूसरोंको पीड़ा

verses.sanskrit: कौशाम्बींनाम नगरीं कलत्रापत्ययुग्ययौ । सुघोषनामविप्रेन्द्रं सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वलितम्
verses.transliteration: kauśāmbīṃnāma nagarīṃ kalatrāpatyayugyayau / sughoṣanāmaviprendraṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvalitam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: देते हैं, उन्हें हैव ही शीघ्र नष्ट कर देता है। थोड़े ही दिनोंमें इन सगरपुत्रोंका नाश हो जायगा।

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा याचितवान्भूमिं पञ्चहस्तायतां बले । सुघोषो धर्मनिरतस्तं निरीक्ष्य कुटुम्बिक्रम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā yācitavānbhūmiṃ pañcahastāyatāṃ bale / sughoṣo dharmaniratastaṃ nirīkṣya kuṭumbikram
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: महात्मा कपिल मुनिके ऐसा कहनेपर देवता विधिपूर्वक उन्हें प्रणाम करके स्वर्गलोकको चले गये। इसी बीचमें राजा सगरने वसिष्ठ आदि महर्षियोंके सहयोगसे परम उत्तम अश्वमेध यज्ञका

verses.sanskrit: मनसा प्रीयमाणेन समभ्यर्च्येदमब्रवीत् । कृतार्थो ऽहं भद्रमते सफलं मम जन्म च
verses.transliteration: manasā prīyamāṇena samabhyarcyedamabravīt / kṛtārtho 'haṃ bhadramate saphalaṃ mama janma ca
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: अनुष्ठान आरम्भ किया। उस यज्ञके लिये नियुक्त किये हुए घोड़ेको देवराज इन्द्रने चुरा लिया और पातालमें जहाँ कपिल मुनि रहते थे, वहीं ले जाकर बाँध दिया। इन्द्रके द्वारा चुराये हुए उस

verses.sanskrit: मत्कुल पावनं जातं त्वदनुग्रहतो द्विज । इत्युक्त्वा तं समभ्यर्च्य सुघोषो धर्मतत्परः
verses.transliteration: matkula pāvanaṃ jātaṃ tvadanugrahato dvija / ityuktvā taṃ samabhyarcya sughoṣo dharmatatparaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: अश्वको खोजनेके लिये सगरके सभी पुत्र आश्चर्यचकित होकर भू आदि लोकोंमें घूमने लगे। जब ऊपरके लोकोंमें कहीं भी उन्हें वह अश्व दिखायी नहीं दिया, तब वे पातालमें जानेको उद्यत हुए। फिर

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चहस्तमितां भूमिं ददौ तस्मै महामतिः । पृथिवी वैष्णवी पुण्या पृथिवीं विष्णुपालिता
verses.transliteration: pañcahastamitāṃ bhūmiṃ dadau tasmai mahāmatiḥ / pṛthivī vaiṣṇavī puṇyā pṛthivīṃ viṣṇupālitā
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: तो सारी पृथ्वीको खोदना शुरू किया। एक-

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यास्तु प्रदानेन प्रीयतां मे जनार्दनः । मन्त्रेणानेन दैत्येन्द्र सुघोषस्तं द्विजोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāstu pradānena prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ / mantreṇānena daityendra sughoṣastaṃ dvijottamam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: डाली। खोदी हुई मिट्टीको उन्होंने समुद्रके तटपर बिखेर दिया और उसी द्वारसे वे सभी सगरपुत्र पाताललोकमें जा पहुँचे। वे सन अविवेकी मदसे उन्मत्त हो रहे थे। पातालमें सब ओर उन्होंने

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुबुद्ध्या समभ्यर्च्य तावतीं पृथिवीं ददौ । सो ऽपि भद्रमतिर्विप्रो धीमता याचितां भुवम्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇubuddhyā samabhyarcya tāvatīṃ pṛthivīṃ dadau / so 'pi bhadramatirvipro dhīmatā yācitāṃ bhuvam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: अश्वको ढूँढ़ना आरम्भ किया। खोजते-खोजते वहाँ उन्हें करोड़ों सूर्योके समान प्रभावशाली महात्मा कपिलका दर्शन हुआ। वे ध्यानमें तन्‍्मय थ्े। उनके पास ही वह घोड़ा भी दिखायी दिया।

verses.sanskrit: दत्तवान्हरिभक्ताय श्रोत्रियाय कुटुम्बिने । सुघोषो भूमिदानेन कोटिवंशसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: dattavānharibhaktāya śrotriyāya kuṭumbine / sughoṣo bhūmidānena koṭivaṃśasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: फिर तो वे सभी अत्यन्त क्रोधमें भर गये और

verses.sanskrit: प्रपेदे विष्णुभवनं यत्र गत्वा न शोचति । बले भद्रमतिश्चापि यतः प्रार्थितवाञ्छ्रियम्
verses.transliteration: prapede viṣṇubhavanaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati / bale bhadramatiścāpi yataḥ prārthitavāñchriyam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: मुनिको देखकर उन्हें मार डालनेका विचार करके वेगपूर्वक दौड़ते हुए उनपर टूट पड़े। उस समय आपसमें एक-दूसरेसे वे इस प्रकार कह रहे थे--'इसे मार डालो, मार डालो। बाँध लो,

verses.sanskrit: स्थितवान्विष्णुभवने सकुटुम्बो युगायुतम् । तथैव ब्रह्मसदने स्थित्वा कोटियुगायुतम्
verses.transliteration: sthitavānviṣṇubhavane sakuṭumbo yugāyutam / tathaiva brahmasadane sthitvā koṭiyugāyutam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: चुराकर यहाँ साधुरूपमें बगुलेकी भाँति ध्यान लगाये बैठा है। अहो ! संसारमें ऐसे भी खल हैं, जो बड़े-बड़े आडम्बर रचते हैं।' इस तरहकी बातें बोलते हुए वे मुनीशवर कपिलका उपहास

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्रं पदं समासाद्य स्थितवान्कल्पपञ्चकम् । ततो भुवं समासाद्य सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: aindraṃ padaṃ samāsādya sthitavānkalpapañcakam / tato bhuvaṃ samāsādya sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: करने लगे। कपिलजी अपने समस्त इन्द्रियवर्ग और बुद्धिको आत्मामें स्थिर करके ध्यानमें तत्पर थे; अत: उनकी इस करतूतका उन्हें कुछ भी पता नहीं चला। सगरपुत्रोंकी मृत्यु निकट थी, इसलिये

verses.sanskrit: जातिस्मरो महाभागो बुभुजे भोगमुत्तमम् । ततो भद्रमतिर्दैत्य निष्कामो विष्णुतत्परः
verses.transliteration: jātismaro mahābhāgo bubhuje bhogamuttamam / tato bhadramatirdaitya niṣkāmo viṣṇutatparaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: उन लोगोंकी बुद्धि मारी गयी थी। वे मुनिको लातोंसे मारने लगे। कुछ लोगोंने उनकी बाहें पकड़ लीं। तब मुनिकी समाधि भड्ढ हो गयी। उन्होंने विस्मित होकर लोकमें उपद्रव करनेवाले

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीं वृत्तिहीनेभ्यो ब्रह्मणेभ्यः प्रदत्तवान् । तस्य विष्णुः प्रसन्नात्मा तत्त्वैशअवर्यमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivīṃ vṛttihīnebhyo brahmaṇebhyaḥ pradattavān / tasya viṣṇuḥ prasannātmā tattvaiśaavaryamanuttamam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: सगरपुत्रोंको लक्ष्य करके गम्भीरभावसे युक्त यह वचन कहा--'जो ऐश्वर्यके मदसे उन्मत्त हैं, जो भूखसे पीड़ित हैं, जो कामी हैं तथा जो अहंकारसे मूढ़ हो रहे हैं--ऐसे मनुष्योंको विवेक

verses.sanskrit: कोटिवंशसमेतस्य ददौ मोक्षमनुत्तमम् । तस्माद्दैत्यपते मह्यं सर्वधर्मपरायण
verses.transliteration: koṭivaṃśasametasya dadau mokṣamanuttamam / tasmāddaityapate mahyaṃ sarvadharmaparāyaṇa
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: नहीं होता। यदि दुष्ट मनुष्य सज्जनोंको सताते हैं तो इसमें आश्चर्य क्या है ? नदीका वेग किनारेपर उगे हुए वृक्षोंको भी गिरा देता है। जहाँ धन है, जवानी है तथा परायी स्त्री भी है, वहाँ सदा सब

verses.sanskrit: तपश्चरिष्येमोक्षाय देहि मे त्रिपदां महीम् । वैरोचनिस्ततो दृष्टः कलशं जलपूरितम्
verses.transliteration: tapaścariṣyemokṣāya dehi me tripadāṃ mahīm / vairocanistato dṛṣṭaḥ kalaśaṃ jalapūritam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: अन्धे और मूर्ख बने रहते हैं। दुष्टके पास लक्ष्मी हो तो वह लोकका विनाश करनेवाली ही होती है। जैसे वायु अग्निकी ज्वालाको बढ़ानेमें सहायक होता है और जैसे दूध साँपके विषको

verses.sanskrit: आददे पृथिवीं दातुं वर्णिने वामनाय । विष्णुः सर्वगतोज्ञात्वा जलधारावरोधिनम्
verses.transliteration: ādade pṛthivīṃ dātuṃ varṇine vāmanāya / viṣṇuḥ sarvagatojñātvā jaladhārāvarodhinam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: बढ़ानेमें कारण होता है, उसी प्रकार दुष्टकी लक्ष्मी उसकी दुष्टताको बढ़ा देती है। अहो! धनके मदसे अन्धा हुआ मनुष्य देखते हुए भी

verses.sanskrit: काव्यं हस्तस्थदर्भाग्रं तच्छरे संन्यवेशयत् । दर्भाग्रे ऽभून्महाशास्त्रं कोटिसूर्यसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: kāvyaṃ hastasthadarbhāgraṃ tacchare saṃnyaveśayat / darbhāgre 'bhūnmahāśāstraṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: :«-क पेश्वर्यमदमत्तानां क्षुधितानां च कामिनाम्। अहड्ढजगारविमूढानां विवेको नैव जायते॥ (ना० पूर्व० ८। १०३)

verses.sanskrit: अमोधं ब्रह्ममत्युग्रं काव्याक्षिग्रासलोलुपम् । आयाय भार्गवसुरानसुरानेकचक्षुषा
verses.transliteration: amodhaṃ brahmamatyugraṃ kāvyākṣigrāsalolupam / āyāya bhārgavasurānasurānekacakṣuṣā
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: नहीं देखता। यदि वह अपने हितको देखता है तभी वह वास्तवमें देखता है।'

verses.sanskrit: पश्येति वान्दिदेशे च दर्भाग्रं शस्त्रसन्निभम् । बलिर्ददौ महाविष्णोर्महीं त्रिपदसंमिताम्
verses.transliteration: paśyeti vāndideśe ca darbhāgraṃ śastrasannibham / balirdadau mahāviṣṇormahīṃ tripadasaṃmitām
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर कपिलजीने कुपित हो अपने नेत्रोंसे आग प्रकट की। उस आगने समस्त सगरपुत्रोंको क्षणभरमें जलाकर भस्म कर डाला। उनकी ननेत्राग्रिको देखकर पातालनिवासी जीव

verses.sanskrit: ववृधे सो ऽपि विश्वात्मा आब्रह्मभुवनं तदा । अमिमीत महीं द्वाभ्यां पद्भ्यां विश्वतनुर्हरिः
verses.transliteration: vavṛdhe so 'pi viśvātmā ābrahmabhuvanaṃ tadā / amimīta mahīṃ dvābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ viśvatanurhariḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: शोकमें डूब गये और असमयमें प्रलय हुआ जानकर चीत्कार करने लगे। उस अग्निसे संतप्त हो सम्पूर्ण सर्प तथा राक्षस समुद्रमें शीघ्रतापूर्वक समा गये। अवश्य ही साधु-महात्माओंका कोप

verses.sanskrit: स आब्रह्मकटाहान्तपदान्येतानि सप्रभः । पादाङ्कुष्टाग्रनिर्भिन्नं ब्रह्माण्डं विभिदे द्विधा
verses.transliteration: sa ābrahmakaṭāhāntapadānyetāni saprabhaḥ / pādāṅkuṣṭāgranirbhinnaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ vibhide dvidhā
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर देवदूतने राजाके यज्ञमें आकर यजमान सगरको वह सब समाचार बताया। राजा सगर सब शास्त्रोंके ज्ञाता थे। यह सब वृत्तान्त सुनकर उन्होंने अत्यन्त प्रसन्नतापूर्वक कहा--

verses.sanskrit: तद्दारा बाह्यसलिलं बहुधारं समागतम् । धौतविष्णुपदं तोयं निर्मलं लोकपावनम्
verses.transliteration: taddārā bāhyasalilaṃ bahudhāraṃ samāgatam / dhautaviṣṇupadaṃ toyaṃ nirmalaṃ lokapāvanam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: हैवने ही उन दुष्टोंको दण्ड दे दिया। माता, पिता, भाई अथवा पुत्र जो भी पाप करता है, वही शत्रु माना गया है। जो पापमें प्रवृत्त होकर सब लोगोंके साथ विरोध करता है, उसे महान् शत्रु

verses.sanskrit: अजाण्डबाह्यनिलयं धारारुपमवर्त्तत । तज्जलं पावनं श्रेष्ठं ब्रह्मादीन्पावयत्सुरान्
verses.transliteration: ajāṇḍabāhyanilayaṃ dhārārupamavarttata / tajjalaṃ pāvanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ brahmādīnpāvayatsurān
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: समझना चाहिए--यही शास्त्रोंका निर्णय है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्पर्षिसेवितं चैव न्यपतन्मेरुमूर्द्धनि
verses.transliteration: satparṣisevitaṃ caiva nyapatanmerumūrddhani
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: मुनीधवर नारदजी! राजा सगरने अपने पुत्रोंका नाश होनेपर भी शोक नहीं किया; क्‍योंकि दुराचारियोंकी मृत्यु साधु पुरुषोंके लिये संतोषका कारण होती है। ' पुत्रहीन पुरुषोंका यज्ञमें अधिकार

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दष्ट्वाद्भुतं कर्म ब्रह्माद्या देवतागणाः । ऋषयो मनवश्चैव ह्यस्तुवन्हर्षविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: etaddaṣṭvādbhutaṃ karma brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ / ṛṣayo manavaścaiva hyastuvanharṣavihvalāḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: नहीं है '। धर्मशास्त्रकी ऐसी आज्ञा होनेके कारण महाराज सगरने अपने पौत्र अंशुमानको ही दत्तक पुत्रके रूपमें गोद ले लिया। सारग्राही राजा सगरने बुद्धिमान् और दिद्वानोंमें श्रेष्ठ अंशुमान्को

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः नमः परेशाय परात्मरुपिणे परात्परायापररुपधारिणे । ब्रह्मात्मने ब्रह्मरतात्मबुद्धये नमो ऽस्तु ते ऽव्याहतकर्मशीलिने
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ namaḥ pareśāya parātmarupiṇe parātparāyāpararupadhāriṇe / brahmātmane brahmaratātmabuddhaye namo 'stu te 'vyāhatakarmaśīline
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: अश्व ढूँढ़ लानेके कार्यमें नियुक्त किया। अंशुमानने उस गुफाके द्वारपर जाकर तेजोराशि मुनिवर कपिलको देखा और उन्हें साष्टाड़ प्रणाम किया। फिर दोनों हाथोंको जोड़कर वह विनयपूर्वक

verses.sanskrit: परेश परमानन्द परमात्मन्परात्पर । सर्वात्मने जगन्मूर्त्ते प्रमाणातीत ते नमः
verses.transliteration: pareśa paramānanda paramātmanparātpara / sarvātmane jaganmūrtte pramāṇātīta te namaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: उनके सामने खड़ा हो गया और शान्तचित्त सनातन देवदेव कपिलसे इस प्रकार बोला। अंशुमानने कहा--ब्रह्मन्! मेरे पिताके भाइयोंने यहाँ आकर जो दुष्टता की है, उसे आप क्षमा

verses.sanskrit: विश्वतश्वक्षुषे तुभ्यं विश्वतो बाहवे नमः । विश्वतः शिरसे चैव विश्वतो गतये नमः
verses.transliteration: viśvataśvakṣuṣe tubhyaṃ viśvato bāhave namaḥ / viśvataḥ śirase caiva viśvato gataye namaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: करें; क्योंकि साधु पुरुष सदा दूसरोंके उपकारमें लगे रहते हैं और क्षमा ही उनका बल है। संत- महात्मा दुष्ट जीवोंपर भी दया करते हैं। चन्द्रमा चाण्डालके घरसे अपनी चाँदनी खींच नहीं लेते

verses.sanskrit: एवंर स्तुतो महाविष्णुर्ब्रह्माद्यैः स्वर्द्दवौकसाम् । दत्त्वाभयं च मुमुदे देवदेवः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃra stuto mahāviṣṇurbrahmādyaiḥ svarddavaukasām / dattvābhayaṃ ca mumude devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: हैं। सज्जन पुरुष दूसरोंसे सताये जानेपर भी सबके लिये सुखकारक ही होता है। देवताओंद्वारा अपनी अमृतमयी कलाके भक्षण किये जानेपर भी चन्द्रमा उन्हें परम संतोष ही देता है।

verses.sanskrit: विरोचनात्मजं दैत्यं पदैकार्थं बबन्ध ह । ततः प्रपन्नं तु बलिं ज्ञात्वा चास्मै रसातलम् । ददौ तद्वारपालश्च भक्तवश्यो बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: virocanātmajaṃ daityaṃ padaikārthaṃ babandha ha / tataḥ prapannaṃ tu baliṃ jñātvā cāsmai rasātalam / dadau tadvārapālaśca bhaktavaśyo babhūva ha
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: चन्दनको काटा जाय या छेदा जाय, वह अपनी सुगन्धसे सबको सुवासित करता रहता है। साधु पुरुषोंका भी ऐसा ही स्वभाव होता है। पुरुषोत्तम ! आपके गुणोंको जाननेवाले मुनीधरगण ऐसा

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच रसातले महाविष्णुर्विरोचनसुतस्य वै । किं भोज्यं कल्पयामास घोरे सर्पभयाकुले
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca rasātale mahāviṣṇurvirocanasutasya vai / kiṃ bhojyaṃ kalpayāmāsa ghore sarpabhayākule
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: मानते हैं कि आप क्षमा, तपस्या तथा धर्माचरणद्वारा समस्त लोकोंको शिक्षा देनेके लिये इस भूतलपर अवतीर्ण हुए हैं। ब्रह्मन्ं! आपको नमस्कार है। मुने! आप ब्रह्मस्वरूप हैं, आपको नमस्कार है।

verses.sanskrit: सनक उवाच अमन्त्रितं हविर्यत्तु हूयते जातवेदसि । अपात्रे दीयते यच्च तद्धोरं भोगसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: sanaka uvāca amantritaṃ haviryattu hūyate jātavedasi / apātre dīyate yacca taddhoraṃ bhogasādhanam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: आप स्वभावत: ब्राह्मणोंका हित करनेवाले हैं और सदा ब्रह्मचिन्तनमें लगे रहते हैं, आपको

verses.sanskrit: हुतं हविरशुचिना दृत्तं सत्कर्म यत्कृतम् । तत्सर्वं तत्र भोगार्हमधः पातफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: hutaṃ haviraśucinā dṛttaṃ satkarma yatkṛtam / tatsarvaṃ tatra bhogārhamadhaḥ pātaphalapradam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: अंशुमान्के इस प्रकार स्तुति करनेपर कपिल मुनिका मुख प्रसन्नतासे खिल उठा। उस समय वे बोले--“निष्पाप राजकुमार! मैं तुमपर प्रसन्न हूँ, वर माँगो।' मुनिके ऐसा कहनेपर अंशुमान्ने

verses.sanskrit: एवं रसातलं विष्णुर्बलये सासुराय तु । दत्त्वाभयं च सर्वेषां सुराणां त्रिदिवं ददौ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ rasātalaṃ viṣṇurbalaye sāsurāya tu / dattvābhayaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ surāṇāṃ tridivaṃ dadau
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: प्रणाम करके कहा--' भगवन् ! हमारे इन पितरोंको ब्रह्मलोकमें पहुँचा दें।' तब कपिल मुनि अंशुमानूपर

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यमानो ऽमरगणैः स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः । गन्धर्वैर्गीयमानश्च पुनर्वामनतां गतः
verses.transliteration: pūjyamāno 'maragaṇaiḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ / gandharvairgīyamānaśca punarvāmanatāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: तुम्हारा पौत्र यहाँ गड्राजीको लाकर अपने पितरोंको स्वर्गलोक पहुँचायेगा। वत्स! तुम्हारे

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दृष्ट्वा महत्कर्ममुनो ब्रह्मवादिनः । परस्परे स्मितमुखाः प्रणेभुः पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: etaddṛṣṭvā mahatkarmamuno brahmavādinaḥ / paraspare smitamukhāḥ praṇebhuḥ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: नदी इन सगरपुत्रोंके पाप धोकर इन्हें परम पदकी प्राप्ति करा देगी। बेटा! इस घोड़ेको ले जाओ, जिससे तुम्हारे पितामहका यज्ञ पूर्ण हो जाय।' तब अंशुमान् अपने पितामहके पास लौट

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतत्मको विष्णुर्वामनत्वमुपागतः । मोहयन्निखिलं लोकं प्रपेदे तपसे वनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtatmako viṣṇurvāmanatvamupāgataḥ / mohayannikhilaṃ lokaṃ prapede tapase vanam
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: किया। सगरने उस पणशुके द्वारा ब्राह्मणोंक साथ वह यज्ञ पूर्ण किया और तपस्यथाद्वारा भगवान् विष्णुकी आराधना करके वे वैकुण्ठधामको चल गये। अंशुमानके दिलीप नामक पुत्र हुआ।

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रभावा सा देवी गङ्गा विष्णुपदोद्भवा । यस्याः स्मरणमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ prabhāvā sā devī gaṅgā viṣṇupadodbhavā / yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: दिलीपसे भगीरथका जन्म हुआ, जो दिव्य लोकसे गज्जाजीको इस भूतलपर ले आये। मुने! भगीरथकी तपस्यासे संतुष्ट हो ब्रह्माजीने उन्हें गड़ाा दे दी; फिर भगीरथ, गड्जाजीको

verses.sanskrit: इदं तु गङ्गामाहात्म्यं यः पठे च्छृणुयादपि । देवालये नदीतीरे सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ tu gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ yaḥ paṭhe cchṛṇuyādapi / devālaye nadītīre so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: According to the legend of Visvakarman Bhauvana narrated in the Aitareya Br. 39.7, and Satapatha Br. XIII.7.1. 13-15, a king is not to gift land. When Visvakarman was about to give away the earth to his sacrificial priest Kasyapa, the earth manifested herself and strongly protested against it saying no man should give away land and threatened him that she would plunge herself in water and render his promise of gift fruitless:
verses.hindi: धारण कौन करेगा--इस विषयमें विचार करने लगे। तदनन्तर भगवान् शिवकी आराधना करके उनकी सहायतासे वे देवनदी गड्जाको पृथ्वीपप ले आये और उनके जलसे स्पर्श

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे गङ्गोत्पत्तिर्गङ्गामाहात्म्यं नामैकादशो ऽध्यायः नातद उवाच श्रुतं तु गङ्गामाहात्म्यं वाञ्छितं पापनाशनम् । अधुना लक्षणं ब्रूहि भ्रातर्मे दानपात्रघयोः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde gaṅgotpattirgaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ nātada uvāca śrutaṃ tu gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ vāñchitaṃ pāpanāśanam / adhunā lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi bhrātarme dānapātraghayoḥ
verses.translation: The great glory of the Gahga has been heard. It is desirable, as it destroys all sins. Now, dear brother, tell me the characteristic of charitable gifts as well as of the persons deserv¬ ing the same.
verses.hindi: कराकर पवित्र हुए पितरोंको उन्होंने दिव्य स्वर्गलोकमें पहुँचा दिया।

verses.sanskrit: सनक उवाच सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां ब्रह्मणः परमो गुरुः । तस्मै तानानि देयानि दत्तस्यानन्त्यमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: sanaka uvāca sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramo guruḥ / tasmai tānāni deyāni dattasyānantyamicchatā
verses.translation: Without any fear or reservation, a Brahmana should accept charitable gifts from all, but neither a Ksatriya nor a Vaisya should ever accept a charitable gift or a donation.
verses.hindi: बलिके द्वारा देवताओंकी पराजय तथा अदितिकी तपस्या

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणः प्रतिगृह्णीयात्सर्वतो भयवर्जितः । न कदापि क्षत्रविशो गृह्णीयातां प्रतिग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ pratigṛhṇīyātsarvato bhayavarjitaḥ / na kadāpi kṣatraviśo gṛhṇīyātāṃ pratigraham
verses.translation: O excellent Brahma, one should neither give any gift nor accept any donation from those who are engaged in sinftil activities or those who are always censured by good people. O N&rada, a charitable gift must be given with special efforts to one who is engaged in good and noble activities.
verses.hindi: नारदजीने कहा--भाईजी! यदि मैं आपकी कृपाका पात्र होऊँ तो भगवान् विष्णुके चरणोंके अग्रभागसे उत्पन्न हुई जो गड़ा बतायी जाती हैं, उनकी उत्पत्तिकी कथा मुझसे कहिये।

verses.sanskrit: चण्डस्य पुत्रहीनस्य दम्भाचाररतस्य च । स्वकर्मत्यागिनश्चापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: caṇḍasya putrahīnasya dambhācāraratasya ca / svakarmatyāginaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: Charitable gifts, enjoyment and destruction—these are the three ways of going away or spending of wealth.
verses.hindi: श्रीसनकजी बोले--निष्पाप नारदजी! मैं गज्जाकी उत्पत्ति बताता हूँ, सुनिये। वह कथा कहने और सुननेवालेके लिये भी पुण्यदायिनी है तथा सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाली है। कश्यप

verses.sanskrit: परदाररतस्यापि परद्रव्याभिलिषिणः । नक्षत्रसूचकस्यापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: paradāraratasyāpi paradravyābhiliṣiṇaḥ / nakṣatrasūcakasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: The riches belonging to a person who neither gifts it away nor enjoys it himself, are the causes of his ruin. OBrah- mana, wealth is that the fruit of which is Dharma and Dharma is that which propitiates god Vi$nu.
verses.hindi: नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक मुनि हो गये हैं। वे ही इन्द्र आदि देवताओंके जनक हैं। दक्ष-पुत्री दिति और अदिति--ये दोनों उनकी पत्नियाँ हैं। अदिति

verses.sanskrit: असूयाविष्टमनसः कृतन्घस्य च मायिनः । अयाज्ययाजकस्यापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: asūyāviṣṭamanasaḥ kṛtanghasya ca māyinaḥ / ayājyayājakasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: Do not trees lead a life? They live in this world for the sake of others, for they oblige others by providing them with their roots and fruits.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म! उन दोनोंके दो पुत्र हैं, वे सदा एक- दूसरेको जीतनेकी इच्छा रखते हैं। दितिका पुत्र आदिहैत्य हिरण्यकशिपु बड़ा बलवान् था। उसके पुत्र प्रह्मद हुए। वे हैत्योंमें बड़े भारी संत थे।

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं याच्ञापरस्यापि हिंसकस्य खलस्य च । रसविक्रयिणश्वैव दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ yācñāparasyāpi hiṃsakasya khalasya ca / rasavikrayiṇaśvaiva dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: In that story the characteristics of ddna (and other righteous deeds) have been described along with the greatness of the Ganga. which destroys all sins.
verses.hindi: प्रह्मदका पुत्र विरोचन हुआ, जो ब्राह्मणभक्त था। विरोचनके पुत्र बलि हुए, जो अत्यन्त तेजस्वी और प्रतापी थे। मुने! बलि ही हैत्योंके सेनापति हुए। वे बहुत बड़ी सेनाके साथ इस पृथ्वीका

verses.sanskrit: नामैका द वेदविक्रयिणश्चापि स्मृतिविक्रयिणस्तथा । धर्मविक्रयिणो विप्र दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: nāmaikā da vedavikrayiṇaścāpi smṛtivikrayiṇastathā / dharmavikrayiṇo vipra dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: The king greeted and honoured god Dharmaraja who had come to him, in accordance with the injunctions laid down in the scriptures (for receiving a distinguished guest). Dharmaraja who was pleased with him addressed him as follows;
verses.hindi: राज्य भोगते थे। समूची पृथ्वीको जीतकर स्वर्गको भी जीत लेनेका विचार कर वे युद्धमें प्रवृत्त हुए। उन्होंने विशाल सेनाके साथ देवलोकको प्रस्थान किया। देवशत्रु बलिने स्वर्गलोकमें पहुँचकर

verses.sanskrit: गानेन जीविका यस्य यस्य भार्या च पुश्चली । परोपतापिनश्चापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: gānena jīvikā yasya yasya bhāryā ca puścalī / paropatāpinaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: O king, you are the most excellent among the knowers of righteousness. You are famous in the three worlds. On hearing about your fame, Dharmaraja himself has come to see you personally.
verses.hindi: सिंहके समान पराक्रमी हैत्योंद्वारा इन्द्रकी राजधानीको घेर लिया। तब इन्द्र आदि देवता भी युद्धके लिये नगरसे बाहर निकले। तदनन्तर देवताओं और हैत्योंमें घोर युद्ध छिड़ गया। हैत्योंने देवताओंकी

verses.sanskrit: असिजीवी मषीजीवी देवलो ग्रामयाजकः । धावको वा भवेत्तेषां दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: asijīvī maṣījīvī devalo grāmayājakaḥ / dhāvako vā bhavetteṣāṃ dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: Gods, fond of your excellent qualities, wish to see you, a truthful monarch engaged in the path of good and the welfare of all living beings.
verses.hindi: सेनापर बाणोंकी झड़ी लगा दी। इसी प्रकार

verses.sanskrit: पाककर्तुः परस्यार्थे कवये गदहारिणे । अभक्ष्य भक्षकस्यापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: pākakartuḥ parasyārthe kavaye gadahāriṇe / abhakṣya bhakṣakasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: O king, good qualities, saintly people and deities abide there where fame, morality or righteousness and affluence reside.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर हैत्यगण भी देवताओंपर नाना प्रकारके अस्त्र-शस्त्रोंद्वारा घातक प्रहार करने लगे। पत्थर,

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रान्नभोजिनश्चैव शूद्राणां शवदाहिनः । पैंश्वलान्नभुजश्चापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: śūdrānnabhojinaścaiva śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhinaḥ / paiṃśvalānnabhujaścāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: O highly blessed king, your conduct of life is splendid and exemplary. Your qualities such as striving for the welfare of all living beings, etc. are difficult to be found even in people like me'*.
verses.hindi: भिन्दिपाल, खड्ग, परशु, तोमर, परिघ, श्षुरिका,

verses.sanskrit: नामविक्रयिणो विष्णोः संध्याकर्ंमोर्ज्झितस्य च । दुष्प्रतिग्रहदग्धस्य दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: nāmavikrayiṇo viṣṇoḥ saṃdhyākarṃmorjjhitasya ca / duṣpratigrahadagdhasya dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: When god Dharmaraja said this, Bhagratha bowed down to him. Delighted yet overcome with a sense of modesty, he submitted to him in soft refined words.
verses.hindi: मुक्के, शूल, नालीक, नाराच, दूरसे फेंकनेयोग्य अन्यान्य अस्त्र तथा मुद्रसे वे देवताओंको मारने लगे। रथ, अश्च,, गज और पैदल सेनाओंसे खचाखच भरा हुआ वह युद्ध निरन्तर बढ़ने

verses.sanskrit: दिवाशयनशीलस्य तथा मैथुनकारिणः । सध्याभोजिन एवापिदत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: divāśayanaśīlasya tathā maithunakāriṇaḥ / sadhyābhojina evāpidattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: "O Lord, the knower of all Dharmas (righteous duties), you are an impartial witness to everything. Filled with divine grace for me, be pleased to explain what I ask of you.
verses.hindi: लगा। देवताओंने भी हैत्योंपर अनेक प्रकारके अस्त्र चलाये। इस प्रकार एक हजार वर्षोतक वह युद्ध चलता रहा। अन्तमें हैत्योंका बल बढ़ जानेके कारण देवता परास्त हो गये और सब-

verses.sanskrit: महापातकयुक्तस्य त्यक्तस्य ज्ञातिबान्धवैः । कुण्डस्य चापि गोलस्य दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: mahāpātakayuktasya tyaktasya jñātibāndhavaiḥ / kuṇḍasya cāpi golasya dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: How many types of dharmas (sacred duties) are there? What regions are reserved for persons who are righteous habi¬ tually? How many kinds of tortures are there and to whom are they meted out?
verses.hindi: के-सब भयभीत हो स्वर्गलोक छोड़कर भाग गये। वे मनुष्योंके रूपमें छिपकर पृथ्वीपर विचरने लगे। विरोचनकुमार बलि भगवान् नारायणकी

verses.sanskrit: परिवत्तेः शठस्यापि परिवत्तुः प्रमादिनः । स्त्रीजितस्यातिदुष्टस्य दत्तं भवित निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: parivatteḥ śaṭhasyāpi parivattuḥ pramādinaḥ / strījitasyātiduṣṭasya dattaṃ bhavita niṣphalam
verses.translation: Who are the persons to be honoured by you and who are to be chastised? O highly blessed one, it behoves you to mention all this in details.'*
verses.hindi: महान् बलसे सम्पन्न हो त्रिभुवनका राज्य भोगने लगे। उन्होंने भगवान् विष्णुकी प्रीतिके लिये तत्पर होकर अनेक अश्वमेध यज्ञ किये। बलि स्वर्गमें रहकर इन्द्र और दिक्पाल-- दोनों पदोंका--

verses.sanskrit: मद्यमांसाशिनश्चापि स्त्रीविटस्यातिलोभिनः । चौरस्य पिशुनस्यापि दत्तं भवति निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: madyamāṃsāśinaścāpi strīviṭasyātilobhinaḥ / caurasya piśunasyāpi dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
verses.translation: "Well done, O highly intelligent one, very well done. Your intellect is unblemished and powerful. I shall explain to you factually in detaUs what are the righteous acts and what are the evil ones. Listen to it with faith and devotion.
verses.hindi: उपभोग करते थे। देवमाता अदिति अपने पुत्रोंकी यह दशा देखकर बहुत दुःखी हुईं। उन्होंने यह सोचकर कि अब मेरा यहाँ रहना व्यर्थ है, हिमालयको प्रस्थान किया। वहाँ इन्द्रका ऐश्वर्य

verses.sanskrit: ये केचित्पापनिरता निन्दिताः सुजनैः सदा । न तेभ्यः प्रतिगृह्णीयान्न च वद्याद्दिजोत्तम । सत्कर्मनिरतायापि देयं यत्नेन नारद
verses.transliteration: ye kecitpāpaniratā ninditāḥ sujanaiḥ sadā / na tebhyaḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna ca vadyāddijottama / satkarmaniratāyāpi deyaṃ yatnena nārada
verses.translation: Dharmas (righteous duties) have been proclaimed as being of various kinds. They are the bestowers of meritorious worlds. The tortures too are declared to be numerous and are very terrible to be viewed.
verses.hindi: हैत्योंकी पराजय चाहती हुई वे भगवान्  ४

verses.sanskrit: यद्दानं श्रद्धया दत्तं तथा विष्णुसमर्पणम् । याचितं वापि पात्रेण भवेत्तद्दानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yaddānaṃ śraddhayā dattaṃ tathā viṣṇusamarpaṇam / yācitaṃ vāpi pātreṇa bhavettaddānamuttamam
verses.translation: The gift of the means of livelihood to Brahmanas is glorified as highly meritorious. Similarly, what is given unto a knower of spiritual lore is of ever-lasting benefit.
verses.hindi: विष्णुके ध्यानमें तत्पर हो अत्यन्त कठोर तपस्या करने लगीं। कुछ कालतक वे निरन्तर बैठी ही रहीं । उसके बाद दीर्घकालतक दोनों पैरोंसे खड़ी रहीं। तदनन्तर बहुत समयतक एक पैरसे और

verses.sanskrit: परलोकं समुद्दश्य ह्यैहिकं वापि नारद । यद्दानं दीयते पात्रे तत्काम्यं मध्यमं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: paralokaṃ samuddaśya hyaihikaṃ vāpi nārada / yaddānaṃ dīyate pātre tatkāmyaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Listen to the meritorious benefits attained by one who bestows means of livelihood upon a scholar of scriptural texts who is burdened with a large family or upon a Vedic scholar blessed with all good qualities and stabilises him.
verses.hindi: फिर उस एक पैरकी अँगुलियोंक ही बलपर खड़ी रहीं। कुछ कालतक तो वे फलाहार करती रहीं, फिर सूखे पत्ते खाकर रहने लगीं। उसके

verses.sanskrit: दग्भेन चापि हिंसार्थं परस्याविधिनापि च । क्रुद्धेनाश्रद्धयापात्रे तद्दानं मध्यमं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: dagbhena cāpi hiṃsārthaṃ parasyāvidhināpi ca / kruddhenāśraddhayāpātre taddānaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: The twice-bom donor accompanied by ten million members of his family on his mother's side and on his father's side, will enter Vinu's abode and rejoice there for a period of a Kalpa.
verses.hindi: बाद बहुत दिनोंतक जल पीकर रहीं, फिर वायुके आहारपर रहने लगीं और अन्तमें उन्होंने सर्वथा आहार त्याग दिया। नारदजी! अदिति अपने अन्त:करणद्वारा सच्चिदानन्दघन परमात्माका

verses.sanskrit: अधमं बलितोषायमध्यमं स्वार्थसिद्धये । उत्तमं हरिप्रीत्यर्थं प्राहुर्वेदविदां वराः
verses.transliteration: adhamaṃ balitoṣāyamadhyamaṃ svārthasiddhaye / uttamaṃ hariprītyarthaṃ prāhurvedavidāṃ varāḥ
verses.translation: Particles of dust on the earth can be counted. Drops of rain can be enumerated. But the benefits of providing Brah- manas with means of livelihood cannot be estimated even by the Creator (god Brahma).
verses.hindi: ध्यान करती हुई एक हजार दिव्य वर्षोतक तपस्यामें लगी रहों।

verses.sanskrit: दानभोगविनाशाश्च रायः स्युर्गतयस्त्रिधा
verses.transliteration: dānabhogavināśāśca rāyaḥ syurgatayastridhā
verses.translation: He too who induces another to provide Brahmanas with means of livelihood saying 'Give', attains the same merit as that of the donor. What need is there to expatiate on it?
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर हैत्योंने अदितिको ध्यानसे विचलित करनेके लिये अपनी दाढ़ोंके अग्रभागसे अग्नि प्रकट की, जिसने उस वनको क्षणभरमें जला दिया। उसका विस्तार सौ योजन था और वह

verses.sanskrit: यो ददाति च नोभुक्ते तद्धनं नाशकारणम् । धनं धर्मफलं विप्र धर्मो माधवतुष्टिकृत्
verses.transliteration: yo dadāti ca nobhukte taddhanaṃ nāśakāraṇam / dhanaṃ dharmaphalaṃ vipra dharmo mādhavatuṣṭikṛt
verses.translation: If a person constructs a lake or causes it to be dug through others, it is not possible to enumerate the merits of that person even with a span of life extending to a period of hundred years.
verses.hindi: नाना प्रकारके जीव-जन्तुओंसे भरा हुआ था। जो हैत्य अदितिका अपमान करनेके लिये गये थे, वे सब उसी अग्रिसे जलकर भस्म हो गये। केवल देवमाता अदिति ही जीवित बची थीं,

verses.sanskrit: तरवः किं न जीवन्ति ते ऽपि लोके परार्थकाः । यत्र मूलफलैर्वृक्षाः परकार्यं प्रकुर्वते
verses.transliteration: taravaḥ kiṃ na jīvanti te 'pi loke parārthakāḥ / yatra mūlaphalairvṛkṣāḥ parakāryaṃ prakurvate
verses.translation: Even if a single wayfarer drinks the water of that lake, there is no doubt that all the sins of tlie digger of that lake are wiped out.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि हैत्योंका विनाश और स्वजनोंपर अनुकम्पा

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्या यदि विप्राग्थ्र न परार्थास्तदा मृताः । परकार्यं न ये मर्त्याः कायेनापि धनेन वा
verses.transliteration: manuṣyā yadi viprāgthra na parārthāstadā mṛtāḥ / parakāryaṃ na ye martyāḥ kāyenāpi dhanena vā
verses.translation: A person who associates himself with the work of digging a lake, according to his capacity, attains the fruit of the same (i.e. digging it himself), so also does the person who is glad at it or who persuades persons to do it.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले भगवान् विष्णुके सुदर्शन चक्रने उनकी

verses.sanskrit: मनसा वचसा वापि ते ज्ञेयाः पापकृत्तमाः । अत्रेतिहासं वक्ष्यामि शृणु नारद तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: manasā vacasā vāpi te jñeyāḥ pāpakṛttamāḥ / atretihāsaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tattvataḥ
verses.translation: If a man throws out of the tank mud of the size of a white mustard, he stays in the heaven for a hundred years, liberated from millions of sins..
verses.hindi: अदितिको भगवदहर्शन और वरफप्राप्ति, वामनजीका अवतार, बलि-वामन-संवाद, भगवानूका तीन पैरसे समस्त ब्रह्माण्डको लेकर बलिको रसातल भेजना

verses.sanskrit: यत्र दानादिकानां तु लक्षणं परिकीर्तितम् । गङ्गामाहात्म्यसहितं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: yatra dānādikānāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam / gaṅgāmāhātmyasahitaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: O excellent king, the eternal lruti states that if the deities or preceptors are pleased with any one, he shall derive the merit of digging lakes.
verses.hindi: नारदजीने पूछा--भाईजी! आपने यह बड़ी अद्भुत बात बतायी है। मैं जानना चाहता हूँ कि उस अग्रिने अदितिको छोड़कर उन हैत्योंको ही क्षणभरमें कैसे जला दिया। आप अदितिके महान्

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथस्य धर्मस्य संवादं पुण्यकारणम् । आसीद्भगीरथो राजा सगरान्वयसंभवः
verses.transliteration: bhagīrathasya dharmasya saṃvādaṃ puṇyakāraṇam / āsīdbhagīratho rājā sagarānvayasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: In this connection, O excellent king, I shall narrate to you a mythological anecdote on listening to which, one is undoubtedly liberated from all sins.
verses.hindi: सत्त्वका वर्णन कीजिये, जो विशेष आश्चर्यका कारण है; क्योंकि मुनीश्वर साधु पुरुष सदा दूसरोंको उपदेश देनेमें तत्पर रहते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: शशास पृथिवीं मेतां सत्पद्वीपां ससागराम् । सर्वधर्मरतो नित्यं सत्यसंधः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ metāṃ satpadvīpāṃ sasāgarām / sarvadharmarato nityaṃ satyasaṃdhaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: The great ministers of that king thought and pondered over what should be or should not be done. They always came to a decision in matters of Dharmas through Dharmaidstras.
verses.hindi: सनकजीने कहा--नारदजी! जिनका मन भगवान्के भजनमें लगा हुआ है, ऐसे संतोंकी महिमा सुनिये। भगवान्के चिन्तनमें लगे हुए साधु पुरुषोंको बाधा देनेमें कौन समर्थ हो सकता

verses.sanskrit: कन्दर्पसद्दशो रुपे यायजृको विचक्षणः । प्रालेयाद्रिसमो धैर्ये धर्मे धर्मसमो नृपः
verses.transliteration: kandarpasaddaśo rupe yāyajṛko vicakṣaṇaḥ / prāleyādrisamo dhairye dharme dharmasamo nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: If a person, without consulting the dstric texts, gives a decision in matters of expiation (of sins), medical diagnosis, or astrological topics, he is called a Brahmana-slayer in Smrtis.
verses.hindi: है ? जहाँ भगवान्का भक्त रहता है, वहाँ ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, शिव, देवता, सिद्ध, मुनीध्वर और साधु- संत नित्य निवास करते हैं। महाभाग ! शान्तचित्तवाले हरिनामपरायण भक्तोंके भी हृदयमें भगवान् विष्णु

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः । सर्वसंपत्समायुक्तः सर्वानन्दकरो मुने
verses.transliteration: sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ / sarvasaṃpatsamāyuktaḥ sarvānandakaro mune
verses.translation: Coming to this conclusion in his mind, the king always used to listen to the holy Dharmas as proclaimed by Manu and other.S'mrh-writers, in accordance with injunctions.
verses.hindi: सदा विराजते हैं, फिर जो निरन्तर उन्हींके ध्यानमें लगे हुए हैं, उनके विषयमें तो कहना ही क्या है? भगवान् शिवकी पूजामें लगा हुआ अथवा भगवान् विष्णुकी आराधनामें तत्पर हुआ

verses.sanskrit: आतिथ्यप्रयतो नित्यं वासुदेवार्चनेरतः । पराक्रमी गुणनिधिर्मैत्रः कारुणिकः सधीः
verses.transliteration: ātithyaprayato nityaṃ vāsudevārcanerataḥ / parākramī guṇanidhirmaitraḥ kāruṇikaḥ sadhīḥ
verses.translation: While the king was ruling that country according to Dharma (l§astric rules of government), there was no person prone to injustice or mean in his kingdom. That realm of the king became equal to the celestial world, as it was being adminis¬ tered through Dharma. It was auspiciously blessed with good king.
verses.hindi: भक्त पुरुष जहाँ रहता है, वहीं लक्ष्मी तथा सम्पूर्ण देवता निवास करते हैं। जहाँ भगवान् विष्णुकी उपासनामें संलग्न भक्त पुरुष वास करता है, वहाँ अग्नि बाधा नहीं पहुँचा सकती। राजा,

verses.sanskrit: एतादृशं तं राजानं ज्ञात्वा दृष्टो भगीरथम् । धर्मराजो द्विजश्रेष्ठ कदाचिद्द्रष्टुमागतः
verses.transliteration: etādṛśaṃ taṃ rājānaṃ jñātvā dṛṣṭo bhagīratham / dharmarājo dvijaśreṣṭha kadāciddraṣṭumāgataḥ
verses.translation: "By whom and wherefor has this lake been built on an elevated piece of land? How can there be water here so that he, the king and his associates may survive?"
verses.hindi: चोर अथवा रोग-व्याधि भी कष्ट नहीं दे सकते हैं। प्रेत, पिशाच, कृष्माण्ड, ग्रह, बालग्रह, डाकिनी तथा राक्षस--ये भगवान् विष्णुकी आराधना करनेवाले पुरुषको पीड़ा नहीं दे सकते। जितेन्द्रिय,

verses.sanskrit: समागतं धर्मराजमर्हयामास भूपतिः । शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना धर्मः प्री उवाच तम्
verses.transliteration: samāgataṃ dharmarājamarhayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ / śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā dharmaḥ prī uvāca tam
verses.translation: O excellent king, then it occurred to him to dig it further. By digging a pit to the depth of a cubit (about 18 inches), he found water.
verses.hindi: सबका हितकारी तथा धर्म-कर्मका पालन करनेवाला पुरुष जहाँ रहता है, वहीं सम्पूर्ण तीर्थ और देवता वास करते हैं। जहाँ एक या आधे पल भी योगी महात्मा पुरुष ठहरते हैं, वहीं सब श्रेय हैं, वहीं

verses.sanskrit: धर्मराज उवाच राजन्धर्मविदां श्रेष्ठप्रसिद्धो ऽसि जगत्त्रये । धर्मराजो ऽथ कीर्तिं ते श्रुत्वा त्वां द्रष्टुमागतः
verses.transliteration: dharmarāja uvāca rājandharmavidāṃ śreṣṭhaprasiddho 'si jagattraye / dharmarājo 'tha kīrtiṃ te śrutvā tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ
verses.translation: By drinking that water the thirst of the king and that of the minister Buddhisagara was quenched.
verses.hindi: तीर्थ है, वही तपोवन है। जिनके नामकीरत॑नसे,

verses.sanskrit: सन्मार्गनिरतं सत्यं सर्वभूतहिते रतम् । द्रष्टुमिच्छन्ति विबुधारतवो त्कुष्टगुणप्रियाः
verses.transliteration: sanmārganirataṃ satyaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratam / draṣṭumicchanti vibudhāratavo tkuṣṭaguṇapriyāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the minister, the excellent king was highly delighted and the king himself undertook to construct it.
