verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे प्रायश्चित्तविधिर्नाम घत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः नारद उवाच कथितो भवता सम्यग्वर्णाश्रमविधिर्मुने । इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि यममार्गं सुदुर्गमम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde prāyaścittavidhirnāma ghatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca kathito bhavatā samyagvarṇāśramavidhirmune / idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yamamārgaṃ sudurgamam
verses.translation: O sage, the rules governing the discipline and conduct of life of the different castes and stages of life have been duly narrated by you. Now I wish to hear the extremely impassable path of Yama.
verses.hindi: प्राणायाम, इनमें दूसरा श्रेष्ठ है। जप और ध्यानके बिना जो प्राणायाम किया जाता है, वह अगर्भ है और जप तथा ध्यानके सहित किये जानेवाले

verses.sanskrit: सनक उवाच शृणु विप्र प्रवक्ष्यामि यममार्गं सुदुर्गमम् । सुखदं पुण्यशीलानां पापिनां भयदायकम्
verses.transliteration: sanaka uvāca śṛṇu vipra pravakṣyāmi yamamārgaṃ sudurgamam / sukhadaṃ puṇyaśīlānāṃ pāpināṃ bhayadāyakam
verses.translation: Listen O Brahma, I shall recount to you the impassable path of Yama that bestows happiness to men of meritorious deeds and that is awe-inspiring unto the sinners.
verses.hindi: प्राणायामको सगर्भ कहते हैं। मनीषी पुरुषोंने इस दो भेदोंवाले प्राणायामको रेचक, पूरक, कुम्भक और शून्यकके भेदसे चार प्रकारका बताया है। जीवोंकी दाहिनी नाड़ीका नाम पिड़ला है।

verses.sanskrit: षडशीतिसहस्राणि योजनार्निनि मुनीश्वर । यममार्गस्य विस्तारः कथैतः पूर्वसूरिभिः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanārnini munīśvara / yamamārgasya vistāraḥ kathaitaḥ pūrvasūribhiḥ
verses.translation: It has been mentioned by the earlier sages (i.e. phUo- sophers) that the extent of the path of Yama is, O leading sage, eightysix thousand Tojanas.
verses.hindi: उसके देवता सूर्य हैं। उसे पितृयोनि भी कहते हैं। इसी प्रकार बायीं नाड़ीका नाम इडा है, जिसे देवयोनि भी कहते हैं। मुनिश्रेष्ठ! चन्द्रमाको उसका अधिदेवता समझो । इन दोनोंके मध्यभागमें

verses.sanskrit: ये नरा दानशीलास्तु ते यान्ति सुखिनो द्विज । धर्मशून्या नरा यान्ति दुःखेन भृशमर्दिताः
verses.transliteration: ye narā dānaśīlāstu te yānti sukhino dvija / dharmaśūnyā narā yānti duḥkhena bhṛśamarditāḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmam, men who habitually give charitable gifts go through it with great pleasure and happiness. Men devoid of righteous activities go through it miserably as they are pounded and thrashed roundly on the way.
verses.hindi: सुषुम्ना नाड़ी है। यह अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म और परम गुहा है। ब्रह्माजीको इसका अधिदेवता जानना चाहिए। नासिकाके बायें छिद्रसे वायुको बाहर निकाले। रेचन करने (निकालने)-के कारण

verses.sanskrit: अतिभीता विवश्त्राश्च शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुकाः । क्रदन्तो विस्तरं दीनाः पापिनो यान्ति तत्पथि
verses.transliteration: atibhītā vivaśtrāśca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ / kradanto vistaraṃ dīnāḥ pāpino yānti tatpathi
verses.translation: Extremely terriiied, devoid of garments and with their throats, lips and palates parched up, the sinners traverse that way crying bitterly and pitiably.
verses.hindi: इसका नाम 'रेचक' है, फिर नासिकाके दाहिने छिद्गरसे वायुकी अपने भीतर भरे। वायुको पूर्ण करने (भरने)-के कारण इसे “पूरक” कहा गया है। अपने देहमें भरी हुई वायुको रोके रहे, छोड़े

verses.sanskrit: हन्यमाना यमभटैः प्रतोदाद्यैस्तथायुधैः
verses.transliteration: hanyamānā yamabhaṭaiḥ pratodādyaistathāyudhaiḥ
verses.translation: Yama's soldiers strike them with whips, goads and other weapons.
verses.hindi: नहीं और भरे हुए कुम्भ (घड़े)-की भाँति स्थिरभावसे बैठा रहे। कुम्भकी भाँति स्थित होनेके कारण इस प्राणायामका नाम “कुम्भक' है। बाहरकी वायुको न तो भीतरकी ओर ग्रहण

verses.sanskrit: इतस्ततः प्रधावन्तो यान्ति दुःखेन तत्पथि । क्वचित्पङ्कः क्वचिदूह्निः क्वचित्सेतत्पसैकतम् । क्वचिद्वै दावरुपेणः तीक्ष्णधाराः शिलाः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: itastataḥ pradhāvanto yānti duḥkhena tatpathi / kvacitpaṅkaḥ kvacidūhniḥ kvacitsetatpasaikatam / kvacidvai dāvarupeṇaḥ tīkṣṇadhārāḥ śilāḥ kvacit
verses.translation: They run about here and there along that path with great pain and misery. In some places there is deep mud; in some places there is fire; in some places there is red-hot sand; at some places there is forest-fire; vdiile there are sharp-edged rocks elsewhere.
verses.hindi: करे और न भीतरकी वायुको बाहर निकाले। जैसे हो, वैसे ही स्थित रहे। इस तरहके प्राणायामको 'शून्यक” समझो। जैसे मतवाले गजराजको धीरे-धीरे वशमें किया जाता है, उसी

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित्कण्टकवृक्षाश्च दुःखारोहशिला नगाः । गाढान्धकाराशअच गुहाः कण्टकावरणं महत्
verses.transliteration: kvacitkaṇṭakavṛkṣāśca duḥkhārohaśilā nagāḥ / gāḍhāndhakārāśaaca guhāḥ kaṇṭakāvaraṇaṃ mahat
verses.translation: In some places there are thorny trees and rocky mountains very difficult to climb; there are many caves with pitch darkness, there are great coverii hedges of thorny bushes.
verses.hindi: प्रकार प्राणको धीरे-धीरे जीतना चाहिए। अन्यथा बड़े-बड़े भयद्डूर रोग हो जाते हैं। जो योगी क्रमश: वायुको जीतनेका अभ्यास करता है, वह निष्पाप हो जाता है और सब पापोंसे मुक्त होनेपर

verses.sanskrit: वप्राग्रारोहणं चैव कन्दरस्य प्रवेशनम् । शर्कराश्च तथा लोष्टाः सूचीतुल्याश्च कण्टकाः
verses.transliteration: vaprāgrārohaṇaṃ caiva kandarasya praveśanam / śarkarāśca tathā loṣṭāḥ sūcītulyāśca kaṇṭakāḥ
verses.translation: In many places, people have to climb to the top of steep bunds and mounds and enter long caves. The path is strewn wifh gravels, pebbles and clods, as well as thorns pointed like needles.
verses.hindi: वह ब्रह्मलोकको प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sanskrit: शैवालं च क्वचिन्मार्गे क्वचित्कीचकपङ्क्तयः । क्वचिव्द्याव्राश्च गर्जन्ते वर्धन्ते च क्वचिज्ज्वराः
verses.transliteration: śaivālaṃ ca kvacinmārge kvacitkīcakapaṅktayaḥ / kvacivdyāvrāśca garjante vardhante ca kvacijjvarāḥ
verses.translation: Some places on the way are made slippery with mosses; in some places there are rows of bamboos; tigers roar in some places; in some places paroxysms of fever (overwhelm the people).
verses.hindi: 'मुनीश्वर! जो विषयोंमें फँसी हुई इन्द्रियोंको

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुविधक्लेशाः पापिनो यान्ति नारद । क्रोशन्तश्च रुदन्तश्च म्लायन्तश्चैव पापिनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhakleśāḥ pāpino yānti nārada / krośantaśca rudantaśca mlāyantaścaiva pāpinaḥ
verses.translation: O Narada, the sinners undergo much distress and move ahead slowly. Crying loudly and weeping they fade and languish.
verses.hindi: है, उसके इस प्रयत्रका नाम 'प्रत्याहार' है। ब्रह्मन्! जिन्होंने प्रत्याहारद्वारा अपनी इन्द्रियोंको जीत लिया है, वे महात्मा पुरुष ध्यान न करनेपर भी

verses.sanskrit: पाशेन यन्त्रिताः केचित्कृष्यमाणास्तथाङ्कुशैः । शास्त्रास्त्रैस्ताड्यमानाश्च पृष्टतो यान्ति पापिनः
verses.transliteration: pāśena yantritāḥ kecitkṛṣyamāṇāstathāṅkuśaiḥ / śāstrāstraistāḍyamānāśca pṛṣṭato yānti pāpinaḥ
verses.translation: Some of the sinners are bound with nooses; some are dragged with goads and hooks; some are beaten and hit with diverse weapons on their backs—in this way the sinners wend their way.
verses.hindi: पुनरावृत्तिरहित परब्रह्म पदको प्राप्त कर लेते हैं। जो इन्द्रियसमुदायको वशमें किये बिना ही ध्यानमें तत्पर होता है, उसे मूर्ख समझो; क्योंकि उसका ध्यान सिद्ध नहीं होता। मनुष्य जिस-जिस वस्तुको

verses.sanskrit: नासाग्रपाशकृष्टाश्च केचिदन्त्रैश्च बधिताः । वहॄन्तश्चायसां भारं शिश्राग्रेण प्रयान्ति वै
verses.transliteration: nāsāgrapāśakṛṣṭāśca kecidantraiśca badhitāḥ / vahṝntaścāyasāṃ bhāraṃ śiśrāgreṇa prayānti vai
verses.translation: Some are dragged with nooses at the tip of their noses, some are bound with entrails. Some go ahead bearing weighty iron mass with the tip of their penis.
verses.hindi: देखता है, उसे अपने आत्मामें आत्मस्वरूप समझे और प्रत्याहारद्वारा वशमें की हुई इन्द्रियोंको अपने आत्मामें ही अन्तर्मुख करके धारण करे। इस प्रकार इन्द्रियोंको जो आत्मामें धारण करना है,

verses.sanskrit: अयोभारद्वयं केचिन्नासाग्रेण तथापरे । कर्णाभ्यां च तथा केचिद्वहॄन्तो यान्ति पापिनः
verses.transliteration: ayobhāradvayaṃ kecinnāsāgreṇa tathāpare / karṇābhyāṃ ca tathā kecidvahṝnto yānti pāpinaḥ
verses.translation: Some sinners bear two weighty iron balls by means of the tips of their noses; some sinners bear the same with their ears and go ahead.
verses.hindi: उसीको “धारणा” कहते हैं। योग (प्रत्याहार)-से इन्द्रियोंके समुदायको जीतकर धारणाद्वारा उन इन्द्रियॉंको दृढ़तापूर्वक हृदयमें धारण कर लेनेके पश्चात् साधक उन परमात्माका ध्यान करे, जो सबका धारण-

verses.sanskrit: केचिच्च स्खलिता यान्ति ताड्यमानास्तथापरे । अत्यर्थोच्ङ्वसिताः केचित्केचिदाच्छत्रलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: kecicca skhalitā yānti tāḍyamānāstathāpare / atyarthocṅvasitāḥ kecitkecidācchatralocanāḥ
verses.translation: Some falter at every step and plod on. Others, on being struck, slip down. Some leave deep sighs and some keep their eyes closed.
verses.hindi: पोषण करनेवाले हैं और जो कभी अपनी महिमासे च्युत नहीं होते। सम्पूर्ण विश्व उन्हींका स्वरूप है। वे सर्वत्र व्यापक होनेसे विष्णु कहलाते हैं। समस्त लोकोंके एकमात्र कारण वे ही हैं। उनके नेत्र

verses.sanskrit: छायाजलविहीने तु पथि यान्त्यतिदुःखिताः । शोचन्तः स्वानि कर्मणि ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतानि च
verses.transliteration: chāyājalavihīne tu pathi yāntyatiduḥkhitāḥ / śocantaḥ svāni karmaṇi jñānājñānakṛtāni ca
verses.translation: Along the path that contains no shady place to rest nor water to drink, they miserably plod on lamenting their sins committed knowingly or unknowingly.*
verses.hindi: विकसित कमलदलके समान सुशोभित हैं। मनोहर कुण्डल उनके कानोंकी शोभा बढ़ाते हैं। उनकी भुजाएँ विशाल हैं। अज्भग-अड्भसे उदारता सूचित होती है। सब प्रकारके आभूषण उनके सुन्दर

verses.sanskrit: ये तु नारद धर्मिष्ठा दानशीला सुबुद्धयः । अतीव सुखसंपन्नास्ते यान्ति धर्ममन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: ye tu nārada dharmiṣṭhā dānaśīlā subuddhayaḥ / atīva sukhasaṃpannāste yānti dharmamandiram
verses.translation: O Nada, those who are pious and righteous, those who are habitual givers of gifts, those who are of good intention, go to the palace of Dharma (god of death) with great pleasure and happiness.
verses.hindi: विग्रहकी शोभा बढ़ाते हैं। उन्होंने पीताम्बर धारण कर रखा है। वे दिव्यशक्तिसे सम्पन्न हैं। उन्होंने स्वर्णमय यज्ञोपवीत धारण किया है। गलेमें तुलसीकी माला पहन रखी है। कौस्तुभभमणिसे उनकी शोभा

verses.sanskrit: अन्नदास्तु मुनुश्रेष्ठ भुञ्जन्तः स्वादु यान्ति वै । नीरदा यान्ति सुखिनः पिबन्तः क्षीरमुत्तममम् । तक्रदा दधिदाश्चैव तत्तद्भोगं लभन्ति वै । घृतदा मधुदाश्चैव क्षीरदाश्च द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: annadāstu munuśreṣṭha bhuñjantaḥ svādu yānti vai / nīradā yānti sukhinaḥ pibantaḥ kṣīramuttamamam / takradā dadhidāścaiva tattadbhogaṃ labhanti vai / ghṛtadā madhudāścaiva kṣīradāśca dvijottama
verses.translation: O leading sage, the giver of robes and cloth goes clad in divine garments. He who has given a mine previously goes along the path eulogised by the immortal ones.
verses.hindi: और बढ़ गयी है। वक्ष:स्थलमें श्रीवत्सका चिह्न सुशोभित है। देवता और असुर सभी भगवान्के चरणोंमें मस्तक नवा रहे हैं। बारह अंगुल विस्तृत तथा आठ दलोंसे विभूषित अपने हृदयकमलके

verses.sanskrit: सुधापानं प्रकुर्वन्तो यान्ति वै धर्ममन्दिरम् । शाकदाः पायसं भुञ्जंन्दीपदो ज्वलयन्दिशः
verses.transliteration: sudhāpānaṃ prakurvanto yānti vai dharmamandiram / śākadāḥ pāyasaṃ bhuñjaṃndīpado jvalayandiśaḥ
verses.translation: The giver of fruits and flowers goes with great conten¬ tedness. The man who gives betel-leaves to chew goes to the abode of Dharma with great delight.
verses.hindi: परात्पर परमात्माका उपर्युक्तरूपसे ध्यान करना चाहिए। ध्येय वस्तुमें चित्तकी वृत्तिका एकाकार हो जाना ही साधु पुरुषोंद्वारा ' ध्यान' कहा गया है। दो घड़ी ध्यान करके भी मनुष्य परम मोक्षको

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्रदो मुनुशार्दूल याति दिव्याम्बरावृतः । पुराकरप्रदो याति स्तूयमानो ऽमरैः पथि
verses.transliteration: vastrado munuśārdūla yāti divyāmbarāvṛtaḥ / purākaraprado yāti stūyamāno 'maraiḥ pathi
verses.translation: The excellent man who had rendered service to his father and mother (while on the Earth), walks ahead with a delighted soul honoured and worshipped by the heaven- dwellers.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त कर लेता है। ध्यानसे पाप नष्ट होते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: गोदानेन नरो याति सर्वसौख्यसमन्वितः । भूमिदो गृहदश्चैव विमाने सर्वसंपदि
verses.transliteration: godānena naro yāti sarvasaukhyasamanvitaḥ / bhūmido gṛhadaścaiva vimāne sarvasaṃpadi
verses.translation: He who renders great service to ascetics who perform great holy rites, and to leading Brahmanas, goes (to Dharma's palace) with great pleasure.
verses.hindi: ध्यानसे मोक्ष मिलता है। ध्यानसे भगवान् विष्णु प्रसन्न होते हैं तथा ध्यानसे सम्पूर्ण मनोरथोंकी सिद्धि हो जाती है। भगवान् महाविष्णुके जो- जो स्वरूप हैं, उनमेंसे किसीका भी एकाग्रतापूर्वक

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णे क्रीडन्याति वृषालयम् । हयदो यानदश्चापि गजदश्च द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe krīḍanyāti vṛṣālayam / hayado yānadaścāpi gajadaśca dvijottama
verses.translation: A person engaged in the gift of learning goes ahead while he is being worshipped by lotus-bom deities. The regular reader of the Pur&ras goes ahead as he is being eulogised by leading sages. Thus, those who are engaged in righteousness go to the abode of Dharma with great pleasure.
verses.hindi: ध्यान करे। उस ध्यानसे संतुष्ट होकर भगवान् विष्णु निश्चय ही मोक्ष देते हैं। साधुशिरोमणे ! ध्येय वस्तुमें मनको इस प्रकार स्थिर कर देना चाहिए कि ध्याता, ध्यान और ध्येयकी त्रिपुटीका

verses.sanskrit: धर्मालयं विमानेन याति भोगान्वितेन वै । अनडुद्दो मुनिश्रेष्ठ यानारुढः प्रयाति वै
verses.transliteration: dharmālayaṃ vimānena yāti bhogānvitena vai / anaḍuddo muniśreṣṭha yānāruḍhaḥ prayāti vai
verses.translation: Men arc most excellent among the intellectual beings; among men the Brahmai are most excellent; the scholars are most excellent among the Brahmanas; really wise ones are most excellent among scholars.
verses.hindi: तनिक भी भान न रह जाय। तब ज्ञानरूपी अमृतके सेवनसे अमृतत्व (परमात्मा)-को प्राप्त होता है।

verses.sanskrit: फलदः पुष्पदश्चापि याति संतोषसंयुतः । तांबूलदो नरो याति प्रहृष्टोर् धममन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: phaladaḥ puṣpadaścāpi yāti saṃtoṣasaṃyutaḥ / tāṃbūlado naro yāti prahṛṣṭor dhamamandiram
verses.translation: Among the wise ones the performers of holy rites are most excellent, the expounders of the Brahmana (or the Veda) are most excellent among them. The person who has no feeling of myness is said to be most excellent among the expounders of Brahman.
verses.hindi: निरन्तर ध्यान करनेसे ध्येय वस्तुके साथ अपना अभेदभाव स्पष्ट अनुभव हो जाता है। जिसकी सब इन्द्रियाँ विषयोंसे निवृत्त हो जाती हैं और वह परमानन्दसे पूर्ण हो वायुशून्य स्थानमें

verses.sanskrit: मातापित्रोश्च शुश्रूषां कृतवान्यो नरोत्तमः । स याति परितुष्टात्मा पूज्यमानो दिविस्थितैः
verses.transliteration: mātāpitrośca śuśrūṣāṃ kṛtavānyo narottamaḥ / sa yāti parituṣṭātmā pūjyamāno divisthitaiḥ
verses.translation: Having summoned the sinners, he would threaten
verses.hindi: जलते हुए दीपककी भाँति अविचलभावसे ध्यानमें स्थित हो जाता है, तो उसकी इस ध्येयाकार स्थितिको 'समाधि' कहते हैं। नारदजी! योगी पुरुष समाधि-अवस्थामें न देखता है, न सुनता

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रूषां कुरुते यस्तु यतीनां व्रतचारिणाम् । द्विजग्र्यब्राह्मणानां च स यात्वतिसुखान्वितः
verses.transliteration: śuśrūṣāṃ kurute yastu yatīnāṃ vratacāriṇām / dvijagryabrāhmaṇānāṃ ca sa yātvatisukhānvitaḥ
verses.translation: He appears terrific due to his weapons glittering like lightning. He has thirtytwo arms and his girth is three Tojanas. His nose is long and his eyes are red.
verses.hindi: है, न सूँघता है, न स्पर्श करता है और न वह कुछ बोलता ही है। उस अवस्थामें योगियोंको सम्पूर्ण उपाधियोंसे मुक्त, शुद्ध, निर्मल, सच्चिदानन्दस्वरूप तथा अविचल आत्माका

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतदयायुक्तः पूज्यमानो ऽमरैर्द्विजः । सर्वभोगान्वितेनासौ विमानेन प्रयाति च
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtadayāyuktaḥ pūjyamāno 'marairdvijaḥ / sarvabhogānvitenāsau vimānena prayāti ca
verses.translation: All the emissaries roar. They too are as terrible as Yama. Thereafter, Citragpta addresses at the behest of Yama all sinners who quake with fear and who bewail their own sinful fate.
verses.hindi: साक्षात्कार होता है। विद्वान् नारदजी ! यह आत्मा परम ज्योतिर्ममय तथा अमेय है। जो मायाके अधीन हैं, उन्हींको वह मायायुक्त-सा प्रतीत होता है। उस मायाका निवारण होनेपर वह

verses.sanskrit: विद्यादानरतो याति पूज्यमानो ऽब्जसूनुभिः । पुराणपठको याति स्तूयमानो मुनीश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: vidyādānarato yāti pūjyamāno 'bjasūnubhiḥ / purāṇapaṭhako yāti stūyamāno munīśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: Why did you not consider before that Yama would mete out punishment? Yama is equal and impartial to the rich and the poor, the fool and the learned, the daring one and the dastard."
verses.hindi: निर्मल ब्रह्मरूपसे प्रकाशित होता है। वह ब्रह्म

verses.sanskrit: एवं धर्मपरा यान्ति सुखं धर्मस्य मन्दिरम् । यमश्चतुर्मुखो भूत्वा शङ्खचक्रगदासिभृत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dharmaparā yānti sukhaṃ dharmasya mandiram / yamaścaturmukho bhūtvā śaṅkhacakragadāsibhṛt
verses.translation: At the end of two Pardrdhas, the annihilation of the whole CSosmic egg (is going to take place as mentioned by you). O son of Brahma, it has been mentioned by you yourself that the enjoyment of the pleasures of the merits, thanks to the charitable gifts of villages, etc., isgpreat and lasts for thou¬ sands and crores of Kalpas.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके अन्तर्यामी आत्मारूपसे स्थित है। परमात्मा सूक्ष्मससे भी अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म और महान्से भी अत्यन्त महान् है। वह सनातन परमेश्वर समस्त विश्वका कारण है। ज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यकर्मरतं सम्यक्स्नेहान्मित्रमिवार्चति । भो भो बुद्धिमतां श्रेष्ठानरकक्लेषभीरवः
verses.transliteration: puṇyakarmarataṃ samyaksnehānmitramivārcati / bho bho buddhimatāṃ śreṣṭhānarakakleṣabhīravaḥ
verses.translation: He appears to be differentiated through the forms of Brahma, Visnu, liva, etc. The eternal lord appears to be differ¬ ently conditioned by these three different Gunas.
verses.hindi: पुरुष परम पवित्र परात्पर ब्रह्मरूपमें उसका दर्शन करते हैं। अकारसे लेकर हकारतकके भिन्न-भिन्न वर्णोंके रूपमें स्थित अनादि पुराणपुरुष परमात्माको ही शब्दब्रह्य कहा गया है और जो विशुद्ध,

verses.sanskrit: युष्माभिः साधितं पुण्यमत्रामुत्रसुखावहम् । मनुषथ्य जन्म यः प्राप्य सुकृतं न करोति च
verses.transliteration: yuṣmābhiḥ sādhitaṃ puṇyamatrāmutrasukhāvaham / manuṣathya janma yaḥ prāpya sukṛtaṃ na karoti ca
verses.translation: By employing the entire Maya-power, He per¬ forms the function of the universe. He cfeates (the imiverse) in the form of Brahma and protects it in the form of Viu. It is certain that in the end he swallows everything in the form of Rudra.
verses.hindi: अक्षर, नित्य, पूर्ण, हृदयाकाशके मध्य विराजमान अथवा आबकाशमें व्याप्त, आनन्दमय, निर्मल एवं शान्त तत्त्व है, उसीको 'परब्रह्म परमात्मा” कहते हैं, योगीलोग अपने हृदयमें जिन अजन्मा, शुद्ध,

verses.sanskrit: स एव पापिनां श्रेष्ठ आत्मघातं करोति च । अनित्यं प्राप्य मानुष्यं नित्यं यस्तु न साधयेत्
verses.transliteration: sa eva pāpināṃ śreṣṭha ātmaghātaṃ karoti ca / anityaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ nityaṃ yastu na sādhayet
verses.translation: The action performed, whether auspicious or inaus¬ picious must, of necessity, be enjoyed. He who is the lord of all worlds is the immanent soul of all and is identical with the universe. He is perfect and eternal and he enjoys through all the fruits of all actions.*
verses.hindi: विकाररहित, सनातन परमात्माका दर्शन करते हैं, उन्हींका नाम परब्रह्म है।

verses.sanskrit: स याति नरकं घोरं को ऽन्यस्तस्मादचेतनः । शरीरं यातनारुपं मलाद्यैः परिदूषितम्
verses.transliteration: sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ ko 'nyastasmādacetanaḥ / śarīraṃ yātanārupaṃ malādyaiḥ paridūṣitam
verses.translation: The God who pervades all universe and who is endowed with different Gunas, creates, protects and swallows up everything. The immutable Lord is the enjoyer of everything.
verses.hindi: मुनिश्रेष्ट! अब दूसरा ध्यान बतलाता हूँ, सुनो। परमात्माका यह ध्यान संसार-तापसे संतप्त मनुष्योंको अमृतकी वर्षके समान शान्ति प्रदान करनेवाला है। परमानन्दस्वरूप भगवान् नारायण

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्यो याति विश्वासं तं विद्यादात्मघातकम् । सर्वेषु प्राणिनः श्रेष्ठास्तेषु वै बुद्धिजीविनः
verses.transliteration: tasminyo yāti viśvāsaṃ taṃ vidyādātmaghātakam / sarveṣu prāṇinaḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣu vai buddhijīvinaḥ
verses.translation: This horrible description of the journey of the departed soul to the capital of Yama has little basis in the Vedk literature. The medieval authors of the Purdpas used this deterrence against immoral tendencies to maintain a certain standard of morality in the public and their success can be gauged from the fact that the illiterate Hindu masses are still under the Pur&tdc influence of Yama and his emissaries.
verses.hindi: प्रणवमें स्थित हैं--ऐसा चिन्तन करे। उनकी

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिमस्तु नराः श्रेष्ठा नरेषु ब्राह्मणास्तथा । ब्राह्मणेषु च विद्वांसो विद्वत्सु कृतबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: buddhimastu narāḥ śreṣṭhā nareṣu brāhmaṇāstathā / brāhmaṇeṣu ca vidvāṃso vidvatsu kṛtabuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: W 5-16 graphically depict the crude tortures of those times. But this Puranic author seems to be unaware that the departed soul has no physical body of gross elements as the two gross elements, viz. the earth and water are lefl behind and the body that goes ahead consists of fire, wind and ether and as such many of the tortures are not applicable to such a body.
verses.hindi: कहीं उपमा नहीं है। वे प्रणबकी अर्धमात्राके ऊपर विराजमान नादस्वरूप हैं। अकार ब्रह्माजीका रूप है, उकार भगवान् विष्णुका स्वरूप है,

verses.sanskrit: कृतबुद्धिषु कर्त्तारः कर्तृषु ब्रह्मवादिनः । ब्रह्मवादिष्वपि तथा श्रेष्ठो निर्मम उच्यते
verses.transliteration: kṛtabuddhiṣu karttāraḥ kartṛṣu brahmavādinaḥ / brahmavādiṣvapi tathā śreṣṭho nirmama ucyate
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: ध्यानात्पापानि नश्यन्ति ध्यानान्मोक्षं च विन्दति। ध्यानात्प्रसीदति हरिर्यानात्सरवार्थसाधनम्॥

verses.sanskrit: एतेभ्यो ऽपि परो ज्ञेयो नित्यं ध्यानपरायणः । तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कर्त्तव्यो धर्मसंग्रहः
verses.transliteration: etebhyo 'pi paro jñeyo nityaṃ dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ / tasmātsarvaprayatnena karttavyo dharmasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: मकार रुद्ररूप है तथा अर्धमात्रा निर्गुण परब्रह्म परमात्मस्वरूप है। अकार, उकार और मकार-- ये प्रणवकी तीन मात्राएँ कही गयी हैं। ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और शिव--ये तीन क्रमश: उनके देवता

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र पूज्यते जन्तुर्धर्मवान्नात्र संशयः । गच्छ स्वपुण्यैर्मत्स्थानं सर्वभोगसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvatra pūjyate janturdharmavānnātra saṃśayaḥ / gaccha svapuṇyairmatsthānaṃ sarvabhogasamanvitam
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: हैं। इन सबका समुच्चयरूप जो 3३»कार है, वह परब्रह्म परमात्माका बोध करानेवाला है। परब्रह्म परमात्मा वाच्य हैं और प्रणव उनका वाचक माना गया है। नारदजी! इन दोनोंमें वाच्य-वाचक-

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति चेद्दुष्कृतं किञ्चित्पश्चादत्रैव भोक्ष्यसे । एवं यमस्तमभ्यर्च्य प्रापयित्वा च सद्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: asti cedduṣkṛtaṃ kiñcitpaścādatraiva bhokṣyase / evaṃ yamastamabhyarcya prāpayitvā ca sadgatim
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: सम्बन्ध उपचारसे ही कहा गया है। जो प्रतिदिन प्रणवका जप करते हैं, वे सम्पूर्ण पातकोंसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं तथा जो निरन्तर उसीके अभ्यासमें लगे रहते हैं, वे परम मोक्ष पाते हैं। जो ब्रह्मा,

verses.sanskrit: आहूय पापिनश्चैव कालदण्डेन तर्जयेत् । प्रलयांबुदनिर्घोषो ह्यञ्जनाद्रिसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: āhūya pāpinaścaiva kāladaṇḍena tarjayet / pralayāṃbudanirghoṣo hyañjanādrisamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: विष्णु और शिवरूप प्रणव-मन्त्रका जप करता है, उसे अपने अन्तःकरणमें कोटि-कोटि सूय्योके समान निर्मल तेजका ध्यान करना चाहिए अथवा प्रणव-जपके समय शालग्रामशिला या किसी

verses.sanskrit: विद्युत्प्र भायुर्घोर्भीमो द्वात्रिंशद्भुजसंयुतः । योजनत्रयविस्तारो रक्ताक्षो दीर्घनासिकः
verses.transliteration: vidyutpra bhāyurghorbhīmo dvātriṃśadbhujasaṃyutaḥ / yojanatrayavistāro raktākṣo dīrghanāsikaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: भगवत्प्रतिमाके स्वरूपका ध्यान करना चाहिए। अथवा जो-जो पापनाशक तीर्थादिक वस्तु है, उसी-उसीका अपने हृदयमें चिन्तन करना चाहिए। मुनीश्वर! यह वैष्णवज्ञान तुम्हें बताया गया है।

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालवदनो वापीतुल्योग्रलोचनः । मृत्युज्वरादिभिर्युक्तश्चित्रगुत्पो ऽपि भीषणः
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālavadano vāpītulyogralocanaḥ / mṛtyujvarādibhiryuktaścitragutpo 'pi bhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: इसे जानकर योगीश्वर पुरुष उत्तम मोक्ष पा लेता है। जो एकाग्रचित्त होकर इस प्रसंगको पढ़ता अथवा सुनता है, वह सब पापोंसे मुक्त हो भगवान् विष्णुका सालोक्य प्राप्त कर लेता है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे दूताश्च गर्जन्ति यमतुल्यविभीषणाः । ततो ब्रवीति तान्सर्वान्कंपमानांश्च पापिनः
verses.transliteration: sarve dūtāśca garjanti yamatulyavibhīṣaṇāḥ / tato bravīti tānsarvānkaṃpamānāṃśca pāpinaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: भवबन्धनसे मुक्तिके लिये भगवान् विष्णुके भजनका उपदेश

verses.sanskrit: शोचन्तः स्वानि कर्माणि चित्रगुत्पो यमाज्ञया । भो भो पापा दुराचारा अहॄङ्कारप्रदूषिताः
verses.transliteration: śocantaḥ svāni karmāṇi citragutpo yamājñayā / bho bho pāpā durācārā ahṝṅkārapradūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: नारदजीने कहा--हे सर्वज्ञ महामुने! सबके स्वामी देवदेव भगवान् जनार्दन जिस प्रकार संतुष्ट होते हैं, वह उपाय मुझे बताइये।

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थमर्जितं पापं युष्माभिरविवेकिभिः । कामक्तोधादिदृष्टेन सगर्वेण तु चेतसा
verses.transliteration: kimarthamarjitaṃ pāpaṃ yuṣmābhiravivekibhiḥ / kāmaktodhādidṛṣṭena sagarveṇa tu cetasā
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: श्रीसनकजी बोले--नारदजी ! यदि मुक्ति चाहते हो तो सच्चिदानन्दस्वरूप परमदेव भगवान् नारायणका सम्पूर्ण चित्तसे भजन करो। भगवान् विष्णुकी शरण लेनेवाले मनुष्यको शत्रु मार नहीं सकते,

verses.sanskrit: यद्यत्पापतरं तत्तत्किमर्थं चरितं जनाः । कृतवन्तः पुरा पापान्यत्यन्तहर्षिताः
verses.transliteration: yadyatpāpataraṃ tattatkimarthaṃ caritaṃ janāḥ / kṛtavantaḥ purā pāpānyatyantaharṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: ग्रह पीड़ा नहीं दे सकते तथा राक्षस उसकी ओर आँख उठाकर देख नहीं सकते। भगवान् जनार्दनमें जिसकी दृढ़ भक्ति है, उसके सम्पूर्ण श्रेय सिद्ध हो जाते हैं। अत: भक्त पुरुष सबसे बढ़कर है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव यातना भोज्याः किं वृथा ह्यतिदुरिवताः । भृत्यमित्रकलत्रार्थं दुष्कृतं चरितं यथा
verses.transliteration: tathaiva yātanā bhojyāḥ kiṃ vṛthā hyatidurivatāḥ / bhṛtyamitrakalatrārthaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ caritaṃ yathā
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: मनुष्योंके उन्हीं पैरोंकोी सफल जानना चाहिए, जो भगवान् विष्णुके मन्दिरमें दर्शनके लिये जाते हैं। उन्हीं हाथोंको सफल समझना चाहिए, जो भगवान्

verses.sanskrit: तथा कर्मवशात्प्रात्पा यूयमत्रातिदुःखिताः । युष्माभिः पोषिता ये तु पुत्राद्या अन्यतोगताः
verses.transliteration: tathā karmavaśātprātpā yūyamatrātiduḥkhitāḥ / yuṣmābhiḥ poṣitā ye tu putrādyā anyatogatāḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: विष्णुकी पूजामें तत्पर होते हैं। पुरुषोंके उन्हीं  शास्त्रोंका सार बतलाता हँ--इस असार संसारमें नेत्रोंको पूर्ण: सफल जानना चाहिए, जो भगवान्  केवल श्रीहरिकी आराधना ही सत्य है। यह जनार्दनका दर्शन करते हैं। साधुपुरुषोंने उसी जिह्लाको  संसारबन्धन अत्यन्त दृढ़ है और महान् मोहमें सफल बताया है, जो निरन्तर हरिनामके जप  डालनेवाला है। भगवद्धक्तिरूपी कुठारसे इसको

verses.sanskrit: युष्माकमेव तत्पापं प्रात्पं किं दुःखकारणम् । यथा कृतानि पापानि युष्माभिः सुबहूनि वै
verses.transliteration: yuṣmākameva tatpāpaṃ prātpaṃ kiṃ duḥkhakāraṇam / yathā kṛtāni pāpāni yuṣmābhiḥ subahūni vai
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: और कीर्तनमें लगी रहती है। मैं सत्य कहता हूँ,  काटकर अत्यन्त सुखी हो जाओ। वही मन सार्थक हितकी बात कहता हूँ और बार-बार सम्पूर्ण  है, जो भगवान् विष्णुके चिन्तनमें लगता है, तथा

verses.sanskrit: तथा प्रात्पानि दुःखानि किमर्थमिह दुःखिताः । विचारयध्वं यूयं तु युष्माभिश्चारितं पुरा
verses.transliteration: tathā prātpāni duḥkhāni kimarthamiha duḥkhitāḥ / vicārayadhvaṃ yūyaṃ tu yuṣmābhiścāritaṃ purā
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: वे ही दोनों कान समस्त जगत्के लिये वन्दनीय हैं, जो भगवत्कथाकी सुधाधारासे परिपूर्ण रहते हैं। नारदजी ! जो आनन्दस्वरूप, अक्षर एवं जाग्रत् आदि तीनों अवस्थाओंसे रहित तथा हृदयमें

verses.sanskrit: यमः करिष्यते दण्डमिति किं न विचारितम् । दरिद्रे ऽपि च मूर्खे च पण्डिते वा श्रियान्विते
verses.transliteration: yamaḥ kariṣyate daṇḍamiti kiṃ na vicāritam / daridre 'pi ca mūrkhe ca paṇḍite vā śriyānvite
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: विराजमान हैं, उन्हीं भगवान्का तुम निरन्तर भजन करो। मुनिश्रेष्ठ। जिनका अन्तःकरण शुद्ध नहीं है--ऐसे लोग भगवान्के स्थान या स्वरूपका न तो वर्णन कर सकते हैं और न दर्शन ही।

verses.sanskrit: कान्दिशीके च वीरे च समवर्तीः यमः स्मृतः । चित्रगुत्पेरितं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ते पापिनस्तदा
verses.transliteration: kāndiśīke ca vīre ca samavartīḥ yamaḥ smṛtaḥ / citragutperitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā te pāpinastadā
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: विप्रवर! यह स्थावर-जंगमरूप जगत् केवल भावनामय है और बिजलीके समान चज्चल है। अत: इसकी ओरसे विरक्त होकर भगवान् जनार्दनका

verses.sanskrit: शौचन्तः स्वानि कर्मणि तूष्णीं तिष्टन्ति भीषिताः । यमाज्ञाकारिणः क्रूरश्चण्डा दूता भयानकाः
verses.transliteration: śaucantaḥ svāni karmaṇi tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭanti bhīṣitāḥ / yamājñākāriṇaḥ krūraścaṇḍā dūtā bhayānakāḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: जिनमें अहिंसा, सत्य, अस्तेय, ब्रह्मचर्य और अपरिग्रह विद्यमान हैं, उन्हींपर जगदीश्वर श्रीहरि संतुष्ट होते हैं। जो सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके प्रति दयाभाव रखता है और ब्राह्मणोंके आदर-सत्कारमें तत्पर

verses.sanskrit: चण्डलाद्याः प्रसह्यैतान्नरकेषु क्षिपन्ति च । स्वदुष्कर्मफलं ते तु भुक्त्वान्ते पापशेषतः
verses.transliteration: caṇḍalādyāḥ prasahyaitānnarakeṣu kṣipanti ca / svaduṣkarmaphalaṃ te tu bhuktvānte pāpaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: रहता है, उसपर जगदीश्वर भगवान् विष्णु प्रसन्न होते हैं। जो भगवान् और उनके भक्तोंकी कथामें प्रेम रखता है, स्वयं भगवान्की कथा कहता है, साधु-महात्माओंका संग करता है और मनमें

verses.sanskrit: महीतलं च संप्राप्य भवन्ति स्थआवरादयः । नारद उवाच भगवन्संशयो जातो मच्चेतसि दयानिधे
verses.transliteration: mahītalaṃ ca saṃprāpya bhavanti sthaāvarādayaḥ / nārada uvāca bhagavansaṃśayo jāto maccetasi dayānidhe
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: अहड्ढार नहीं लाता, उसपर भगवान् विष्णु प्रसन्न रहते हैं। जो भूख-प्यास और लड़खड़ाकर गिरने आदिके अवसरोंपर भी सदा भगवान् विष्णुके नामका उच्चारण करता है, उसपर भगवान् अधोक्षज

verses.sanskrit: त्वं समर्थो ऽसि तच्छेत्तुं यतो नो ह्यग्रजो भवान् । धर्माश्च विविधाः प्रोक्ताः पापान्यपि बहूनि च
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ samartho 'si tacchettuṃ yato no hyagrajo bhavān / dharmāśca vividhāḥ proktāḥ pāpānyapi bahūni ca
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: (विष्णु) प्रसन्न होते हैं। मुने! जो स्त्री पतिको प्राणके समान समझकर उनके आदर-सत्कारमें सदा लगी रहती है, उसपर प्रसन्न हो जगदीश्वर श्रीहरि उसे अपना परम धाम दे देते हैं। जो ईर्ष्या

verses.sanskrit: चिरभोज्यं फलं तेषामुक्तं बहुविदा त्वया । दिनान्ते ब्रह्मणः प्रोक्तो नाशो लोकत्रयस्य वै
verses.transliteration: cirabhojyaṃ phalaṃ teṣāmuktaṃ bahuvidā tvayā / dinānte brahmaṇaḥ prokto nāśo lokatrayasya vai
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: तथा दोषदृष्टिसे रहित होकर अहड्ढारसे दूर रहते हैं और सदा देवाराधन किया करते हैं, उनपर भगवान् केशव प्रसन्न होते हैं। अतः देवर्षे! सुनो, तुम सदा श्रीहरिका भजन करो। शरीर मृत्युसे

verses.sanskrit: परार्द्धद्वितयान्ते तु ब्रह्माण्डस्यापि संक्षयः । ग्रामदानादिपुण्यानां त्वयैव विधिनन्दन
verses.transliteration: parārddhadvitayānte tu brahmāṇḍasyāpi saṃkṣayaḥ / grāmadānādipuṇyānāṃ tvayaiva vidhinandana
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: जुड़ा हुआ है। जीवन अत्यन्त चञ्चल है। धनपर राजा आदिके द्वारा बराबर बाधा आती रहती है

verses.sanskrit: कल्पकोटिसहस्रेषु महान्भोग उदाहृतः । सर्वेषामेव लोकानां विनाशः प्राकृते लये
verses.transliteration: kalpakoṭisahasreṣu mahānbhoga udāhṛtaḥ / sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ vināśaḥ prākṛte laye
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: और सम्पत्तियाँ क्षणभरमें नष्ट हो जानेवाली हैं। देवर्षे! क्या तुम नहीं देखते कि आधी आयु तो नींदसे ही नष्ट हो जाती है और कुछ आयु भोजन आदिमें समाप्त हो जाती है। आयुका कुछ भाग

verses.sanskrit: एकः शिष्यत एवेति त्वया प्रोक्तं जनार्दनः । एष मे संशयो जातस्तं भवाञ्छेत्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: ekaḥ śiṣyata eveti tvayā proktaṃ janārdanaḥ / eṣa me saṃśayo jātastaṃ bhavāñchettumarhati
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: बचपनमें, कुछ विषय-भोगोंमें और कुछ बुढ़ापेमें व्यर्थ बीत जाता है। फिर तुम धर्मका आचरण कब करोगे? बचपन और बुढ़ापेमें भगवान्की आराधना नहीं हो सकती, अत: अहड्ढार छोड़कर

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यपापोपभोगानां समात्पिर्नास्य संप्लवे । सनक उवाच साधु साधौ महाप्राज्ञ गुह्याद्गुह्यतमं त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: puṇyapāpopabhogānāṃ samātpirnāsya saṃplave / sanaka uvāca sādhu sādhau mahāprājña guhyādguhyatamaṃ tvidam
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: युवावस्थामें ही धर्मोका अनुष्ठान करना चाहिए। मुने! यह शरीर मृत्युका निवासस्थान और आपत्तियोंका सबसे बड़ा अड्डा है। शरीर रोगोंका घर है। यह मल आदिसे सदा दूषित रहता है। फिर मनुष्य

verses.sanskrit: पृष्टं तत्ते ऽभिधास्यामि शृणुष्व सुसमाहितः । नारायणो ऽक्षरो ऽनन्तः परं ज्योतिः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭaṃ tatte 'bhidhāsyāmi śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ / nārāyaṇo 'kṣaro 'nantaḥ paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: इसे सदा रहनेवाला समझकर व्यर्थ पाप क्‍यों करते हैं। यह संसार असार है। इसमें नाना प्रकारके दुःख भरे हुए हैं। निश्चय ही यह मृत्युसे व्याप्त है, अत: इसपर विश्वास नहीं करना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: विशुद्धो निर्गुणो नित्यो मायामोहविवर्जितः । निर्गुणो ऽपि परानन्दो गुणवानिव भाति यः
verses.transliteration: viśuddho nirguṇo nityo māyāmohavivarjitaḥ / nirguṇo 'pi parānando guṇavāniva bhāti yaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: इसलिये विप्रवर ! सुनो, मैं यह सत्य कहता हँ-- देह-बन्धनकी निवृत्तिके लिये भगवान् विष्णुकी ही पूजा करनी चाहिए। अभिमान और लोभ त्यागकर काम-क्रोधसे रहित होकर सदा भगवान्

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवाद्यैस्तु भेदवानिव लक्ष्यते । गुणोपाधिकभेदेषु त्रिष्वेतेषु सनातन
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaistu bhedavāniva lakṣyate / guṇopādhikabhedeṣu triṣveteṣu sanātana
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: विष्णुका भजन करो; क्योंकि मनुष्यजन्म अत्यन्त

verses.sanskrit: संयोज्य मायामखिलं जगत्कार्यं करोति च । ब्रह्मरुपेण सृजति विष्णुरुपेण पाति च
verses.transliteration: saṃyojya māyāmakhilaṃ jagatkāryaṃ karoti ca / brahmarupeṇa sṛjati viṣṇurupeṇa pāti ca
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: सत्तम! (अधिकांश) जीवोंको कोटि सहख्र जन्मोंतक स्थावर आदि योनियोंमें भटकनेके बाद कभी किसी प्रकार मनुष्य-शरीर मिलता है। साधु- शिरोमणे ! मनुष्य-जन्ममें भी देवाराधनकी बुद्धि,

verses.sanskrit: अन्ते च रुद्ररुपेण सर्वमत्तीति निश्चितम् । प्रसयान्ते समुत्थाय ब्रह्मरुपी जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: ante ca rudrarupeṇa sarvamattīti niścitam / prasayānte samutthāya brahmarupī janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: दानकी बुद्धि और योगसाधनाकी बुडद्धिका प्राप्त होना मनुष्योंके पूर्वजन्मकी तपस्याका फल है। जो दुर्लभ मानव-शरीर पाकर एक बार भी श्रीहरिकी पूजा नहीं करता, उससे बढ़कर मूर्ख, जड़बुद्धि

verses.sanskrit: चराचरात्मकं विश्वं यथापूर्वमकल्पयत् । स्थावराद्याशअच विप्रेन्द्र यत्र यत्र व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: carācarātmakaṃ viśvaṃ yathāpūrvamakalpayat / sthāvarādyāśaaca viprendra yatra yatra vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: कौन है ? दुर्लभ मानव-जन्म पाकर जो भगवान् विष्णुकी पूजा नहीं करते, उन महामूर्ख मनुष्योंमें विवेक कहाँ है ? ब्रह्मन्! जगदीश्वर भगवान् विष्णु आराधना करनेपर मनोवाज्छित फल देते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा तत्तज्जगत्सर्वं यथापूर्वं करोति वै । तस्मात्कृतानां पापानां पुण्यानां चैव सत्तम
verses.transliteration: brahmā tattajjagatsarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ karoti vai / tasmātkṛtānāṃ pāpānāṃ puṇyānāṃ caiva sattama
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: नारदजी ! बाँह उठाकर यह सत्य-सत्य और पुन: सत्य बात दुहरायी जाती है कि पाखण्डपूर्ण आचरणका त्याग करके मनुष्य भगवान् वासुदेवकी आराधनामें लग जाय। क्रोध मानसिक संतापका

verses.sanskrit: अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कर्मणां ह्यक्षयं फलम् । नाभुक्तं क्षीयते कर्म कल्पकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ karmaṇāṃ hyakṣayaṃ phalam / nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: कारण है। क्रोध संसारबन्धनमें डालनेवाला है और क्रोध सब धर्मोका नाश करनेवाला है। अतः क्रोधको छोड़ देना चाहिए। काम इस जन्मका मूल कारण है, काम पाप करानेमें हेतु है और

verses.sanskrit: अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम् । यो देवः सर्वलोकानामन्तरात्मा जगन्मयः । सर्वकर्मफलं भुक्ते परिपूर्णः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham / yo devaḥ sarvalokānāmantarātmā jaganmayaḥ / sarvakarmaphalaṃ bhukte paripūrṇaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: काम यशका नाश करनेवाला है। अत: कामको भी त्याग देना चाहिए। मात्सर्य समस्त दुःख- समुदायका कारण माना गया है, वह नरकोंका भी साधन है, अत: उसे भी त्याग देना चाहिए'।

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽसौ विश्वंभरो देवो गुणमेदव्यवस्थितः । सूजत्यवति चात्त्येतत्सर्वं सर्वभुगव्ययः
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau viśvaṃbharo devo guṇamedavyavasthitaḥ / sūjatyavati cāttyetatsarvaṃ sarvabhugavyayaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu XI1.54 ff and Yajflavalkya. 111.206 ff which state that sinnera after serving their term in hells are bom as lower animals, insects, trees,, shrubs, etc.
verses.hindi: मन ही मनुष्योंके बन्धन और मोक्षका कारण है। अत: मनको परमात्मामें लगाकर सुखी हो जाना चाहिए। अहो! मनुष्योंका धेर्य कितना अद्भुत, कितना विचित्र तथा कितना आश्चर्यजनक है कि

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे प्रथमपादे यमदूतकृत्यनिरुपणं नामैकत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः सनक उवाच एवं कर्मपाशनियन्त्रितजन्ततवः स्वर्गादिपुण्यस्थानेषु पुण्यभोगमनुभूय यातीव दुःखतरं पापफलमनुभूय प्रक्षीणकर्मा वशेषेणामुं लोकमागत्य सर्वभयविह्वलेषु मृत्युबाधासंयुतेषुस्थावरादिषु जायते । वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्लीगिरयश्च तृणानि च । स्थावरा इति विख्याता महामोहसमावृताः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge prathamapāde yamadūtakṛtyanirupaṇaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sanaka uvāca evaṃ karmapāśaniyantritajantatavaḥ svargādipuṇyasthāneṣu puṇyabhogamanubhūya yātīva duḥkhataraṃ pāpaphalamanubhūya prakṣīṇakarmā vaśeṣeṇāmuṃ lokamāgatya sarvabhayavihvaleṣu mṛtyubādhāsaṃyuteṣusthāvarādiṣu jāyate / vṛkṣagulmalatāvallīgirayaśca tṛṇāni ca / sthāvarā iti vikhyātā mahāmohasamāvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Thus all the creatures curbed and controlled by their respective Karmas (Actions, the fruit whereof they have to reap) enjoy the pleasures of their Puias (merits) in heaven and other places of merits and undergo extremely painful sufferings, as the result of their sins, in helb. With the residue of their dwindled Karmas, they come to this world. They are bom as immobiles and other beings infested with all fearsome things and subject to the harassment of death. Trees, bushes, creepers twining plants, grass and the mountains are well known as Sthdoaras (Immobile beings). They are enveloped by great delusions. In the course of their state of being immobile (the development is as follows): The seeds sown in the ground become well cooked (as it were) through the reproductive faculty (that had been dormant) immediately after being watered. They become swollen and assume the form of the main shoot and its root. It germinates into a sprout from which the leaves, stem and tubular vessels develop. Buds come out from the stalk and blossom into flowers. Among the flowers some do not yield fruits. Some of the flowers produce fruits. When the flowers mature the chaffs develop at their bottoms. Thanks to the residual impressions of the Karmans of the living beings destined to enjoy, the cool snowy beams of the moon and the lymphatic juice of herb plants penetrate the husks and the chaffs. They assume milklike form and in course of time become grains. Thanks to the dor¬ mant impressions of destiny for enjoyment belonging to the living beings, they fructify in the course of a year (the crop is ready for reaping the harvest).
verses.hindi: जगदीश्वर भगवान् विष्णुके होते हुए भी वे मदसे उन्मत्त होकर उनका भजन नहीं करते हैं) । सबका धारण-पोषण करनेवाले जगदीश्वर भगवान् अच्युतकी आराधना किये बिना संसार-सागरमें डूबे हुए

verses.sanskrit: स्थावरत्वे पृथिव्यामुत्पबीजानि जलसेकानुपदं सुसंस्कारसामग्रीवशादन्तरुष्मप्रपाचितान्युच्छूनत्वमापद्य ततो मूलभावं तन्मूलादङ्कुरोत्पत्तिस्तस्मादपि पर्णकाण्डनालादिकं काण्डेषु च प्रसवमापद्यन्ते तेषु च पुष्पसंभवः
verses.transliteration: sthāvaratve pṛthivyāmutpabījāni jalasekānupadaṃ susaṃskārasāmagrīvaśādantaruṣmaprapācitānyucchūnatvamāpadya tato mūlabhāvaṃ tanmūlādaṅkurotpattistasmādapi parṇakāṇḍanālādikaṃ kāṇḍeṣu ca prasavamāpadyante teṣu ca puṣpasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: In the course of their state of life as immobile beings that continues for a long time, they experience misery in many ways. For example, they are munched and crunched by monkeys and other animals; they are cut off by men; they are destroyed by forest fire; they endure chilliness, scorching Then they take to PaJuyoni (birth as animals). They are agitated and tormented forcibly. They suffer immense agony in vain. They are overwhelmed with htmger. They perpetually move about in the forests. They are afflicted with passionate sensual attachment even to their mothers. They undergo many sufferings due to gusts of wind, etc. During some births they are herbivorous. During other births they are carnivorous, some swallowing even fecel matter; some live subsisting on bulbous roots, fruits and roots. They are bent upon inflicting pain on weaker animals. They too suffer miseries. In their state of oviparous living beings (i.e. birds), they take in gaseous, flesh, fecal and other matter, they are prone to injure others and they themselves suffer. After being bom as domestic beasts (such as cattle) and other animals, they endure all sorts of miseries such as separation from their own kindred, bearing heavy loads, bondage in nooses and tethers, hitting with whips, etc., dragging the ploughs and similar agonies.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य कैसे पार जा सकेंगे ? अच्युत, अनन्त और गोविन्द--इन नामोंके उच्चारणरूप औषधसे सब रोग नष्ट हो जाते हैं। यह मैं सत्य कहता हूँ, सत्य कहता हूँ । जो लोग नारायण ! जगन्नाथ ! वासुदेव !

verses.sanskrit: तानि पुष्पाणि कानिचिदफलानि कानिचित्फलहेतुभूतानि तेषु पुष्पेषु वृद्धभावेषु सत्सु तत्पुष्पमूलतस्तुषोत्पत्तिर्जायते तेषु तुषु भोक्तॄणां प्राणिनां संस्कारसामग्रीवशाद्धिमरश्मिकिरणासन्नतया तदोषधिरसस्तुषान्तः प्रविश्य क्षीरभावं समेत्य स्वकाले तण्डुलाकारतामुपगम्य प्राणिनां भोगसंस्कारवशात्संवत्सरे फलिनः स्युः
verses.transliteration: tāni puṣpāṇi kānicidaphalāni kānicitphalahetubhūtāni teṣu puṣpeṣu vṛddhabhāveṣu satsu tatpuṣpamūlatastuṣotpattirjāyate teṣu tuṣu bhoktṝṇāṃ prāṇināṃ saṃskārasāmagrīvaśāddhimaraśmikiraṇāsannatayā tadoṣadhirasastuṣāntaḥ praviśya kṣīrabhāvaṃ sametya svakāle taṇḍulākāratāmupagamya prāṇināṃ bhogasaṃskāravaśātsaṃvatsare phalinaḥ syuḥ
verses.translation: After wandering thus through various births, they gradually attain hiunan life. Some of than enter human life as a result of special merit.* As human beings too, they suffer no less when they are born as cobblers, C&iiUaSy hunters, barbers, washermen, potters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, weavers, tailors, Siddhas with matted hair, launderers and dyen, scribes and painters, ser¬ vants, errand boys, menial servants, slaves, indigent fellows etc.* Some have sturplus limbs while others are wanting in some limbs (and. physically handicapped). Their distresses are numerous. They suffer fix>m fever, phlegmatic attack, enlarge¬ ment of the spleen, pain in the legs, eyes, head, sides and womb and other distress as well.* In the birth as human beings (there are other sufferings
verses.hindi: बड़े कष्टकी बात है, बड़े कष्टकी बात है कि यह  जनार्दन! आदि नामोंका नित्य उच्चारण किया जीव इस शरीरको नाशवान् समझकर भी धर्मका  करते हैं, वे सर्वत्र वन्दनीय हैं। देवर्षे ! दुष्ट चित्तवाले

verses.sanskrit: स्थावरत्वे ऽपि बहुकालं वानरादिभिर्भुज्यमाना हि च्छेदनदवाग्निदहनशीतातपादिदुःखमनुभूय म्रियते । ततश्च क्रिमयो भूत्वा सदादुःखबहुलाः क्षणार्ध्दं जीवन्तः क्षणार्ध्दं म्रियमाणा बलवत्प्राणिपीडायां निवारयितुमक्षमाः शीतवातादिक्लेशभूयिष्ठा नित्यं क्षुधाक्षुधिता मलमूत्रादिषु सचरन्तो दुःखमनुभवन्ति
verses.transliteration: sthāvaratve 'pi bahukālaṃ vānarādibhirbhujyamānā hi cchedanadavāgnidahanaśītātapādiduḥkhamanubhūya mriyate / tataśca krimayo bhūtvā sadāduḥkhabahulāḥ kṣaṇārdhdaṃ jīvantaḥ kṣaṇārdhdaṃ mriyamāṇā balavatprāṇipīḍāyāṃ nivārayitumakṣamāḥ śītavātādikleśabhūyiṣṭhā nityaṃ kṣudhākṣudhitā malamūtrādiṣu sacaranto duḥkhamanubhavanti
verses.translation: The semen virile becomes a foetus within five days of the entry of the soul. Within half a month it becomes a fieshy man. Within a month it attains the size of a PradeSa (the ■span measured with the forefinger and the thumb). From that time onwards it begins to move within the belly of the mother, thanks to the action of the wind. Although it has no consciousness, it is unable to stay in one single place within the belly of the mother, due to the unbearable heat and pain. *'Alas I am extremely sinful. In my previous birth I was too fond of servants, children, friends, womenfolk, houses, fields, wealth, grains, etc. In order to maintain my wives (and others) I used to rob others of their wealth, fields, etc. in their very sight. Since I was blind due to lust, I had abducted other men's wives. Thus, I have committed many sins. As a result of it I underwent sufferings in hells. I was then bom as immo¬ bile being and experienced great miseries. Now, enveloped in this embryo, I bum within myself as well as without.*
verses.hindi: २. काममूलमिदं जन्म काम: पापस्य कारणम्। यश:क्षयकर: कामस्तस्मात्तं परिवर्जयेत्॥ समस्तदुःखजालानां मात्सर्य॑ कारणंस्मृतम्। नरकाणां साधनं च तस्मात्तदपि संत्यजेतू॥

verses.sanskrit: तत एव पद्मयोनिमागत्य बलवद्वाधोद्वेजिता वृथोद्वेगभूयिष्ठाः क्षुत्क्षान्ता नित्यं वनचारिणो मातृष्वपि विषयातुरा वातादिक्लेषबहुलाः कश्मिंश्चिज्जन्मनि तृणाशनाः कस्मिंश्चिज्जन्मनि मांसामेध्याद्यदनाः कस्मिंश्चिज्जन्मनि कन्दमूलफलाशना दुर्बलप्राणिपीडानिरता दुःखमनुभवन्ति
verses.transliteration: tata eva padmayonimāgatya balavadvādhodvejitā vṛthodvegabhūyiṣṭhāḥ kṣutkṣāntā nityaṃ vanacāriṇo mātṛṣvapi viṣayāturā vātādikleṣabahulāḥ kaśmiṃścijjanmani tṛṇāśanāḥ kasmiṃścijjanmani māṃsāmedhyādyadanāḥ kasmiṃścijjanmani kandamūlaphalāśanā durbalaprāṇipīḍāniratā duḥkhamanubhavanti
verses.translation: The wives and others maintained by me have gone elsewhere according to their own Kamos. Due to that sin, I bum within myself ehveloped by this (outer skin of the) embryo. Formerly, I had been distressed by jealousy on seeing another man*s wealth and glory. Even now, the sinner that I am, 1 am beiz burned by the fire (heat) of this womb. I had inflicted pain on others physically, mentally and verbally. I am being burnt by that sin. I am lonely and extremely distressed."
verses.hindi: ४. अच्युतानन्तगोविन्दनामोच्चारणभेषजातू । नश्यन्ति सकला रोगा: सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम्॥

verses.sanskrit: अण्डजत्वे ऽपि वाताशनामांसामेध्याद्यशनाश्च परपीडापरायणा नित्यं दुःखबहुला ग्राम्यपशुयोनिमागता अपि स्वजातिवियोगभारोद्वहनपाशादिबन्धनताडनहलादिधारणादिसर्वदुःखान्यनुभवन्ति
verses.transliteration: aṇḍajatve 'pi vātāśanāmāṃsāmedhyādyaśanāśca parapīḍāparāyaṇā nityaṃ duḥkhabahulā grāmyapaśuyonimāgatā api svajātiviyogabhārodvahanapāśādibandhanatāḍanahalādidhāraṇādisarvaduḥkhānyanubhavanti
verses.translation: O sage Narada, at the time of the confinement of his mother, the soul within the womb is afflicted by the wind. Urged by his Karmas he is forced out through the vaginal pas¬ sage. Inflicting pain on his mother also, he simultaneously experiences all tortures. The external wind enlivens him. Immediately after the contact with the external wind, he loses all his memory. He experiences bodily pains, etc. of various types and he docs so only through subservience to others. It is impossible for him to ward off even the flies.
verses.hindi: फिर संसार-रूप अग्रमिमें जला हुआ कौन मानव उनकी पूजा नहीं करेगा? मुनिश्रेष्ठ! विष्णुभक्त चाण्डाल भी भक्तिहीन द्विजसे बढ़कर है। अतः काम, क्रोध आदिको त्यागकर अविनाशी भगवान्

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुयोनिषु संभ्रान्ताः क्रमेण मानुषं जन्म प्राप्नुवन्ति । केचिच्च पुण्यविशेषाद्युत्क्रमेणापि मनुष्यजन्माश्नुवते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahuyoniṣu saṃbhrāntāḥ krameṇa mānuṣaṃ janma prāpnuvanti / kecicca puṇyaviśeṣādyutkrameṇāpi manuṣyajanmāśnuvate
verses.translation: After becoming a slightly bigger boy he experiences all these things:—He is beaten by his mother, father and pre¬ ceptor. He gets the habit of listless wandering here and there. He plays about in dust, ashes and mud. He is always quarrel¬ some. He is dirty. He engages himselfin many futile tasks. When those do not fructify he feels sorry. Thus, he undergoes sufferings. Then in his youth (he experiences various other suffer¬ ings:) there is misery in earning wealth; there is misery in preserving what is earned. He is very miserable when the earned wealth is lost or spent. The young men are deluded by Maya; their minds are defiled by lust and fury and similar emotions; they are always engrossed in jealousy, and in devising means of knocking off other men's wealth and abducting other men's wives; they are always worried over the ways of suste¬ nance for their sons, friends and wives; they are puffed with vain arrogance. When their sons or other kinsmen are bed¬ ridden due to ailments, they cancel all their engagements and sit beside the patients. They are too remorseful and begin to muse as follows: No action regarding the house, fields, etc. has been contemplated by me. How is the increasing family to be maintained?
verses.hindi: नारायणका भजन करना चाहिए। उनके प्रसन्न होनेपर सब संतुष्ट होते हैं; क्योंकि वे भगवान् श्रीहरि ही सबके भीतर विद्यमान हैं। जैसे सम्पूर्ण स्थावर-जड़म जगत् आकाशसे व्याप्त हैं, उसी

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यजन्म नापि च चर्मकारचण्डालव्याधानापितरजककुंभकारलोहकारस्वर्णकारतन्तुवाचसौचिकजटिलसिद्धधावकलेखकभृतकशासनहारिनीचभृत्यद्ररिदहीनाङ्गाधिकाङ्गत्वादि दुःखबहुलज्वरतापशीतश्लेष्मगुल्मपादाक्षिशिरोगर्भपार्श्ववेदनादिदुःखमनुभवन्ति
verses.transliteration: manuṣyajanma nāpi ca carmakāracaṇḍālavyādhānāpitarajakakuṃbhakāralohakārasvarṇakāratantuvācasaucikajaṭilasiddhadhāvakalekhakabhṛtakaśāsanahārinīcabhṛtyadraridahīnāṅgādhikāṅgatvādi duḥkhabahulajvaratāpaśītaśleṣmagulmapādākṣiśirogarbhapārśvavedanādiduḥkhamanubhavanti
verses.translation: I have no capital with me. We do not get timely showters of rain. Where has the horse run away? How is it that my kinc have not yet returned? My enemies rush at me. How can I conquer them? I am incompetent to pursue any vocation. These guests have come now i Thereafter, he becomes incapable of even making any movement of (drawing back) his hands and feet. He is- surrounded by weeping kinsmen. He is unable to speak. His worry now is, "to whom will the wealth earned by him go?". Tears begin to well up in his eyes and cloud them. There is a snorting-like sound in his throat. The vital breaths leave off his body. He is then rebuked by the emissaries of Yama. Bound and fettered by them, he falls into the hells as before.
verses.hindi: प्रकार इस चराचर विश्वको भगवान् विष्णुने व्याप्त कर रखा है। भगवान् विष्णुके भजनसे जन्म और मृत्यु दोनोंका नाश हो जाता है। ध्यान, स्मरण, पूजन अथवा प्रणाममात्र कर लेनेपर भगवान् जनार्दन

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यत्वे ऽपि यदा स्त्रीपुरुषयोर्व्यवायस्तत्समयेरेतो यदा जरायुं प्रविशति तदैव कर्मवशाज्जन्तुः शुक्रेण सह जरायुं प्रविश्य शुक्रशोणितकलले प्रवर्त्तते
verses.transliteration: manuṣyatve 'pi yadā strīpuruṣayorvyavāyastatsamayereto yadā jarāyuṃ praviśati tadaiva karmavaśājjantuḥ śukreṇa saha jarāyuṃ praviśya śukraśoṇitakalale pravarttate
verses.translation: Just as metals are cast into fire and blown with the Those men who are devoid of knowledge are said to be brutes. Hence, for the liberation from worldly existence, one shall practise perfect knowledge. Alas! even when Narayana, the lord of the universe, the bestower of all desired benefits, stands by, men devoid of perfect knowledge are cooked in the hells!
verses.hindi: जीवके संसारबन्धनको काट देते हैं। ब्रह्मर्ष! उनके नामका उच्चारण करनेमात्रसे महापातकोंका नाश हो जाता है और उनकी विधिपूर्वक पूजा करके तो मनुष्य मोक्षका भागी होता है। ब्रह्मन्! यह

verses.sanskrit: तद्वीर्यं जीवप्रवेशात्पञ्चाहात्कललं भवति अर्द्धमासे । पलवलभावमुपेत्य मासे प्रादेशमात्रत्वमापद्यते
verses.transliteration: tadvīryaṃ jīvapraveśātpañcāhātkalalaṃ bhavati arddhamāse / palavalabhāvamupetya māse prādeśamātratvamāpadyate
verses.translation: Ignorant persons enveloped by great delusions, consider this.transient body permanent—the body that exudes fecal matter and urine. Those who arc richly endowed with spiritual know¬ ledge, those who are engaged in the worship of Hari attain the greatest abode, a return from which is difficult to get. An echo of Manu XII.54 ff & Y&jflavalkya III.206 ff. Curiously enough here, both Manu and Yajftavalkya are textually very similar to each other pointing thereby to an earlier common source.
verses.hindi: बड़े आश्चर्यकी बात है, बड़ी अद्भुत बात है और बड़ी विचित्र बात है कि भगवान् विष्णुके नामके रहते हुए भी लोग जन्म-मृत्युरूप संसारमें चक्कर काटते हैं'। जबतक इन्द्रियाँ शिथिल नहीं

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति वायुवशाच्चैतन्याभावे ऽपि मातुरुह्ये दुःसहतापल्केशतयैकत्र स्थातुमशक्यत्वाद् भ्रमति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti vāyuvaśāccaitanyābhāve 'pi māturuhye duḥsahatāpalkeśatayaikatra sthātumaśakyatvād bhramati
verses.translation: The ancient theory of evolution. Before a Jlba reaches the stage of human beings they undergo the following stages of evolution: immobile beings, trees, grass animal-world (wild beasts) oviparous beings and domestic animals -*■ human being. The idea that people are bom in lower castes as a result of their sins in previous birth u traceable to the Dhantta Sutra period. Thiu Apastamba (Dh. S. II. 1.2.6-7) states that after undergoing the torments of the hell, the sinner is bom as a GindA> Paulkasa and Vaina and outcaste. Gf. Manu's explana¬ tion for birth as a goldsmith (Manu XII.61). Since ancient times diseases are believed to be the consequences of sins. Thiu Vifpu Dh. S. Ch. 45, Manu XI.49-52, Satatapa I. 3-11, Gautama (versi¬ fied Smrti) Gh. 20 (to mention a few) state the diseases and bodily defects from which sinners suffer after they are bom as men. Not that all of these authors agree in their pronoimcements of such defects and diseases as the result of a particular sin. Thus Brahmana-slaughter causes leprosy according to Vasi;tha 20.44 but Phthbis according to Manu XI.49, Yajhavalkya III. 209 Vijiianesvara in MitdkfarH on Yajnavalkya III. 216 gives a list of births in lower species and diseases and deformities suffered for various sins.
verses.hindi: होतीं और जबतक रोग-व्याधि नहीं सताते, तभीतक भगवान् विष्णुकी आराधना कर लेनी चाहिए। जीव जब माताके गर्भसे निकलता है, तभी मृत्यु उसके साथ हो लेती है। अत: सबको धर्मपालनमें

verses.sanskrit: मासे द्वितीये पूर्णे पुरुषाकारमात्रतामुपगमय मासत्रितये पूर्णे करचरणाद्यवयवभावमुपगम्य चतुर्षु मासेषु गतेषु सर्वावयवानां संधिभेदपरिज्ञानं पञ्चस्वतीतेषु नखानामभिव्यञ्जककता षट्स्वतीतेषु नखसंधिपरिस्फुटतामुपगम्य नाभिसूत्रेण पुष्यमाणममेध्यमूत्रसिक्ताङ्गं जरायुणा बन्धितरक्तास्थिक्रिमिवसामज्जास्नायुकेशादिदूषिते कुत्सिते शरीरे निवासिनं स्वयमप्येवं परिदूषितदेहं मातुश्च कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णभुक्तदह्यमात्मानं दृष्ट्वा देही पूर्वजन्मस्मरणानुभावात्पूर्वानुभूतनरकदुःथानि च स्मृत्वान्तर्दुःखेन च परिदह्यमानो मातुर्देहातिमूत्रादिरुक्षेण दह्यमान एवं मनसि प्रलयति
verses.transliteration: māse dvitīye pūrṇe puruṣākāramātratāmupagamaya māsatritaye pūrṇe karacaraṇādyavayavabhāvamupagamya caturṣu māseṣu gateṣu sarvāvayavānāṃ saṃdhibhedaparijñānaṃ pañcasvatīteṣu nakhānāmabhivyañjakakatā ṣaṭsvatīteṣu nakhasaṃdhiparisphuṭatāmupagamya nābhisūtreṇa puṣyamāṇamamedhyamūtrasiktāṅgaṃ jarāyuṇā bandhitaraktāsthikrimivasāmajjāsnāyukeśādidūṣite kutsite śarīre nivāsinaṃ svayamapyevaṃ paridūṣitadehaṃ mātuśca kaṭvamlalavaṇātyuṣṇabhuktadahyamātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā dehī pūrvajanmasmaraṇānubhāvātpūrvānubhūtanarakaduḥthāni ca smṛtvāntarduḥkhena ca paridahyamāno māturdehātimūtrādirukṣeṇa dahyamāna evaṃ manasi pralayati
verses.translation: O excellent sage, scries of actions are being performed by living beings every day and are enjoyed also. How can they {Karmas) be destroyed? The embodied soul takes up the body as a result of his Karman\ he is bound by lust. As a result of lust he is over¬ whelmed by avarice and avarice makes him prone to anger. Due to anger, Dharma perishes and the destruction of Dharma leads to misapprehension. A man of confused intellect commits sin again.
verses.hindi: लग जाना चाहिए। अहो! बड़े कष्टकी बात है,

verses.sanskrit: अहो ऽत्यन्तपापो ऽहंपूर्वजन्मनिभृत्यापत्यमित्रयोषिद्गृहक्षेत्रधनधान्यादिष्वत्यन्तरागेण कलत्रपोषणार्थं परधनक्षेत्रादिकं पश्यतो हरणाद्युपायैरपह्यत्य कामान्धतया परस्त्रीहरणादिकमनुभूय महापापान्याचरंस्तैः पापैरहमेक एवंविधनरकाननुभूय पुनः स्थावरादिषु महादुःखमनुभूय संप्रति जरायुणा परिवेष्टितो ऽन्तर्दुखेन बहिस्तापेन च दह्यामि
verses.transliteration: aho 'tyantapāpo 'haṃpūrvajanmanibhṛtyāpatyamitrayoṣidgṛhakṣetradhanadhānyādiṣvatyantarāgeṇa kalatrapoṣaṇārthaṃ paradhanakṣetrādikaṃ paśyato haraṇādyupāyairapahyatya kāmāndhatayā parastrīharaṇādikamanubhūya mahāpāpānyācaraṃstaiḥ pāpairahameka evaṃvidhanarakānanubhūya punaḥ sthāvarādiṣu mahāduḥkhamanubhūya saṃprati jarāyuṇā pariveṣṭito 'ntardukhena bahistāpena ca dahyāmi
verses.translation: Well done, O highly intelligent one, well done. Your mind is noble and free of impurities, since you desire to know from us the means of liberation from the misery of worldly existence. O strict observer of religious vows, indeed, it is only that Deity who is the bestower of salvation—the deity at whose behest Brahma creates the entire universe; Hari protects it and Rudra annihilates it. Know Vi?nu* to be the bestower of salvation. He is Narayana free from ailments. Thanks to his prowess, arc bom the principles beginning with Ahartikdra (the Ego) and ending with Viiefa (particularities).
verses.hindi: मनुष्योंकी कितनी भारी मूर्खता है कि वे अपने हृदयमें विराजमान भगवान् विष्णुको नहीं जानते हैं। मुनिश्रेष्ठ ! नारद ! सुनो, में बार-बार इस बातको दुहराता हूँ, भगवान् विष्णु श्रद्धालु जनोंपर ही

verses.sanskrit: मया पोषिता दाराश्च स्वकर्मवशादन्यतो गताः
verses.transliteration: mayā poṣitā dārāśca svakarmavaśādanyato gatāḥ
verses.translation: All this (visible universe) consisting of the mobile and immobile, is not different from him. One is liberated from misery of seoAsdra by meditating on the mighty Lord, devoid of old age. Verily they call him the Liberator (lit. the means of liberation from SaAsdra) one above modifications and aberra¬ tions, who is unborn, the purest, the self-luminous, the unsullied embodiment of perfect knowledge and of eternal bliss. Those who have conquered their Prlbas (vital breaths), those who have controlled their diet, those who are always absorbed in meditation, see him in their hearts. Know him to be the Reality that accords happiness.
verses.hindi: संतुष्ट होते हैं, अधिक धन और भाई-बन्धुवालोंपर नहीं। इहलोक और परलोकमें सुख चाहनेवाला मनुष्य सदा श्रीहरिकी पूजा करे तथा इहलोक और परलोकमें दुःख चाहनेवाला मनुष्य दूसरोंकी

verses.sanskrit: अहो दुखं हि देहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: aho dukhaṃ hi dehinām
verses.translation: At the end of the Kalpa, he withdraws everything and lies down on the cosmic water. Sages, the perceivers of the truth, call Visu, the bestower of salvation. The KarmajHas (the knowers of the path of Karmans), who know the meanings of the Vedic passages, worship him through various kinds of sacrifices. He alone is the bestower of the fruits of holy rites to them and salvation to those who perform holy rites without desire of their fruits. They call him the lord, the bestower of salvation— the lord who is unmanifest and who partakes of oblations (offered in sacrificial fire) by assuming the forms of deities and the oblation of food and other offerings to the manes by assum¬ ing the forms of Pitrs (ancestors).*
verses.hindi: निन्दामें तत्पर रहे। जो देवाधिदेव भगवान् जनार्दनकी भक्तिसे रहित हैं, ऐसे मनुष्योंके जन्मको धिक्कार है। जिसे सत्पात्रके लिये दान नहीं दिया जाता, उस धनको बारम्बार धिक्कार है। मुनिश्रेष्ठ! जो

verses.sanskrit: देहस्तु पापात्संजातस्तस्मात्पापं न कारयेत् । भृत्यभित्रकलत्रार्थमन्यद्द्रव्यं हृतं मया
verses.transliteration: dehastu pāpātsaṃjātastasmātpāpaṃ na kārayet / bhṛtyabhitrakalatrārthamanyaddravyaṃ hṛtaṃ mayā
verses.translation: One should worship that merciful Lord who on being meditated upon, or bowed to or worshipped with devotion, bestows the permanent abode (Mokfa). That immutable Hari, the Supreme Person, the only O leading sage, after worshipping his lotus-like feet, the embodied souls immediately attain to immortality (i.e. Moka). They know him to be the Supreme Person.
verses.hindi: शरीर भगवान् विष्णुको नमस्कार नहीं करता, उसे पापकी खान समझना चाहिए। जिसने सुपात्रको दान न देकर जो कुछ द्रव्य जोड़ रखा है, वह

verses.sanskrit: तेन पापेन दह्यामि जरायुपरिवेष्टितः । दृष्ट्वान्यस्य श्रियं पूर्वं सतत्पो ऽहमसूयया खितः
verses.transliteration: tena pāpena dahyāmi jarāyupariveṣṭitaḥ / dṛṣṭvānyasya śriyaṃ pūrvaṃ satatpo 'hamasūyayā khitaḥ
verses.translation: They know him to be one without a second, devoid of attributes, non-dual and matchless, eternal, incomparable and perfect embodiment of knowledge. He is the deity who enables one to achieve salvation. The Yogin who always worships this Supreme entity of such a nature, through the rites of the Yogic path, attains the greatest region. The Yogin who has eschewed all contacts and associa¬ tions, who is endowed with ama (self-control) and other good qualities and who is devoid of lust and similar bad qualities attains the highest region.
verses.hindi: लोकमें चोरीसे रखे हुए धनकी भाँति निन्दनीय है। संसारी मनुष्य बिजलीके समान चञ्लल धन- सम्पत्तिसे मतवाले हो रहे हैं। वे जीवोंके अज्ञानमय पाशको दूर करनेवाले जगदीश्वर श्रीहरिकी आराधना

verses.sanskrit: गर्भाग्निनानुदह्येयमिदानीमपि पापकृत् । कायेन मनसा वाचा परपीडामकारिषम्तेन पापेन दह्यामि त्वहमेको ऽतिदुःखितः
verses.transliteration: garbhāgninānudahyeyamidānīmapi pāpakṛt / kāyena manasā vācā parapīḍāmakāriṣamtena pāpena dahyāmi tvahameko 'tiduḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who ponder over the meanings of principles (or the Reality) say that the greatest salvation is attainable through perfect knowledge. This perfect knowledge has its root in devotion. Similarly this devotion is engendered in those persons who perform holy rites. When all the sins are quelled, the intellect becomes free from impurities. That same intellect is declared by wise sages by the word JrUbta (knowledge). They say that knowledge bestows salvation. It is the Yogins who acquire that knowledge. Yoga is said to be of two kinds, differentiated by holy rites and by perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: हैवी और आसुरी सृष्टिके भेदसे सृष्टि दो प्रकारकी बतायी गयी है। जहाँ भगवान्की भक्ति (और सदाचार) है, वह हैवी सृष्टि है और जो भक्ति (और सदाचार)-से हीन है, वह आसुरी

verses.sanskrit: एवं बहुविधं गर्भस्थो जन्तुर्विलप्य स्वयमेव वा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ garbhastho janturvilapya svayameva vā
verses.translation: The jMna Toga (path of knowledge) cannot be accom¬ plished without the Kriyd, Toga (path of holy rites). Hence, one who is engaged in the Kriyd Toga should worship Hari with deep faith. With devotion the following idols of Keava are to be worshipped; the idols termed as Dvija (Brahmana), BhUmi (Earth), (fire), Surya (Sun), Ambu (Water) Dhdtu (metals or the essential ingredients of body), Hrt (the heart) and Citra (Picture). Hence, becoming completely averse to (i.t. abstaining absolutely from) indicting pain on others in thought, word and deed, one, endowed with devotion, should worship Lord Visnu who pervades everything.
verses.hindi: सृष्टि है। अतः विप्रवर नारद! सुनो, भगवान् विष्णुके भजनमें लगे हुए मनुष्य सर्वत्र श्रेष्ठ कहे गये हैं; क्योंकि भक्ति अत्यन्त दुर्लभ है। जो ईर्ष्या और द्वेषसे रहित, ब्राह्मणोंकी रक्षामें तत्पर तथा

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानमाश्वास्य उत्पत्तेरनन्तरं सत्संगेन विष्णोश्चरितश्रवणेन च विशुद्धमना भूत्वा सत्कर्माणि निर्वर्त्य अखिलजगदन्तरात्मनः सत्यज्ञानानन्दमयस्य शक्तिप्रभावानुष्टितविष्टपवर्गस्य लक्ष्मीपतेर्नारायणस्य सकलसुरासुरयक्षगन्धर्वराक्षसपन्न गमुनिकिन्नरसमूहार्चितचरणकमलयुगं भक्तितः समभ्यर्च्य दुःसहः संसारच्छेदस्यकारणभूतं वेदरहस्योपनिषद्भिः परिस्फुटं सकललोकपरायणं हृदिनिधाय दुःखतरमिमं संस्कारागारमतिक्रमिष्यामीति मनसि भवयति
verses.transliteration: ātmānamāśvāsya utpatteranantaraṃ satsaṃgena viṣṇoścaritaśravaṇena ca viśuddhamanā bhūtvā satkarmāṇi nirvartya akhilajagadantarātmanaḥ satyajñānānandamayasya śaktiprabhāvānuṣṭitaviṣṭapavargasya lakṣmīpaternārāyaṇasya sakalasurāsurayakṣagandharvarākṣasapanna gamunikinnarasamūhārcitacaraṇakamalayugaṃ bhaktitaḥ samabhyarcya duḥsahaḥ saṃsāracchedasyakāraṇabhūtaṃ vedarahasyopaniṣadbhiḥ parisphuṭaṃ sakalalokaparāyaṇaṃ hṛdinidhāya duḥkhataramimaṃ saṃskārāgāramatikramiṣyāmīti manasi bhavayati
verses.translation: The following good qualities are common to both types of Yogas—viz. nonviolence, truthfulness, absence of anger, celibacy, non-acceptance of gifts (and non-possession of pro¬ perty), absence of jealousy and mercifulness. Firmly determining mentally that "the eternal Visnu is identical with the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings", one shall practise the two types of Yogas. The learned men who consider all living beings their own Atman realise the supreme nature of the discus-bearing lord of Devas (viz. Visnu).
verses.hindi: काम आदि दोषोंसे दूर हैं, उनपर भगवान् विष्णु संतुष्ट होते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: यतस्तन्मातुः प्रसूतिसमये सति गर्भस्थोदेही नारदमुने वायुनापरिपीडितो मातुश्चापि दुःखं कुर्वन्कर्मपाशेन बलाद्योनिमार्गान्निष्क्रामन्सकलयातनाभोगमेककालभवमनुभवति
verses.transliteration: yatastanmātuḥ prasūtisamaye sati garbhasthodehī nāradamune vāyunāparipīḍito mātuścāpi duḥkhaṃ kurvankarmapāśena balādyonimārgānniṣkrāmansakalayātanābhogamekakālabhavamanubhavati
verses.translation: If a person full of envy and jealousy becomes absorbed in austerities, worship and meditation, his austerities, worship and meditation—everything is futile. Hence, a man, eagerly engaged in practising the good qualities of (self-control), etc. and who is absorbed in Kriyd-Toga should duly worship Visnu who is the Soul of all (and is one with them), for the purpose of liberation (from Sarhsdra), If a person interested in the welfare of all worlds, mentally, verbally and physically, devoutly worships the lord of Devas, it is called Kriyd Toga.
verses.hindi: बेदमालिको जानन्ति मुनिका उपदेश तथा वेदमालिकी मुक्ति

verses.sanskrit: तेनातिक्लेशेन योनियन्त्रपूडितो गर्भान्निष्कान्तो निःसंज्ञतां याति
verses.transliteration: tenātikleśena yoniyantrapūḍito garbhānniṣkānto niḥsaṃjñatāṃ yāti
verses.translation: The person who eulogises through hymns, etc. Lord Narayana, the source of the origin of the universe, Vi§nu, Hari, the immanent soul of everyone, through hymns, etc., he is called, a Karma Togin. The worship of Visnu through flowers, etc., by means of observance of fasts, etc. as well as listening to Purdas (and other forms of devotion), etc., is declared as Kriyd Toga.
verses.hindi: श्रीसनकजी कहते हैं--नारद ! जिन्होंने योगके द्वारा काम, क्रोध, मद, लोभ, मोह और मात्सर्यरूपी छ: शत्रुओंको जीत लिया है तथा जो अहड्ढारशून्य और शान्त हैं, ऐसे ज्ञानी

verses.sanskrit: तं तु बाह्यवायुः समुज्जीवयति । बाह्यवायुस्पर्शसमनन्तरमेव नष्टस्मृतिपूर्वानुभूताखिलदुःखानि वर्त्तमानान्यपि ज्ञानाभावदविज्ञायात्यन्तदुःखमनुभवति
verses.transliteration: taṃ tu bāhyavāyuḥ samujjīvayati / bāhyavāyusparśasamanantarameva naṣṭasmṛtipūrvānubhūtākhiladuḥkhāni varttamānānyapi jñānābhāvadavijñāyātyantaduḥkhamanubhavati
verses.translation: All the sins accumulated in the course of previous births of those who are devotionally attached to Visnu and whose minds are absorbed in Kriyd Toga perish completely. In the company of saintly persons who are adepts in the interpretation of scriptural texts, the intelligent man shall deeply ponder over what is permanent and what is non-perma- nent in the world consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. All the sense objects are evanescent. Only Hari is eternal. One should eschew the non-eternal objects and resort only to the eternal one (viz. Hari).
verses.hindi: महात्मा ज्ञानस्वरूप अविनाशी श्रीहरिका ज्ञानयोगके द्वारा यजन करते हैं । जो ब्रत, दान, तपस्या, यज्ञ तथा तीर्थस्नान करके विशुद्ध हो गये हैं, वे कर्मयोगी महापुरुष कर्मयोगके द्वारा भगवान्

verses.sanskrit: एवं बालत्वमापन्नो जन्तुस्तत्रापि स्वमलमूत्रलित्पदेह आध्यात्मिकादिपीड्यमानो ऽपि वक्तुमशक्तक्षुत्तृषापीडितो रुदिते सति स्तनादिकं देयमिति मन्वानाः प्रयतन्ते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bālatvamāpanno jantustatrāpi svamalamūtralitpadeha ādhyātmikādipīḍyamāno 'pi vaktumaśaktakṣuttṛṣāpīḍito rudite sati stanādikaṃ deyamiti manvānāḥ prayatante
verses.translation: He should also be unattached to the pleasures of this as well as of the other world. He who is not detached becomes involved in the cycle of worldy existence. Never can he be severed from the bond of worldly -existence,—the man who is passionately attached to non-eternal objects.
verses.hindi: अच्युतका पूजन करते हैं। जो लोभी, दुर्व्यसनोंमें आसक्त और अज्ञानी हैं, वे जगदीश्वर श्रीहरिकी आराधना नहीं करते। वे मूढ़ अपनेको अजर- अमर समझते हैं; किंतु वास्तवमें मनुष्योंमें वे

verses.sanskrit: एवमनेकं देहभोगमन्याधीनतयानुभूयमानो दंशादिष्वपि निवारयितुमशक्तः
verses.transliteration: evamanekaṃ dehabhogamanyādhīnatayānubhūyamāno daṃśādiṣvapi nivārayitumaśaktaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmans if any one realises this that N&riyana abides pervading the universe consisting of the perishable and. the imperishable, they say, it is the knowledge arising from Yoga. Henceforth, I shall recount the means for the acqui¬ sition of Yoga, the means that makes this metempsychosis, recede. The knowledge that is pure is Yoga. The wise know that this knowledge is the bestower of salvation. O excellent sage, when the non-difference between the individual soul and the Supreme Soul is realised, the bonds of the Apara Atman (the lower i.e. the individual soul) are snapped.
verses.hindi: कीड़ेके समान जीवन बिताते हैं। जो बिजलीकी लकीरके समान क्षणभरमें चमककर लुप्त हो जानेवाली है, ऐसी लक्ष्मीके मदसे उन्मत्त हो व्यर्थ अहंकारसे दूषित चित्तवाले मनुष्य सब

verses.sanskrit: बाल्यभावमासाद्य मातापित्रोरुपाध्यायस्य ताडनं सदा पर्यटनशीलत्वं पांशुभस्मपङ्कादिषुक्रीडनं सदा कलहनियतत्वाम शुचित्वं बहुव्यापाराभासकार्यनियतत्वं तदसंभव आध्यात्मिकदुःखमेवंविधमनुभवति
verses.transliteration: bālyabhāvamāsādya mātāpitrorupādhyāyasya tāḍanaṃ sadā paryaṭanaśīlatvaṃ pāṃśubhasmapaṅkādiṣukrīḍanaṃ sadā kalahaniyatatvāma śucitvaṃ bahuvyāpārābhāsakāryaniyatatvaṃ tadasaṃbhava ādhyātmikaduḥkhamevaṃvidhamanubhavati
verses.translation: That attributeless great Atman has no function or rite- to perform. It has neither form nor colour. It is neither an agent nor an enjoyer. O Brahmana, the universe appears to be of diverse kinds to those who arc devoid of perfect knowledge. To those endowed with the supreme (spiritual) knowledge, it is one with the greatest Brahman.
verses.hindi: प्रकारसे कल्याण करनेवाले जगदीश्वर भगवान्

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु तरुणभावेन धनार्जनमर्जितस्य रक्षणं तस्य नाशव्ययादिषु चात्यन्तदुःखिता मायया मोहिताः कामक्रोधादिदुष्टमनसाः सदासूयापरायणाः परस्वपरस्त्रीहरणोपायपरायणाः पुत्रमित्रकलत्रादिभरणोपायचिन्तापरायणा वृथाहङ्कारदूषिताः पुत्रादिषु व्याध्यादि पीडितेषु सत्सु सर्वव्यात्पिं परित्यज्य रोगादिभिः क्लेशितानां समीपे स्वयमाध्यात्मिकदुःखेन परिप्लुता वक्ष्यमाणप्रकारेण चितामश्नुवते
verses.transliteration: tatastu taruṇabhāvena dhanārjanamarjitasya rakṣaṇaṃ tasya nāśavyayādiṣu cātyantaduḥkhitā māyayā mohitāḥ kāmakrodhādiduṣṭamanasāḥ sadāsūyāparāyaṇāḥ parasvaparastrīharaṇopāyaparāyaṇāḥ putramitrakalatrādibharaṇopāyacintāparāyaṇā vṛthāhaṅkāradūṣitāḥ putrādiṣu vyādhyādi pīḍiteṣu satsu sarvavyātpiṃ parityajya rogādibhiḥ kleśitānāṃ samīpe svayamādhyātmikaduḥkhena pariplutā vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa citāmaśnuvate
verses.translation: The only greatest bliss, the attributeless one, the greater than the greatest, the unchanging one, appears to be assuming many forms due to difference in perception. O excellent one among the Brahmanas, people per¬ ceive difference in the Parama Atman due to the Maya of the wielder of the Maya. Hence a Mumukfu (one desirous of libe¬ ration) should eschew the Maya through the Yogic power. O excellent sage, the Yogin must destroy ignorance through Yoga. The Yoga is achieved through eight ancillaries. I shall mention them factually.
verses.hindi: विष्णुकी पूजा नहीं करते हैं। जो भगवद्धर्मके पालनमें तत्पर, शान्त, श्रीहरिके चरणारविन्दोंकी सेवा करनेवाले तथा सम्पूर्ण जगत्पर अनुग्रह रखनेवाले हैं, ऐसे तो कोई बिरले महात्मा ही

verses.sanskrit: गृहक्षेत्रादिकं कम किञ्चिन्नापि विचारितम् । समृद्धस्य कुटुम्बस्य कथं भवति वर्त्तनम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhakṣetrādikaṃ kama kiñcinnāpi vicāritam / samṛddhasya kuṭumbasya kathaṃ bhavati varttanam
verses.translation: The Tamos (Restraints) are in brief the following: Ahirhsd (non-violence), Satya (truthfulness), Asteya (non-steal¬ ing), Brakmacarya (celibacy), Aparigraha (non-acceptance of Abstention from inflicting pain on all living beings is called Ahirhsi (Non-Violence) by good men. It is the bestower of Yogic achievements.
verses.hindi: हैवयोगसे उत्पन्न हो जाते हैं। जो मन, वाणी और क्रियाद्वारा भक्तिपूर्वक भगवान् विष्णुकी आराधना करता है, वह समस्त लोकोंमें परम उत्तम, परम धामको जाता है। इस विषयमें इस

verses.sanskrit: मम मूलधनं नास्ति वृष्टिश्चापि न वर्षति । अश्वः पलायितः कुत्र गावः किं नागता मम
verses.transliteration: mama mūladhanaṃ nāsti vṛṣṭiścāpi na varṣati / aśvaḥ palāyitaḥ kutra gāvaḥ kiṃ nāgatā mama
verses.translation: O excellent sage, statement of the actual fact after discriminating between Dharma (righteousness) and Adharma (unrighteousness), they call Satya (truth). Now listen to Asteya (non-stealing). Taking away the wealth of others through force or stealth is called Sta (stealth) by good men. The opposite of the same is non-stealing (Asta). Eschewal of sexual intercourse in regard to every¬ one is glorified as Brahmacarya (celibacy). Due to the abandon¬ ment of celibacy, even a person endowed with knowledge, becomes a sinner.
verses.hindi: प्राचीन इतिहासका उदाहरण दिया करते हैं, जिसे पढ़ने और सुननेवालोंके समस्त पापोंका नाश हो जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: बालापत्या च मे भार्या व्याधितो ऽहं च निर्धनः । अविचारात्कृषिर्नष्टा पुत्रा नित्यं रुदन्ति च
verses.transliteration: bālāpatyā ca me bhāryā vyādhito 'haṃ ca nirdhanaḥ / avicārātkṛṣirnaṣṭā putrā nityaṃ rudanti ca
verses.translation: He who professes to be one refraining from intimate contact with all, but continues to indulge in sexual intercourse, should be known as one on a par with a Candala. He is excommunicated from all castes. O Brahmana, if anyone engaged in the practice of Yoga harbours a craving for sensuous objects, other men are affected by the sin of Brahmahatyd (Brahmana-slaughter) even by talking to him.
verses.hindi: नारदजी ! प्राचीन कालकी बात है। रैवतमन्वन्तरमें वेदमालि नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक ब्राह्मण रहते थे, जो वेदों और वेदाड्रोंके पारदर्शी विद्वान् थे। उनके मनमें सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके प्रति दया भरी हुई थी।

verses.sanskrit: भग्नं छिन्नं तु मे सद्म बान्धवा अपि दूरगाः । न लभ्यते वर्त्तनं च राज बाधातिदुःसहा
verses.transliteration: bhagnaṃ chinnaṃ tu me sadma bāndhavā api dūragāḥ / na labhyate varttanaṃ ca rāja bādhātiduḥsahā
verses.translation: If a person who eschews all intimate contacts resumes the contacts once again, one attains the defect of a great sin {Mahdpdpa) even by means of contact with those who touch O leading sage, non-acceptance of moneys even in emergencies, is called Aparigraha. It leads to the achievement of Yogic power. If as a result of one's own superior position one indul¬ ges in harsh speech, knowers of Dharma call it Krodha (fury). Akrodha is its opposite.
