verses.hindi: स्थानमें हों और मृत्यु (आठवाँ) स्थान शुद्ध हो तो उस समय ब्रह्मचर्यब्रत ग्रहण करनेवाला द्विज वेद-शास्त्रमें 'निष्णात' होता है॥ ३६५ ॥ गुरु, शुक्र अथवा शाखाधिपति यदि अपने अधिमित्रगृहमें

verses.sanskrit: महोत्कापतनं काष्टतृणरक्तप्रवर्षणम् । गान्धर्वं देहदिग्धूमं भूमिकंपं दिवा निशि
verses.transliteration: mahotkāpatanaṃ kāṣṭatṛṇaraktapravarṣaṇam / gāndharvaṃ dehadigdhūmaṃ bhūmikaṃpaṃ divā niśi
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: या उसके उच्च गृहमें अथवा उसके अंशमें स्थित हों तो यज्ञोपवीत लेनेवाला ब्रह्मचारी विद्या तथा धनसे सम्पन्न होता है॥३६६॥ शाखाधिपतिका दिन हो, बालकको शाखाधिपतिका बल प्राप्त हो

verses.sanskrit: अनग्नौ च स्फुलिङ्गाश्च ज्वलनं च विनेन्धनम् । निशीन्द्रचापमण्डूकं शिखरे श्वेतवायसः
verses.transliteration: anagnau ca sphuliṅgāśca jvalanaṃ ca vinendhanam / niśīndracāpamaṇḍūkaṃ śikhare śvetavāyasaḥ
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: तथा शाखाधिपतिका ही लग्र हो--ये तीन बातें उपनयन-संस्कारमें दुर्लभ हैं॥ ३६७ ॥ उसके चतुर्थाशमें चन्द्रमा हों तो यज्ञोपवीत लेनेवाला बालक विद्यामें निपुण होता है; किंतु यदि वह पापग्रहके अंशमें

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यन्ते विस्फुलिङ्गाश्च गोगजाश्वोष्ट्रगात्रतः । जन्तवो द्वित्रिशिरसो जायन्ते वापि योनिषु
verses.transliteration: dṛśyante visphuliṅgāśca gogajāśvoṣṭragātrataḥ / jantavo dvitriśiraso jāyante vāpi yoniṣu
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: अथवा अपने अंशमें हो तो यज्ञोपवीती द्विज सदा दरिद्र और दु:खी रहता है॥ ३६८ ॥ जब श्रवणादि नक्षत्रमें विद्यमान चन्द्रमा कर्कके अंश-विशेषयमें स्थित हो तो ब्रह्मचर्यत्रत ग्रहण करनेवाला द्विज

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः सूर्याश्चतसृषु ह्यर्दितायुगपद्रवेः । जम्बूकग्रामसंवासः केतूनां च प्रदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ sūryāścatasṛṣu hyarditāyugapadraveḥ / jambūkagrāmasaṃvāsaḥ ketūnāṃ ca pradarśanam
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: बेद, शास्त्र तथा धन-धान्य-समृद्धिसे सम्पन्न होता है॥२३६९॥ शुभ लग्र हो, शुभग्रहका अंश चल

verses.sanskrit: काकानामाकुलं रात्रौ कपोतानां दिवा यदि । अकाले पुष्पिता वृक्षा दृश्यन्ते फलिता यदि
verses.transliteration: kākānāmākulaṃ rātrau kapotānāṃ divā yadi / akāle puṣpitā vṛkṣā dṛśyante phalitā yadi
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: स्थान शुभग्रहोंसे संयुक्त हो अथवा उनपर शुभग्रहोंकी दृष्टि हो, अभीष्ट स्थानमें स्थित बृहस्पति, सूर्य और चन्द्रमा आदि पाँच बलवान ग्रहोंसे लग्नस्थान संयुक्त या दृष्ट हो अथवा स्थान आदिके बलसे

verses.sanskrit: कार्यं तच्छेदनं तत्र ततः शान्तिर्मनीषिभिः । एवमाद्या महोत्पाता बहवः स्थाननाशदा
verses.transliteration: kāryaṃ tacchedanaṃ tatra tataḥ śāntirmanīṣibhiḥ / evamādyā mahotpātā bahavaḥ sthānanāśadā
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: जाता हो और वह इक्कीस महादोषोंसे रहित हो

verses.sanskrit: केचिन्मृत्युप्रदाः केचिच्छत्रुभ्यश्च भयप्रदाः । मध्याद्भयं यशो मृत्युः क्षयः कीर्तिः सुखासुखम्
verses.transliteration: kecinmṛtyupradāḥ kecicchatrubhyaśca bhayapradāḥ / madhyādbhayaṃ yaśo mṛtyuḥ kṣayaḥ kīrtiḥ sukhāsukham
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: तो यज्ञोपवीत लेना शुभ है। शुभग्रहोंसे संयुक्त या दृष्ट सभी राशियाँ शुभ हैं ॥ ३७०--३७२ ॥ वे शुभ राशियाँ शुभ ग्रहके नवांशमें हों तो ब्रतबन्ध (यज्ञोपवीत) -में ग्राह्म हैं, किंतु कर्कराशिका अंश

verses.sanskrit: ऐस्वर्यं धनहानिं च मधुच्छन्नं च वाल्मिकम् । इत्यादिषु च सर्वेषूत्पातेषु द्विजसत्तम
verses.transliteration: aisvaryaṃ dhanahāniṃ ca madhucchannaṃ ca vālmikam / ityādiṣu ca sarveṣūtpāteṣu dvijasattama
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: शुभ ग्रहसे युक्त तथा दृष्ट हो तो भी कभी ग्रहण करने योग्य नहीं है॥ ३७३ ॥ इसलिये वृष और मिथुनके अंश तथा तुला और कन्याके अंश शुभ हैं। इस प्रकार लग्नगत नवांश होनेपर ब्रतबन्ध

verses.sanskrit: शान्तिं कुर्यात्प्रयत्नेन कल्पोक्तविधिना शुभम् । इत्येतत्कथितं विप्र ज्यौतिषं ते समासतः
verses.transliteration: śāntiṃ kuryātprayatnena kalpoktavidhinā śubham / ityetatkathitaṃ vipra jyautiṣaṃ te samāsataḥ
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: उत्तम बताया गया है॥ ३७४॥ तीसरे, छठे और ग्यारहवें स्थानमें पापग्रह हों, छठा, आठवाँ और बारहवाँ स्थान शुभग्रहसे खाली हो और चन्द्रमा छठे, आठवें, लग्न तथा बारहवें स्थानमें न हों तो

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि च्छन्दः शास्त्रमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi cchandaḥ śāstramanuttamam
verses.translation: O sage! I have lightly indicated to you the charac¬ teristics of Chandas dstra (the Science of Prosody). The details of subtle varieties of Prastir as are infinite.
verses.hindi: उपनयन शुभ होता है॥३७५॥ चन्द्रमा अपने उच्च स्थानमें होकर भी यदि ब्रती पुरुषके ब्रतबन्ध- मुहूर्त-सम्बन्धी लग्रमें स्थित हो तो वह उस बालकको निर्धन और क्षयका रोगी बना देता है॥३७६॥

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्न।पूर्व।बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयपादे षट्पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः सनन्दन उवाच वैदिकं लौकिकं चापि छन्दो द्विविधमुच्यते । मात्रावर्णविभेदेन तच्चापि द्विविधं पुनः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhanna.pūrva.bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde ṣaṭpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ sanandana uvāca vaidikaṃ laukikaṃ cāpi chando dvividhamucyate / mātrāvarṇavibhedena taccāpi dvividhaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Prasi&ra —A UbuUr represenlAtton of the long and short
verses.hindi: यदि सूर्य केन्द्रस्थानमें प्रकाशित हों तो यज्ञोपवीत लेनेवाले बालकोंके पिताका नाश हो जाता है। पाँच दोषोंसे रहित लग्न उपनयनमें शुभदायक होता है ॥ ३७७ ॥ वसन्‍्त-ऋतुके सिवा और कभी

verses.sanskrit: मयौ रसौ तजौ भनौ गुरुर्लघुरपिद्विज । कारणं छन्दसि प्रोक्ताश्छन्दःशास्त्रविशारदैः
verses.transliteration: mayau rasau tajau bhanau gururlaghurapidvija / kāraṇaṃ chandasi proktāśchandaḥśāstraviśāradaiḥ
verses.translation: Pratidro nfam 4k4dtigakriyAh /
verses.hindi: कृष्णपक्षमें, गलग्रहमें, अनध्यायके दिन, भद्रामें तथा षष्ठीको बालकका उपनयन-संस्कार नहीं होना चाहिए॥ ३७८ ॥ त्रयोदशीसे लेकर चार, सप्तमीसे लेकर तीन दिन और चतुर्थी ये आठ गलग्रह

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगो मगणः प्रोक्तो मुखलो यगणः स्मृतः । मध्यलो रगणश्वैव प्रान्त्यगः सगणो मतः

verses.transliteration: āditrike dvicaturthe samamarddhasamaṃ tatam / lakṣma bhinnaṃ yasya pādacatuṣke viṣamaṃ hi tat

verses.transliteration: ekākṣarātsamārabhya varṇaikaikasya vṛddhitaḥ / ṣaḍviṃśatyakṣaraṃ yāvatpādastāvatpṛthak pṛthak

verses.transliteration: ityetatkiñcidākhyātaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ chandasāṃ nune / prastāroktaprabhedānāṃ nāmānāṃstyaṃ pragāhate
verses.translation: These last 5 verses ofthb Chapter of the NP. are the same as those in Ked&ra Bhatta's Vriia Patndkara. It appears that both NP. and Ked&ra Bhatta used a common source. For the interpretation of above verses, I have used the Comm. VftlaratndkantpatUM on Vftta Ratnikara by the Simhali scholar Sitaskandha Mabg Sthavira (Nimaya Sagar Edt., 1906).
verses.hindi: छुरी या तलवारकी मुट्ठीकी ओर पूर्व और अग्रकी ओर अन्त समझना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयपादे सङ्क्षिप्तच्छन्दोवर्णनं नाम सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः नारद उवाच अनूचानप्रसंगेन वेदाङ्गान्यखिलानि च । श्रुतानि त्वन्मुखांभोजात्समासव्यासयोगतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyapāde saṅkṣiptacchandovarṇanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca anūcānaprasaṃgena vedāṅgānyakhilāni ca / śrutāni tvanmukhāṃbhojātsamāsavyāsayogataḥ
verses.translation: 'Your son shall be as pure as the Fire, as the Wind, as the Earth, as the Water and as the Sky.
verses.hindi: पापग्रह हो और वह नीचराशिमें पापग्रहसे देखा जाता हो तो वह कन्या कुलटा स्वभाववाली अथवा मृतवत्सा होती है, इसमें संशय नहीं है॥ ३९८--४०० ॥ यदि प्रश्नलग्नसे ३, ५, ७, ११

verses.sanskrit: शुकोत्पत्तिं समाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण महामते । सनन्दन उवाच मेरुशृङ्गे किल पुरा कर्णिकारवनायते
verses.transliteration: śukotpattiṃ samācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate / sanandana uvāca meruśṛṅge kila purā karṇikāravanāyate
verses.translation: He will be the partaker of consciousness of himself being the Brahman; his intelligence and mind shall be con¬ centrated on the Brahman; he shall be permanently established in the Brahman. By dint of his (Brahmanic) splendour, he will be renowned all over the three worlds.'*
verses.hindi: और १९० वें भावमें चन्द्रमा हो तथा उसपर गुरुकी दृष्टि हो तो समझना चाहिए कि उस कन्याको शीघ्र ही पतिकी प्राप्ति होगी ॥ ४०१ ॥ यदि प्रश्नलग्रमें तुला, वृष या कर्क राशि हो तथा वह शुक्र और

verses.sanskrit: विजहार महोदेवो भौमैभूतगणैवृतः । शैलराजसुता चैव देवी तत्राभवत्पुरा
verses.transliteration: vijahāra mahodevo bhaumaibhūtagaṇaivṛtaḥ / śailarājasutā caiva devī tatrābhavatpurā
verses.translation: After having obtained that excellent boon from the Lord, Vyasa, the son of Satyavatl, was one day engaged in churning the sacrificial sticks, with the desire of making a Are (for sacriAcial purpose).
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमासे युक्त हो तो विवाहके विषयमें प्रश्न करनेपर वरके लिये कन्या (पत्नी) लाभ होता है अथवा सम राशि लग्न हो, उसमें समराशिका ही द्रेष्काण हो और सम राशिका नवमांश तथा उसपर

verses.sanskrit: तत्र दिव्यं तपस्तेपे कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः । योगेनात्मानमाविश्य योगधर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: tatra divyaṃ tapastepe kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ / yogenātmānamāviśya yogadharmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: At that time, the illustrious sage happened to see a heavenly damsel called Ghrtaci who, in consequence of her brilliant splendour, possessed excellent beauty.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमा और शुक्रकी दृष्टि हो तो वरको पत्नीकी प्राप्ति होती है ॥ ४०२-४०३॥

verses.sanskrit: धारयन्स तपस्तेपे पुत्रार्थं सुनिसंत्तमः । अग्नेर्भूमेस्तथा वायोरन्तरिक्षस्य चाभितः
verses.transliteration: dhārayansa tapastepe putrārthaṃ sunisaṃttamaḥ / agnerbhūmestathā vāyorantarikṣasya cābhitaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that celestial damsel, in that forest, the great sage Vyasa became instantly passionately enamoured of her.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार यदि प्रश्नलग्रमें पुरुषराशि और पुरुषराशिका नवमांश हो तथा उसपर पुरुषग्रह (रवि, मड्गल और गुरु)-की दृष्टि हो तो जिनके लिये प्रश्न किया गया है, उन कन्याओंको पतिकी

verses.sanskrit: वीर्येण संमतः पुत्रो मम भूयादिति स्म ह । संकल्पेनाथ सो ऽनेन दुष्प्रापमकगृतात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: vīryeṇa saṃmataḥ putro mama bhūyāditi sma ha / saṃkalpenātha so 'nena duṣprāpamakagṛtātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: After making Vy deeply agitated with passion, the most beautiful Ghrt4cl, transforming herself into a she- parrot, approached him.
verses.hindi: यदि प्रश्नसमयमें कृष्णपक्ष हो और चन्द्रमा सम राशिमें होकर लग्रसे छठे या आठवें भावमें पापग्रहसे देखा जाता हो तो (निकट भविष्यमें) विवाह-सम्बन्ध नहीं हो पाता है॥४०५॥ यदि प्रश्रकालमें शुभ निमित्त और शुभ शकुन देखने- सुननेमें आवें तो बर-कन्याके लिये शुभ होता है

verses.sanskrit: वरयामास देवेशमास्थितस्तप उत्तमम् । अतिष्टन्मारुताहारः शतं किल समाः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: varayāmāsa deveśamāsthitastapa uttamam / atiṣṭanmārutāhāraḥ śataṃ kila samāḥ prabhuḥ

verses.sanskrit: आराधयन्महादेवं बहुरूपमुमापतिम् । तत्र ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव सर्वे देवर्षयस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ārādhayanmahādevaṃ bahurūpamumāpatim / tatra brahmarṣayaścaiva sarve devarṣayastathā
verses.translation: With great (moral) mragc, the sage tried to restrain his passion. But his mind being extremely agitated Vy was unable to control it.
verses.hindi: लेकर कन्याके घरमें जाय और विनीत भावसे कन्याका वरण करे। (कन्याका वरण वरके बड़े भाई अथवा गुरुजनको करना चाहिए।) उसके बाद कन्याका पिता प्रसन्नचित्त होकर अभीष्ट

verses.sanskrit: लोकपालाश्च साध्याश्च वसुभिश्चाष्टभिः सह । आदित्याश्चैव रुद्राश्च दिवाकरनिशाकरौ
verses.transliteration: lokapālāśca sādhyāśca vasubhiścāṣṭabhiḥ saha / ādityāścaiva rudrāśca divākaraniśākarau
verses.translation: * The Cahga, the greatest of all rivers, assumed her (godly) form and coming to the top of theMeru bathed 6uka (with her own waters after his birth), O Narada.
verses.hindi: वरको कन्यादान करे ॥ ४०७--४०९ ॥

verses.sanskrit: विश्वा वसुश्च गन्धर्वः सिद्धाश्चाप्सरासांगणाः । तत्र रुद्रो महादेवः कर्णिकारमयीं शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: viśvā vasuśca gandharvaḥ siddhāścāpsarāsāṃgaṇāḥ / tatra rudro mahādevaḥ karṇikāramayīṃ śubhām
verses.translation: There fell from the sky to the ground a deer-skin garment for Suka (to wear it). The Gandharvas constantly performed their musical concerts and the various groups of celestial nymphs indulged in dances.
verses.hindi: कन्याके पिताको चाहिए कि अपनी कन्यासे श्रेष्ठ कुल, शील, वयस्, रूप, धन और विद्यासे युक्त वरको वरके वयसूसे छोटी रूपवती अपनी कन्या दे। कन्यादानसे पूर्व सब गुणोंकी आश्रयभूता,

verses.sanskrit: धारयानः स्रजं भाति शारदीव निशाकरः । तस्निन् दिव्ये वने रम्ये देवदेवर्षिसंकुले
verses.transliteration: dhārayānaḥ srajaṃ bhāti śāradīva niśākaraḥ / tasnin divye vane ramye devadevarṣisaṃkule
verses.translation: Desirous as he was of the highest beatitude and endowed with humility as he was, he bowed down to him and requested him: 'You are an expert in the religious path that leads to Emancipation from Samsara. May you be pleased to elucidate that to me, so that I may be blessed with Supreme tranquility of mind.'*
verses.hindi: तीनों लोकोंमें सबसे अधिक सुन्दरी, दिव्य गन्ध, माला और वस्त्रसे सुशोभित, सम्पूर्ण शुभ लक्षणोंसे युक्त तथा सब आभूषणोंसे मण्डित, अमूल्य मणिमालाओंसे दसों दिशाओंको प्रकाशित करती

verses.transliteration: āsthitaḥ paramaṃ yogaṃ vyāsaḥ putrārthamudyataḥ / na cāsya hīyate varṇo na glānirupajāyate
verses.translation: Though he had the capabiUty of traversing through the sky the whole of the earth alongwith the oceans, he crossed on foot the mountains and reached the sub*continent called Bharata.

verses.transliteration: trayāṇāmapilokānāṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat / jaṭāśca tejasā tasya vaiśvānaraśikhopamāḥ
verses.translation: When he arrived atthegateof (Janaka's) palace he was stopped by the door-keepers. The great Yogin stood there unaffected by hunger or thint.
verses.hindi: आप सौभाग्य, आरोग्य और पुत्र प्रदान करें।”' इस प्रकार प्रार्थगा करके पूजाके बाद विधानपूर्वक ऊपर कहे हुए गुणयुक्त वरके लिये अपनी कुमारी कन्याका दान करे॥ ४१०--४१४॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रज्वलन्त्यः स्म दृश्यन्ते युक्तस्यामिततेजसः । एवं विधेन तपसा तस्य भक्त्या च नारद
verses.transliteration: prajvalantyaḥ sma dṛśyante yuktasyāmitatejasaḥ / evaṃ vidhena tapasā tasya bhaktyā ca nārada

He worshipped Suka with due formalities and paying obeisance to him with his palms joined, led him to the second apartment of the king's palace.

verses.transliteration: yathā hyagniyathā vāyuryathā bhūmiryathā jalam / yathā khe ca tathā śuddho bhaviṣyati sutastaṃva
verses.translation: All those damsels were young, beautful-looking with fine tresses of hair, possessing excellent hips, clad in red clothes of fine texture and decked with ornaments of burnished gold.
verses.hindi: और ज्येष्ट--ये चार मास विवाहमें श्रेष्ठ तथा कार्तिक और मार्गशीर्ष ये दो मास मध्यम हैं। अन्य मास निन्दित हैं॥४१६॥

verses.transliteration: tadbhāvabhāgī tadbuddhistadātmā tadupāśrayaḥ / tejasā tasya lokāṃstrīnyaśaḥ prāpsyati kevalam

verses.sanskrit: सा तु कृत्वा तदा व्यासं कामसंविग्नमानसम् । शुकीभूया महारम्या घृताची समुपागमत्
verses.transliteration: sā tu kṛtvā tadā vyāsaṃ kāmasaṃvignamānasam / śukībhūyā mahāramyā ghṛtācī samupāgamat

They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.

verses.sanskrit: स तामप्सरसं दृष्ट्वा रूपेणान्येनसंवृताम् । स्मरराजेनानुगतः सर्वगात्रातिगेन ह
verses.transliteration: sa tāmapsarasaṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpeṇānyenasaṃvṛtām / smararājenānugataḥ sarvagātrātigena ha

They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: ( गुरु तथा शुक्रके बाल्य और वृद्धत्व-- ) शुक्र जब पश्चिममें उदय होता है तो दस दिन और पूर्वमें उदय होता है तो तीन दिन तक बालक रहता है तथा जब पश्चिममें अस्त होनेको

verses.sanskrit: स तु महता निगृह्णन् हृच्छयं मुनिः । न शशाक नियन्तुं तं व्यासः प्रविसृतं मनः
verses.transliteration: sa tu mahatā nigṛhṇan hṛcchayaṃ muniḥ / na śaśāka niyantuṃ taṃ vyāsaḥ pravisṛtaṃ manaḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: रहता है तो अस्तसे पाँच दिन पहले और पूर्वमें अस्त होनेसे पंद्रह दिन पहले वृद्ध हो जाता है। गुरु उदयके बाद पंद्रह दिन बालक और अस्तसे पहले पंद्रह दिन वृद्ध रहता है॥४१९॥

verses.sanskrit: भावित्वाञ्चैव भाव्यस्य घृताच्या वपुषा । हृतम् यत्नान्नियच्छतश्चापि मुने एतञ्चिकीर्षया
verses.transliteration: bhāvitvāñcaiva bhāvyasya ghṛtācyā vapuṣā / hṛtam yatnānniyacchataścāpi mune etañcikīrṣayā

verses.sanskrit: अरण्यामेव सहसा तस्य शुक्रमवापतत् । शुक्रे निर्मथ्यमाने ऽस्यां शुको जज्ञे महातपाः
verses.transliteration: araṇyāmeva sahasā tasya śukramavāpatat / śukre nirmathyamāne 'syāṃ śuko jajñe mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: जन्ममास, जन्मनक्षत्र और जन्म-तिथि-वारमें भी विवाह नहीं करना चाहिए। आद्य गर्भकी कन्या और आइद्य गर्भके वरका परस्पर विवाह नहीं कराना चाहिए तथा वर-कन्यामें कोई एक ही

verses.sanskrit: परमर्षिर्महायोगी अरणीगर्भसंभवः । यथैव हि समिद्धो ऽग्निर्भाति हव्यमुपात्तवान्
verses.transliteration: paramarṣirmahāyogī araṇīgarbhasaṃbhavaḥ / yathaiva hi samiddho 'gnirbhāti havyamupāttavān
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठ (आद्य गर्भका) हो तो ज्येष्ठ मासमें विवाह श्रेष्ठ है। यदि दोनों ज्येष्ट हों तो ज्येष्ठ मासमें विवाह अनिष्टकारक कहा गया है ॥४२१-४२२॥

verses.sanskrit: तथा रूपः शुको जज्ञे प्रज्वलन्निव तेजसा । बिभ्रञ्चित्रं च विप्रेन्द्र रूपवर्णमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tathā rūpaḥ śuko jajñe prajvalanniva tejasā / bibhrañcitraṃ ca viprendra rūpavarṇamanuttamam
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: ( विवाहमें वर्ज्य-- ) भूकम्पादि उत्पात तथा सर्वग्रास सूर्यग्रहण या चन्द्रग्रहण हो तो उसके बाद सात दिनतकका समय शुभ नहीं है। यदि खण्डग्रहण हो तो उसके बाद तीन दिन अशुभ

verses.sanskrit: तं गङ्गां सरितां श्रेष्ठां मेरुपृष्ठे स्वरूपिणीम् । अभ्येत्य स्नापयामास वारिणा स्वेन नारद
verses.transliteration: taṃ gaṅgāṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ merupṛṣṭhe svarūpiṇīm / abhyetya snāpayāmāsa vāriṇā svena nārada
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: होते हैं। तीन दिनका स्पर्श करनेवाली (वृद्धि)

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाजिनं चान्तरिक्षाच्छुकार्थे भुव्यवापतत् । जगीयन्त च गन्धर्वा ननृतुञ्चाप्सरोगणाः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇājinaṃ cāntarikṣācchukārthe bhuvyavāpatat / jagīyanta ca gandharvā nanṛtuñcāpsarogaṇāḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयश्चैव प्रावाद्यन्त महास्वनाः । विश्वावसुश्च गन्धर्वस्तथा तुंबुरुनारदौ
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayaścaiva prāvādyanta mahāsvanāḥ / viśvāvasuśca gandharvastathā tuṃburunāradau
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: १.आषाढ़ शुक्ला ११ से कार्तिक शुक्ला ११ तक भगवान् हषीकेशके शयनका काल है। २.अर्थात् गोचरबल एक, वेधबल दो और अष्टकवर्ग-बल तीनके बराबर है।

verses.sanskrit: हाहाहूहूश्च गन्धर्वौं तुष्टुवुः शुकसंभवम् । तत्र शक्रपुरोगाश्च लोकपालाः समागताः
verses.transliteration: hāhāhūhūśca gandharvauṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ śukasaṃbhavam / tatra śakrapurogāśca lokapālāḥ samāgatāḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: ३.जातक अध्यायमें देखिये। अभिप्राय यह है कि नक्षत्रविहित (गुणयुक्त) न मिले तो उसका मुहूर्त लेना चाहिए। यदि लग्नराशि निर्बल हो तो उसके नवमांश आदिका बल देखकर निर्बल लग्नको भी प्रशस्त समझना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: देवा देवर्षथयश्चटैव तथा ब्रह्मर्षयो ऽपि च । दिव्यानि सर्वपुष्पाणि प्रववर्ष च मारुतः
verses.transliteration: devā devarṣathayaścaṭaiva tathā brahmarṣayo 'pi ca / divyāni sarvapuṣpāṇi pravavarṣa ca mārutaḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: शुभप्रद होता है। यदि चार ग्रह भी बली हों तो भी उन्हें शुभप्रद ही समझना चाहिए॥ ४३२-४३३ ॥

verses.sanskrit: जङ्गमं स्थावरं चैव प्रहृष्टमभवज्जगत् । तं महात्मा स्वयं प्रीत्या देव्या सह महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ caiva prahṛṣṭamabhavajjagat / taṃ mahātmā svayaṃ prītyā devyā saha mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: मुने! जामित्र (लग्रसे सप्तम स्थान) शुद्ध (ग्रहवर्जित) हो तथा लग्न इक्कीस दोषोंसे रहित हो तो उसे विवाहमें ग्रहण करना चाहिए। अब मैं उन इक्कीस दोषोंके नाम, स्वरूप और फलका

verses.sanskrit: जातमात्रं मुनेः पुत्रं विधिनोपानयत्तदा । तस्य देवेश्वरः शक्तो दिव्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: jātamātraṃ muneḥ putraṃ vidhinopānayattadā / tasya deveśvaraḥ śakto divyamadbhutadarśanam
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: ( विवाहके इक्‍्कीस दोष-- ) पश्चाड्ग-शुद्धिका न होना, यह प्रथम दोष कहा गया है। उदयास्तकी शुद्धिका न होना २, उस दिन सूर्यकी संक्रान्तिका होना ३, पापग्रहका षड्वर्गमें रहना ४, लग्नसे छठे भावमें शुक्रकी स्थिति ५, अष्टममें मड्रलका रहना ६, गण्डान्त होना ७, कर्तरीयोग ८, बारहवें, छठे

verses.sanskrit: ददौ कमण्डलुं प्रीत्या देवा वासांसि चाभितः । हंसाश्च शतपत्राश्च सारसाश्च सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: dadau kamaṇḍaluṃ prītyā devā vāsāṃsi cābhitaḥ / haṃsāśca śatapatrāśca sārasāśca sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: खार्जूर १४, नक्षत्रेकचरण १५, ग्रहण और उत्पातके नक्षत्र १६, पापग्रहसे विद्ध नक्षत्र १७, पापसे युक्त नक्षत्र १८, पापग्रहका नवमांश १९, महापात २० और वैधृति २१--विवाहमें ये २१ दोष कहे गये

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणमवर्तन्त शुकाश्चाषाश्च नारद । आरणे यस्तदा दिव्यं प्राप्य जन्म महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇamavartanta śukāścāṣāśca nārada / āraṇe yastadā divyaṃ prāpya janma mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: मुने! तिथि, वार, नक्षत्र, योग और करण-- इन पाँचोंका मेल “पश्ञाड़” कहलाता है। उसकी शुद्धि 'पच्चाड़ शुद्धि कहलाती है। जिस दिन पञ्चाड़के दोष हों, उस दिन विवाहलग्न बनाना निरर्थक है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैवोवास मेधावी व्रतचारी समाहितः । उत्पन्नमात्रं तं वेदाः सरहस्याः ससंग्रहाः
verses.transliteration: tatraivovāsa medhāvī vratacārī samāhitaḥ / utpannamātraṃ taṃ vedāḥ sarahasyāḥ sasaṃgrahāḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकारका लग्र यदि पाँच इष्ट ग्रहोंसे युक्त हो तो भी उसको विषमिश्रित दूधके समान त्याग देना चाहिए॥४३९-४४०- ॥ लग्न या उसके नवमांश अपने-अपने स्वामीसे युक्त या दृष्ट न हों

verses.sanskrit: उपतस्थुर्मुनिश्रेष्ठं यथास्य पितरं तथा । बृहस्पतिं स वव्रे च वेदवेदाङ्गभाष्यवित्
verses.transliteration: upatasthurmuniśreṣṭhaṃ yathāsya pitaraṃ tathā / bṛhaspatiṃ sa vavre ca vedavedāṅgabhāṣyavit
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: अथवा परस्पर (लग्नेशसे नवमांश और नवमांशपतिसे लग्नेश) युक्त या दृष्ट न हों अथवा अपने स्वामीके शुभग्रह मित्रसे युक्त या दृष्ट न हों तो वरके लिये

verses.sanskrit: उपाध्यायं द्विजश्रेष्ठ धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन् । सो ऽधीत्य वेदानखिलान्सरहस्यान्ससंग्रहान्
verses.transliteration: upādhyāyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha dharmamevānucintayan / so 'dhītya vedānakhilānsarahasyānsasaṃgrahān
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. verses.sanskrit: प्रावेशयत्ततः कक्षआं द्वितीयां राजवेश्मनः । तत्रान्तःपुरसंबद्धं महच्चैत्रग्थोपमम्
verses.transliteration: prāveśayattataḥ kakṣaāṃ dvitīyāṃ rājaveśmanaḥ / tatrāntaḥpurasaṃbaddhaṃ mahaccaitragthopamam
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: लग्न शुभग्रहसे युक्त हो तो भी उस लग्नको, उस नवमांशसे युक्त लग्नबको अथवा उसके स्वामीको यत्रपूर्वक त्याग देना चाहिए॥ ४६०-४६१५ ॥

verses.sanskrit: सुविभक्तजलाक्रीडं रम्यं पुष्पितपादपम् । दर्शयित्वासने स्थाप्य राजानं च व्यजिज्ञपत्
verses.transliteration: suvibhaktajalākrīḍaṃ ramyaṃ puṣpitapādapam / darśayitvāsane sthāpya rājānaṃ ca vyajijñapat
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: ( द्वादश राशिदोष ) वर-वधूके जन्म-लग्र या जन्मराशिसे द्वादश राशि यदि विवाह-लग्रमें पड़े तो वर-वधूके धनकी हानि होती है। इसलिये उस लग्रको, उसके नवमांशको और उसके स्वामीको

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा राजा शुकं प्राप्तं वारस्त्रीः स न्ययुङ्क्त च । सेवायै तस्य भावस्य ज्ञानाय मुनिसतम
verses.transliteration: śrutvā rājā śukaṃ prāptaṃ vārastrīḥ sa nyayuṅkta ca / sevāyai tasya bhāvasya jñānāya munisatama
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: (जन्मलग्न और जन्मराशिकी प्रशंसा-- ) जन्म- राशि और जन्मलग्रका उदय विवाहमें शुभ होता है तथा दोनोंके उपचय (३, ६, १०, ११) स्थान यदि विवाह-लग्नमें हो तो अत्यन्त शुभप्रद होते हैं ॥४६३- ॥

verses.sanskrit: तं चारुकेश्यः शुश्रेण्यस्तरुण्यः प्रियदर्शनाः । सूक्ष्मरक्तांबरधरास्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः
verses.transliteration: taṃ cārukeśyaḥ śuśreṇyastaruṇyaḥ priyadarśanāḥ / sūkṣmaraktāṃbaradharāstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.

verses.sanskrit: संलापालापकुशाला भावज्ञाः सर्वकोविदाः । परं पञ्चाशतस्तस्य पाद्यादीनि व्यकल्पयन्
verses.transliteration: saṃlāpālāpakuśālā bhāvajñāḥ sarvakovidāḥ / paraṃ pañcāśatastasya pādyādīni vyakalpayan
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.

verses.sanskrit: देश कालोपपन्नेन साध्वन्नेनाप्यतर्पयन् । तस्य भुक्तवतस्तात तास्ततः पुरकाननम्
verses.transliteration: deśa kālopapannena sādhvannenāpyatarpayan / tasya bhuktavatastāta tāstataḥ purakānanam
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: धनिष्ठाका १०, शतभिषाका १८, पूर्व भाद्रपदका १६, उत्तर भाद्रपदका २४ और रेवतीका धुवाडू ३० है। इन अश्विनी आदि नक्षत्रोंक अपने-अपने ध्रुवाड्ड तुल्य घड़ीके बाद ४ घड़ीतक विषघटी

verses.sanskrit: सुरम्यं दर्शयामासुरेकैकत्वेन नारद । क्रीडन्त्यश्च हसंत्यश्च गायन्त्यश्चैव ताः शुकम्
verses.transliteration: suramyaṃ darśayāmāsurekaikatvena nārada / krīḍantyaśca hasaṃtyaśca gāyantyaścaiva tāḥ śukam
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: होती है। विवाह आदि शुभ कार्योंमें विषधटिकाओंका

verses.sanskrit: उदारसत्वं सत्वज्ञाःसर्वाः पर्य्यचरंस्तदा । आरणेयस्तु शुद्धात्मा जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: udārasatvaṃ satvajñāḥsarvāḥ paryyacaraṃstadā / āraṇeyastu śuddhātmā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: । करना चाहिए' ॥ ४६४--४६८ ॥ रवि आदि वारोंमें जो मुहूर्त निन्दित कहा गया है, वह यदि अन्य लाख गुणोंसे युक्त हो तो भी विवाह आदि शुभ कार्योमें वर्जनीय ही है॥ ४६९ ॥

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानस्थ एव सततं न हृष्यति न कुप्यति । पादशौचं तु कृत्वा वै शुकः संध्यामुपास्य च
verses.transliteration: dhyānastha eva satataṃ na hṛṣyati na kupyati / pādaśaucaṃ tu kṛtvā vai śukaḥ saṃdhyāmupāsya ca
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: रवि आदि दिनोंमें जो-जो वार-दोष कहे गये हैं, वे अन्य सब गुणोंसे युक्त हों तो भी शुभ कार्यमें वर्जनीय हैं ॥ ४७० ॥

verses.sanskrit: निषसादासने पुण्ये तमेवार्थं व्यचिन्तयत् । पूर्वरात्रे तु तत्रासौ भूत्वा ध्यानपरायणः
verses.transliteration: niṣasādāsane puṇye tamevārthaṃ vyacintayat / pūrvarātre tu tatrāsau bhūtvā dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रके जिस चरणमें पूर्वोक्त 'एकार्गल दोष' हो, उस चरण (नवांश)-से युक्त जो लग्न हो उसमें यदि गुरु, शुक्रका योग हो तो भी विषयुक्त दूधके समान उसको त्याग देना चाहिए॥ ४७१॥

verses.sanskrit: मध्यरात्रे यथान्याय्यं निद्रामाहारयत्प्रभुः । ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय कृत्वा शौचमनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: madhyarātre yathānyāyyaṃ nidrāmāhārayatprabhuḥ / tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtvā śaucamanantaram
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: ग्रहण तथा उत्पातसे दूषित नक्षत्रको तीन ऋतु (छ: मास)-तक शुभ कार्यमें छोड़ देना चाहिए। जब चन्द्रमा उस नक्षत्रको भोगकर छोड़ दे तो वह नक्षत्र जली हुई लकड़ीके समान निष्फल हो

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीभिः परिवृत्तो धीमान्ध्यानमेवान्वपद्यत । अनेन विधिना तत्र तदहःशेषमप्युत
verses.transliteration: strībhiḥ parivṛtto dhīmāndhyānamevānvapadyata / anena vidhinā tatra tadahaḥśeṣamapyuta
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: जाता है अर्थात् दोष-कारक नहीं रह जाता। शुभ कार्योमें ग्रहसे विद्ध और पापग्रहसे युक्त सम्पूर्ण नक्षत्रकों मदिरामिश्रित पञ्मगव्यके समान त्याग देना चाहिए; परंतु यदि नक्षत्र शुभग्रहसे विद्ध हो

verses.sanskrit: तां च रात्रिं नृपकुले वर्तयामास नारद
verses.transliteration: tāṃ ca rātriṃ nṛpakule vartayāmāsa nārada
verses.translation: All of them were experts in agreeable conversa* tion, competent to read the minds of man and skilled in all (amorous) acts. They were more than fifty. They arranged for his reception with water for washing feet etc. They gratified him with such articles of food as were agreeable in the season.
verses.hindi: तो उसका विद्ध चरणमात्र त्याज्य है, सम्पूर्ण

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने द्वितीयभागे शुकप्रलोभनं नामाष्टञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः सनन्दन उवाच ततः स राजा सहितो मन्त्रिभिर्द्विजसत्तम । पुरः पुरोहितं कृत्वा सर्वाण्यन्तः पुराणि च
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne dvitīyabhāge śukapralobhanaṃ nāmāṣṭañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ sanandana uvāca tataḥ sa rājā sahito mantribhirdvijasattama / puraḥ purohitaṃ kṛtvā sarvāṇyantaḥ purāṇi ca
verses.translation: At the command of my father, I have therefore, come hereto you to discuss with you (these matten). Hence, it behoves you, O foremost among the upholden of dhama to instruct me precisely.
verses.hindi: कन्या और धनुका उत्तरार्ध तथा इन राशियोंके नवमांश विवाहलग्रमें शुभप्रद हैं। किसी भी लग्रमें अन्तिम नवमांश यदि वर्गोत्तम हो तभी उसे शुभप्रद समझना चाहिए'  अन्यथा विवाह-लग्रका अन्तिम

verses.sanskrit: शिरसा चार्ध्यमादाय गुरुपुत्रं समभ्यगात् । महदासनमादाय सर्वरत्नविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: śirasā cārdhyamādāya guruputraṃ samabhyagāt / mahadāsanamādāya sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
verses.translation: What should be done by a Brahmaria here? What is the essence of those religious duties which are conducive to Liberation? How is the Liberation (fromSarhsara) to be achiev* ed? Is it obtainable by (spiritual) knowledge or by penance.
verses.hindi: नवमांश (२६ अंश ४० कलाके बाद) अशुभ होता है। यहाँ अन्य नवमांश नहीं ग्रहण करने चाहिए; क्योंकि वे 'कुनवांश' कहलाते हैं। लग्रमें कुनवांश हो तो अन्य सब गुणोंसे युक्त होनेपर भी

verses.sanskrit: प्रददौ गुरुपुत्राय शुकाय परमोचितम् । तत्रोपविष्टं तं कार्ष्णिशास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: pradadau guruputrāya śukāya paramocitam / tatropaviṣṭaṃ taṃ kārṣṇiśāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā
verses.translation: Listen tome, dear child, what are the duties of a fir&hma])a since his birth. After the investiture of the sacred thread, he should devote himself to the study of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: वह त्याज्य है। जिस दिन महापात (सूर्य-चन्द्रमाका क्रान्ति-साम्य) हो, वह दिन भी शुभ कार्यमें छोड़ देने योग्य है; क्योंकि वह अन्य सब गुणोंसे युक्त होनेपर भी वर-वधूके लिये घातक होता है।

verses.sanskrit: पाद्यं निवेद्य प्रथमं सार्घ्यं गां च न्यवेदयत् । स च तांमन्त्रतः पूजां प्रतिगृह्य द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: pādyaṃ nivedya prathamaṃ sārghyaṃ gāṃ ca nyavedayat / sa ca tāṃmantrataḥ pūjāṃ pratigṛhya dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: By performing penance, services to his preceptor and observance of celibacy and by remaining devoid of greed and jealousy, he should do his duties to Devas and Pitrs.
verses.hindi: इन दोषोंसे भिन्न विद्युतू, नीहार (कुहरा) और वृष्टि आदि दोष, जिनका अभी वर्णन नहीं किया गया है, 'स्वल्पदोष' कहलाते हैं ॥ ४७५--४७८ ॥

verses.sanskrit: पर्यपृच्छन्महातेजाराज्ञः कुशलमव्ययम् । उदारसत्त्वाभिजनो राजापि गुरुसूनवे
verses.transliteration: paryapṛcchanmahātejārājñaḥ kuśalamavyayam / udārasattvābhijano rājāpi gurusūnave
verses.translation: Having studied the Vedas regularly and controlled his senses, and after paying off the tuition*fee of his preceptor, and after taking the permission of his teacher he should formally conclude his stage of religious studentship (by performance of Samdvartona ceremony).
verses.hindi: दग्ध, अन्ध, बधिर तथा हैः के --इन राशियोंके लग्र', नक्षत्र नहीं; किंतु पापग्रहसे विद्ध नक्षत्र शुभकार्यमें  एवं छोटे-छोटे और भी दोष हैं; अब उनकी सम्पूर्ण रूपसे त्याग देने योग्य है॥ ४७२--४७४॥  व्यवस्थाका प्रतिपादन किया जाता है ॥ ४७९-४८० ॥

verses.sanskrit: आवेद्य कुशलं भूमौ निषसाद तदाज्ञया । सो ऽपि वैयासकिं भूयः पृष्ट्वा कुशलमव्ययम् । किमागमनिमित्येव पर्यपृच्छद्विधानवित्
verses.transliteration: āvedya kuśalaṃ bhūmau niṣasāda tadājñayā / so 'pi vaiyāsakiṃ bhūyaḥ pṛṣṭvā kuśalamavyayam / kimāgamanimityeva paryapṛcchadvidhānavit
verses.translation: After completion of the Somdoartana he should betake himself to the householder's stage of life. (After marriage) he should live in the company of his spouse, devoid of malice and jealousy, and he should duly and continuously maintain domestic (sacrificial) fire.*
verses.hindi: १. विशेष--यदि नक्षत्रका मान ६० घड़ी हो तब इतने ध्रुवाड्डु और उसके पंद्रहवें भाग चार घटीतक 'विषघटी ' का अवस्थान मध्यममानके अनुसार कहा गया है। इससे यह स्वयं सिद्ध होता है कि यदि नक्षत्रका मान ६० घड़ीसे अधिक या अल्प होगा तो विषघटीका मान और धुवाड्डू भी उसी अनुपातसे अधिक या कम हो जायगा तथा स्पष्ट भभोगमानका पंद्रहवाँ भाग ही विषघटीका स्पष्ट मान होगा।

verses.sanskrit: शुक उवाच पित्राहमुक्तो भद्रं ते मोक्षधर्मार्थकोविदः । विदेहराजोह्याद्योमे जनको नाम विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: śuka uvāca pitrāhamukto bhadraṃ te mokṣadharmārthakovidaḥ / videharājohyādyome janako nāma viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: After procreating sons and grandsons, he should retire as a hermit to a forest and continue to worship the same (domestic) sacrificial fires and receive lovingly guests with due hospitality.
verses.hindi: मान लीजिये कि पुनर्वसुका भभोगमान ५६ घड़ी है तो त्रैाराशिकसे अनुपात निकालिये। यदि ६० घड़ीमें ३० ध्रुवाड्ड तो इष्ट भभोग ५६ घड़ीमें क्या होगा ? इस प्रकार ५६ से ३० को गुणा करके ६० के द्वारा भाग देनेसे लब्धि २८ पुनर्वसुका स्पष्ट धरुवाड्ड हुआ तथा भभोग ५६ का पंद्रहवाँ भाग ३ घड़ी ४४ पल स्पष्ट 'विषघटी ' हुईं। इसलिये २८ घड़ीके बाद ३ घड़ी ४ पलतक विषघटी रहेगी।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र त्वं गच्छ तूर्णं वै स ते हृदयसंशयम् । प्रवृत्तौ च निवृत्तौ च सर्वं छेत्स्यत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: tatra tvaṃ gaccha tūrṇaṃ vai sa te hṛdayasaṃśayam / pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca sarvaṃ chetsyatyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: Thereafter, the knower of Dharma should establish all (sacrificial) fires within his soul and rising above the pair of opposites, and banishing all passionate attachment from his soul, he should pass his life in the stage of life called Brchmd- frama (or Sannyw).
verses.hindi: २. किसी भी राशिमें अपना ही नवमांश हो तो वह वर्गोत्तम कहलाता है। जैसे मेषमें मेषका नवमांश तथा वृषमें वृषका नवमांश इत्यादि।

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं पितुर्नियोगात्त्वा मुपप्रष्टुमिहागतः । तन्मे धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ piturniyogāttvā mupapraṣṭumihāgataḥ / tanme dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha yathāvadvaktumarhasi
verses.translation: (It may be true that) when perfect spiritual knowl¬ edge dawns and the eternal entity (the Brahman) is realised directly, {Moka) is automatically attained). But they say that attainment of (true spiritual) knowledge is not possible without direct association with and penonal stay with the spiritual preceptor.
verses.hindi: ३. सूर्य जिस नक्षत्रमें वर्तमान हो, उसमें ५, ७, ८, १०, १४, १५, १८, १९, २१, २२, २३, २४, २५--इन संख्याओंके किसी भी नक्षत्रमें चन्द्रमा हो तो 'उपग्रहदोष' कहलाता है।

verses.sanskrit: किं कार्यं ब्राह्मणेनेह मोक्षार्थश्च किमात्मकः । कथं च मोक्षः कर्तव्यो ज्ञानेन तपसापि वा
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇeneha mokṣārthaśca kimātmakaḥ / kathaṃ ca mokṣaḥ kartavyo jñānena tapasāpi vā
verses.translation: Is it necessary for a person to go through the three stages of life (studenthood, the life of a householder and that of a forest-hermit)? This is what I ask you. It behoves you to explain this.
verses.hindi: ४. सूर्य यदि धनु या मीनमें हो तो द्वितीया, वृष या कुम्भमें हो तो चतुर्थी, कर्क या मेषमें हो तो षष्ठी, कन्या या मिथुनमें हो तो अष्टमी, सिंह या वृश्चिकमें हो तो दशमी तथा तुला या मकरमें हो तो द्वादशी “दग्ध तिथि” कहलाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जनक उवाच यत्कार्यं ब्राह्मणेनेह जन्मप्रभृति तच्छुणु । कृतोपनयनस्तात भवेद्वेदपरायणः
verses.transliteration: janaka uvāca yatkāryaṃ brāhmaṇeneha janmaprabhṛti tacchuṇu / kṛtopanayanastāta bhavedvedaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: In order to prevent the annihilation of worlds and for forestalling the destruction of acts (on which the existence of the world depends), a person performs both auspicioxis and in¬ auspicious deeds. It is only after that, that the Liberation is achieved.
verses.hindi: ५. हर मीन, वृष, मिथुन, मेष, कन्या, तुला, वृश्चिक, धनु और कर्क--ये क्रमश: चैत्र आदि मासोंमें 'दग्ध

verses.sanskrit: तपसा गुरुवृत्त्या च ब्रह्मचर्येण चान्वितः । देवतानां पितॄणां च ह्यतृष्णश्चानसूयकः
verses.transliteration: tapasā guruvṛttyā ca brahmacaryeṇa cānvitaḥ / devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca hyatṛṣṇaścānasūyakaḥ
verses.translation: When (through performance of peoanee) one be¬ comes perfectly purified in one's soul, by means of purificatory causes* in the course of many births in the world, he attains Liberation from Sathsara even in the first {Brakmacarya) stage of iiie.
verses.hindi: वृष्टि (वर्षा)--ये यदि असमयमें हों तभी दोष समझे जाते हैं। यदि समयपर हों (जैसे जाड़ेके दिनमें पाला पड़े, वर्षा ऋतुमें वर्षा हो तथा सघन मेघमें बिजली चमके , तो सब शुभ ही समझे

verses.sanskrit: वेदानधीत्य नियतो दक्षिणामपवर्त्य च । अभ्यनुज्ञामनुप्राप्य समावर्तेत वै द्विजः
verses.transliteration: vedānadhītya niyato dakṣiṇāmapavartya ca / abhyanujñāmanuprāpya samāvarteta vai dvijaḥ
verses.translation: One should always cast off defects or faults caused by the attributes Rajas and Tomas. Adhering to the path characi-
verses.hindi: जाते हैं ॥ ४८१ ॥ यदि बृहस्पति, शुक्र अथवा बुध इनमेंसे एक भी केन्द्रमें हों तो इन सब दोषोंको नष्ट कर देते हैं। इसमें संशय नहीं है॥४८२॥

verses.sanskrit: समावृत्तस्तु गार्हस्थ्ये सदारो नियतो वसेत् । अनसूयुर्यथान्यायमाहिताग्निरनादृते
verses.transliteration: samāvṛttastu gārhasthye sadāro niyato vaset / anasūyuryathānyāyamāhitāgniranādṛte
verses.translation: Realizing his own soul in all created beings and beholding all creatures within his soul, he should behave (with* out being attached to anything in the Somsato) like an aquatic animal which does not become wet though moving through waters.
verses.hindi: ( पञ्चनशलाका-वेध--- ) पाँच रेखाएँ पड़ी और पाँच रेखाएँ खड़ी खींचकर दो-दो रेखाएँ कोणोंमें खींचने (बनाने)-से पद्चशलाका-चक्र' बनता है। इस चक्रके ईशान कोणवाली दूसरी रेखामें कृत्तिकाको

verses.sanskrit: उत्पाद्य पुत्रपौत्रांश्च वन्याश्रमपदे वसेत् । तानेवाग्नीन्यथान्यायं पूजयन्नतिथिप्रियः
verses.transliteration: utpādya putrapautrāṃśca vanyāśramapade vaset / tānevāgnīnyathānyāyaṃ pūjayannatithipriyaḥ
verses.translation: Transcending the pairs of opposite attributes and associated with auspiciousness, he becomes completely liberated (from Sarhsdra) after casting off the physical body and attains Infinity in the next world like a bird, soaring up high in the sky above (the currents of) the wind.
verses.hindi: लिखकर आगे प्रदक्षिण-क्रमसे रोहिणी आदि अभिजितूसहित सम्पूर्ण नक्षत्रोंका उल्लेख करे। जिस रेखामें ग्रह हो, उसी रेखाकी दूसरी ओरवाला नक्षत्र विद्धं समझा जाता है॥४८३-॥

verses.sanskrit: सर्वानग्नीन्यथान्यायमात्मन्यारोप्य धर्मवित् । निर्द्वन्द्वो वीतरागात्मा ब्रह्माश्रमपदे वसेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvānagnīnyathānyāyamātmanyāropya dharmavit / nirdvandvo vītarāgātmā brahmāśramapade vaset
verses.translation: In this context, listen to the Gdlhds sung in ancient times by King Yayaii, They are remembered in their hearts by all twice-borns who are experts in the philosophy of Liberation.
verses.hindi: अश्रित नक्षत्रसे आगे और पीछे १२, २२, ३, ७, ६, ५, ८ तथा ९ वें हैनिक नक्षत्रको लातोंसे दूषित करते हैं, इसलिये इसका नाम “लत्तादोष' है।

verses.sanskrit: शुक उवाच उत्पन्ने ज्ञानविज्ञाने प्रत्यक्षे हृदि शश्वते । न विना गुरुसंवासाज्ज्ञानस्याधिगमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śuka uvāca utpanne jñānavijñāne pratyakṣe hṛdi śaśvate / na vinā gurusaṃvāsājjñānasyādhigamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The resplendent lustre (i.e. the Supreme soul) is in one's soul. It is a jewel there itself. It is possible to be observed by oneself, but only with concentrated mind.
verses.hindi: ( पातदोष--- ) सूर्य जिस नक्षत्रमें हों उससे

verses.sanskrit: किमवश्यं तु वस्तव्यमाश्रमेषु न वा नृप । एतद्भवन्तं पृच्छामि तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: kimavaśyaṃ tu vastavyamāśrameṣu na vā nṛpa / etadbhavantaṃ pṛcchāmi tadbhavānvaktumarhati
verses.translation: He who behaves in such a way that others are not afraid of him and when a person b not inspired with fear at the sight of another penon, he who neither covets nor hates anything, attains to the Brahman.
verses.hindi: श्रवणतककी जितनी संख्या हो, उतनी ही यदि

verses.sanskrit: जनक उवाच न विना ज्ञानविज्ञाने मोक्षस्याधिगमो भवेत् ।। न विना गुरुसंबधाज्ज्ञानस्याधिगमस्तथा
verses.transliteration: janaka uvāca na vinā jñānavijñāne mokṣasyādhigamo bhavet /. na vinā gurusaṃbadhājjñānasyādhigamastathā
verses.translation: Just as a tortoise spreads out its limbs and withdraws again (within itself), in the same way, the sense-organs are to be restrained by the recluse through his mind.
verses.hindi: अश्विनीसे दिन-नक्षत्रतक गिननेसे संख्या हो तो वह नक्षत्र पातदोषसे दूषित समझा जाता है ॥ ४८४-४८५ ॥

verses.sanskrit: आचार्यः प्लाविता तस्य ज्ञानं प्लव इहोच्यते । विज्ञाय कृतकृत्यस्तु तीर्णस्तत्रोभयं त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: ācāryaḥ plāvitā tasya jñānaṃ plava ihocyate / vijñāya kṛtakṛtyastu tīrṇastatrobhayaṃ tyajet
verses.translation: Just as one's place of residence plunged in darkness is seen with (the light emanating from) a lamp, in the same manner it is possible to visuali 2 e the Atman with the brilliant light of intelligence.
verses.hindi: ( परिहार-- ) सौराष्ट्र (काठियावाड़) और शाल्वदेशमें लत्तादोष वर्जित है। कलिड्ड (जगन्नाथपुरीसे कृष्णा नदीतकके भूभाग), वड्ढ

verses.sanskrit: अनुच्छेदाय लोकानामनुच्छेदाय कर्मणाम् । कृत्वा शुभाशुभं कर्म मोक्षो नामेह लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: anucchedāya lokānāmanucchedāya karmaṇām / kṛtvā śubhāśubhaṃ karma mokṣo nāmeha labhyate
verses.translation: 1, however, can clearly see that you are endowed with all these (within you), O prominent one among the intelligents. If there be anything else to be known, your worship will know it fundamentally (and correctly).
verses.hindi: देशमें पातदोष त्याज्य हैं; अन्य देशोंमें ये दोष त्याज्य नहीं हैं ॥ ४८६-४८७ ॥ मासदग्ध तिथि तथा दग्ध लग्न--ये मध्यदेश (प्रयागसे पश्चिम, कुरुक्षेत्रसे पूर्व, विन्ध्य और हिमालयके मध्य) में वर्जित हैं।

verses.sanskrit: भावितैः कारणैश्चार्यं बहुसंसारयोनिषु । आसादयति शुद्धात्मा मोक्षं हि प्रथमाश्रमे
verses.transliteration: bhāvitaiḥ kāraṇaiścāryaṃ bahusaṃsārayoniṣu / āsādayati śuddhātmā mokṣaṃ hi prathamāśrame
verses.translation: O Brahmanicai sage, you are already famous as one who have transcended (lit. gone to the other end of) worldly objects of sense through the grace of your spiritual preceptor as well as through your penonal discipline (i.e. disciplined way of life).
verses.hindi: अन्य देशोंमें ये दूषित नहीं हैं॥४८८॥ पड्जु, अन्ध, काण, लग्र तथा मासोंमें जो शून्य राशियाँ कही गयी हैं, वे गौड़ (बड्भरालसे भुवनेश्वरतक) और मालव (मालवा) देशमें त्याज्य हैं। अन्य

verses.sanskrit: तमासाद्य तु मुक्तस्य दृष्टार्थस्य विपश्चितः । त्रिधाश्रमेषु कोन्वर्थो भवेत्परमभीप्सतः
verses.transliteration: tamāsādya tu muktasya dṛṣṭārthasya vipaścitaḥ / tridhāśrameṣu konvartho bhavetparamabhīpsataḥ
verses.translation: Maybe due to immaturity or due to doubts or fears caused by delusion, some people do not attain that spiritual goal {Moka) even though knowledge leading to Mok$a is dawned in
verses.hindi: ( विशेष-- ) अधिक दोषोंसे दुष्ट कालको तो ब्रह्माजी भी शुभ नहीं बना सकते हैं; इसलिये जिसमें थोड़ा दोष और अधिक गुण हों, ऐसा काल ग्रहण करना चाहिए॥ ४९०॥

verses.sanskrit: राजसांस्तामसांश्चैव नित्यं दोषान्विसर्जयेत । सात्त्विकं मार्गमास्थाय पश्येदात्मानमात्मना
verses.transliteration: rājasāṃstāmasāṃścaiva nityaṃ doṣānvisarjayeta / sāttvikaṃ mārgamāsthāya paśyedātmānamātmanā
verses.translation: When all the doubts have been dispelled by persons like me, they, by dint of their pure determined efforts, cut the knots (of doubt) in their heart and do not fall a victim to dis* tress (i.e. are not distressed).
verses.hindi: ( बेदी और मण्डप- ) इस प्रकार वर-वधूके लिये शुभप्रद उत्तम समयमें श्रेष्ठ लग्नका निरीक्षण (खोज) करना चाहिए। तदनन्तर एक हाथ ऊँची,

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि । संपश्यन्नैव लिप्येत जले वारिचरगो यथा
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani / saṃpaśyannaiva lipyeta jale vāricarago yathā
verses.translation: You entertain no differentiation between pleasure
verses.hindi: तुला और वृश्चिक--ये दोनों केवल दिनमें तथा धनु और मकर--ये दोनों केवल रात्रिमें 'बधिर ' होते हैं । एवं मेष, वृष और सिंह--ये तीनों दिनमें तथा मिथुन, कर्क, कन्या--ये तीनों रात्रिमें ' अन्ध ' होते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पक्षीवत्पवनाद्वर्ध्वममुत्रानुन्त्यश्नुते । विहाय देहं निर्मुक्तो निर्द्वन्द्वः शुभसंगतः
verses.transliteration: pakṣīvatpavanādvardhvamamutrānuntyaśnute / vihāya dehaṃ nirmukto nirdvandvaḥ śubhasaṃgataḥ
verses.translation: You feel no bonds to your kinsmen. You are not inspired with fear at fearful objects. I find that to you censure and praise are all equal.
verses.hindi: दिनमें कुम्भ और रात्रिमें मीन 'पद्णु ' होते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अत्र गाथाः पुरा गीताः शृणु राज्ञा ययातिना । धार्यते या द्विजैस्तात मोक्षशास्त्रविशारदैः

verses.translation: I see that you are a person among other wise persons who have taken to the highest imperishable path devoid of ailments.
verses.hindi: २. जैसे--श्रवणमें कोई ग्रह हो तो मघा नक्षत्र विद्ध

verses.translation: O Brahma you are already existing in that state (called Moka) which is the fruit attained by a Brahmaoa and it is not a particular region. What else do you (want to) ask me about?*•
verses.hindi: ४. इनमें सूर्य अपनेसे आगे और पूर्ण चन्द्र पीछे, फिर मड्भल आगे और बुध पीछेके नक्षत्रोंको दूषित करते हैं। ऐसा ही क्रम आगे भी समझना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यानध्यापयन्तं च पैलादीन्वेदसंहिताः । आरर्णेयो विशुद्धात्मा दिवाकरसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: śiṣyānadhyāpayantaṃ ca pailādīnvedasaṃhitāḥ / ārarṇeyo viśuddhātmā divākarasamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: NP reads rctna/H iaUraioa <etM tat but Mbh. (tM) v. 32 reads utrpaJantutu tat samam / 'll (the tool) exists in all beings.*
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठा, मूल, पूर्वाषाढ, श्रवण, शतभिषा, उत्तर भाद्रपद, रेवती-- इन)-में उत्पन्न कन्याके लिये अश्विनीसे आरम्भ करके रेवतीतक तीन पर्वोपर क्रम-उत्क्रम'ं से गिनकर नाड़ी समझे। तीन

verses.sanskrit: पितुर्जग्राह पादौ चज सादरं हृष्टमानसः । ततो निवेदयामास पितुः सर्वमुदारधीः
verses.transliteration: piturjagrāha pādau caja sādaraṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ / tato nivedayāmāsa pituḥ sarvamudāradhīḥ
verses.translation: NP reads rctna/H iaUraioa <etM tat but Mbh. (tM) v. 32 reads utrpaJantutu tat samam / 'll (the tool) exists in all beings.*
verses.hindi: चरणवाले (कृत्तिका, पुनर्वसु, उत्तराफालगुनी, विशाखा, उत्तराषाढ़ और पूर्व भाद्रपद) नक्षत्रोमें उत्पन्न कन्याके लिये कृत्तिकासे लेकर भरणीतक क्रम-उत्क्रम' से चार पर्वोपर गिनकर नाड़ीका

verses.sanskrit: शुको जनकराजेन संवादं मोक्षसाधनम् । तच्छत्वा वेदकर्तासौ प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: śuko janakarājena saṃvādaṃ mokṣasādhanam / tacchatvā vedakartāsau prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
verses.translation: NP reads rctna/H iaUraioa <etM tat but Mbh. (tM) v. 32 reads utrpaJantutu tat samam / 'll (the tool) exists in all beings.*
verses.hindi: ज्ञान प्रात्त करे तथा दो चरणोंवाले (मृगशिरा, चित्रा, धनिष्ठा) नक्षत्रोंमें उत्पन्न कन्याकी नाड़ी जाननेके लिये मृगशिरासे लेकर रोहिणीतक पाँच पर्वोपर क्रम-उत्क्रमसे गिने। यदि वर और वधू

verses.sanskrit: समालिङ्ग्य सुतं व्यासः स्वपार्श्वस्थं चकार च
verses.transliteration: samāliṅgya sutaṃ vyāsaḥ svapārśvasthaṃ cakāra ca
verses.translation: NP reads rctna/H iaUraioa <etM tat but Mbh. (tM) v. 32 reads utrpaJantutu tat samam / 'll (the tool) exists in all beings.*

verses.sanskrit: ततः पैलादयो विप्रा वेदान् व्यासादधीत्य च । शैलशृङ्गाद्भुवं प्राप्ता याजनाध्यापने रताः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pailādayo viprā vedān vyāsādadhītya ca / śailaśṛṅgādbhuvaṃ prāptā yājanādhyāpane ratāḥ
verses.translation: NP reads rctna/H iaUraioa <etM tat but Mbh. (tM) v. 32 reads utrpaJantutu tat samam / 'll (the tool) exists in all beings.*
verses.hindi: १. रशियोंके वर्णको स्पष्ट समझनेके लिये यह कोएष्ठ देखें--

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने एकोनषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः सनदन उवाच अवतीर्णेषु विप्रेषु यासः पुत्रसहायवान् । तूर्ष्णीं ध्यानपरो धीमानेकान्ते समुपाविशत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne ekonaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sanadana uvāca avatīrṇeṣu vipreṣu yāsaḥ putrasahāyavān / tūrṣṇīṃ dhyānaparo dhīmānekānte samupāviśat
verses.translation: Y/htn the Brahmanas (disciples of Vyasa) descended (from the height of Vyisa*s hermitage) or departed, the intelligent Vyasa with only bis son (Suka) as the companion, remained silently absorbed in meditation in the hermitage.
verses.hindi: वर और कन्याकी कुण्डली मिलानेके लिये जो वश्य, योनि, राशिकूट, योनिकूट, वर्णकूट तथा नाडी आदिका वर्णन किया गया है, उन सबको सुगमतापूर्वक जानने तथा उनके गुणोंको समझनेके लिये निम्नाद्धित चक्रोंपर दृष्टिपात

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाचाशरी री वाक् व्यासं पुत्रसमन्वितम् । भो भो महर्षे बासिष्ठ ब्रह्मघोषो न वर्तते
verses.transliteration: tamuvācāśarī rī vāk vyāsaṃ putrasamanvitam / bho bho maharṣe bāsiṣṭha brahmaghoṣo na vartate
verses.translation: An incorporeal voice* addressed Vyto along with

verses.sanskrit: एको ध्यानपरस्तूष्णी किमाःसे चिन्तयन्निव । ब्रह्मघोषैर्विरहितः पर्वतो ऽयं न शोभते
verses.transliteration: eko dhyānaparastūṣṇī kimāḥse cintayanniva / brahmaghoṣairvirahitaḥ parvato 'yaṃ na śobhate
verses.translation: Why are you sitting thus silent and absorbed in medi¬ tation, as if you are (anxiously) brooding over something? This mountain devoid of the vibrant echoes (of Vedas) docs not appear splendid.
verses.hindi: जन्मकालिक ग्रहोंकी स्थिति तथा जन्म-नक्षत्र-सम्बन्धी आठ प्रकारके कूटद्वारा वर-वधूकी कुण्डलीका मिलान किया जाता है। यदि जन्म-लग्न या जन्म-राशि (चन्द्रमा) से १, ४, ७, ८ या १२ वें स्थानमें मड्भल या अन्य पापग्रह वरकी कुण्डलीमें हों तो पत्रीके लिये और कन्याकी कुण्डलीमें हों तो बरके लिये अनिष्टकारी होते हैं। यदि दोनोंकी कुण्डलियोंमें उक्त स्थानोंमें पापग्रहकी संख्या समान हो तो उक्त दोष नहीं माना जाता है । उदाहरणके लिये--

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादधीष्व भगवन्सार्द्ध पुत्रेण धीमता । वेदान्वेदविदा चैव सुप्रसन्नमनाः सदा
verses.transliteration: tasmādadhīṣva bhagavansārddha putreṇa dhīmatā / vedānvedavidā caiva suprasannamanāḥ sadā
verses.translation: O venerable Sir, with a delighted heart, recite the Vedas along with your intelligent son who is well-versed in the Vedas,"
verses.hindi: पुनर्वसुके चतुर्थ चरणमें जन्म पूर्वाफाल्गुनीके प्रथम चरणमें जन्म

verses.sanskrit: तच्छुत्वा वचनं व्यासो नभोवाणीसमीरितम् । शुकेन सह पुत्रेण वेदाभ्यासमथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: tacchutvā vacanaṃ vyāso nabhovāṇīsamīritam / śukena saha putreṇa vedābhyāsamathākarot
verses.translation: On hearing that speech addressed to him by the ethereal voice, Vyasa began to chant the Vedas along with his son Suka.
verses.hindi: यहाँ वरकी कुण्डलीमें ४थे और ७वें स्थानमें शनि और मड्भल दो पापग्रह हैं तथा कन्याकी कुण्डलीमें भी ७ वें स्थानमें शनि, मड्भल हैं, जिससे दोनोंके परस्पर माड्रलिक दोष नष्ट होनेके कारण इन दोनोंका वैवाहिक सम्बन्ध श्रेष्ठ सिद्ध होता है। यहाँ भकूटके गुण इस प्रकार हैं--

verses.sanskrit: तयोरभ्यसतोरेवं बहुकालं द्विजोत्तम । वातो ऽतिमात्रं प्रववौ समुद्रानिलवीजितः
verses.transliteration: tayorabhyasatorevaṃ bahukālaṃ dvijottama / vāto 'timātraṃ pravavau samudrānilavījitaḥ
verses.translation: While both of them were chanting the Vedas for a pretty long time, there arose, O excellent Brahmana, a violent wind which was as if driven by the gales that break out on the seas.
verses.hindi: इस तरह नक्षत्रमेलापकमें भी गुणोंका योग २२॥ है। अठारहसे अधिक होनेके कारण इन दोनोंका विवाह- सम्बन्ध श्रेष्ठ सिद्ध होता है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽनध्याय इति तं व्यासः पुत्रमवारयत् । शुको वारितमात्रस्तु कौतूहलसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: tato 'nadhyāya iti taṃ vyāsaḥ putramavārayat / śuko vāritamātrastu kautūhalasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: "You are blest with the spiritual vision. Your steady
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार अन्य कुण्डलियोंसे भी ग्रह और नक्षत्रका मेल देखकर विवाहका निर्णय करना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: अपृच्छत्पितरं तत्र कुतो वायुरभूदयम् । आख्यातुमर्हति भवान्सर्वं वायोर्विचैष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: apṛcchatpitaraṃ tatra kuto vāyurabhūdayam / ākhyātumarhati bhavānsarvaṃ vāyorvicaiṣṭitam
verses.translation: Hence realising the Vedas in your own self do you reflect and meditate: the path pertaining to the Supreme soul is known as the path of gods [Devaydm ). The path that is made of Tamas is called the path of Pitrs [Pitr-ydna ).
verses.hindi: ( विवाहोंके भेद--- ) ऊपर बताये हुए शुभ समयमें (१) प्राजापत्य, (२) ब्राह्म, (३) हैव और (४) आर्ष--ये चार प्रकारके विवाह करने चाहिए । ये ही चारों विवाह उपर्युक्त फल देनेवाले

verses.sanskrit: शुकस्यैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा व्यासः परमविस्मितः । अनध्यायनिमित्तऽस्मिन्निदं वचनं मब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śukasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā vyāsaḥ paramavismitaḥ / anadhyāyanimitta'sminnidaṃ vacanaṃ mabravīt
verses.translation: The Vedas are a form of the wind. If uttered with force and loudly (at this time) the external wind gets pained." (Hence one should not recite the Vedas when stormy winds blow)
verses.hindi: होते हैं। इससे अतिरिक्त जो गान्धर्व, आसुर, पैशाच तथा राक्षस विवाह हैं, वे तो सब समय समान ही फल देनेवाले होते हैं॥५१०-५११॥

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं ते चक्षुरुत्पन्नं स्वस्थं ते निश्चलं मनः । तमसा रजसा चापि त्यक्तः सत्ये व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ te cakṣurutpannaṃ svasthaṃ te niścalaṃ manaḥ / tamasā rajasā cāpi tyaktaḥ satye vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmana! Then Sanatkumara who was prominent among the knowers of the Veda enquired, "O highly fortunate son of Vyasa, O highly brilliant sage! What are you doing (now)?**
verses.hindi: कालमें जो लग्न रहता है, उससे चतुर्थ लग्रका नाम अभिजित् है और सातवाँ गोधूलि-लग्न कहलाता है। ये दोनों विवाहमें पुत्र-पौत्रकी वृद्धि करनेवाले होते हैं ॥५१२॥ पूर्व तथा कलिड्र देशवासियोंके

verses.sanskrit: तस्यात्मनि स्वयं वेदान्बुद्ध्वा समनुचिन्तय । देवयानचरो विष्णोः पितृयानश्च तामसः
verses.transliteration: tasyātmani svayaṃ vedānbuddhvā samanucintaya / devayānacaro viṣṇoḥ pitṛyānaśca tāmasaḥ
verses.translation: O son of Brahma, I am now engaged in the self
verses.hindi: लिये गोधूलि-लग्र प्रधान है और अभिजित्-लग्र तो सब देशोंके लिये मुख्य कहा गया है, क्योंकि वह सब दोषोंका नाश करनेवाला है॥५१३॥

verses.sanskrit: द्वावेतौ प्रत्ययं यातौ दिवं चाधश्च गच्छतः । पिथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे च यतः संयान्ति वायवः
verses.transliteration: dvāvetau pratyayaṃ yātau divaṃ cādhaśca gacchataḥ / pithivyāmantarikṣe ca yataḥ saṃyānti vāyavaḥ
verses.translation: I wish to ask you something about the principle that is conducive to the attainment of salvation. Please recount it O highly blessed one, so that I may attain that perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: ( अभिजित्-प्रशंसा--- ) सूर्यके मध्य आकाशमें जानेपर अभिजितू मुहूर्त होता है, वह समस्त दोषोंको नष्ट कर देता है, ठीक उसी तरह, जैसे त्रिपुरासुरको श्रीशिवजीने नष्ट किया था॥५१४॥

verses.sanskrit: सप्त ते वायुमार्गा वै तान्निबोधानुपूर्वशः । तत्र देवगणाः साध्याः समभूवन्महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: sapta te vāyumārgā vai tānnibodhānupūrvaśaḥ / tatra devagaṇāḥ sādhyāḥ samabhūvanmahābalāḥ
verses.translation: Refraining from sinful activities, being continuously engaged in meritorious activities, good behaviour and adherence to conventional duties* these are the most excellent things contributing to welfare.
verses.hindi: पुत्रका विवाह करनेके बाद छ: मासोंके भीतर पुत्रीका विवाह नहीं करना चाहिए। एक पुत्र या पुत्रीका विवाह करनेके बाद दूसरे पुत्रका उपनयन भी नहीं करना चाहिए। इसी प्रकार एक मड़ल

verses.sanskrit: तेषामप्यभवत्पुत्रः समानो नाम दुर्जयः । उदानस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽभूव्द्यानस्तस्याभवत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: teṣāmapyabhavatputraḥ samāno nāma durjayaḥ / udānastasya putro 'bhūvdyānastasyābhavatsutaḥ
verses.translation: Having obtained the birth as a human being (the life in) which b fraught with sorrow he who becomes attached to it becomes stupefied; such a man is incapable of being emancipated from sorrow. At tad) meet (to worldly objects) b an indication of misery.
verses.hindi: कार्य करनेके बाद छः: मासोंके भीतर दूसरा मड़ल कार्य नहीं करना चाहिए। एक गर्भसे उत्पन्न दो कनन्‍्याओंका विवाह यदि छ: मासके भीतर हो तो निश्चय ही तीन वर्षके भीतर उनमेंसे

verses.sanskrit: अपानश्च ततो जज्ञे प्राणश्चापि ततः परम् । अनपत्यो ऽभवत्प्राणो दुर्द्धर्षः शत्रुमर्दनः
verses.transliteration: apānaśca tato jajñe prāṇaścāpi tataḥ param / anapatyo 'bhavatprāṇo durddharṣaḥ śatrumardanaḥ
verses.translation: The intellect of one attached to the worldly affairs heightens one's vicious snare of delusion. One ensnared by delusion attains misery here and hereafter.
verses.hindi: एक विधवा होती है ॥ ५१५-५१६॥ अपने पुत्रके साथ जिसकी पुत्रीका विवाह हो, फिर उसके पुत्रंके साथ अपनी पुत्रीका विवाह करना ' प्रत्युद्बाह ' कहलाता है। ऐसा कभी नहीं करना चाहिए तथा
