verses.sanskrit: वर्मास्त्राभ्यामस्त्रमुक्तं शेषार्णैर्व्यापकं पुनः । हृदये जठरे नाभौ जठरे गुह्यदेशतः
verses.transliteration: varmāstrābhyāmastramuktaṃ śeṣārṇairvyāpakaṃ punaḥ / hṛdaye jaṭhare nābhau jaṭhare guhyadeśataḥ
verses.translation: Having heard such scriptural texts as arc auspicious dispelling sorrow, conducive to mental peace and happiness, one attains pure intelligence, whereby one attains really happy state.
verses.hindi: ८६. नवनीतहर:-माखनका हरण करनेवाले, ८७. बाल:-बाल्यावस्थासे विभूषित, ८८. नवनीत- प्रियाशन:-मक्खन जिनका प्यारा भोजन है, ८९. बालवृन्दी-गोप-बालकोंके समुदायको साथ

verses.sanskrit: दक्षपादे वामपादे सक्थ्नि जानुनि जङ्घयोः । विन्यसेद्बीजदशकं प्रणवद्वयमध्यगम्
verses.transliteration: dakṣapāde vāmapāde sakthni jānuni jaṅghayoḥ / vinyasedbījadaśakaṃ praṇavadvayamadhyagam
verses.translation: Every day, thousands of incidents causing delight (sorrowMbh.) and hundreds of happenings causing sorrow affect a penon devoid of wisdom, but not a person endowed with understanding and learning.
verses.hindi: रखनेवाले, ९०. मर्कवृन्दी-वानरोंके झुंडके साथ

verses.sanskrit: ताराद्यानथ शेषार्णान्मस्तके च ललाटके । भ्रुवोः श्रुत्योस्तथैवाक्ष्णोर्नसि वक्त्रे गलेंऽसके
verses.transliteration: tārādyānatha śeṣārṇānmastake ca lalāṭake / bhruvoḥ śrutyostathaivākṣṇornasi vaktre galeṃ'sake
verses.translation: Persons of little intelligence and understanding become overwhelmed with mental sorrow of every kind due to advent of, and association with what is undesirable and severance from what is agreeable.
verses.hindi: नेत्रोंसे देखनेवाले, ९२. पलायित:-मैयाकी साँटीके भयसे भाग जानेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमन्त्रेण सर्वाङ्गे कृत्वा व्यापकमादृतः । सर्वेष्टसिद्धये ध्यायेत्कार्तवीर्यं जनेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvamantreṇa sarvāṅge kṛtvā vyāpakamādṛtaḥ / sarveṣṭasiddhaye dhyāyetkārtavīryaṃ janeśvaram
verses.translation: One should not nostalgically brood over the merits of the articles which one possessed in the past. One who does not think of them with reverent affection, becomes free from the bondage of love.
verses.hindi: ९३. यशोदातर्जित:-यशोदा मैयाकी डाँट सहनेवाले, ९४. कम्पी-मैया मारेगी इस भयसे काँपनेवाले, ९५. मायारुदितशोभन:-लीलाकृत रुदनसे सुशोभित, ९६. दामोदरः:-मैयाद्वारा रस्सीसे

verses.sanskrit: उद्यद्रर्कसहस्राभं सर्वभूपतिवन्दितम् । दोर्भिः पञ्चाशता दक्षैर्बाणान्वामैर्धनूंषि च
verses.transliteration: udyadrarkasahasrābhaṃ sarvabhūpativanditam / dorbhiḥ pañcāśatā dakṣairbāṇānvāmairdhanūṃṣi ca
verses.translation: One should try to detect faults in things to which one feels attached. He should attribute undesirability to them* Then alone he becomes resplendent* immediately.
verses.hindi: कमरमें बाँधे जानेवाले, ९७. अप्रमेयात्मा-जिसकी कोई माप नहीं ऐसे स्वरूपसे युक्त, ९८. दयालु:- सबपर दया करनेवाले, ९९. भक्तवत्सलः-भक्तोंसे प्यार करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: दधतं स्वर्णमालाढ्यं रक्तवस्त्रसमावृतम् । चक्रावतारं श्रीविष्णोर्ध्यायेदर्जुनभूपतिम्
verses.transliteration: dadhataṃ svarṇamālāḍhyaṃ raktavastrasamāvṛtam / cakrāvatāraṃ śrīviṣṇordhyāyedarjunabhūpatim
verses.translation: Living beings sometimes gain and sometimes lose worldly objects. It should not be the cause of sorrow, to a person.
verses.hindi: ५१००. उलूखले सुबद्ध:ः-ऊखलमें अच्छी तरह बँधे हुए, १०१. नम्नशिरा-झुके मस्तकवाले, १५०२. गोपीकदर्थितः-गोपियोंद्वारा यशोदा मैयाके पास जिनके बालचापल्यकी शिकायत की गयी

verses.sanskrit: लक्षमेकं जपेन्मन्त्रं दशांशं जुहुयात्तिलैः । सतण्डुलैः पायसेन विष्णुपीठे यजत्तुतम्
verses.transliteration: lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāttilaiḥ / sataṇḍulaiḥ pāyasena viṣṇupīṭhe yajattutam
verses.translation: When a calamity causing physical or mental grief visits and cannot be warded off, one should not brood over it«
verses.hindi: है वे, १०३. वृक्षभड़ी-यमलार्जुन नामक वृक्षोंको भड़ करनेवाले, १०४. शोकभड्री-स्वयं सुरक्षित रहकर स्वजनोंका शोक भड्ज़ करनेवाले, १०५. धनदात्मजमोक्षण:-कुबेरपुत्रोंका उद्धार

verses.sanskrit: षट्कोणेषु षडङ्गानि ततो दिक्षु विविक्षु च । चौरमदविभञ्जनं मारीमदविभञ्जनम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni tato dikṣu vivikṣu ca / cauramadavibhañjanaṃ mārīmadavibhañjanam
verses.translation: This b the antidote against misery that it should not
verses.hindi: १०६. देवर्षिवचनश्लाघी-देवर्षि नारदके वचनका आदर करनेवाले, १०७, भक्तवात्सल्यसागर:- भक्तवत्सलताके समुद्र, १०८. बत्रजकोलाहलकरः- अपनी बालोचित क्रीड़ाओंसे ब्रजमें कोलाहल

verses.sanskrit: अरिमदविभञ्जनं दैत्यमदविभञ्जनम् । दुष्टनाशं दुःखनाशं दुरितापद्विनाशकम्
verses.transliteration: arimadavibhañjanaṃ daityamadavibhañjanam / duṣṭanāśaṃ duḥkhanāśaṃ duritāpadvināśakam
verses.translation: One shall dispel mental misery by means of intellect and remove the physical pain by means of medicines. This is the power of knowledge; one should not behave like commoners in such matters.
verses.hindi: ब्रजवासियोंके आनन्दकी वृद्धि करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: दिक्ष्वष्टशक्तयः पूज्याः प्राच्यादिष्वसितप्रभाः । क्षेमङ्करी वश्यकरी श्रीकरी च यशस्करी
verses.transliteration: dikṣvaṣṭaśaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ prācyādiṣvasitaprabhāḥ / kṣemaṅkarī vaśyakarī śrīkarī ca yaśaskarī
verses.translation: No learned and sensible man shall yearn for these evanescent things viz.—the life, (comely) features, youth, hoarded wealth, health and association with beloved persons.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रिय, मन, बुद्धि आदिको प्रेरणा देनेवाले, ११२. साक्षी-अनन्त विश्वके सम्पूर्ण पदार्थों और भावोंके द्रष्टा, ११३. व॒न्दावननिवासकृत््-वृन्दावनमें निवास करनेवाले, ११४. वत्सपालः-बछड़ोंको

verses.sanskrit: आयुः करी तथा प्रज्ञाकरी विद्याकरी पुनः । धनकर्यष्टमी पश्चाल्लोकेशा अस्त्रसंयुताः
verses.transliteration: āyuḥ karī tathā prajñākarī vidyākarī punaḥ / dhanakaryaṣṭamī paścāllokeśā astrasaṃyutāḥ
verses.translation: Like the sharppointed arrows discharged by a good archer, physical and mental ailments affect the bodies deeply.
verses.hindi: पालनेवाले, ११५. वत्सपति:ः-बछड़ोंके स्वामी एवं रक्षक, ११६. गोपदारकमण्डन:-गोपबालकोंकी मण्डलीको सुशोभित करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: एवं संसाधितो मन्त्रः प्रयोगार्हः प्रजायते । कार्तवीर्यार्जुनस्याथ पूजायन्त्रमिहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃsādhito mantraḥ prayogārhaḥ prajāyate / kārtavīryārjunasyātha pūjāyantramihocyate
verses.translation: Taking with them the good and evil incidents that befall men according to their destiny and hence are not expected by them, the nights too pass away* ceaselessly.
verses.hindi: वाले, ११८. बालरतिः-गोपबालकोंसे प्रेम करनेवाले, ११९. बालकः-बालरूपधारी गोपाल, १२०. कनकाड्ढदी"सोनेका बाजूबंद

verses.sanskrit: स्वबीजानङ्गध्रुववाक्कर्णिकं दिग्दलं लिखेत् । तारादिवर्मान्तदलं शेषवर्णदलान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: svabījānaṅgadhruvavākkarṇikaṃ digdalaṃ likhet / tārādivarmāntadalaṃ śeṣavarṇadalāntaram
verses.translation: Whatever one may desire, one shall attain, provided the fruit of actions of men does not depend on other factors.
verses.hindi: मोतियोंक आभूषण धारण करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: ऊष्मान्त्यस्वरकिञ्जल्कं शेषार्णैः परिवेष्टितम् । कोणालङ्कृतभूतार्णभूगृहं यन्त्रमीशितुः
verses.transliteration: ūṣmāntyasvarakiñjalkaṃ śeṣārṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitam / koṇālaṅkṛtabhūtārṇabhūgṛhaṃ yantramīśituḥ
verses.translation: Another man attempts always to inflict violence on all living beings. He becomes old in deceiving but blessed with happiness throughout his life.
verses.hindi: १२४. किड्धिणीकटकी-कपियें क्षुद्र घण्टिका और हाथोंमें कड़े पहननेवाले, १२५. सूत्री- बाल्यावस्थामें सूतकी करधनी और बड़े होनेपर यज्ञोपवीत धारण करनेवाले; १२६. नूपुरी-

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धभूमावष्टगन्धैर्लिखित्वा यन्त्रमादरात् । तत्र कुंभं प्रतिष्ठाप्य तत्रावाह्यार्चयेन्नृपम्
verses.transliteration: śuddhabhūmāvaṣṭagandhairlikhitvā yantramādarāt / tatra kuṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tatrāvāhyārcayennṛpam
verses.translation: Fortune blesses someone who never stirs out but who sits (idle). Some one does everything but never obtains desired objects.
verses.hindi: पैरोंमें नूपुर पहननेवाले, १२७. मुद्रिकान्वितः- हाथकी अंगुलियोंमें अंगूठी धारण करनेवाले, १२८. वत्सासुरप्रतिध्वंसी-वत्सासुरका विनाश

verses.sanskrit: स्पृष्ट्वा कुंभं जपेन्मन्त्रं सहस्रं विजितेन्द्रियः । अभिषिं चेत्तदंभोभिः प्रियं सर्वेष्टसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: spṛṣṭvā kuṃbhaṃ japenmantraṃ sahasraṃ vijitendriyaḥ / abhiṣiṃ cettadaṃbhobhiḥ priyaṃ sarveṣṭasiddhaye
verses.translation: In order to recount the faults of men, the semen created in oneself at the sight of another, goes to still another person.®
verses.hindi: करनेवाले, १२९. वकासुरविनाशन:- वकासुरका विनाश करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रान्यशो रोगनाशमायुः स्वजनरञ्जनम् । वाक्सिद्धिं सुदृशः कुम्भाभिषिक्तो लभते नरः
verses.transliteration: putrānyaśo roganāśamāyuḥ svajanarañjanam / vāksiddhiṃ sudṛśaḥ kumbhābhiṣikto labhate naraḥ
verses.translation: To some persons who desire sons, who wish to per¬ petuate their lines and who (by worshipping deities etc.), strive for its achievement, not even an egg (an embryo in the womb) is bom.
verses.hindi: सर्परूपधारी हैत्यका विनाश करनेवाले, १३९. विनिद्रीकृतबालकः -सर्पके विषसे मूच्छित गोपबालकोंको अपनी अमृतमयी दृष्टिसे जीवित करके जगानेवाले, १३२. आद्यः-सबके आदिकारण;

verses.sanskrit: शत्रूपद्रव आपन्ने ग्रामे वा पुटभेदने । संस्थापंयेदिदं यन्त्रं शत्रुभीतिनिवृत्तये
verses.transliteration: śatrūpadrava āpanne grāme vā puṭabhedane / saṃsthāpaṃyedidaṃ yantraṃ śatrubhītinivṛttaye
verses.translation: Some persons who dread the birth of an embryo as one fean a furious serpent, a long-lived son is born. How verily he is like his departed father! (who has as if returned aAer departing from this life—Mbh. ibid. v. 17)
verses.hindi: १३३. आत्पमप्रदः"प्रेमी भक्तोंके लिये अपने आत्मातकको दे डालनेवाले, १३४. सड्भीचगोप- बालकोंके सड़ः रहनेवाले, १३५. यमुनातीरभोजन:- यमुनाजीके तटपर ग्वालबालोंके साथ भोजन

verses.sanskrit: सर्षपारिष्टलशुनकार्पासैर्मार्यते रिपुः । धत्तूरैः स्तभ्यते निम्बैर्द्वेष्यते वश्यतेंऽबुजैः
verses.transliteration: sarṣapāriṣṭalaśunakārpāsairmāryate ripuḥ / dhattūraiḥ stabhyate nimbairdveṣyate vaśyateṃ'bujaiḥ
verses.translation: Some persons dejected due to sonlessness and with a burning desire for sons, at last get a son after performing penance and offering sacrifices to gods. The sons, duly borne for ten months (in the wombs by their wives) are born to be the banes and disgrace to their families.
verses.hindi: १३६.गोपालमण्डलीमध्य:-ग्वालबालों की मण्डलीके बीचमें बैठनेवाले, १३७. सर्वगोपाल- भूषण:-सम्पूर्ण ग्वालबालोंको विभूषित करनेवाले, १३८. कृतहस्ततलग्रास:-हथेलीमें अन्नका ग्रास

verses.sanskrit: उञ्चाटने विभीतस्य समिद्भिः खदिरस्य च । कटुतैलमहिष्याज्यैर्हेमद्रव्याञ्जनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: uñcāṭane vibhītasya samidbhiḥ khadirasya ca / kaṭutailamahiṣyājyairhemadravyāñjanaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Thanks to these blessed rites and observations, others inherit the hoarded wealth and grains and other diverse sources of enjoyment earned and stored by their fbre&thcn.
verses.hindi: १४०. कृतबाहुश्रड्रयष्टिः-हाथोंमें सींग और छड़ी धारण करनेवाले, १४१. गुझ्लालंकृतकण्ठक:ः- गुझाकी मालासे अपने कण्ठको विभूषित करनेवाले, १४२. मयूरपिच्छमुकुटः-मोरपंखका मुकुट धारण

verses.sanskrit: यवैर्हुते श्रियः प्राप्तिस्तिलैराज्यैरघक्षयः । तिलतण्डुलसिद्धार्थजालैर्वश्यो नृपो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yavairhute śriyaḥ prāptistilairājyairaghakṣayaḥ / tilataṇḍulasiddhārthajālairvaśyo nṛpo bhavet
verses.translation: When a man and a woman come in contact with each other, in the act of sexual intercourse, the embryo is formed in the womb like a calamity visiting the woman.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले, १४३. वनमालाविभूषित:-वनमालासे

verses.sanskrit: अपामार्गार्कदूर्वाणां होमो लक्ष्मीप्रदो ऽघनुत् । स्त्रीवश्यकृत्प्रियङ्गूणां मुराणां भूतशान्तिदः
verses.transliteration: apāmārgārkadūrvāṇāṃ homo lakṣmīprado 'ghanut / strīvaśyakṛtpriyaṅgūṇāṃ murāṇāṃ bhūtaśāntidaḥ
verses.translation: Even those various physicians though experts and equipped with medicines are themselves dragged (attacked) by diseases like beasts assailed by tigen.
verses.hindi: १४४. गैरिकाचित्रितवपु:-गेरूसे अपने शरीरमें चित्रोंकी रचना करनेवाले, १४५. नवमेघवपु:-नवीन मेघ-घटाके समान श्याम शरीरवाले, १४६. स्मर:- कामदेवस्वरूप, १४७, कोटिकन्दर्पलावण्य:-

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थोदुंबरप्लक्षवटबिल्वसमुद्भवाः । समिधो लभते हुत्वा पुत्रानायुर्द्धनं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: aśvatthoduṃbaraplakṣavaṭabilvasamudbhavāḥ / samidho labhate hutvā putrānāyurddhanaṃ sukham
verses.translation: Even though they imbibe many astringent and different kinds of medicated ghees, they arc seen broken down by old age like big trees (luga)** by elephants.
verses.hindi: करोड़ों कामदेवोंके समान सौन्दर्यशाली, १४८. लसन्मकरकुण्डल:-सुन्दर मकराकृति कुण्डल धारण करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: निर्मोकहेमसिद्धार्थलवणैश्चौरनाशनम् । रोचनागोमयैस्तंभो भूप्राप्तिः शालिभिर्हुतैः
verses.transliteration: nirmokahemasiddhārthalavaṇaiścauranāśanam / rocanāgomayaistaṃbho bhūprāptiḥ śālibhirhutaiḥ
verses.translation: Who administers medicines to ailing animals, birds, beasts of prey and povcrty-striken people? These are not gcncr- ally seen to be suffering from diseases.
verses.hindi: १५०. भगवान्नऐश्वर्य, धर्म, यश, श्री, ज्ञान और वैराग्य--इन छहों ऐश्वर्योंसे पूर्णतया युक्त,

verses.sanskrit: होमसंख्या तु सर्वत्र सहस्रादयुतावधि । प्रकल्पनीया मन्त्रज्ञैः कार्य्यगौरवलाघवात्
verses.transliteration: homasaṃkhyā tu sarvatra sahasrādayutāvadhi / prakalpanīyā mantrajñaiḥ kāryyagauravalāghavāt
verses.translation: A disease attacks and captures even terrible unassath
verses.hindi: १५२. कोटिसागरगाम्भीर्य:-करोड़ों समुद्रोंक समान गम्भीर, १५३. कालकाल:ः:-कालके भी महाकाल,

verses.sanskrit: कार्तवीर्य्यस्य मन्त्राणामुच्यते लक्षणं बुधाः । कार्तवीर्यार्जुनं ङेंतं सर्वमन्त्रेषु योजयेत्
verses.transliteration: kārtavīryyasya mantrāṇāmucyate lakṣaṇaṃ budhāḥ / kārtavīryārjunaṃ ṅeṃtaṃ sarvamantreṣu yojayet
verses.translation: In this way, people gagged and unable even to groan, submerged in delusion and sorrow are (seen to be) carried away in the big powerful current in which they arc thrown.
verses.hindi: १५५७. विरज्तिमोहनवपु:-अपने अद्धुतरूपसे ब्रह्माजीको भी मोहमें डालनेवाले, १५६. गोप- वत्सवपुर्धर:-ग्वालबालों और बछड़ोंका रूप धारण करनेवाले, १५७. ब्रह्मण्डकोटिजनक:-करोड़ों

verses.sanskrit: स्वबीजाद्यो दशार्णो ऽसौ अन्ये नवशिवाक्षराः । आद्यबीजद्वयेनासौ द्वितीयो मन्त्र ईरितः
verses.transliteration: svabījādyo daśārṇo 'sau anye navaśivākṣarāḥ / ādyabījadvayenāsau dvitīyo mantra īritaḥ
verses.translation: Neither by wealth nor by power of austere penance can embodied beings seeking to conquer nature, overcome it.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माण्डोंके उत्पादक, १५८. ब्रह्ममोहविनाशकः- ब्रह्माजीके मोहका नाश करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: स्वकामाभ्यां तृतीयो ऽसौ स्वभ्रूभ्यां तु चतुर्थकः । स्वपाशाभ्यां पञ्चमो ऽसौ षष्टः स्वेन च मायया
verses.transliteration: svakāmābhyāṃ tṛtīyo 'sau svabhrūbhyāṃ tu caturthakaḥ / svapāśābhyāṃ pañcamo 'sau ṣaṣṭaḥ svena ca māyayā
verses.translation: All persons desire to attain gradually to the top of the world. They strive to the best of their ability, But the result docs not tally with their cherished desire.
verses.hindi: १५९. ब्रह्मा-स्वयं ही ब्रह्माजीके रूपमें प्रकट, १६०. ब्रह्योडितः-ब्रह्माजीके द्वारा सस्‍्तुत, १६१. स्वामी-सबके अधिपति, १६२. शक्रदर्पादिनाशन:-इन्द्रके घमंड आदिको

verses.sanskrit: स्वाङ्कुशाभ्यां सप्तमः स्यात्स्वरमाभ्यामथाष्टमः । स्ववाग्भवाभ्यां नवमो वर्मास्त्राभ्यामथान्तिमः
verses.transliteration: svāṅkuśābhyāṃ saptamaḥ syātsvaramābhyāmathāṣṭamaḥ / svavāgbhavābhyāṃ navamo varmāstrābhyāmathāntimaḥ
verses.translation: If people were to obtain the fruit of their attempt (or cherished objective), tliey would never die, would never grow decrepit and would never have to experience anything
verses.hindi: नष्ट करनेवाले, १६३. गिरिपूजोपदेष्टा-गोवर्धन

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयादिनवान्तेषु बीजयोः स्याद्व्यतिक्रमः । मन्त्रे तु दशमे वर्णा नववर्मास्त्रमध्यगाः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyādinavānteṣu bījayoḥ syādvyatikramaḥ / mantre tu daśame varṇā navavarmāstramadhyagāḥ
verses.translation: Persons who are careful as well as crooked, cruel and brave pay homage to men inebriated with the flush of affluence and puffed up with arrogance (Mbh. reads: those intoxicated with spirituous liquors).
verses.hindi: पर्वकी पूजाका उपदेश देनेवाले, १६४. धृतगोवर्धनाचल:-गोवर्धन पर्वतको धारण करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: एतेषु मन्त्रवर्येषु स्वानुकूलं मनुं भजेत् । एषामाद्ये विराट्छदो ऽन्येषु त्रिष्टुबुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: eteṣu mantravaryeṣu svānukūlaṃ manuṃ bhajet / eṣāmādye virāṭchado 'nyeṣu triṣṭubudāhṛtam
verses.translation: In the case of some, griefs or sorrows recede even before they are glimpsed (by the prospective sufferer) while others who possess nothing of their own overstep* them.
verses.hindi: १६५. पुरन्दरेडित:-इन्द्रके द्वारा स्तुत,

verses.sanskrit: दश मन्त्रा इमे प्रोक्ता यदा स्युः प्रणवादिकाः । तदादिमः शिवार्णः स्यादन्ये तु द्वादशाक्षराः
verses.transliteration: daśa mantrā ime proktā yadā syuḥ praṇavādikāḥ / tadādimaḥ śivārṇaḥ syādanye tu dvādaśākṣarāḥ
verses.translation: All penons aspire aAer affluence or prosperity. Out of them a few have chariots ahead of them in processions. Some men have no wealth (v.l. in the MBh. 'arc wifeless) while others have hundreds of wives.
verses.hindi: १६७. कामधेनुप्रपूजित:-कामधेनुद्वारा पूजित,

verses.sanskrit: त्रिष्टुपूछन्दस्तथाद्ये स्यादन्येषु जगती मता । एवं विंशतिमन्त्राणां यजनं पूर्ववन्मतम
verses.transliteration: triṣṭupūchandastathādye syādanyeṣu jagatī matā / evaṃ viṃśatimantrāṇāṃ yajanaṃ pūrvavanmatama
verses.translation: The opposite pairs—pleasure and pain—exist side by side. People have either one or the other. Have a look at this or that. You should not succumb to delusion.
verses.hindi: जलसे इन्द्रदपपर अभिषिक्त, १६९. गोविन्दः-गौओंके इन्द्र होनेपर गोविन्द नामसे प्रसिद्ध, १७०. गोपरक्षकः- गोपोंकी रक्षा करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घाढ्यमूलबीजेन कुर्यादेषां षडङ्गकम् । तारो हृत्कार्तवीर्यार्जुनाय वर्मास्त्रठद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: dīrghāḍhyamūlabījena kuryādeṣāṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam / tāro hṛtkārtavīryārjunāya varmāstraṭhadvayam
verses.translation: Eschew both Dharma as well as Adharma, cast off (the duallstic concept of) truth and falsehood. After eschewing all the notions, be established in your own Self, be happy and free from all ailments.
verses.hindi: १७१. कालियारतिकर:-कालिय नागका दमन करनेवाले, १७२. क्रूरः-दुष्टोंकी दण्ड देनेके

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशार्णो मन्त्रो ऽयमस्येज्या पूर्ववन्मता । भूनेत्रसमनेत्राक्षिवर्णेरस्याङ्गपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: caturdaśārṇo mantro 'yamasyejyā pūrvavanmatā / bhūnetrasamanetrākṣivarṇerasyāṅgapañcakam
verses.translation: O excellent sage I have recounted to you in details that secret and mysterious teachii.It is due to such knowledge that the gods (who were formerly human beings) could transect the earth and go to settle in the heaven.''
verses.hindi: स्तुत, १७४. विरादू-विराट् पुरुष, १७५. धेनुकारिः- धेनुकासुरके शत्रु, १७६. प्रलम्बारि:-बलभद्ररूपसे प्रलम्ब॒ नामक असुरका नाश करनेवाले, १७७. वृषासुरविमर्दन:वृषभरूपधारी अरिष्टासुरका

verses.sanskrit: तारो हृद्भगवान् ङेंतः कार्तवीर्यार्जुनस्तथा । वर्मास्त्राग्निप्रियामन्त्रः प्रोक्तो ह्यष्टादशार्णकः
verses.transliteration: tāro hṛdbhagavān ṅeṃtaḥ kārtavīryārjunastathā / varmāstrāgnipriyāmantraḥ prokto hyaṣṭādaśārṇakaḥ
verses.translation: Having addressed thus Suka, the son of Vy&sa, and bidding good-bye to him, ilic great sage Saxiatkum&ra
verses.hindi: १७८. मयासुरात्मजध्वंसी-मयासुरके पुत्र

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवेदसप्तयुग्माक्षिवर्णैः पञ्चाङ्गकं मनोः । नमो भगवते श्रीति कार्तवीर्यार्जुनाय च
verses.transliteration: trivedasaptayugmākṣivarṇaiḥ pañcāṅgakaṃ manoḥ / namo bhagavate śrīti kārtavīryārjunāya ca
verses.translation: AAer understanding the whole philosophic position, Suka, the greatest of the Yogins, became eager to explore the region of the Brahman and went to his father.
verses.hindi: व्योमासुरका नाश करनेवाले, १७९. केशिकण्ठविदारक:-केशीका कण्ठ.विदीर्ण

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदुष्टान्तकायेति तपोबलपराक्रमः । परिपालितसप्तान्ते द्वीपाय सर्वरापदम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaduṣṭāntakāyeti tapobalaparākramaḥ / paripālitasaptānte dvīpāya sarvarāpadam
verses.translation: Thereafter, after meeting his father and bowing him down, the great sage Suka circumambulated him (clockwise) and proceeded to mount Kaiiasa.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले, १८०. गोपगोप्ता5ग्वालोंके रक्षक, १८१. दावाग्रिपरिशोषक:ः-दावानलका शोषण

verses.sanskrit: जन्यचूडा मणान्ते ये महाशक्तिमते ततः । सहस्रदहनप्रान्ते वर्मास्त्रान्तो महामनुः
verses.transliteration: janyacūḍā maṇānte ye mahāśaktimate tataḥ / sahasradahanaprānte varmāstrānto mahāmanuḥ
verses.translation: Vyasa, being overcome with filial aiTcction (for his son and pained at separation from him and grieved at heart, cried out, *'0 son, wait at least foramoment/'
verses.hindi: १८२. गोपकन्यावस्त्रहारी-गोपकुमारियोंके चीर हरण करनेवाले, १८३. गोपकन्यावरप्रद:- गोपकन्याओंको वर देनेवाले, १८४. यज्ञपत्यन्नभोजी- यज्ञपत्रियोंके अन्नू भोजन करनेवाले,

verses.sanskrit: त्रिषष्टिवर्णवान्प्रोक्तः स्मरमात्सर्वविघ्नहृत् । राजन्यक्रवर्ती च वीरः शूरस्तृतीयकः
verses.transliteration: triṣaṣṭivarṇavānproktaḥ smaramātsarvavighnahṛt / rājanyakravartī ca vīraḥ śūrastṛtīyakaḥ
verses.translation: Mbh. v. 6. reads: mraiyefs 'gets disgusted with them*.
verses.hindi: १८५. मुनिमानापहारकः८ अपनेको मुनि माननेवाले ब्राह्मणोंके अभिमानको दूर करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: माहिष्मतीपतिः पश्चाञ्चतुर्थः समुदीरितः । रेवांबुपरितृप्तश्च काणो हस्तप्रबाधितः

verses.sanskrit: दशास्येति च षड्भिः स्यात्पदैर्ङेतैः षडङ्गकम् । सिंच्यमानं युवतिभिः क्रीडन्तं नर्मदाजले
verses.transliteration: daśāsyeti ca ṣaḍbhiḥ syātpadairṅetaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam / siṃcyamānaṃ yuvatibhiḥ krīḍantaṃ narmadājale

verses.hindi: गन्धर्व (विद्याधर)-को शापसे छुड़ानेवाले, १८९. शद्डुचूडशिरोहर:-शट्डुचूड नामक गुह्मयकका मस्तक काट लेनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तैर्जलौधं रुन्धन्तं ध्यायेन्मत्तं नृपोत्तमम् । एवं ध्यात्वायुतं मन्त्रं पजेदन्यत्तु पूर्ववत्

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं तु प्रजपेल्लक्षं पूजायोगश्च पूर्ववत् । कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो नाम राजा बाहुसहस्रवान्
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṃ tu prajapellakṣaṃ pūjāyogaśca pūrvavat / kārtavīryārjuno nāma rājā bāhusahasravān

verses.sanskrit: तस्य संस्मरणादेव हृतं नष्टं च संवदेत् । लभ्यते मन्त्रवर्यो ऽयं द्वात्रिंशद्वर्णसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: tasya saṃsmaraṇādeva hṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca saṃvadet / labhyate mantravaryo 'yaṃ dvātriṃśadvarṇasaṃyutaḥ

verses.sanskrit: पादैः सर्वेण पञ्चाङ्गं ध्यानपूजादि पूर्ववत् । कार्तवीर्याय शब्दान्ते विद्महे पदमुञ्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: pādaiḥ sarveṇa pañcāṅgaṃ dhyānapūjādi pūrvavat / kārtavīryāya śabdānte vidmahe padamuñcaret

verses.sanskrit: महावीर्याय वर्णान्ते धीमहीति पदं वदेत् । तन्नोर्ऽजुनः प्रवर्णान्ते चोदयात्पदमीरयेत्
verses.transliteration: mahāvīryāya varṇānte dhīmahīti padaṃ vadet / tannor'junaḥ pravarṇānte codayātpadamīrayet

verses.sanskrit: अधुना तु महाभाग कीर्तवीर्यहनूमतोः । कवचे श्रोतुमिच्छामि तद्वदस्वकृपानिधे

verses.translation: O highly blessed one, O store-house of mercy, I now wish to hear the Kavaca of Karttavirya and Hanuman. Please recount it«

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच शृणु विप्रेन्द्र वक्ष्यामि कवचं परमाद्भुतम् । कार्तवीर्यस्य येनासौ प्रसन्नः कार्यसिद्धिकृत्

verses.translation: O leading brahmin, listen. I shall recount the extre* mely wonderful Kavaca of Karttavirya, through which he causes the fulfilment of the tasks when he is delighted.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रादित्यसंकाशे नानारत्नसमुज्ज्वंले । भास्वद्ध्वजपताकाढ्ये तुरगायुतभूषिते

verses.translation: May the deity accompanied by the Sakti called Mahavayakarl (the great enchanter and charmer) protect my western quarter. He is the destroyer of all enemies. He is the bearer of great aiTows and bow.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशत्रुक्षयकरं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् । सर्वसंपत्प्रदातारं विजयश्रीनिषेवितम्

verses.translation: May the deity accompanied by Ayubkarl (cause of longevity) protect my north-western direction. He is glorious. He is the destroyer of great fear. He holds the bow and arrows.

verses.sanskrit: रथनागाश्वपादातवृन्दमध्यगमीश्वरम् । वरदं चक्रवर्तीनं सर्वलोकैकपालकम्

verses.translation: These murtis (forms) are red in colour. They wear red garlands and garments. They are the principal deities and are stationed separately and severally in excellent chariots.

verses.sanskrit: अस्याङ्गमूर्तयः पञ्च पान्तु मां स्फटिकोज्ज्वलाः । अग्नीशासुरवायव्यकोणेषु हृदयादिकाः

verses.translation: May Indra and others who possess great strength and are stationed in their respective quarters, who are the leaders of his attendants and who have their own vehicles, weapons and ornaments, protect me.
verses.hindi: ३८३. स्वर्गगामी-पारिजातके लिये स्वर्गलोककी यात्रा करनेवाले, ३८४. अदित्या: कुण्डलप्रद:- अदितिको कुण्डल देनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: क्षेमङ्करीशक्तियुतश्चौरवर्गविभञ्जनः । प्राचीं दिशं रक्षतु मे बाणबाणासनायुधः
verses.transliteration: kṣemaṅkarīśaktiyutaścauravargavibhañjanaḥ / prācīṃ diśaṃ rakṣatu me bāṇabāṇāsanāyudhaḥ

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकरीशक्तिसहितो मारीभयविनाशकः । शरचापधरः श्रीमान् दिशं मे पातु दक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: śrīkarīśaktisahito mārībhayavināśakaḥ / śaracāpadharaḥ śrīmān diśaṃ me pātu dakṣiṇām
verses.translation: May those great syllables (inalrkas) in the form of highly brilliant mantras protect me from other quarters. By their pervasiveness may they protect me from the sole of (he feet to the head.
verses.hindi: ३९१. साम्बतात:-साम्बके पिता, ३९२. बहुसुत: अधिक पुत्रोंवाले, ३९३. विधु:-विष्णुस्वरूप,

verses.sanskrit: महावश्यकरीयुक्तः सर्वशत्रुविनाशकृत् । महेषुचापधृक्पातु मम प्राचेतसीं दिशम्
verses.transliteration: mahāvaśyakarīyuktaḥ sarvaśatruvināśakṛt / maheṣucāpadhṛkpātu mama prācetasīṃ diśam
verses.translation: May K&rttavirya protect the bead. May Haihayel- vara (the Lord ofHaihaya) protect the forehead. MaySumukba
verses.hindi: ३९४. गर्गाचार्य:-गर्गमुनिको आचार्य बनानेवाले, ३९५. सत्यगतिः-"सत्यसे ही प्राप्त होनेवाले, ३९६. धर्माधार:-धर्मके आश्रय, ३९७. धराधर:- पृथ्वीको धारण करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: यशःकर्या समायुक्तो दैत्यसंघविनाशनः । परिरक्षतु मे सम्यग्विदिशं चैत्रभानवीम्
verses.transliteration: yaśaḥkaryā samāyukto daityasaṃghavināśanaḥ / parirakṣatu me samyagvidiśaṃ caitrabhānavīm
verses.translation: May Sukumara (the gentle one) protect the skin. May Dhanurdhara (the wielder of the bow) protect the pair of of eyebrows. May Pundarikak (the lotuseycd) protect the eye. May Gunakara (the storebousc of good qualities) protect my nose.
verses.hindi: ३९८. द्वारकामण्डन:-”द्वारकाको सुशोभित करनेवाले, ३९९. श्लोक्य:-यशोगानके योग्य,

verses.sanskrit: विद्याकरीसमायुक्तः सुमहहुःखनाशनः । पातु मे नैरृतीं चापपाणिर्विदिशमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vidyākarīsamāyuktaḥ sumahahuḥkhanāśanaḥ / pātu me nairṛtīṃ cāpapāṇirvidiśamīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: May BrahmajAeya (comprehensible only to Brahmi) ever protect the lips. May Kavi (the poet) protect the teeth. May Sarvaastra Kaladharin (one who possesses all scriptural lores and arts) protect the tongue.
verses.hindi: वेदोंके आश्रय, ४०२. पौण्ड्ूकप्राणहारी- मिथ्या वासुदेवनामधारी पौण्ड्कके प्राण लेनेवाले, ४०३. काशिराजशिरोहर:- काशिराजका सिर

verses.sanskrit: धनकर्या समायुक्तो महादुरित नाशनः । इष्वासनेषुधृक्पातु विदिशं मम वायवीम्
verses.transliteration: dhanakaryā samāyukto mahādurita nāśanaḥ / iṣvāsaneṣudhṛkpātu vidiśaṃ mama vāyavīm
verses.translation: May Dattatreyapriya (the favourite of Dattatreya) protect the neck. May Rajakuleivara (the lord of the Royal family) protect the shoulders. May Dai»yadarpaghna (the destroyer of the arrogance of (en*hcaded Ravana) protect the arms. May Mahabala (one of great strength) protect my heart.
verses.hindi: ४०४. अवैष्णवविप्रदाही"अवैष्णव ब्राह्मणोंको, जो यदुवंशियोंके प्रति मारणका प्रयोग कर रहे थे, दग्ध करनेवाले, ४०५. सुदक्षिणभयावह:- काशिराजके पुत्र सुदक्षिणणो भय देनेवाले,

verses.sanskrit: आयुःकर्या युतः श्रीमान्महाभयविनाशनः । चापेषुधारी शैवीं मे विदिशं परिरक्षतु
verses.transliteration: āyuḥkaryā yutaḥ śrīmānmahābhayavināśanaḥ / cāpeṣudhārī śaivīṃ me vidiśaṃ parirakṣatu
verses.translation: May Revambulllasaihdrpta (one who proudly sports about in the waters of Reva) protect the stomach. May vira iura (the hero and the valorous) protect my navel. May Sarvadufaha (the destroyer of all wicked ones) protect my sides.
verses.hindi: ४०६. जरासन्धविदारी"भीमसेनके द्वारा जरासन्धको चीर डालनेवाले, ४०७. धर्मनन्दनयज्ञकृत-धर्मपुत्र युधिष्ठटिरका यज्ञ पूर्ण करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: विजयश्रीयुतः साक्षात्सहस्रारधरो विभुः । दिशमूर्द्ध्वामवतु मे सर्वदुष्टभयङ्करः
verses.transliteration: vijayaśrīyutaḥ sākṣātsahasrāradharo vibhuḥ / diśamūrddhvāmavatu me sarvaduṣṭabhayaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: May Sahasrabhujabhrt (one who has a thousand arms) protect my back. May Saptadvipadhipa (the lord of seven continents) protect the hips. May Mahismadnatha> the lord of Mad)iati protect the thighs. May Bhuvah Vallabhah (the lover of the earth) protect the knees.
verses.hindi: ४०८. शिशुपालशिरश्छेदी-शिशुपालका सिर काटनेवाले, ४०९. दन्तवक्त्रविनाशन:-दन्तवक्त्रका नाश करनेवाले, ४१०. विदूरथान्तक:-विदूरथके काल, ४१९१. श्रीशः-लक्ष्मीके स्वामी,

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खभृत्सुमहाशक्तिसंयुतो ऽप्यधरां दिशम् । परिरक्षतु मे दुःखध्वान्तसम्भेदभास्करः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhabhṛtsumahāśaktisaṃyuto 'pyadharāṃ diśam / parirakṣatu me duḥkhadhvāntasambhedabhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: May viradhipa (the lord of the heroes) protect the calves. May Manojava (one who has the speed of the mind) protect the feet. May Sarvayudhadhara (the wielder of all weapons) protect all limbs and all vulnerable joints.
verses.hindi: बलभद्ररूपसे द्विविद वानरका नाश करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: महायोगसमायुक्तः सर्वदिक्चक्रमण्डलः । महायोगीश्वरः पातु सर्वतो मम पद्मभृत्
verses.transliteration: mahāyogasamāyuktaḥ sarvadikcakramaṇḍalaḥ / mahāyogīśvaraḥ pātu sarvato mama padmabhṛt
verses.translation: May Sarvadusantaka (tlie annihilator of all wicked persons) protect the body consisting of eight dhitus (fluids of
verses.hindi: ४१४. रूक्मिणीमानहारी-र॒ुक्मिणीका अभिमान दूर करनेवाले, ४१५. रुक्मिणीमानवर्धन:- रुक्मिणीका सम्मान बढ़ानेवाले, ४१६. देवर्षिशापहर्ता- देवर्षि नारदका शाप दूर करनेवाले,

verses.sanskrit: एतास्तु मूर्तयो रक्ता रक्तमाल्यांशुकावृताः । प्रधानदेवतारूपाः पृथग्रथवरे स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: etāstu mūrtayo raktā raktamālyāṃśukāvṛtāḥ / pradhānadevatārūpāḥ pṛthagrathavare sthitāḥ
verses.translation: May I become free from fear and liberated from hundreds of obstacles after tying up this kavaca of the ruler of Haihaya, which is divine and unbreakable.
verses.hindi: ४१७. द्रौपदीवाक्यपालकः-द्रौपदीके वचनोंका पालन करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: शक्तयः पद्महस्ताश्चत नीलेन्दीवरसन्न्निभाः । शुक्लमाल्यानुवसनाः सुलिप्ततिलकोज्ज्वलाः
verses.transliteration: śaktayaḥ padmahastāścata nīlendīvarasannnibhāḥ / śuklamālyānuvasanāḥ suliptatilakojjvalāḥ
verses.translation: SuJruta gives the names different GfaAor, see chapter 27. The names are:

verses.transliteration: tatpārśadeśvarāḥ svasvavāhanāyudhabhūṣaṇāḥ / svasvadikṣu sthitāḥ pāntu māmindrādyā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: SkMda 2. Skandpasinra 3. Sekunt, 4. Rsvail 5. Fulandy
verses.hindi: कुन्तीपुत्रोंक दुःखसमुदायका नाश करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: एतस्तस्य समाख्याताः सर्वावरणदेवताः । सर्वतो मां सदा पातुं सर्वशक्तिसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: etastasya samākhyātāḥ sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ / sarvato māṃ sadā pātuṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitāḥ

verses.sanskrit: हृदये चोदरे नाभौ जठरे गुह्यमण्डले । तेजोरूपाः स्थिताः पातुं वाञ्छासुखनद्रुमाः
verses.transliteration: hṛdaye codare nābhau jaṭhare guhyamaṇḍale / tejorūpāḥ sthitāḥ pātuṃ vāñchāsukhanadrumāḥ
verses.translation: By mentioning these one hundred and eight names (the devotee shall complete the puja). May the ten murtis spreading over ten directions protect me.
verses.hindi: ४२६. विश्वपालकपालक:-विश्वकी रक्षा करनेवाले

verses.sanskrit: दिशं चान्ये महावर्णा मन्त्ररूपा महोज्ज्वलाः । व्यापकत्वेन पान्त्वस्मानापादतलमस्तकम्
verses.transliteration: diśaṃ cānye mahāvarṇā mantrarūpā mahojjvalāḥ / vyāpakatvena pāntvasmānāpādatalamastakam
verses.translation: (If the devotee sees that his cattle and other wealth has been taken away by the thieves) he shall then repeat the mantra seven times at night in this that within seven days he regains all the articles lost.
verses.hindi: अर्जके सारथि, ४२८. सत्यःनसत्यस्वरूप, ४२९. सत्यसाध्य:-सत्यसे ही प्राप्त होने योग्य, ४३०. भयापहः-”भक्तोंके भयका नाश करनेवाले,

verses.sanskrit: कार्तवीर्यः शिरः पातु ललाटं हैहयेश्वरः । सुमुखो मे मुखं पातु कर्णौं व्याप्तजगत्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: kārtavīryaḥ śiraḥ pātu lalāṭaṃ haihayeśvaraḥ / sumukho me mukhaṃ pātu karṇauṃ vyāptajagattrayaḥ
verses.translation: If the man faces the east and repeats the Mantra twentyseven times he shall be able to withstand the hosts of enemies resembling Dev as and Asuras.
verses.hindi: सत्यमें रत, ४३३.सत्यप्रिय:-सत्य जिनको प्यारा है, ४३४. उदारधीः-उदार बुद्धिवाले।

verses.sanskrit: सुकुमारो हनुं पातु भ्रूयुगं मे धनुर्धरः । नयनं पुंमडरीकाक्षगो नासिकां मे गुणाकरः
verses.transliteration: sukumāro hanuṃ pātu bhrūyugaṃ me dhanurdharaḥ / nayanaṃ puṃmaḍarīkākṣago nāsikāṃ me guṇākaraḥ
verses.translation: During arguments and quarrels of terrible nature, he who reads this five times, shall surely be victorious. He will never court failure.
verses.hindi: ४३५. महासेनजयी-"शोणितपुरमें बाणासुरके पक्षमें युद्धुके लिये आये हुए स्वामिकार्तिकेयको भी परास्त करनेवाले, ४३६. शिवसैन्यविनाशन:- भगवान् शिवकी सेनाको मार भगानेवाले,

verses.sanskrit: अधरोष्ठौ सदा पातु ब्रह्ज्ञेयो द्विजान्कविः । सर्वशास्त्रकलाधारी जिह्वां चिबुकमव्ययः
verses.transliteration: adharoṣṭhau sadā pātu brahjñeyo dvijānkaviḥ / sarvaśāstrakalādhārī jihvāṃ cibukamavyayaḥ
verses.translation: In the course of affliction due to any sickness the devotee shall read this (kavaca) three or five times. He is then not afflicted by sickness death, vampires, goblins or ghosts.
verses.hindi: ४३७. बाणासुरभुजच्छेत्ता-बाणासुरकी भुजाओंको काटनेवाले, ४३८. बाणबाहुवरप्रदः-बाणासुरको चार भुजाओंसे युक्त रहनेका वर देनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: दत्तात्रेयप्रियः कण्ठं स्कन्धौ राजकुलेश्वरः । भुजौ दशास्यदर्पघ्नो हृदयं मे महाबलः
verses.transliteration: dattātreyapriyaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ skandhau rājakuleśvaraḥ / bhujau daśāsyadarpaghno hṛdayaṃ me mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: For the purpose of liberation from bondage one shall recite this twelve times during the night. There is no doubt about this that the man in bondage is liberated within three days.
verses.hindi: ४३९. तारक्ष्यमानापहारी-गरुड़का अभिमान चूर्ण करनेवाले, ४४०. ता्च्यतेजोविवर्धन:-गरुड़के तेजको बढ़ानेवाले, ४४१. रामस्वरूपधारी- श्रीरामका स्वरूप धारण करनेवाले, ४४२. सत्यभामामुदावहः-

verses.sanskrit: कुक्षिं रक्षतु मे विद्वान् वक्षः परपुरञ्जयः । करौ सर्वार्थदः पातुकराग्राणि जगत्प्रियः
verses.transliteration: kukṣiṃ rakṣatu me vidvān vakṣaḥ parapurañjayaḥ / karau sarvārthadaḥ pātukarāgrāṇi jagatpriyaḥ
verses.translation: By means of the same procedure in the activity of achieving anything even the inaccessible can be achieved by the most excellent of the knowers of the mantras within seven days.
verses.hindi: ४४३. रलाकरजलक्रीड:-समुद्रके जलमें क्रीडा करनेवाले, ४४४. ब्रजलीलाप्रदर्शक:-अधिकारी भक्तोंकी ब्रजलीलाका दर्शन करानेवाले, ४४५७. स्वप्रतिज्ञापरिध्वंसी-भीष्मजीकी प्रतिज्ञा

verses.sanskrit: रेवांबगुलीलासंहप्तो जठरं परिरक्षतु । वीरशूरस्तु मे नाभिं पार्श्वौ मे सर्वदुष्टहा
verses.transliteration: revāṃbagulīlāsaṃhapto jaṭharaṃ parirakṣatu / vīraśūrastu me nābhiṃ pārśvau me sarvaduṣṭahā
verses.translation: At the time of setting out on a journey a man shall read this Kavaca, then he will not have anything to fear from wicked thieves, tigers etc. or from enemies.
verses.hindi: रखनेके लिये अपनी प्रतिज्ञा तोड़ देनेवाले, ४ड६. भीष्माज्ञापरिपालकः-भीष्मकी आज्ञाका पालन करनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रभुजनृत्पृष्टं सप्तद्वीपाधिपः कटिम् । ऊरू माहिष्मतीनाथो जानुनी वल्लभो भुवः
verses.transliteration: sahasrabhujanṛtpṛṣṭaṃ saptadvīpādhipaḥ kaṭim / ūrū māhiṣmatīnātho jānunī vallabho bhuvaḥ
verses.translation: A man shall sprinkle handfuls of water over his body even as he recites this kavaca. He is not then harassed due to krtyas (evil influence of a mantra), poisons, ailments or swellings.
verses.hindi: ४४७. वीरायुधहर:-वीरोंके अस्त्र-शस्त्र हर लेनेवाले, ४४८. काल:-कालस्वरूप, ४४९. कालि- केश:-कालिकाके स्वामी, ४५०. महावलः-

verses.sanskrit: जङ्घे वीराधिपः पातु पातु पादौ मनोजवः । पातु सर्वायुधधरः सर्वाङ्गं सर्वमर्मसु
verses.transliteration: jaṅghe vīrādhipaḥ pātu pātu pādau manojavaḥ / pātu sarvāyudhadharaḥ sarvāṅgaṃ sarvamarmasu
verses.translation: A man shall sprinkle handfuls of water over his body even as he recites this kavaca. He is not then harassed due to krtyas (evil influence of a mantra), poisons, ailments or swellings.
verses.hindi: बर्बबीकका सिर कावनेवाले, ४५२. बर्बरीकशिरप्रद:-बर्बरीकका सिर देनेवाले।

verses.sanskrit: संपदस्तस्य जायन्ते जनास्तस्य वशे सदा । यः सेवते सदा विप्र श्रीमञ्चक्रावतारकम्
verses.transliteration: saṃpadastasya jāyante janāstasya vaśe sadā / yaḥ sevate sadā vipra śrīmañcakrāvatārakam
verses.translation: A man shall sprinkle handfuls of water over his body even as he recites this kavaca. He is not then harassed due to krtyas (evil influence of a mantra), poisons, ailments or swellings.
verses.hindi: ७११. मनोरमानश्रीकृष्णफेक मनको रमानेवाली, ७१२. नगधात्री-पर्वतोंके अधिष्ठात् देवताको उत्पन्न करनेवाली, ७१३. यशोदात्री-यश देनेवाली, ७१४. महादेवीजसर्वश्रेष्ठ देवी,

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रक्षां सदा कुर्याञ्चक्रं विष्णोर्महात्मनः । मयैतत्कवचं विप्र दत्तात्रेयान्मुनीश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: tasya rakṣāṃ sadā kuryāñcakraṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ / mayaitatkavacaṃ vipra dattātreyānmunīśvarāt
verses.translation: A man shall sprinkle handfuls of water over his body even as he recites this kavaca. He is not then harassed due to krtyas (evil influence of a mantra), poisons, ailments or swellings.
verses.hindi: ७१५. शुभड्डरी-कल्याण करनेवाली।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतं तुभ्यं निगदितं धारयस्वाखिलेष्टदम्
verses.transliteration: śrutaṃ tubhyaṃ nigaditaṃ dhārayasvākhileṣṭadam
verses.translation: A man shall sprinkle handfuls of water over his body even as he recites this kavaca. He is not then harassed due to krtyas (evil influence of a mantra), poisons, ailments or swellings.
verses.hindi: ७१६. श्रीशेषदेवजननी5"लक्ष्मीजी, शेषजी और देवताओंको उत्पन्न करनेवाली, ७१७. अवतारगणप्रसू:-अवतारगणोंको उत्तपन्न करनेवाली, ७१८. उत्पलाड्डनचहाथ-पैरोंमें

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे कार्तवीर्यकवचकथनं नाम सप्तसप्ततितोमो ऽध्यायः सनत्कुमार उवाच कार्तवीर्यस्य कवचं कथितं ते मुनीश्वर । मोहविध्वंसनं जैत्रं मारुतेः कवचं शृणु
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde kārtavīryakavacakathanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitomo 'dhyāyaḥ sanatkumāra uvāca kārtavīryasya kavacaṃ kathitaṃ te munīśvara / mohavidhvaṃsanaṃ jaitraṃ māruteḥ kavacaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: O leading sage, the kavaca of Karttavirya has been recounted to you. Now Ibten to the kavaca of Maruti (Hanuman) that destroys delusion and brings about victory.
verses.hindi: नील कमलके चिह्न धारण करनेवाली, ७१९. अरबविन्दाद्गागकमलके चिहसे युक्त, ७२०. प्रासादाद्भा-्मन्दिके चिहसे युक्त, ७२१. अद्वितीयका-जिसके समान दूसरी कोई

verses.sanskrit: यस्य संधारणात्सद्यः सर्वे नश्यन्त्युपद्रवाः । भूतप्रेतारिजं दुःखं नाशमेति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yasya saṃdhāraṇātsadyaḥ sarve naśyantyupadravāḥ / bhūtapretārijaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāśameti na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: By wearing it, all harassments perish instantaneously. There is no doubt about this that every misery originating fioin goblins and ghosts perishes.
verses.hindi: ७२२. रथाड्भलानरथके चिहसे युक्त, ७२३. कुझराड्भा-्हाथीके चिहसे युक्त, ७२४. कुण्डलाड्डपदस्थिता-चरणोंमें कुण्डलके चिहसे युक्त, ७२५. छत्राड्डाछत्रके चिहसे युक्त,

verses.sanskrit: एकदाहं गतो द्रष्टुं रामं रमयतां वरम् । आनन्दवनिकासंस्थं ध्यायन्तं स्वात्मनः पदम्
verses.transliteration: ekadāhaṃ gato draṣṭuṃ rāmaṃ ramayatāṃ varam / ānandavanikāsaṃsthaṃ dhyāyantaṃ svātmanaḥ padam
verses.translation: Once, I had been to Anandavanika forest to see Ra, the formost among those who delight others and meditating on his pure self.
verses.hindi: ७२६. विद्युदड्डा-वज्रंके चिहसे युक्त, ७२७. पुष्पमालाड्विता- पुष्पमालाके चिहसे युक्त।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र रामं रमानाथं पूजितं त्रिदशेश्वरैः । नमस्कृत्य तदादिष्टमासनं स्थितवान् पुरः
verses.transliteration: tatra rāmaṃ ramānāthaṃ pūjitaṃ tridaśeśvaraiḥ / namaskṛtya tadādiṣṭamāsanaṃ sthitavān puraḥ
verses.translation: There, on being asked by me the leadii king &rl Rama himself told me eagerly everything that happened ending with Ravapa's death.
verses.hindi: ७२८. दण्डाड्लाग्दण्डके चिहसे युक्त, ७२९. मुकुटाड्ला-्मुकुके चिहसे युक्त, ७३०. पूर्णचन्द्रापूर्णचन्द्रके सदूश शोभासम्पन्न,

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सर्वं मया वृत्तं रावणस्य वधान्तकम् । पृष्टं प्रोवाच राजेन्द्रः श्रीरामः स्वयमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tatra sarvaṃ mayā vṛttaṃ rāvaṇasya vadhāntakam / pṛṣṭaṃ provāca rājendraḥ śrīrāmaḥ svayamādarāt
verses.translation: Thereafter at the end of the narration of the story, the lord gave me the kavaca of Hanuman. I shall recount it to you. It should not be disclosed to anybody.
verses.hindi: ७३९१. शुकाड्डवितान्‍शुकके चिहसे युक्त, ७३२. कृष्णान्नाहारपाकानश्रीकृष्फो भोजन करानेके लिये भाँति-भाँतिकी रसोई तैयार करनेवाली, ७३३-वृन्दाकुखविहारिणी-वृन्दावनके

verses.sanskrit: ततः कथान्ते भगवान्मारुतेः कवचं ददौ । मह्यं तत्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि न प्रकाश्यं हि कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kathānte bhagavānmāruteḥ kavacaṃ dadau / mahyaṃ tatte pravakṣyāmi na prakāśyaṃ hi kutracit
verses.translation: In view of hk considering Hanumw as a child of hb, Sri Rama pointed out this Kavaca that will surely be the bestower of worldly pleasures and salvation, this kavaca of the son of AAjana.
verses.hindi: ७३४-.कृष्णप्रबोधनकरी-कृष्णतो शयनसे जगानेवाली, ७३५. कृष्णशेषान्नभोजिनी- श्रीकृष्णके आरोगनेसे बचे हुए प्रसादरूप अन्नको ग्रहण करनेवाली, ७३६. पद्मयकेसरमध्यस्था-कमलकेसरोंके

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यदेतन्निर्द्दिष्टं बालभावेन नारद । श्रीरामेणाञ्जनासूनासूनोर्भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyadetannirddiṣṭaṃ bālabhāvena nārada / śrīrāmeṇāñjanāsūnāsūnorbhuktimuktipradāyakam
verses.translation: May Hanuman protect me from the east, Pavanat* maja (son of wind-god) from the south. May the slayer of Ak protect me in the west and may Sagarataraka (one who has crossed the ocean) protect me in the north.
verses.hindi: मध्यमें विराजमान, ७३७. सड्डरीतागमवेदिनी- सड्गीतशास्त्रको जाननेवाली।

verses.sanskrit: हनुमान् पूर्वतः पातु दक्षिणे पवनात्मजः । पातु प्रतीच्यामक्षघ्नः सौम्ये सागरतारकः
verses.transliteration: hanumān pūrvataḥ pātu dakṣiṇe pavanātmajaḥ / pātu pratīcyāmakṣaghnaḥ saumye sāgaratārakaḥ
verses.translation: Let the beloved son ofKcsari, the leader of monkeys
verses.hindi: ७३८. कोटिकल्पान्तभ्रूभड़ाजअपने भ्रभड्रमात्रसे करोड़ों कल्पोंका अन्त करनेवाली, ७३९. अप्राप्तप्रलया-कभी प्रलयको प्राप्त न होनेवाली, ७४०, अच्युता-अपनी महिमासे कभी विचलित

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्द्ध पातु कपिश्रेष्ठः केसरिप्रियनन्दनः । अधस्ताद्विष्णुभक्तस्तु पातु मध्ये च पावनिः
verses.transliteration: ūrddha pātu kapiśreṣṭhaḥ kesaripriyanandanaḥ / adhastādviṣṇubhaktastu pātu madhye ca pāvaniḥ
verses.translation: May Lahkadahaka (one who burnt LahkA] protect me continuously from all mishaps. May the minister as Sugriva protect my head. Let the son of Vayu protect my forehead.
verses.hindi: न होनेवाली, ७४१. सर्वसत्त्यनिधि:-पूर्ण सत्त्तगुणकी निधि, ७४२. पद्शद्भादिनिधिसेविता-पद्म-शद्ठु आदि निधियोंसे सेवित।

verses.sanskrit: लङ्काविदाहकः पातु सर्वापद्भ्यो निरन्तरम् । सुग्रीवसचिवः पातु मस्तकं वायुनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: laṅkāvidāhakaḥ pātu sarvāpadbhyo nirantaram / sugrīvasacivaḥ pātu mastakaṃ vāyunandanaḥ
verses.translation: May Mahavira continuously protect me in the middle of the eyebrows. May the lord of monkeys the remover of chaya (shadow of Si la) protect the two eyes.
verses.hindi: अष्टविध गुणोंके ऐश्वयोंसे युक्त, ७४४. देववृन्दविमोहिनी- देवसमुदायको मोहित करनेवाली, ७४५. सबनिन्दप्रदा-सबको आनन्द देनेवाली, ७४६. सर्वान्सर्वस्वरूपा, ७४७.सुबर्णलतिकाकृति:-

verses.sanskrit: भालं पातु महावीरो भ्रुवोर्मध्ये निरन्तरम् । नेत्रे छायापहारी च पातु नः प्लवगेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bhālaṃ pātu mahāvīro bhruvormadhye nirantaram / netre chāyāpahārī ca pātu naḥ plavageśvaraḥ
verses.translation: May the servant ofSrirama protect the cheeks and the roots of the ears. May the son of AAjana protect the tip of thenose, may Harii vara (lord of the monkeys protect the mouth.
verses.hindi: स्वर्णमयी लताके समान आकृतिवाली।

verses.sanskrit: कपोलौ कर्णमूले च पातु श्रीरामकिङ्करः । नासाग्रमञ्जनासूनुः पातु वक्त्रं हरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kapolau karṇamūle ca pātu śrīrāmakiṅkaraḥ / nāsāgramañjanāsūnuḥ pātu vaktraṃ harīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: May the enemy of Daityas protect the neck, may the conqueror of the enemies of Devas protect the shoulders, may Mahatejas (one of excessive refulgence) protect the arms, Caranayudha (<mehaving the feet as weapons) protect the hands.
verses.hindi: ७४८. कृष्णाभिसारसंकेता-श्रीकृष्णसे मिलनेके लिये संकेतस्थानमें स्थित, ७४९. मालिनी-मालासे अलंकृत, ७५०. नृत्यपण्डिता-नृत्यकलाकी विदुषी, ७५१. गोपीसिन्धुसकाशाप्या 5 गोपीसमुदायरूपी

verses.sanskrit: पातु कण्ठे तु दैत्यारिः स्कन्धौ पातु सुरारिजित् । भुजौ पातु महातेजाः करौ च चरणायुधः
verses.transliteration: pātu kaṇṭhe tu daityāriḥ skandhau pātu surārijit / bhujau pātu mahātejāḥ karau ca caraṇāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: May Nakhayudha (one who has his nail as his wea¬ pons) protect my nails, may the lord of monkeys protect the belly, may Mudrapahi (who carried Rama's signet ring) protect the chest, may Bhujayudha (one with his arms as weapons) protect the sides.
verses.hindi: सिन्धुमें प्राप्त होनेवाली, ७५२. गोपमण्डपशोभिनी- वृषभानुगोपके मण्डपमें शोभा पानेवाली।

verses.sanskrit: नखान्नाखायुधः पातु कुक्षौ पातु कपीश्वरः । वक्षो मुद्रापहारी च पातु पार्श्वे भुजायुधः
verses.transliteration: nakhānnākhāyudhaḥ pātu kukṣau pātu kapīśvaraḥ / vakṣo mudrāpahārī ca pātu pārśve bhujāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: May Mahaprajfia (the highly intelligent one) protect the private parts, may Atitbipriya (one fond of guesu)
verses.hindi: ७५३. श्रीकृष्णप्रीतिदाश्रीकृष्णके प्रेमको प्रदान करनेवाली, ७५४. भीताश्रीकृष्णके वियोगके भयसे भीत, ७५५. प्रत्यड्भपुलकाश्निता-प्रत्येक अड़में श्रीकृष्ण-प्रेमजनित रोमाश्नसे युक्त,

verses.sanskrit: लङ्कानिभञ्जनः पातु पृष्टदेशे निरन्तरम् । नाभिं श्रीरामभक्तस्तु कटिं पात्वनिलात्मजः
verses.transliteration: laṅkānibhañjanaḥ pātu pṛṣṭadeśe nirantaram / nābhiṃ śrīrāmabhaktastu kaṭiṃ pātvanilātmajaḥ
verses.translation: May the excellent monkey protect the calves, may Mahabala (one of excessive strength) protect the heeb, may Acaloddhraka (the uplifter of the mountain) and Bhaskarasan- nibha (one who resembles the sun) protect my feet.
verses.hindi: ७५६. श्रीकृष्णालिड्रनरता-श्रीकृष्णका स्पर्श करमें तत्पर, ७५७. गोविन्दविरहाक्षमा- श्रीकृष्णका वियोग सहन करनेमें असमर्थ।

verses.sanskrit: गुह्यं पातु महाप्रज्ञः सक्थिनी अतिथिप्रियः । ऊरू च जानुनी पातु लङ्काप्रासादभञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: guhyaṃ pātu mahāprajñaḥ sakthinī atithipriyaḥ / ūrū ca jānunī pātu laṅkāprāsādabhañjanaḥ
verses.translation: May the monkey, son of the wjnd*god protect us day and night in the three worlds whether we are standing, goingi seated, drinking or eating.
verses.hindi: ७७५८. अनन्तगुणसम्पन्नाअनन्त गुणोंसे युक्त, ७५९. कृष्णकीर्तनलालसा-श्रीकृष्णके नाम और गुणोंके कीर्तन करनेकी रुचिवाली,

verses.sanskrit: जङ्घे पातु कपिश्रेष्ठो गुल्फौ पातु महाबलः । अचलोद्धारकः पातु पादौ भास्करसन्निभः
verses.transliteration: jaṅghe pātu kapiśreṣṭho gulphau pātu mahābalaḥ / acaloddhārakaḥ pātu pādau bhāskarasannibhaḥ
verses.translation: May Sarvarupa (the omnifbrmed), Sarvajfta (the omniscient) Sfjisthitikara (the cause of creation and sustenance) protect me. On seeing his terrible form al! terrible fellows run away.
verses.hindi: तीन बीजोंसे संयुक्तरूपवाली, ७६९१. कृष्णानुग्रहवाजछनी- श्रीकृष्णके अनुग्रहको चाहनेवाली।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गानि पातु सत्त्वाढ्यः पातु पादाङ्गुलीः सदा । मुखाङ्गानि महाशूरः पातु रोमाणि चात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: aṅgāni pātu sattvāḍhyaḥ pātu pādāṅgulīḥ sadā / mukhāṅgāni mahāśūraḥ pātu romāṇi cātmavān
verses.translation: I bow down to him who holds many and infinite cosmic eggs, whose form is that of Brahman who is of ihc nature of sam!rai>a (the wind god) and whose form is that of the Atman.
verses.hindi: ७६२. विमलादिनिषेव्या-विमला, उत्कर्षिणी आदि सखियोंद्वारा सेव्य, ७६३. ललिताद्यर्चिता- ललिता आदि सखियोंसे पूजित, ७६४. सती- उत्तम शील और सदाचारसे सम्पन्न, ७६५.

verses.sanskrit: दिवारात्रौ त्रिलोकेषु सदागतिलुतो ऽवतु । स्थितं व्रजन्तमासीनं पिबन्तं जक्षतं कपिः
verses.transliteration: divārātrau trilokeṣu sadāgatiluto 'vatu / sthitaṃ vrajantamāsīnaṃ pibantaṃ jakṣataṃ kapiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance unto Hanuman, obeisance to the son of the w nd god; obeisance to the devotee of $rl Rama, obeisance to the great Syama (dark-complexioned lord.)
verses.hindi: पद्मवन्दस्थिता- कमलवनमें निवास करनेवाली, ७६६. हष्टा-हर्षसे युक्त, ७६७. त्रिपुरापरिसेविता- त्रिपुरसुन्दरीके द्वारा सेवित।

verses.sanskrit: लोकोत्तरगुणः श्रीमान् पातु त्र्यंबकसंभवः । प्रमत्तमप्रमत्तं वा शयानं गहनेंऽबुनि
verses.transliteration: lokottaraguṇaḥ śrīmān pātu tryaṃbakasaṃbhavaḥ / pramattamapramattaṃ vā śayānaṃ gahaneṃ'buni
verses.translation: Obeisance to the heroic monkey, who brought al>out the alliance with Sugriva, who crossed the great ocean and who burned the whole of Lanka.
verses.hindi: ७६८. वृन्दावत्यर्चिता-वृन्दावती देवीके द्वारा

verses.sanskrit: स्थलेंऽतरिक्षे ह्यग्नौ वा पर्वते सागरे द्रुमे । संग्रामे संकटे घोरे विराङ्रूपधरो ऽवतु
verses.transliteration: sthaleṃ'tarikṣe hyagnau vā parvate sāgare drume / saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe ghore virāṅrūpadharo 'vatu
verses.translation: Obebance unto him who dispelled the sorrow of Sita, who carried Rama's signet ring, and who is the cause of Ravapa's end. Obeisance unto Sarvottaratinan (one who is of the form that is greater than everything).
verses.hindi: बुद्धिकी पहुँचसे परे, ७७२. भक्तवललभा-भत्तप्रिया,

verses.sanskrit: डाकिनीशाकिनीमारीकालरात्रिमरीचिकाः । शयानं मां विभुः पातु पिशाचोरगराक्षसीः
verses.transliteration: ḍākinīśākinīmārīkālarātrimarīcikāḥ / śayānaṃ māṃ vibhuḥ pātu piśācoragarākṣasīḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance, obebance unto the cause of destruction of the sacrifice of Meghanada. Obeisance unto the destroyer of tiae Aiok grove; unto the bestower of victory.
verses.hindi: घनीभूत सुखस्वरूपा, ७७४. श्रेयोहेतु:-कल्याणकी प्राप्तिमें हेतु, ७७५.सुभोगदा-मुक्तिप्रद भोग देनेवाली।

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यदेहधरो धीमान्सर्वसत्त्वभयङ्करः । साधकेन्द्रावनः शश्वत्पातु सर्वत एव माम्
verses.transliteration: divyadehadharo dhīmānsarvasattvabhayaṅkaraḥ / sādhakendrāvanaḥ śaśvatpātu sarvata eva mām
verses.translation: Obeisance unco the heroic son of the wind god, un¬ to him who passes the sky, unto him who cut off the head of the chief watchman of the grove, unto him who smashed down the palaces in Lanka.
verses.hindi: ७७६. सारड्भानश्रीकृष्णप्रेमकी प्यासी चातकी, ७७७, शारदानसरस्वतीस्वरूपा,

verses.sanskrit: यद्रूपं भीषणं दृष्ट्वा पलायन्ते भयानकाः । स सर्वरूपः सर्वज्ञः सृष्टिस्थितिकरो ऽवतु
verses.transliteration: yadrūpaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyante bhayānakāḥ / sa sarvarūpaḥ sarvajñaḥ sṛṣṭisthitikaro 'vatu
verses.translation: Obeisance unto you, the messenger of Rama unto him whose complexion is like that of shining gold, unto him who has a lor tail and unto him who had contributed to the sitccess ofSaumitri (Laksmai>a)»
verses.hindi: सुन्दर व॒ुन्दावनमें विचरनेवाली, ७८०. ब्रह्मानन्दा- ब्रह्मानन्दस्वरूपा, ७८१. चिदानन्दा-चिदानन्दमयी, ७८२. ध्यानानन्दा- श्रीकृष्ण-ध्यानजनित आननन्‍दमें मग्र, ७८३. अर्धमात्रिकान अर्धमात्रास्वरूपा।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्वयं विष्णुः साक्षाद्देवो महेश्वरः । सूर्यमण्डलगः श्रीदः पातु कालत्रये ऽपि माम्
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ brahmā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ sākṣāddevo maheśvaraḥ / sūryamaṇḍalagaḥ śrīdaḥ pātu kālatraye 'pi mām
verses.translation: Obebance, unto the slayer of.\ksa, unto him who warded oft* the miraculous weapon of Brahma, unto him who removed the wound'caused' by the great 'Sakti' in the body of Lak?maQ«r«
verses.hindi: ७८४.गन्धर्वा-गानविद्यामें प्रवीण, ७८५. सुरतन्ञाः सुरतकलाको जाननेवाली, ७८६. गोविन्दप्राणसड्रमा० गोविन्दके साथ एक प्राण होकर रहनेवाली, ७८७. कृष्णाड्ुभूषणा- श्रीकृष्णके अड्रोंको विभूषित

verses.sanskrit: यस्य शब्दमुपाकर्ण्य दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः । देवा मनुष्यास्तिर्यञ्चः स्थावरा जङ्गमास्तथा
verses.transliteration: yasya śabdamupākarṇya daityadānavarākṣasāḥ / devā manuṣyāstiryañcaḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāstathā
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance unto the slayer of the R$a- sas, the enemies and evil spirits. Obeisance, obeisance unto the delighter of the groups of heroic bears and monkeys.
verses.hindi: करनेवाली, ७८८. रत्रभूषणा-रल्मय आभूषण

verses.sanskrit: सभया भयनिर्मुक्ता भवन्ति स्वकृतानुगाः । यस्यानेककथाः पुण्याः श्रूयन्ते प्रतिकल्पके
verses.transliteration: sabhayā bhayanirmuktā bhavanti svakṛtānugāḥ / yasyānekakathāḥ puṇyāḥ śrūyante pratikalpake
verses.translation: Obeisance unto you the destroyer of the soldiers in the enemy army, unto the destroyer of weapons and missiles. Obeisance, obeisance unto the destroyer of poison, enemies and fear.
verses.hindi: धारण करनेवाली, ७८९. स्वर्णभूषिता5 सोनेके आभूषणोंसे विभूषित। ७९०. श्रीकृष्णददयावासा- श्रीकृष्णके हृदय-

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽवतात्साधकश्रेष्ठं सदा रामपरायणमः । वैधात्रधातृप्रभृति यत्किञ्चिद्दृश्यते ऽत्यलम्
verses.transliteration: so 'vatātsādhakaśreṣṭhaṃ sadā rāmaparāyaṇamaḥ / vaidhātradhātṛprabhṛti yatkiñciddṛśyate 'tyalam
verses.translation: Obeisance unto the destroyer of fear from great enemies, unto the sole cause of protection to the devotees, unto him who benumbs (i.e. nullifies) the mantras urged by others as well as those who chant the mantras.
verses.hindi: मन्दिमें. निवास करनेवाली, ७९१. मुक्ताकनकनासिका-नासिकामें मुक्तायुक्त सुवर्की आभूषण धारण करनेवाली,

verses.sanskrit: विद्ध्वि व्याप्तं यथा कीशरूपेणानञ्जनेन तत् । यो विभुः सो ऽहमेषो ऽहं स्वीयः स्वयमणुर्बृहत्
verses.transliteration: viddhvi vyāptaṃ yathā kīśarūpeṇānañjanena tat / yo vibhuḥ so 'hameṣo 'haṃ svīyaḥ svayamaṇurbṛhat
verses.translation: Obeisance, obeisance, unto him who causes rocks to float on water, unto him who swallows the disc of the rising sun, unto the remover of misery.
verses.hindi: ७९२. सद्र॒ल्लकड्भुणयुता5हाथोंमें सुन्दर रलजटित

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्यजुःसामरूपश्च प्रणवस्त्रिवृदध्वरः । तस्मै स्वस्मै च सर्वस्मै नतो ऽस्म्यात्मसमाधिना
verses.transliteration: ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpaśca praṇavastrivṛdadhvaraḥ / tasmai svasmai ca sarvasmai nato 'smyātmasamādhinā
verses.translation: Obeisance unto the terrible one turning nails for weapons, unto one who uses his teeth as weap>om, unto the traveller in the sky, unto Sarva (Siva i.e. Hanuman who is an incarnation of Siva), obeisance unto you of adamantine body.
verses.hindi: ७९४. स्वर्णनूपुरसम्पन्ना-सोनेके नृपुरोंसे

verses.sanskrit: अनेकानन्तब्रह्माण्डधृते ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणे । समीरणात्मने तस्मै नतो ऽस्म्यात्मस्वरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: anekānantabrahmāṇḍadhṛte brahmasvarūpiṇe / samīraṇātmane tasmai nato 'smyātmasvarūpiṇe
verses.translation: Obeisance unto you with the lion cloth as the sole garment, unto one who is devoted to Rama (engrossed in devotion to Rama) unto one who is the sun in the southern region, unto one who appears as the rising moon unto the good.
verses.hindi: सुवर्णी किल्लछिंणी (करधनी)-से अलंकृत, ७९६. अशेषरासकुतुका-महाराजके लिये उत्कण्ठित रहनेवाली, ७९७, रम्भोरु:-केलेके समान जंघावाली,

verses.sanskrit: नमो हनुमते तस्मै नमो मारुतसूनवे । नमः श्रीरामभक्ताय श्यामाय महते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo hanumate tasmai namo mārutasūnave / namaḥ śrīrāmabhaktāya śyāmāya mahate namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance unto the destroyer of the pain due to the wounds from Kuyis (evil influence of mantra), unto the remover of all pain, unto one who offered alliance and caused the victory of Partha (i.e. Arjuna ) in the battle at the behest of his Master.
verses.hindi: विहारिणी-स्वर्गसे भी परे गोलोक धाममें विहार करनेवाली, «०२. प्रसूनकबरी-वेणीमें फूलोंके

verses.sanskrit: नमो वानर वीराय सुग्रीवसख्यकारिणे । संकाविदहनायाथ महासागरतारिणे
verses.transliteration: namo vānara vīrāya sugrīvasakhyakāriṇe / saṃkāvidahanāyātha mahāsāgaratāriṇe
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who contributes to the success of devotees, in the divine atuments and in battle, unto one who produces the Kilakilirava (a sound expressive of joy) and unto one who produces terrible sounds.
verses.hindi: ८०४. महासिन्दूरसुन्दरी-उत्तम सिन्दूरसे अति

verses.sanskrit: सीताशोकविनाशाय राममुद्राधराय च । रावणान्तनिदानाय नमः सर्वोत्तरात्मने
verses.transliteration: sītāśokavināśāya rāmamudrādharāya ca / rāvaṇāntanidānāya namaḥ sarvottarātmane
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who causes the sarhstarnbhaja (steady and stunned state) of all fevers and ailments; unto the remover of terror; unto one who is particularly satisfied with the diet of the fruits in the forest.
verses.hindi: ८०५. कैशोरवयसा-किशोरावस्थासे युक्त,

verses.sanskrit: मेघनादमखध्वंसकारणाय नमोनमः । अशोकवनविध्वंसकारिणे जयदायिने
verses.transliteration: meghanādamakhadhvaṃsakāraṇāya namonamaḥ / aśokavanavidhvaṃsakāriṇe jayadāyine
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who causes the sarhstarnbhaja (steady and stunned state) of all fevers and ailments; unto the remover of terror; unto one who is particularly satisfied with the diet of the fruits in the forest.
verses.hindi: श्रीकृष्णनामरूपी सुधाका अधरोंके द्वारा नित्य आस्वादन करनेवाली, ८०९. श्यामप्रेमविनोदिनी श्रीकृष्णप्रेमसे ही मनोरञ्ञन करनेवाली।

verses.sanskrit: वायुपुत्राय वीराय आकाशोदरगामिने । वनपालशिरश्छेत्रे लङ्काप्रासादभञ्जिने
verses.transliteration: vāyuputrāya vīrāya ākāśodaragāmine / vanapālaśiraśchetre laṅkāprāsādabhañjine
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who causes the sarhstarnbhaja (steady and stunned state) of all fevers and ailments; unto the remover of terror; unto one who is particularly satisfied with the diet of the fruits in the forest.
verses.hindi: ८१०. शिखिपिच्छलसच्चूडा-मयूर-पंखसे सुशोभित केशोंवाली, ८११. स्वर्णचम्पकभूषिता» स्वर्णवम्पाके आभूषणोंसे विभूषित, ८१२.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलत्काञ्चनवर्णाय दीर्घलाङ्गूलधारिणे । सौमित्रिजयदात्रे च रामदूताय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: jvalatkāñcanavarṇāya dīrghalāṅgūladhāriṇe / saumitrijayadātre ca rāmadūtāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who causes the sarhstarnbhaja (steady and stunned state) of all fevers and ailments; unto the remover of terror; unto one who is particularly satisfied with the diet of the fruits in the forest.
verses.hindi: कस्तुरीके श्रृज्धासे सुशोभित, ८१३.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षस्य वधकर्त्रे च ब्रह्मशस्त्रनिवारिणे । लक्ष्मणाङ्गमहाशक्तिजातक्षतविनाशिने
verses.transliteration: akṣasya vadhakartre ca brahmaśastranivāriṇe / lakṣmaṇāṅgamahāśaktijātakṣatavināśine
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who causes the sarhstarnbhaja (steady and stunned state) of all fevers and ailments; unto the remover of terror; unto one who is particularly satisfied with the diet of the fruits in the forest.
verses.hindi: ८१४. हेमहारान्विता-सुवर्णके हारसे अलंकृत, ८१५. पुष्पहाराद्या-पुष्पमालासे मण्डित,

verses.sanskrit: रक्षोघ्नाय रिपुघ्नाय भूतघ्नाय नमोनमः । ऋक्षवानरवीरौघप्रासादाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: rakṣoghnāya ripughnāya bhūtaghnāya namonamaḥ / ṛkṣavānaravīraughaprāsādāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who causes the sarhstarnbhaja (steady and stunned state) of all fevers and ailments; unto the remover of terror; unto one who is particularly satisfied with the diet of the fruits in the forest.
verses.hindi: माधुर्य भावके कारण मधुर, ८१८. पद्मा-पद्मानामसे प्रसिद्ध, 2१९. पद्मरहस्ता-हाथमें कमल धारण करनेवाली, ८२०. सुविश्रुता-अति विख्यात।

verses.sanskrit: परसैन्यबलघ्नाय शस्त्रास्त्रघ्नाय ते नमः । विषघ्नाय द्विषघ्नाय भयघ्नाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: parasainyabalaghnāya śastrāstraghnāya te namaḥ / viṣaghnāya dviṣaghnāya bhayaghnāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who causes the sarhstarnbhaja (steady and stunned state) of all fevers and ailments; unto the remover of terror; unto one who is particularly satisfied with the diet of the fruits in the forest.
verses.hindi: ८२१. भ्रूभड्राभड्रकोदण्डकटाक्षसरसन्थिनी« श्रीकृष्णके प्रति तिरछी भौंहरूपी सुदृढ़ धनुषपर कटाक्षरूपी बाणोंका संधान करनेवाली, ८२२. शेषदेवशिरःस्था-शेषजीके मस्तकपर पृथ्वीके

verses.sanskrit: महीरिपुभयघ्नाय भक्तत्राणैककारिण । परप्रेरितमन्त्राणां मन्त्राणां स्तंभकारिणे
verses.transliteration: mahīripubhayaghnāya bhaktatrāṇaikakāriṇa / parapreritamantrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ staṃbhakāriṇe
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who causes the sarhstarnbhaja (steady and stunned state) of all fevers and ailments; unto the remover of terror; unto one who is particularly satisfied with the diet of the fruits in the forest.
verses.hindi: रूपमें स्थित, ८२३. नित्यस्थलबिहारिणी-नित्य लीला-स्थलियोंमें विचरनेवाली।

verses.sanskrit: पयः पाषाणतरणकारणाय नमोनमः । बालार्कमण्डलग्रासकारिणे दुःखहारिणे
verses.transliteration: payaḥ pāṣāṇataraṇakāraṇāya namonamaḥ / bālārkamaṇḍalagrāsakāriṇe duḥkhahāriṇe
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one who causes the sarhstarnbhaja (steady and stunned state) of all fevers and ailments; unto the remover of terror; unto one who is particularly satisfied with the diet of the fruits in the forest.

verses.translation: (BhuU Suddhi). Hie purification of the elemenu, the constituents of the phyijcal body, is to be done by means of First of aU one
