verses.hindi: गोबरको धरतीपर गिरनेसे पहले आकाशमेंसे ही ले ले। उस गोबरसे एक सौ आठ पिण्ड बनाकर उन्हें तॉबे या मिट्टीके पात्रमें रखकर धूपमें सुखा ले। फिर एकादशीको उपवास करके भगवान्

verses.sanskrit: पितास्माकं मुनिश्रेष्ठ मानसीं कल्पदैहिकीम् । ततः पश्चात्पञ्चवक्त्रं कृष्णं प्राह महामते
verses.transliteration: pitāsmākaṃ muniśreṣṭha mānasīṃ kalpadaihikīm / tataḥ paścātpañcavaktraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāha mahāmate
verses.translation: Worshipping of Sarasvatl.
verses.hindi: विष्णुकी स्वर्णमयी प्रतिमाका विधिपूर्वक पूजन और सात्रिमें जागरण करे। सुन्दर मड्भलमय गीतवाद्य, स्तोत्र-पाठ और जप आदिके द्वारा जागरणका कार्य सफल बनावे। तत्पश्चात् प्रात:-

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गां गृहाण विश्वेश शिवलोके तपश्वर । यावत्सृष्टिस्तदन्ते तु लोकान्संहर सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: durgāṃ gṛhāṇa viśveśa śivaloke tapaśvara / yāvatsṛṣṭistadante tu lokānsaṃhara sarvataḥ
verses.translation: After performing six aAgas with aim the aspiring sildhaka shall fix the syllables. He shall fix ohkira in the cerebral orifice. He shall fix hrim in between the eyebrows. He shall fix syllables beginning with iri in the mouthy nostrib, ears and rectum.
verses.hindi: काल जलसे भरे हुए कलशपर तिलसे भरा पात्र रखकर उसके ऊपर उस स्वर्णमयी प्रतिमाको रखे और विभिन्न उपचारोंसे उसकी पूजा करे। इसके बाद दो काष्ठोंके रगड़ने आदिके द्वारा नूतन अग्रि

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि कृष्णं नमस्तृत्य शिवलोकं जगाम ह । ततः कालान्तरे ब्रह्मन्कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi kṛṣṇaṃ namastṛtya śivalokaṃ jagāma ha / tataḥ kālāntare brahmankṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The excellent sidhaka shall repeat the mantra one million two hundred thousand times with white lotuses naga flowers or campaka flowers.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न करके उसकी पूजा करे और दिद्वान् पुरुष उस प्रज्वलित अग्रिमें तिल और घीसहित एक- एक गोमय-पिण्डका विष्णुसम्बन्धी द्वादशाक्षर -

verses.sanskrit: वक्त्रात्सरस्वती जाता बीणापुस्तकधारिणी । तामादिदेश भघगवान् वैकुण्ठं गच्छ मानदे
verses.transliteration: vaktrātsarasvatī jātā bīṇāpustakadhāriṇī / tāmādideśa bhaghagavān vaikuṇṭhaṃ gaccha mānade
verses.translation: He shall wonhip in the aforesaid altar of mitrkas in accordance with the injunction to be laid down later on. He shall make the seat with letters in the form of a lotus and conceive the form of the deity with the mulamantra.
verses.hindi: प्रेमपूर्ण हृदयसे प्रसन्नतापूर्वक एक सौ आठ ब्राह्मणोंको खीर भोजन करावे। फिर कलशसहित वह प्रतिमा आचार्यको अर्पित करे। तदनन्तर दूसरे ब्राह्मणोंको यथाशक्ति दक्षिणा दे। पुरुष हो

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीसमीपे तिष्ठ त्वं चतुर्भुजसमाश्रया । सापि कृष्णं नमस्कृत्य गता नारायणान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīsamīpe tiṣṭha tvaṃ caturbhujasamāśrayā / sāpi kṛṣṇaṃ namaskṛtya gatā nārāyaṇāntikam
verses.translation: To the right side of the deity the splendid Sanskrit must be worshipped. The Prakfta mode of words, the bes- tower of all siddhb must be worshipped to the left side.
verses.hindi: या स्त्री, इस ब्रतका आदरपूर्वक पालन करके वह रूप और सौभाग्य प्राप्त कर लेती है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं पञ्चविधा जाता सा राधा सृष्टिकारणम् । आसां पूर्णस्वरूपाणां मन्त्रध्यानार्चनादिकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pañcavidhā jātā sā rādhā sṛṣṭikāraṇam / āsāṃ pūrṇasvarūpāṇāṃ mantradhyānārcanādikam
verses.translation: The devotee shall stand in chest-deepwater meditat¬ ing on the goddess stationed in the disc of the sun. Everyday he shall repeat the mantra three thousand times.
verses.hindi: माघ शुक्ला द्वादशीको शालग्रामशिलाकी विधिपूर्वक भक्तिभावसे पूजा करके उसके मुख्यभागमें सुवर्ण रखे। फिर उसे चाँदीके पात्रमें रखकर दो शत वस्त्रोंसे ढक दे। तत्पश्चात् वेदवेत्ता ब्राह्मणको

verses.sanskrit: वदामि शृणु विप्रेद्रं लोकानां सिद्धिदायकम् । तारः क्रियायुक् प्रतिश्ठा प्रीत्याढ्या च ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: vadāmi śṛṇu vipredraṃ lokānāṃ siddhidāyakam / tāraḥ kriyāyuk pratiśṭhā prītyāḍhyā ca tataḥ param
verses.translation: In the three comers Brahmi and other Saktis are to be worshipped in the three corners and outside of it Adityas are to be worshipped along with in due sequence.
verses.hindi: उसका दान दे। दान देनेके पश्चात् उस ब्राह्मणको खाँड़ और घीके साथ हितकर खीरका भोजन करावे, यह करके स्वयं एक समय भोजनका ब्रत करते हुए भगवान् विष्णुके चिन्तनमें लगा रहे।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानामृता क्षुधायुक्ता वह्निजायान्तकतो मनुः । सुतपास्तु ऋषिश्छन्दो गायत्री देवता मनोः
verses.transliteration: jñānāmṛtā kṣudhāyuktā vahnijāyāntakato manuḥ / sutapāstu ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā manoḥ
verses.translation: Then, he shall worship planets and Indra and others outside of it along with their weapons. Thus, the devotee shall worship the goddess with her tenavarana deities.
verses.hindi: ऐसा करनेवाला पुरुष यहाँ मनोवाओज्छित भोग भोगनेके पश्चात् विष्णुधाम प्राप्त कर लेता है। ब्रह्मन्! फाल्गुन मासके शुक्लपक्षकी द्वादशीको श्रीहरिकी सुवर्णमयी प्रतिमाका गन्ध-पुष्प आदिसे

verses.sanskrit: राधिका प्रणवो बीजं स्वाहा शक्तिरुदाहृता । षडक्षरैः षडङ्गानि कुर्याद्विन्दुविभूषितैः
verses.transliteration: rādhikā praṇavo bījaṃ svāhā śaktirudāhṛtā / ṣaḍakṣaraiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryādvinduvibhūṣitaiḥ
verses.translation: He shall repeat mantra eight hundred thousand times and perform homas eight thousand limes with gingelly seeds. He will liberate himself from all sins and attain longevity.
verses.hindi: पूजन करके उसे वेदवेत्ता ब्राह्मणको दान कर दे। फिर बारह ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन करा उन्हें दक्षिणा देकर विदा करे। उसके बाद स्वयं भाई- बन्धुओंके साथ भोजन करे। त्रिस्पृशा, उन्‍्मीलनी,

verses.sanskrit: ततो ध्यायन्स्वहृदये राधिकां कृष्णभामिनीम् । श्वेतचंपकवर्णाभां कोटिचन्द्रसमप्रभाम्
verses.transliteration: tato dhyāyansvahṛdaye rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇabhāminīm / śvetacaṃpakavarṇābhāṃ koṭicandrasamaprabhām
verses.translation: He shall perform ten thousand homas with red lotuses soaked intrimadhu. There is no doubt that MahalaksmI will favour him within six months.
verses.hindi: अपराजिता--ये आठ प्रकारकी द्वादशी तिथियाँ सब पापोंका नाश करनेवाली हैं। इनमें सदा उपवासपूर्वक व्रत रहना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यां नीलेन्दीवरलोचनाम् । सुश्रोणीं सुनितंबां च पक्वबिंबाधरांबराम्
verses.transliteration: śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ nīlendīvaralocanām / suśroṇīṃ sunitaṃbāṃ ca pakvabiṃbādharāṃbarām
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee shall perform the pervasive nyasa by means of the mula mantra thrice. He shall meditate on the deity as mentioned before with forms and attributes.
verses.hindi: श्रीनारदजीने पूछा--ब्रह्मन्! इन सब द्वादशियोंका लक्षण कैसा है ? और उनका फल कैसा होता है, वह सब मुझे बताइये। इसके सिवा अन्य पुण्यदायक तिथियोंका भी परिचय दीजिये।

verses.sanskrit: मुक्ताकुन्दाभदशनां वह्निशुद्धांशुकान्विताम् । रत्नकेयूरवलयहारकुण्डलशोभिताम्
verses.transliteration: muktākundābhadaśanāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitām / ratnakeyūravalayahārakuṇḍalaśobhitām
verses.translation: May the fourfooted deity Brahmai, having the staff of Brahma having the face towards the south» and possessing twentysix tattvas protect my southern quarter.
verses.hindi: सूतजी कहते हैं--महर्षियो! देवर्षि नारदने द्विजश्रेष्ठ सनातनजीसे जब इस प्रकार प्रश्न किया

verses.sanskrit: गोपीभिः सुप्रियाभिश्च सेवितां श्वेतचामरैः । रासमण्डलमध्यस्थां रत्नसिंहासनस्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: gopībhiḥ supriyābhiśca sevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ / rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitām
verses.translation: May the deity marked by Brahma's head having the face towards the west, the one with five feet and with the form of fifty tattvas protect my western quarter.
verses.hindi: तो सनातन मुनिने अपने भाई महाभागवत नारदजीकी प्रशंसा करके कहा। सनातनजी बोले--भेया ! तुम तो साधु पुरुषोंके संशयका निवारण करनेवाले हो। तुमने यह बहुत

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं क्षिप्त्वा पूजयेदुपचारकैः । लक्षषट्कं जपेन्मन्त्रं तद्दशांशं हुनेत्तिलैः
verses.transliteration: dhyātvā puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣiptvā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ / lakṣaṣaṭkaṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunettilaiḥ
verses.translation: May the sixfooted deity possessing Brahman as the fourth, gentle, in face of the nature of Atharv&ngirasa and of the nature of sixty tattvas and kalas protect my northern quarter.
verses.hindi: सुन्दर प्रश्न किया है। मैं तुम्हें महाद्वादशियोंके

verses.sanskrit: आज्याक्तैर्मातृकापीठे पूजा चावरणैः सह । षट्कोणेषु षडङ्गानि तद्बाह्ये ऽष्टदले यजेत्
verses.transliteration: ājyāktairmātṛkāpīṭhe pūjā cāvaraṇaiḥ saha / ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni tadbāhye 'ṣṭadale yajet
verses.translation: May the ninefooted deity, constituted of fifty letters and hundred syllables, Vyoma stationed in tbe Ved&nta protect my upper region.
verses.hindi: जिस दिन एकादशी सूर्योदयसे पहले-- अरुणोदयकालमें ही निवृत्त हो गयी हो, (दिनभर द्वादशी हो और रातके अन्तिम भागमें त्रयोदशी

verses.sanskrit: मालावतीं माधवीं च रत्नमालां सुशीलिकाम् । ततः शशिकलां पारिजातां पद्मावतीं तथा
verses.transliteration: mālāvatīṃ mādhavīṃ ca ratnamālāṃ suśīlikām / tataḥ śaśikalāṃ pārijātāṃ padmāvatīṃ tathā
verses.translation: May Brahmasandhya resembling the lightening! having four arms, seated on the deer, holding bow and arrows, leathershicld and sword protect my south-eastern direction.
verses.hindi: द्वादशी होती है। उसका महान् फल होता है। नारद! जो मनुष्य उसमें उपवास करके भगवान् गोविन्दका पूजन करता है, वह निश्चय ही एक हजार अश्वमेध-यज्ञका फल पाता है। जब

verses.sanskrit: सुंदरीं च क्रमात्प्राच्यां दिग्विदिक्षु ततो बहिः । इन्द्राद्यान्सायुधानिष्ट्वा विनियोगांस्तु साधयेत्
verses.transliteration: suṃdarīṃ ca kramātprācyāṃ digvidikṣu tato bahiḥ / indrādyānsāyudhāniṣṭvā viniyogāṃstu sādhayet
verses.translation: May virgin Brahmi, Gayatri of red limbs having swan as the vehicle and holding water pot, rosary and the sacrificial ladles, sruk and sruva protect my south-western direction.
verses.hindi: अरुणोदयकालमें एकादशी तिथि दशमीसे विद्ध हो (और एकादशी पूरे दिन रहकर दूसरे दिन भी कुछ कालतक विद्यमान हो) तो उस प्रथम दिनकी एकादशीको छोड़कर दूसरे दिन महाद्वादशीको

verses.sanskrit: राधा कृष्णप्रिया रासेश्वरी गोपीगणाधिपा । निर्गुणा कृष्णपूज्या च मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी
verses.transliteration: rādhā kṛṣṇapriyā rāseśvarī gopīgaṇādhipā / nirguṇā kṛṣṇapūjyā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī
verses.translation: May the white-complexioned youthful Savitri, having bull for her vehicle and holding skull, trident, rosary and garland protect my north-western direction.
verses.hindi: उपवास करे (उसे “उन्मीलनी' द्वादशी कहते हैं)। उस उन्मीलनी ब्रतमें उत्तम पूजाकी विधिसे भगवान् वासुदेवका यजन करके मनुष्य एक सहसत्र राजसूय-यज्ञका फल पाता है। जब

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेश्वरी सर्वपूज्या वैराजजननी तथा । पूर्वाद्याशासु रक्षन्तु पान्तु मां सर्वतः सदा
verses.transliteration: sarveśvarī sarvapūjyā vairājajananī tathā / pūrvādyāśāsu rakṣantu pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadā
verses.translation: May the aged Sarasvatl of darit complexion be- loiing to ViQU, seated on Garud& and bolding the conch, the discus and the gesture of fearlessness protect my north-eastern direction.
verses.hindi: सूर्योदयकालमें दशमी एकादशीका स्पर्श करती हो (और द्वादशीकी वृद्धि हुई हो) तो उस एकादशीको त्यागकर “वज्जुली' नामवाली उस महाद्वादशीको ही सदा उपवास करना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: त्वं देवि जगतां माता विष्णुमाया सनातनी । कृष्णमायादिदेवी च कृष्णप्राणाधिके शुभे
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ devi jagatāṃ mātā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī / kṛṣṇamāyādidevī ca kṛṣṇaprāṇādhike śubhe
verses.translation: May their respective weapons and ornaments stationed in their respective sides and quarters and the laktis associated with the limbs of planets protect me.
verses.hindi: उसमें सबको सदा अभयदान करनेवाले परम पुरुष संकर्षणदेवका गन्ध आदि उपचारोंसे भक्तिपूर्वक पूजन करे। यह महाद्वादशी सम्पूर्ण यज्ञोंका फल देनेवाली, सब पापोंको हर लेनेवाली तथा समस्त

verses.sanskrit: कष्णभक्तिप्रदे राधे नमस्ते मङ्गलप्रदे । इति सम्प्रार्थ्य सर्वेशीं स्तुत्वा हृदि विसर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: kaṣṇabhaktiprade rādhe namaste maṅgalaprade / iti samprārthya sarveśīṃ stutvā hṛdi visarjayet
verses.translation: The deities presiding over mudris as the presiding deities of mantras, protect us spreading over the body from head to foot.
verses.hindi: सम्पदाओंको देनेवाली कही गयी है। विप्रवर! जब पूर्णिमा अथवा अमावास्या नामकी तिथियाँ बढ जाती हैं, तो उस पक्षकी द्वादशीका नाम 'पक्षवर्धिनी' होता है, जो महान् फल देनेवाली

verses.sanskrit: एवं यो भजते राधां सर्वाद्यां सर्वमङ्गलाम् । भुक्त्वेह भोगानखिलान्सो ऽन्ते गोलोकमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yo bhajate rādhāṃ sarvādyāṃ sarvamaṅgalām / bhuktveha bhogānakhilānso 'nte golokamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: है। उसमें सम्पूर्ण ऐश्वर्य प्रदान करनेवाले तथा पुत्र और पौनत्रोंको बढ़ानेवाले जगदीश्वर भगवान प्रद्युम्नका पूजन करना चाहिए। जब शुक्‍्लपफक्षमें द्वादशी तिथि मघा नक्षत्रसे युक्त हो तो उसका नाम

verses.sanskrit: अथ तुभ्यं महालक्ष्म्या विधानं वच्मि नारद । यदाराधनतो भूयात्साधको भुक्तिमुक्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: atha tubhyaṃ mahālakṣmyā vidhānaṃ vacmi nārada / yadārādhanato bhūyātsādhako bhuktimuktimān
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: “जया” होता है। वह सम्पूर्ण शत्रुओंका विनाश करनेवाली है। उसमें समस्त कामनाओंके दाता और मनुष्योंको सम्पूर्ण सौभाग्य प्रदान करनेवाले लक्ष्मीपति भगवान् अनिरुद्धकी आराधना करनी

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीमायाकामवाणीपूर्वा कमलवासिनी । ङेंता वह्निप्रियान्तो ऽयं मन्त्रकल्पद्रुमः परः
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīmāyākāmavāṇīpūrvā kamalavāsinī / ṅeṃtā vahnipriyānto 'yaṃ mantrakalpadrumaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। जब शुक्‍्लपक्षमें द्वादशी तिथि श्रवण नक्षत्रसे युक्त हो तो वह 'विजया' नामसे प्रसिद्ध होती है। उसमें सदा समस्त भोगोंके आश्रय तथा सम्पूर्ण सौख्य प्रदान करनेवाले भगवान् गदाधरकी

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिर्नारायणश्चास्य छन्दो हि जगती तथा । देवता तु महालक्ष्मीर्द्विद्विवर्णैः षडङ्गकम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣirnārāyaṇaścāsya chando hi jagatī tathā / devatā tu mahālakṣmīrdvidvivarṇaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgakam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: पूजा करनी चाहिए। विप्रवर ! 'विजया 'में उपवास करके मनुष्य सम्पूर्ण तीर्थोका फल पाता है। जब शुक्लपक्षमें द्वादशी रोहिणी नक्षत्रसे युक्त होती है, तब वह महापुण्यमयी “जयन्ती” नामसे प्रसिद्ध

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतचंपकवर्णाभां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् । ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यां भक्तानुग्रहकातराम्
verses.transliteration: śvetacaṃpakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām / īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: होती है। उसमें मनुष्योंको सिद्धि देनेवाले भगवान् वामनकी अर्चना करनी चाहिए। यह तिथि उपवास करनेपर सम्पूर्ण ब्रतोंका फल देती है, समस्त दानोंका फल प्रस्तुत करती है और भोग

verses.sanskrit: बिभ्रतीं रत्नमालां च कोटिचन्द्रसमप्रभाम् । ध्यात्वा जपेदर्कलक्षं पायसेन दशांशतः
verses.transliteration: bibhratīṃ ratnamālāṃ ca koṭicandrasamaprabhām / dhyātvā japedarkalakṣaṃ pāyasena daśāṃśataḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: तथा मोक्ष देनेवाली होती है। जब शुक्लपक्षमें द्वादशी तिथि पुष्य नक्षत्रसे युक्त हो तो उसे अपराजिता' कहा गया है। वह सम्पूर्ण ज्ञान देनेवाली है। उसमें संसार-बन्धनका नाश करनेवाले,

verses.sanskrit: जुहुयादेधिते वह्नौ श्रीदृकाष्टैः समर्चयेत् । नवशक्तियुते पीठे ह्यङ्गै रावरणैः सह
verses.transliteration: juhuyādedhite vahnau śrīdṛkāṣṭaiḥ samarcayet / navaśaktiyute pīṭhe hyaṅgai rāvaraṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानके समुद्र तथा रोग-शोकसे रहित भगवान् नारायणकी आराधना करनी चाहिए। उस तिथिको उपवास करके ब्राह्ममभोजन करानेवाला मनुष्य उस ब्रतके पुण्यसे ही संसार-बन्धनसे मुक्त हो

verses.sanskrit: विभूतिरुन्नतिः कान्तिः सृष्टिः कीर्तिश्च सन्नतिः । व्याष्टिरुत्कृष्टिरृद्धिश्च संप्रोक्ता नव शक्तयः
verses.transliteration: vibhūtirunnatiḥ kāntiḥ sṛṣṭiḥ kīrtiśca sannatiḥ / vyāṣṭirutkṛṣṭirṛddhiśca saṃproktā nava śaktayaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: जब आषाढ़ शुक्ला द्वादशीको अनुराधा नक्षत्र हो, तब दो ब्रत करने चाहिए। यहाँ एक ही

verses.sanskrit: अत्रावाह्य च मूलेन मूर्तिं संकल्प्य साधकः । षट् कोणेषु षडङ्गानि दक्षिणे तु गजाननम्
verses.transliteration: atrāvāhya ca mūlena mūrtiṃ saṃkalpya sādhakaḥ / ṣaṭ koṇeṣu ṣaḍaṅgāni dakṣiṇe tu gajānanam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: जब भाद्रपद शुक्ला द्वादशीको श्रवण नक्षत्रका योग हो और कार्तिक शुक्ला द्वादशीको रेवती

verses.sanskrit: वामे कुसुमधन्वानं वसुपत्रे ततो यजेत् । उमां श्रीं भारतीं दुर्गां धरणीं वेदमातरम्
verses.transliteration: vāme kusumadhanvānaṃ vasupatre tato yajet / umāṃ śrīṃ bhāratīṃ durgāṃ dharaṇīṃ vedamātaram
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रका संयोग हो तो एकादशी और द्वादशी  पातकोंका नाश करनेवाला बताया गया है। दोनों दिन ब्रत रहने चाहिए। विप्रवर! इनके  द्वादशीसहित एकादशीका ब्रत नित्य माना गया सिवा अन्यत्र द्वादशीको एक समय भोजन करके  है, अत: यहाँ उसका उद्यापन नहीं कहा गया।

verses.sanskrit: देवीमुषां च पूर्वादौ दिग्विदिक्षु क्रमेण हि । जह्नुसूर्यसुते पूज्ये पादप्रक्षालनोद्यते
verses.transliteration: devīmuṣāṃ ca pūrvādau digvidikṣu krameṇa hi / jahnusūryasute pūjye pādaprakṣālanodyate
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: ब्रत रहना चाहिए। यह ब्रत स्वभावसे ही सब  इसे जीवनपर्यन्त करते रहना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खपद्मनिधी पूज्यौ पार्श्वयोर्घृतचामरौ । धृतातपत्रं वरुणं पूजयेत्पश्चिमे ततः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhapadmanidhī pūjyau pārśvayorghṛtacāmarau / dhṛtātapatraṃ varuṇaṃ pūjayetpaścime tataḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: त्रयोदशी-सम्बन्धी त्रतोंकी विधि और महिमा

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्य राशीन्परितो यथास्थानं नवग्रहान् । चतुर्दन्तैरावतादीन् दिग्विदिक्षु ततोर्ऽचयेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjya rāśīnparito yathāsthānaṃ navagrahān / caturdantairāvatādīn digvidikṣu tator'cayet
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: यथाशक्ति सोने, चाँदी अथवा मिट्टीकी मूर्ति बनाकर उनकी पूजा करे। भगवती उमा सिंहपर बैठी हों और भगवान् शद्भूर वृषभपर। नारद!

verses.sanskrit: तद्बहिर्लोकपालांश्च तदस्त्राणि च तद्बहिः । दूर्वाभिराज्यसिक्ताभिर्जुहुयादायुषे नरः
verses.transliteration: tadbahirlokapālāṃśca tadastrāṇi ca tadbahiḥ / dūrvābhirājyasiktābhirjuhuyādāyuṣe naraḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: सनातनजी कहते हैं--नारद! अब में तुम्हें त्रयोदशीके ब्रत बतलाता हूँ, जिनका भक्तिपूर्वक पालन करके मनुष्य इस पृथ्वीपर सौभाग्यशाली होता है। चैत्र कृष्णपक्षकी त्रयोदशी शनिवारसे

verses.sanskrit: गुडूचीमाज्यसंसिक्तां जुहुयात्सप्तवासरम् । अषअटोत्तरसहस्रं यः स जीवेच्छरदां शतम्
verses.transliteration: guḍūcīmājyasaṃsiktāṃ juhuyātsaptavāsaram / aṣaaṭottarasahasraṃ yaḥ sa jīveccharadāṃ śatam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: युक्त हो तो “महावारुणी” मानी गयी है। यदि उसमें गड़ा-स््नानका अवसर मिले तो वह कोटि सूर्यग्रहणोंसे अधिक फल देनेवाली है। चैत्रके कृष्णपक्षमें त्रयोशशीको शुभ योग, शतभिषा

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा तिलान्घृताभ्यक्तान्दीर्घमायुष्यमाप्नुयात् । आरभ्यार्कदिनं मन्त्री दशाहं घृतसंप्लुतः
verses.transliteration: hutvā tilānghṛtābhyaktāndīrghamāyuṣyamāpnuyāt / ārabhyārkadinaṃ mantrī daśāhaṃ ghṛtasaṃplutaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्र और शनिवारका योग हो तो वह “महामहावारुणी '- के नामसे विख्यात होती है। ज्येष्ठ शुक्ला त्रयोदशीको 'दौर्भाग्यशमनब्रत' होता है। उस दिन नदीके जलमें स्नान करके पवित्र

verses.sanskrit: जुहुयादर्कसमिधः शरीरारोग्यसिद्धये । शालिभिर्जुह्वतो नित्यमष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: juhuyādarkasamidhaḥ śarīrārogyasiddhaye / śālibhirjuhvato nityamaṣṭottarasahasrakam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: स्थानमें उत्पन्न हुए सफेद मदार, आक और लाल कनेरकी पूजा करे। उस समय आकाशमें सूर्यकी ओर देखकर निम्नाद्धित मन्त्रका उच्चारण करते हुए प्रार्थना करें--

verses.sanskrit: अचिरादेव महती लक्ष्मी संजायते ध्रुवम् । उषाजा जीनालिकेररजोभिर्गृतमिश्रितैः
verses.transliteration: acirādeva mahatī lakṣmī saṃjāyate dhruvam / uṣājā jīnālikerarajobhirgṛtamiśritaiḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: मन्दारकरवीराका भवन्तो भास्करांशजा:

verses.sanskrit: हुनेदष्टोत्तरशतं पायसाशी तु नित्यशः । मण्डलाज्जायते सो ऽपि कुबेर इव मानवः
verses.transliteration: hunedaṣṭottaraśataṃ pāyasāśī tu nityaśaḥ / maṇḍalājjāyate so 'pi kubera iva mānavaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: भगवान् भास्करके अंशसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं। अतः पूजित होकर मेरे दुर्भाग्यका नाश करें, आपको

verses.sanskrit: हविषा गुडमिश्रेण होमतो ह्यन्नवान्भवेत् । जपापुष्पाणि जुहुयादष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: haviṣā guḍamiśreṇa homato hyannavānbhavet / japāpuṣpāṇi juhuyādaṣṭottarasahasrakam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार जो भक्तिपूर्वक एक-एक वर्षतक इन तीनों वृक्षोंकी पूजा करता है, उसका दुर्भाग्य नष्ट हो जाता है। आषाढ़ शुक्ला त्रयोदशीको एक समय भोजनका ब्रत करे। भगवती पार्वती

verses.sanskrit: तांबूलरससंमिश्रं तद्भस्मतिलकं चरेत् । चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां मोहनाय द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tāṃbūlarasasaṃmiśraṃ tadbhasmatilakaṃ caret / caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ mohanāya dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: और भगवान् शझ्भर--इन दोनों जगदीश्वरोंकी

verses.sanskrit: एवं यो भजते लक्ष्मीं साधकेन्द्रो मुनीश्वर । सम्पदस्तस्य जायन्ते महालक्ष्मीः प्रसीदति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yo bhajate lakṣmīṃ sādhakendro munīśvara / sampadastasya jāyante mahālakṣmīḥ prasīdati
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: इन दोनों प्रतिमाओंको देवमन्दिर, गोशाला अथवा ब्राह्मणके घरमें वेदमन्त्रद्दारा स्थापित करके लगातार पाँच दिनतक नित्य पूजन तथा एक समय भोजनके ब्रतका पालन करे। तदनन्तर

verses.sanskrit: देहान्ते वैष्णवं धाम लभते नात्र संशयः । या तु दुर्गा द्विजश्रेष्ठ शिवलोकं गता सती
verses.transliteration: dehānte vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ / yā tu durgā dvijaśreṣṭha śivalokaṃ gatā satī
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: अन्तिम दिन प्रातःकाल स्नान करके पुनः उन दोनों प्रतिमाओंकी पूजा करे। फिर वेद-वेदाड़के ज्ञाससे सुशोभित ब्राह्मणको वे दोनों विग्रह समर्पित कर दे। पाँच वर्षोंतक प्रतिवर्ष इसी

verses.sanskrit: सा शिवाज्ञामनुप्राप्य दिव्यलोकं विनिर्ममे । देवीलोकेति विख्यातं सर्वलोकविलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: sā śivājñāmanuprāpya divyalokaṃ vinirmame / devīloketi vikhyātaṃ sarvalokavilakṣaṇam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: प्रकार करना चाहिए। पाँचवाँ वर्ष बीतनेपर दूध देनेवाली दो गौओंके साथ उन दोनों प्रतिमाओंका

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थिता जगन्माता तपोनियममास्थिता । विविधान् स्वावतारान्हि त्रिकाले कुरुते ऽनिशम्
verses.transliteration: tatra sthitā jaganmātā taponiyamamāsthitā / vividhān svāvatārānhi trikāle kurute 'niśam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: दान करे। स्त्री हो या पुरुष--जो इस प्रकार इस शुभ ब्रतका पालन करता है, वह सात जन्मोंतक दाम्पत्यसुखसे वजश्चित नहीं होता--उसका दाम्पत्य-सम्बन्ध बीचमें खण्डित नहीं होता।

verses.sanskrit: मायाधिका ह्लादिनीयुक् चन्द्राढ्या सर्गिणी पुनः । प्रतिष्ठा स्मृतिसंयुक्ता क्षुधया सहिता पुनः
verses.transliteration: māyādhikā hlādinīyuk candrāḍhyā sargiṇī punaḥ / pratiṣṭhā smṛtisaṃyuktā kṣudhayā sahitā punaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: भाद्रपद शुक्ला त्रयोदशीको “गोन्रिरात्रब्रत बताया गया है। उस दिन भगवान् लक्ष्मीनारायणकी सोने या चाँदीकी प्रतिमा बनवाकर उसे पञ्ञामृतसे स्रान करावे। तत्पश्चात् शुभ अष्टदल मण्डलमें

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानामृता वह्निजायान्तस्ताराद्यो मनुर्मतः । ऋषिः स्याद्वामदेवो ऽस्य छन्दो गायत्रमीरितम्
verses.transliteration: jñānāmṛtā vahnijāyāntastārādyo manurmataḥ / ṛṣiḥ syādvāmadevo 'sya chando gāyatramīritam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: पीठपर उस भगवद्ठिग्रहको स्थापित करके सुन्दर वस्त्र चढ़ाकर गन्ध आदिसे उसकी पूजा करे। तत्पश्चात् आरती करके अन्न और जलसहित घटदान करे। नारद! इस प्रकार तीन दिनतक

verses.sanskrit: देवता जगतामादिर्दुर्गा दुर्गतिनाशिनी । ताराद्येकैकवर्णेन हृदयादित्रयं मतम्
verses.transliteration: devatā jagatāmādirdurgā durgatināśinī / tārādyekaikavarṇena hṛdayāditrayaṃ matam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: सब विधिका पालन करके ब्रतके अन्तमें गौका पूजन करे और भलीभाँति धनकी दक्षिणा देकर निम्नाद्धित मन्त्रसे गौको नमस्कारपूर्वक दान दे--

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिर्वर्मेक्षण द्वाभ्यां सर्वैरस्त्रमुदीरितम् । महामरकतप्रख्यां सहस्रभुजमण्डिताम्
verses.transliteration: tribhirvarmekṣaṇa dvābhyāṃ sarvairastramudīritam / mahāmarakataprakhyāṃ sahasrabhujamaṇḍitām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: “जब क्षीरसमुद्रका मन्थन होने लगा, उस समय उससे पाँच गौए उत्पन्न हुईं। उनके मध्यमें जो ननन्‍्दा नामवाली गौ है, उस धेनुको बारम्बार

verses.sanskrit: नानाशस्त्राणि दधतीं त्रिनेत्रां शशिशेखराम् । कङ्कणाङ्गदहाराढ्यां क्वणन्नूपुरकान्विताम्
verses.transliteration: nānāśastrāṇi dadhatīṃ trinetrāṃ śaśiśekharām / kaṅkaṇāṅgadahārāḍhyāṃ kvaṇannūpurakānvitām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर नीचे लिखे मन्त्रसे गायकी प्रदक्षिणा करके उसे ब्राह्मणको दान दे। (मन्त्र इस

verses.sanskrit: किरीटकुण्डलधरां दुर्गां देवीं विचिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: kirīṭakuṇḍaladharāṃ durgāṃ devīṃ vicintayet
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: गावो मे पार्श्रतः सन्‍्तु गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम्॥

verses.sanskrit: वसुलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं तिलैः समधुरैर्हुनेत । पय्ॐऽधसा वा सहस्रं नवपद्मात्मके यजेत्
verses.transliteration: vasulakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tilaiḥ samadhurairhuneta / payoṃ'dhasā vā sahasraṃ navapadmātmake yajet
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: मेरे बगलमें रहें और मैं गौओंके बीचमें

verses.sanskrit: प्रभा माया जया सूक्ष्मा विशुद्धानं दिनी पुनः । सुप्रभा विजया सर्वसिद्धिदा पीठशक्तयः
verses.transliteration: prabhā māyā jayā sūkṣmā viśuddhānaṃ dinī punaḥ / suprabhā vijayā sarvasiddhidā pīṭhaśaktayaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् ब्राह्मणदम्पतिका पूर्णतः: सत्कार करके उन्हें भोजन करावे और उन्हें आदरपूर्वक लक्ष्मी- नारायणकी प्रतिमा दान करे। सहस्नों अश्वमेध

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिर्ह्रस्वत्रयक्लीबरहितैः पूजये दिमाः । प्रणवो वज्रनखदंष्ट्रायुधाय महापदात्
verses.transliteration: adbhirhrasvatrayaklībarahitaiḥ pūjaye dimāḥ / praṇavo vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya mahāpadāt
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: और सैकड़ों राजसूय यज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान करके मनुष्य जिस फलको पाता है, उसीको वह 'गेत्रिरात्रत्रस'से पा लेता है। आश्विन शुक्ला त्रयोदशीको तीन राततक “अशोककब्रत' करे।

verses.sanskrit: सिंहाय वर्मास्त्रं हृञ्च प्रोक्तः सिंहमनुर्मुने । दद्यादासनमेतेन मूर्तिं मूलेन कल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: siṃhāya varmāstraṃ hṛñca proktaḥ siṃhamanurmune / dadyādāsanametena mūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayet
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: सुवर्णमयी प्रतिमा बनवाकर शास्त्रीय विधिसे उसकी प्रतिदिन पूजा और आदरपूर्वक एक सौ आठ परिक्रमा करे। उस समय इस मन्त्रका उच्चारण करना चाहिए--

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गावृर्त्तिं पुराभ्यार्च्य शक्तीः पत्रेषु पूजयेत् । जया च विजया कीर्तिः प्रीतिः पश्चात्प्रभा पुनः
verses.transliteration: aṅgāvṛrttiṃ purābhyārcya śaktīḥ patreṣu pūjayet / jayā ca vijayā kīrtiḥ prītiḥ paścātprabhā punaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: लोकोपकारकरणस्तत्प्रसीद शिवप्रिय॥

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धा मेधा श्रुतिश्चैवस्वनामाद्यक्षरादिकाः । पत्राग्रेष्वर्चयेदष्टावायुधानि यथाक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: śraddhā medhā śrutiścaivasvanāmādyakṣarādikāḥ / patrāgreṣvarcayedaṣṭāvāyudhāni yathākramāt
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: अशोक! तुम्हें पूर्वकालमें परम कृपालु भगवान् शड्डूरने उत्पन्न किया है। तुम सम्पूर्ण जगत्का उपकार करनेवाले हो; अतः शिवप्रिय अशोक!

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदाखड्गपाशाङ्कुशशरान्धनुः । लोकेश्वरांस्ततो बाह्ये तेषामस्त्राण्यनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadākhaḍgapāśāṅkuśaśarāndhanuḥ / lokeśvarāṃstato bāhye teṣāmastrāṇyanantaram
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर तीसरे दिन, उस अशोकवृक्षमें भगवान् शड्डूरकी विधिवत् पूजा करके ब्राह्मणको भोजन करावे और उसे अशोक-प्रतिमाका दान करे। इस प्रकार ब्रत करनेवाली नारी कभी वैधव्यका कष्ट

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं जपादिभिर्मन्त्री मन्त्रे सिद्धे विधानवित् । कुर्यात्प्रयोगानमुना यथा स्वस्वमनीषितान्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ japādibhirmantrī mantre siddhe vidhānavit / kuryātprayogānamunā yathā svasvamanīṣitān
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: नहीं पाती। वह पुत्र-पौत्र आदिके साथ रहकर अपने पतिकी अत्यन्त प्रियतमा होती है। कार्तिक कृष्णा त्रयोदशीको एकाग्रचित्त हो एक समय भोजनका ब्रत करे। प्रदोषकालमें तेलका दीपक

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठाप्य विधानेन कलशान्नवशोभनान् । रत्नहेमादिसंयुक्तान्घटेषु नवसु स्थितान्
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānena kalaśānnavaśobhanān / ratnahemādisaṃyuktānghaṭeṣu navasu sthitān
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: जलाकर उसकी यल्रपूर्वक पूजा करे और घरके द्वारपर बाहरके भागमें उस दीपकको इस उद्देश्यसे रखे कि इसके दानसे यमराज मुझपर प्रसन्न हों। विप्रेन्द्र! ऐसा करनेपर मनुष्यको यमराजकी पीड़ा

verses.sanskrit: मध्यस्थे पूजयेद्देवीमितरेषु जयादिकाः । संपूज्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैरभिषिञ्चेन्नराधिपम्
verses.transliteration: madhyasthe pūjayeddevīmitareṣu jayādikāḥ / saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairabhiṣiñcennarādhipam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: नहीं प्राप्त होती। द्विजोत्तम! कार्तिक शुक्ला त्रयोदशीको मनुष्य एक समय भोजन करके ब्रत रखे। प्रदोषकालमें पुनः स्नान करके मौन और एकाग्रचित्त हो बत्तीस दीपकोंकी पद्क्तिसे भगवान्

verses.sanskrit: राजा विजयते शत्रून्यो ऽधिको विजयश्रियम् । प्राप्नोत्रोगो दीर्घायुः सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: rājā vijayate śatrūnyo 'dhiko vijayaśriyam / prāpnotrogo dīrghāyuḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: शिवको आलोकित करे। घीसे दीपकोंको जलाये और गन्ध आदिसे भगवान् शिवकी पूजा करे।

verses.sanskrit: वन्ध्याभिषिक्ता विधिनालभते तनयं वरम् । मन्त्रेणानेन संजप्तमाज्यं क्षुद्रग्रहापहम्
verses.transliteration: vandhyābhiṣiktā vidhinālabhate tanayaṃ varam / mantreṇānena saṃjaptamājyaṃ kṣudragrahāpaham
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: फिर नाना प्रकारके फलों और नैवेद्योंद्वारा उन्हें संतुष्ट करे। तदनन्तर निम्नलिखित नामोंसे देवेश्वर शिवकी स्तुति करे--

verses.sanskrit: गर्भिणीनां विशेषेण जप्तं भस्मादिकं तथा । जृंभश्वासे तु कृष्णस्य प्रविष्टेराधिकामुखम्
verses.transliteration: garbhiṇīnāṃ viśeṣeṇa japtaṃ bhasmādikaṃ tathā / jṛṃbhaśvāse tu kṛṣṇasya praviṣṭerādhikāmukham
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: रुद्र, भीम, नीलकण्ठ और वेधा (स््रष्टा)-को नमस्कार है। कपर्दी (जटा-जूटधारी), सुरेश तथा व्योमकेशको नमस्कार है। वृषध्वज, सोम तथा सोमनाथको नमस्कार है। दिगम्बर, भड्,

verses.sanskrit: या तु देवी समुद्भूता वीणापुस्तकधारिणी । तस्या विधानं विप्रेन्द्र शृणु लोकोपकारकम्
verses.transliteration: yā tu devī samudbhūtā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī / tasyā vidhānaṃ viprendra śṛṇu lokopakārakam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: उमाकान्त और वर्द्धी (वृद्धि करनेवाले) शिवको नमस्कार है। तपोमय, व्याप्त और शिपिदविष्ट (तेजस्वी) भगवान् शड्डूरको नमस्कार है। व्यालप्रिय (सर्पोंको पसंद करनेवाले), व्याल (सर्पस्वरूप)

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवो वाग्भवं माया श्रीः कामः शक्तिरीरिता । सरस्वती चतुर्थ्यन्ता स्वाहान्तो द्वादशाक्षरः
verses.transliteration: praṇavo vāgbhavaṃ māyā śrīḥ kāmaḥ śaktirīritā / sarasvatī caturthyantā svāhānto dvādaśākṣaraḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: और व्यालपति शिवको नमस्कार है। महीधर (पर्वतरूप), व्योम (आकाशस्वरूप) और पशुपतिको नमस्कार है। त्रिपुरहन्ता, सिंह, शार्दूल तथा वृषभको नमस्कार है। मित, मितनाथ, सिद्ध,

verses.sanskrit: मनुर्नारायण ऋषिर्विराट् छन्दः समीरितम् । महासरस्वती चास्य देवता परिकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: manurnārāyaṇa ṛṣirvirāṭ chandaḥ samīritam / mahāsarasvatī cāsya devatā parikīrtitā
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: परमेष्ठी, वेदगीत, गुप्त और वेदगुह्म शिवको नमस्कार है। दीर्घ, दीर्घरूप, दीर्घार्थ, महीयान्, जगदाधार और व्योमस्वरूप शिवको नमस्कार है। कल्याणस्वरूप, विशिष्ट-पुरुष, शिष्ट (साधु-

verses.sanskrit: वाग्भवेन षडङ्गानि कृत्वा वर्णान्न्यसेद् बुधः । ब्रह्मरन्ध्रे न्यसेत्तारं लज्जां भ्रूमध्यगां न्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: vāgbhavena ṣaḍaṅgāni kṛtvā varṇānnyased budhaḥ / brahmarandhre nyasettāraṃ lajjāṃ bhrūmadhyagāṃ nyaset
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: महात्मा), परमात्मा, गजकृत्तिधर (वस्त्ररूपसे हाथीका चमड़ा धारण करनेवाले), अन्धकासुरहन्ता भगवान् शिवको नमस्कार है। नील, लोहित एवं शुक्ल वर्णवाले, चण्डमुण्डप्रिय, भक्तिप्रिय, देवस्वरूप,

verses.sanskrit: मुखनासादिकर्णेषु गुदेषु श्रीमुखार्णकान् । ततो वाग्देवतां ध्यायेद्वीणापुस्तकधारिणीम्
verses.transliteration: mukhanāsādikarṇeṣu gudeṣu śrīmukhārṇakān / tato vāgdevatāṃ dhyāyedvīṇāpustakadhāriṇīm
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: दक्षयज्ञनगाशक तथा अविनाशी शिवको नमस्कार है। महेश। आपको नमस्कार है। महादेव! सबका संहार करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है। आपके तीन नेत्र हैं। आप तीनों वेदोंके आश्रय हैं।

verses.sanskrit: कर्पूरकुन्दधवलां पूर्णचन्द्रोज्ज्वलाननाम् । हंसाधिरूढां भालेन्दुदिव्यालङ्कारशोभिताम्
verses.transliteration: karpūrakundadhavalāṃ pūrṇacandrojjvalānanām / haṃsādhirūḍhāṃ bhālendudivyālaṅkāraśobhitām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: वेदाड़स्वरूप आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है। आप अर्थ हैं, अर्थस्वरूप हैं और परमार्थ हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। विश्वरूप, विश्वमय तथा विश्वनाथ भगवान् शिवको नमस्कार है। जो

verses.sanskrit: जपेद्द्वादशलक्षाणि तत्सहस्रं सितांबुजैः । नागचंपकपुष्पैर्वा जुहुयात्साधकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: japeddvādaśalakṣāṇi tatsahasraṃ sitāṃbujaiḥ / nāgacaṃpakapuṣpairvā juhuyātsādhakottamaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: सबका कल्याण करनेवाले शड्डूर हैं, कालस्वरूप हैं तथा कालके कला-काष्ठा आदि छोटे-छोटे अवयवरूप हैं; जिनका कोई रूप नहीं है, जिनके

verses.sanskrit: मातृकोक्ते यजेत्पीठे वक्ष्यमाणक्रमेण ताम् । वर्णाब्जेनासनं दद्यान्मूर्तिं मूलेन कल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: mātṛkokte yajetpīṭhe vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa tām / varṇābjenāsanaṃ dadyānmūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayet
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: विविध रूप हैं तथा जो सूक्ष्मसे भी सूक्ष्म हैं, उन भगवान् शिवको नमस्कार है। प्रभो! आप श्मशानमें निवास करनेवाले हैं, आप चर्ममय वस्त्र धारण करते हैं; आपको नमस्कार है। आपके मस्तकपर

verses.sanskrit: देव्या दक्षिणतः पूज्या संस्कृता वाङ्मयी शुभा । प्राकृता वामतः पूज्या वाङ्मयीसर्वसिद्धिदा
verses.transliteration: devyā dakṣiṇataḥ pūjyā saṃskṛtā vāṅmayī śubhā / prākṛtā vāmataḥ pūjyā vāṅmayīsarvasiddhidā
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमाका मुकुट सुशोभित है, आप भयंकर भूमिमें निवास करते हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप दुर्ग (कठिनतासे प्राप्त होने योग्य), दुर्गपार (कठिनाइयोंसे पार लगानेवाले), दुर्गावयवसाक्षी

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमङ्गानि षट्कोणे प्रज्ञाद्याः प्रयजेद्बहिः । प्रज्ञा मेधा श्रुतिः शक्तिः स्मृतिर्वागीश्वरी मतिः
verses.transliteration: pūrvamaṅgāni ṣaṭkoṇe prajñādyāḥ prayajedbahiḥ / prajñā medhā śrutiḥ śaktiḥ smṛtirvāgīśvarī matiḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: (पार्वतीजीके अड्भ-प्रत्यड्रका दर्शन करनेवाले), लिड्ररूप, लिड्रमय और लिडज्रोंके अधिपति हैं, आपको नमस्कार है। आप प्रभावरूप हैं। प्रभावरूप प्रयोजनके साधक हैं, आपको बारम्बार नमस्कार

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्तिश्चेति समाख्याता ब्रह्माद्यास्तदनन्तरम् । लोकेशानर्चयेद्भूयस्तदस्त्राणि च तद्बहिः
verses.transliteration: svastiśceti samākhyātā brahmādyāstadanantaram / lokeśānarcayedbhūyastadastrāṇi ca tadbahiḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: है। आप कारणोंके भी कारण, मृत्युञ्रय तथा स्वयम्भूस्वरूप हैं, आपको नमस्कार है, नमस्कार है। आपके तीन नेत्र हैं। शितिकण्ठ ! आप तेजकी निधि हैं। गौरीजीके साथ नित्य संयुक्त रहनेवाले

verses.sanskrit: एवं संपूज्य वाग्देवीं साक्षाद्वाग्वल्लभो भवेत् । ब्रह्मचर्यरतः शुद्धः शुद्धदन्तनखा दिकः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃpūjya vāgdevīṃ sākṣādvāgvallabho bhavet / brahmacaryarataḥ śuddhaḥ śuddhadantanakhā dikaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: और मड्रलके हेतुभूत हैं, आपको नमस्कार है।

verses.sanskrit: संस्मरन् सर्ववनिताः सततं देवताधिया । कवित्वं लभते धीमान् मासैर्द्वादशभिर्ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsmaran sarvavanitāḥ satataṃ devatādhiyā / kavitvaṃ labhate dhīmān māsairdvādaśabhirdhruvam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: विप्रवर! पिनाकधारी महादेवजीके गुणोंका प्रतिपादन करनेवाले इन नामोंका पाठ करके महादेवजीकी परिक्रमा करनेसे मनुष्य भगवानके निज धाममें जाता है। ब्रह्मन्! इस प्रकार ब्रत

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा तन्मन्त्रितं तोयं सहस्रं प्रत्यहं मुने । महाकविर्भवेन्मन्त्री वत्सरेण न संशयः
verses.transliteration: pītvā tanmantritaṃ toyaṃ sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ mune / mahākavirbhavenmantrī vatsareṇa na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: करके मनुष्य महादेवजीके प्रसादसे इहलोकके सम्पूर्ण भोग भोगकर अन्तमें शिवधाम प्राप्त कर लेता है। पौष शुक्ला त्रयोदशीको अच्युत श्रीहरिका पूजन करके सब मनोरथोंकी सिद्धिके लिये श्रेष्ठ

verses.sanskrit: उरोमात्रोदके स्थित्वा ध्यायन्मार्तण्डमण्डले । स्थितां देवीं प्रतिदिनं त्रिसहस्रं जपेन्मनुम्
verses.transliteration: uromātrodake sthitvā dhyāyanmārtaṇḍamaṇḍale / sthitāṃ devīṃ pratidinaṃ trisahasraṃ japenmanum
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्णणफो घीसे भरा हुआ पात्र दान करे। ब्रह्मन! माघ शुक्ला त्रयोदशीसे लेकर तीन दिनतक “माघ-स्त्रान' का ब्रत होता है, जो नाना प्रकारके मनोवाज्छित फलको देनेवाला है। माघ

verses.sanskrit: लभते मण्डलात्सिद्धिं वाचामप्रतिमां भुवि । पालाशबिल्वकुसुमैर्जुहुयान्मधुरोक्षितैः
verses.transliteration: labhate maṇḍalātsiddhiṃ vācāmapratimāṃ bhuvi / pālāśabilvakusumairjuhuyānmadhurokṣitaiḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: मासमें प्रयागमें तीन दिन स्नान करनेवाले पुरुषको जो फल प्राप्त होता है, वह एक हजार अश्वमेध- यज्ञ करनेसे भी इस पृथ्वीपर सुलभ नहीं होता। वहाँ किया हुआ स््रान, जप, होम और दान

verses.sanskrit: समिद्भिर्वा तदुत्थाभिर्यशः प्राप्नोति वाक्पतेः । राजवृक्षसमुद्भूतैः प्रसूनैर्मधुराप्लुतैः
verses.transliteration: samidbhirvā tadutthābhiryaśaḥ prāpnoti vākpateḥ / rājavṛkṣasamudbhūtaiḥ prasūnairmadhurāplutaiḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: अनन्तगुना अथवा अक्षय हो जाता है। फाल्गुन

verses.sanskrit: सत्समिद्भिश्च जुहुयात्कवित्वमतुलं लभेत् । अथ प्रवक्ष्ये विप्रेन्द्र सावित्रीं ब्रह्मणः प्रियाम्
verses.transliteration: satsamidbhiśca juhuyātkavitvamatulaṃ labhet / atha pravakṣye viprendra sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇaḥ priyām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: मासके शुक्ल पक्षकी त्रयोदशीको उपवास करके  भक्ति एवं एकाग्रताके साथ पूजन करे। तत्पश्चात् भगवान् जगन्नाथको प्रणाम करे। तत्पश्चात् ' धनदत्रत'  वस्त्र, माला, गन्ध और आभूषणोंसे बछड़ेसहित प्रारम्भ करे। नाना प्रकारके रंगोंसे एक पट्टपर  शुभ गौको अलंकृत करके वेददेत्ता ब्राह्मणके यक्षपति महाराज कुबेरकी आकृति अड्डधित कर  लिये विधिपूर्वक दान करे। फिर बारह या तेरह

verses.sanskrit: यां समाराध्य ससृजे ब्रह्मा लोकांश्चराचरान् । लक्ष्मी माया कामपूर्वा सावित्री ङेसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: yāṃ samārādhya sasṛje brahmā lokāṃścarācarān / lakṣmī māyā kāmapūrvā sāvitrī ṅesamanvitā
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: ले और भक्तिभावसे गन्ध आदि उपचोरोंद्वारा  ब्राह्मणोंको मिष्टान्न भोजन कराकर वस्त्र आदिसे उसकी पूजा करे। आचार्यकी पूजा करके पूर्वोक्त प्रतिमा उन्हें

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहान्तो मनुराख्यातः सावित्र्या वसुवर्णवान् । ऋषिर्ब्रह्मास्य गायत्री छन्दः प्रोक्तं च देवता
verses.transliteration: svāhānto manurākhyātaḥ sāvitryā vasuvarṇavān / ṛṣirbrahmāsya gāyatrī chandaḥ proktaṃ ca devatā
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: द्विजोत्तम ! इस प्रकार प्रत्येक मासके शुक्लपक्षकी  अर्पण करे। फिर ब्राह्मणोंको यथाशक्ति दक्षिणा त्रयोदशीको मनुष्य कुबेरकी पूजा करे। उस दिन  दे, उन्हें नमस्कार करके विदा करे। इसके बाद वह उपवास करके रहे या एक समय भोजन  बुद्धिमान् पुरुष इष्ट-बन्धुओंके साथ एकाग्रचित्त करे। तदनन्तर एक वर्षमें त्रतकी समाप्ति होनेपर  हो स्वयं भोजन करे। विप्रवर! इस प्रकार ब्रत

verses.sanskrit: सावित्री सर्वदेवानां सावित्री परिकीर्तिता । हृदन्तिकैर्ब्रह्म विष्णुरुद्रेश्वरसदाशिवैः
verses.transliteration: sāvitrī sarvadevānāṃ sāvitrī parikīrtitā / hṛdantikairbrahma viṣṇurudreśvarasadāśivaiḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: पुन: सुवर्णमयी निधियोंके साथ धनाध्यक्ष कुबेरकी  पूर्ण करनेपर निर्धन मनुष्य धन पाकर इस भी सुवर्णमयी प्रतिमा बनाकर पञ्चामृत आदि  पृथ्वीपर दूसरे कुबेरकी भाँति विख्यात हो स्रानों, षोडश उपचारों और भाँति-भाँतिके नैवेद्योंसे  आनन्दका अनुभव करता है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मना च ङेयुक्तैरङ्गानां कल्पनं मतम् । तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभां ज्वलन्तीं ब्रह्मतेजसा
verses.transliteration: sarvātmanā ca ṅeyuktairaṅgānāṃ kalpanaṃ matam / taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ jvalantīṃ brahmatejasā
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: वर्षभरके चतुर्दशीत्रतोंकी विधि और महिमा

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्ममध्याह्नमार्तण्डसहस्रसमविग्रहाम् । ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम्
verses.transliteration: grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍasahasrasamavigrahām / īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: सनातनजी कहते हैं--नारद! सुनो, अब मैं  भोजन करे। द्विजश्रेष्ठ! इसी प्रकार समस्त कृष्णा तुम्हें चतुर्दशीके त्रत बतलाता हूँ, जिनका पालन  चतुर्दशियोंमें धन और संतानकी इच्छा रखनेवाले करके मनुष्य इस लोकमें सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंको  पुरुषको यह शिवसम्बन्धी ब्रत करना चाहिए। प्राप्त कर लेता है। चैत्र शुक्ला चतुर्दशीको कुंकुम,  वैशाख शुक्ला चतुर्दशीको ' श्रीनसिंहब्रत 'का अनुष्ठान

verses.sanskrit: बह्निशुद्धांशुकाधानां भक्तानुग्रहकातराम् । सुखदां मुक्तिदां चैव सर्वसंपत्प्रदां शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: bahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām / sukhadāṃ muktidāṃ caiva sarvasaṃpatpradāṃ śivām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: अगुरु, चन्दन, गन्ध आदि उपचार, वस्त्र तथा  करे। यदि शक्ति हो तो उपवासपूर्वक ब्रत करना मणियोंद्वारा भगवान् शिवकी बड़ी भारी पूजा करनी चाहिए। चँदोवा, ध्वज एवं छत्र आदि देकर मातृकाओंका भी पूजन करना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: वेदबीजस्वरूपां च ध्यायेद्वेदप्रसूं सतीम् । ध्यात्वैवं मण्डले विद्वान् त्रिकोणोज्ज्वलकर्णिके
verses.transliteration: vedabījasvarūpāṃ ca dhyāyedvedaprasūṃ satīm / dhyātvaivaṃ maṇḍale vidvān trikoṇojjvalakarṇike
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: करके इस प्रकार पूजन करता है, वह मनुष्य इस पृथ्वीपर अश्वमेध-यज्ञ़से भी अधिक पुण्यलाभ करता है। इसी तिथिको गन्ध, पुष्प आदिके द्वारा दमनक-पूजन करके पूर्णिमाको कल्याणस्वरूप

verses.sanskrit: सौरे पीठे यजेद्देवीं दीप्तादिनवशक्तिभिः । मूलमन्त्रेण कॢप्तायां मूर्तौं देवीं प्रपूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: saure pīṭhe yajeddevīṃ dīptādinavaśaktibhiḥ / mūlamantreṇa kḷptāyāṃ mūrtauṃ devīṃ prapūjayet
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिवकी सेवामें समर्पित करना चाहिए। बैशाख कृष्णा चतुर्दशीको उपवास करके प्रदोषकालमें स्नान करे और श्वेत वस्त्र धारण करके विद्वान् पुरुष गन्ध आदि उपचारों तथा बिल्वपत्रोंसे

verses.sanskrit: कोणेषु त्रिषु संपूज्या ब्राहृयाद्याः शक्तयो बहिः । आदित्याद्यास्ततः पूज्या उषादिसहिताः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: koṇeṣu triṣu saṃpūjyā brāhṛyādyāḥ śaktayo bahiḥ / ādityādyāstataḥ pūjyā uṣādisahitāḥ kramāt
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: पूजा करे। श्रैष्ठ ब्राह्मणको निमन्त्रण

verses.sanskrit: तततः षडङ्गान्यभ्यर्च्य केसरेषु यथाविधि । प्रह्लादिनीं प्रभां पश्चान्नित्यां विश्वंभरां पुनः
verses.transliteration: tatataḥ ṣaḍaṅgānyabhyarcya kesareṣu yathāvidhi / prahlādinīṃ prabhāṃ paścānnityāṃ viśvaṃbharāṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: देकर उसे भोजन करानेके बाद दूसरे दिन स्वयं

verses.sanskrit: विलासिनीप्रभावत्यौ जयां शान्तां यजेत्पुनः । कान्तिं दुर्गासरस्वत्यौ विद्यारूपां ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: vilāsinīprabhāvatyau jayāṃ śāntāṃ yajetpunaḥ / kāntiṃ durgāsarasvatyau vidyārūpāṃ tataḥ param
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: चाहिए और यदि शक्ति न हो तो एक समय भोजन करके करना चाहिए। सायंकालमें हैत्यसूदन भगवान् नृसिंहको पञ्मामृत आदिसे स्नान कराकर षोडशोपचारसे उनकी पूजा करे।

verses.sanskrit: विशालसंज्ञितामीशां व्यापिनीं विमलां यजेत् । तमोपहारिणीं सूक्ष्मां विश्वयोनिं जयावहाम्
verses.transliteration: viśālasaṃjñitāmīśāṃ vyāpinīṃ vimalāṃ yajet / tamopahāriṇīṃ sūkṣmāṃ viśvayoniṃ jayāvahām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् इस मन्त्रका उच्चारण करते हुए भगवान्से क्षमा-प्रार्थना करे-- तप्ततटककेशान्त ज्वलत्पावकलोचन।

verses.sanskrit: पद्नालयां परां शोभां ब्रह्मरूपां ततोर्ऽचयेत् । ब्राह्म्याद्याः शारणा बाह्ये पूजयेत्प्रोक्तलक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: padnālayāṃ parāṃ śobhāṃ brahmarūpāṃ tator'cayet / brāhmyādyāḥ śāraṇā bāhye pūjayetproktalakṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: “दिव्यसिंह ! आपके अयाल तपाये हुए सोनेके समान दमक रहे हैं, नेत्र प्रजजलित अग्रिके समान दहक रहे हैं और आपके नखोंका स्पर्श वज़से भी अधिक कठोर है, आपको नमस्कार है।'

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽभ्यर्च्येद् ग्रहान्बाह्ये शक्राद्यानयुधैः सह । इत्थमावरणैर्देवीः दशभिः परिपूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: tato 'bhyarcyed grahānbāhye śakrādyānayudhaiḥ saha / itthamāvaraṇairdevīḥ daśabhiḥ paripūjayet
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: देवेश्वर भगवान् नृसिंहसे इस प्रकार प्रार्थना करके ब्रती पुरुष मिट्टीकी वेदीपर सोये। इन्द्रियों और क्रोधको काबूमें रखे और सब प्रकारके भोगोंसे अलग रहे। जो इस प्रकार प्रत्येक वर्षमें

verses.sanskrit: अष्टलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं तत्सहस्रं हुनेत्तिलैः । सर्वपापुविनिर्मुक्तो दीर्घमायुः स विन्दति
verses.transliteration: aṣṭalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tatsahasraṃ hunettilaiḥ / sarvapāpuvinirmukto dīrghamāyuḥ sa vindati
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: विधिपूर्वक उत्तम ब्रतका पालन करता है, वह सम्पूर्ण भोगोंको भोगकर अन्तमें श्रीहरिके पदको प्रात कर लेता है। मुनीधर! इसी तिथिको 3»कोरेश्वरकी यात्रा करनी चाहिए। वहाँ ३कारेश्वरके

verses.sanskrit: अरुणाब्जैस्त्रिमध्वक्तैर्जुहुयादयुतं ततः । महालक्ष्मीर्भवेत्तस्य षण्मासान्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: aruṇābjaistrimadhvaktairjuhuyādayutaṃ tataḥ / mahālakṣmīrbhavettasya ṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: पूजनका अवसर दुर्लभ है। उनका दर्शन पापोंका नाश करनेवाला है। ३»कारेश्वरका पूजन, ध्यान, जप और दर्शन जो भी हो जाय, वह मनुष्योंके लिये ज्ञान और मोक्ष देनेवाला बताया गया है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मवृक्षप्रसूनैस्तु जुहुयाद्बाह्यतेजसे । बहुना किमिहोक्तेन यथावत्साधिता सती
verses.transliteration: brahmavṛkṣaprasūnaistu juhuyādbāhyatejase / bahunā kimihoktena yathāvatsādhitā satī
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: इस तिथिको पापनाशक “लिड्डब्नत' भी करना चाहिए। आटेका शिवलिड्र बनाकर उसे पश्चामृतसे स्नान करावे। फिर उसपर कुंकुमका लेप करे और वस्त्र, आभूषण, धूप, दीप तथा नैवेद्यके

verses.sanskrit: साधकानामियं विद्या भवेत्कामदुधा मुने । अथ ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: sādhakānāmiyaṃ vidyā bhavetkāmadudhā mune / atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: द्वारा उसकी पूजा करे। जो इस प्रकार सब मनोरथोंकी सिद्धि प्रदान करनेवाले पिष्टमय शिवलिड्गजका पूजन करता है, वह महादेवजीकी कृपासे भोग और मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है। ज्येष्

verses.sanskrit: सावित्रीपञ्जरं नाम सर्वरक्षाकरं नृणाम् । व्योमकेशार्लकासक्तां सुकिरीटविराजिताम्
verses.transliteration: sāvitrīpañjaraṃ nāma sarvarakṣākaraṃ nṛṇām / vyomakeśārlakāsaktāṃ sukirīṭavirājitām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: शुक्ला चतुर्दशीको दिनमें पञ्माग्रिका सेवन करे

verses.sanskrit: मेघभ्रुकुटिलाक्रान्तां विधिविष्णुशिवाननाम् । गुरुभार्गवकर्णान्तां सोमसूर्याग्निलोचनाम्
verses.transliteration: meghabhrukuṭilākrāntāṃ vidhiviṣṇuśivānanām / gurubhārgavakarṇāntāṃ somasūryāgnilocanām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: और सायंकाल सुवर्णमयी धेनुका दान करे। यह रुद्र-त्रस” कहा गया है। जो मनुष्य आषाढ़ शुक्ला चतुर्दशीको देश-कालमें उत्पन्न हुए फूलोंद्वारा भगवान् शिवका पूजन करता है, वह समस्त

verses.sanskrit: इडापिङ्गलिकासूक्ष्मावायुनासापुटान्विताम् । संध्याद्विजोष्ठपुटितां लसद्वागुपजिह्विकाम्
verses.transliteration: iḍāpiṅgalikāsūkṣmāvāyunāsāpuṭānvitām / saṃdhyādvijoṣṭhapuṭitāṃ lasadvāgupajihvikām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: सम्पदाओंको प्राप्त कर लेता है। द्विजश्रेष्ठ! श्रावण शुक्ला चतुर्दशीको अपनी शाखामें बतायी हुई विधिके अनुसार पवित्रारोपण करना चाहिए। पहले पवित्रकको सौ बार अभिमन्त्रित करके

verses.sanskrit: संध्यासूर्यमणिग्रीवां मरुद्बाहुसमन्वितान् । पर्जन्यदृदयासक्तां वस्वाख्यप्रतिमण्डलाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyāsūryamaṇigrīvāṃ marudbāhusamanvitān / parjanyadṛdayāsaktāṃ vasvākhyapratimaṇḍalām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: देवीको समर्पित करे। स्त्री हो या पुरुष यदि वह पवित्रारोपण करता है तो महादेवजीके प्रसादसे भोग एवं मोक्ष प्राप्त कर लेता है।

verses.sanskrit: आकाशोदरविभ्रान्तां नाभ्यवान्तरवीथिकाम् । प्रजापत्याख्यजघनां कटीन्द्राणीसमाश्रिताम्
verses.transliteration: ākāśodaravibhrāntāṃ nābhyavāntaravīthikām / prajāpatyākhyajaghanāṃ kaṭīndrāṇīsamāśritām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: भाद्रपद शुक्ला चतुर्दशीको उत्तम “अनन्त- ब्रत'का पालन करना चाहिए। इसमें एक समय भोजन किया जाता है। एक सेर गेहँका आटा लेकर उसे शक्कर और घीमें मिलाकर पकावे--

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्वोर्मलयमेरुभ्यां शोभमानां सरिद्वराम् । सुजानुजहुकुशिकां वैश्वदेवाख्यसंज्ञिकाम्
verses.transliteration: ūrvormalayamerubhyāṃ śobhamānāṃ saridvarām / sujānujahukuśikāṃ vaiśvadevākhyasaṃjñikām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: पूआ तैयार करे और वह भगवान् अनन्तको अर्पण करे। इससे पहले कपास अथवा रेशमके सुन्दर सूतको चौदह गाँठोंसे युक्त करके उसका गन्ध आदि उपचारोंसे पूजन करे। फिर पुराने

verses.sanskrit: पादाङ्घ्रिनखलोमाख्यभूनागद्रुमलक्षिताम् । ग्रहराश्यर्क्षयोगादिमूर्तावयवसंज्ञिकाम्
verses.transliteration: pādāṅghrinakhalomākhyabhūnāgadrumalakṣitām / graharāśyarkṣayogādimūrtāvayavasaṃjñikām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: सूतको बाँहमेंसे उतारकर उसे किसी जलाशयमें डाल दे और नये अनन्त सूत्रको नारी बायीं भुजामें और पुरुष दायीं भुजामें बाँध ले। आटेका पूआ या पिट्टी पकाकर दक्षिणासहित उसका दान

verses.sanskrit: तिथिमासर्तुपक्षाख्यैः संकेतनिमिषात्मिकाम् । मायाकल्पितवैचित्र्यसंध्याख्यच्छदनावृताम्
verses.transliteration: tithimāsartupakṣākhyaiḥ saṃketanimiṣātmikām / māyākalpitavaicitryasaṃdhyākhyacchadanāvṛtām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: करे। फिर स्वयं भी परिमित मात्रामें उसे भोजन करे। इस प्रकार इस उत्तम ब्रतका चौदह वर्षोतक पालन करना चाहिए। इसके बाद दिद्वान् पुरुष उसका उद्यापन करे। मुने! रँंगे हुए चावलोंसे

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलत्कालानलप्रख्य्ॐ तडित्कीटिसमप्रभाम् । कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशां शशिकोटिसुशीतलाम्
verses.transliteration: jvalatkālānalaprakhyoṃ taḍitkīṭisamaprabhām / koṭisūryapratīkāśāṃ śaśikoṭisuśītalām
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: सुन्दर सर्वतोभद्रमण्डल बनाकर उसमें ताँबेका कलश स्थापित करे। उस कलशके ऊपर रेशमी पीताम्बरसे आच्छादित भगवान् अनन्तकी सुन्दर सुवर्णमयी प्रतिमा स्थापित करे और उसका

verses.sanskrit: सुधामण्डलमध्यस्थां सांद्रानन्दामृतात्मिकाम् । वागतीतां मनो ऽगर्म्या वरदां वेदमातरम्
verses.transliteration: sudhāmaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ sāṃdrānandāmṛtātmikām / vāgatītāṃ mano 'garmyā varadāṃ vedamātaram
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. Thus, O brahmin, the characteristics of five Prakrtisbave been mentioned by you along with their mantras and mode of propitiation. It (the hymn) fulfils all desires.
verses.hindi: विधिपूर्वक यजन करे। इसके सिवा गणेश, मातृका, नवग्रह तथा लोकपालोंका भी पृथक् - पृथक् पूजन करे। फिर हविष्यसे होम करके

verses.sanskrit: चराचरमयीं नित्यां ब्रह्माक्षरसमन्विताम् । ध्यात्वा स्वात्माविभेदेन सावित्रीपञ्जरं न्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: carācaramayīṃ nityāṃ brahmākṣarasamanvitām / dhyātvā svātmāvibhedena sāvitrīpañjaraṃ nyaset
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn of Savitri containing one hundred and eight names shall be long-lived, happy, humble and successful. He will have sons. verses.sanskrit: विश्वा तुर्या वरेण्या च निसृणी यमुना भुवा । मोदा देवी वरिष्ठा च धीश्च शान्तिर्मती मही
