verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: धर्मादिकल्पिते पीठे पङ्कजे चातिशोभने । षट्कोणान्तस्त्रिकोणस्थव्योमपङ्कजसंयुते
verses.transliteration: dharmādikalpite pīṭhe paṅkaje cātiśobhane / ṣaṭkoṇāntastrikoṇasthavyomapaṅkajasaṃyute
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: बटुकं पूजयेद्देवं सांगावरणकं क्रमात् । शत्रुपक्षस्य रुधिरं पिशिन्त च दिनेदिने । भक्षयस्व गणैः सार्द्धं सारमेयसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: baṭukaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ sāṃgāvaraṇakaṃ kramāt / śatrupakṣasya rudhiraṃ piśinta ca dinedine / bhakṣayasva gaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ sārameyasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: बलिमन्त्रो ऽयमाख्यातः शत्रुनाम्ना विदर्भितः । अनेन बलिना हृष्टो बटुकः परसैन्यकम्
verses.transliteration: balimantro 'yamākhyātaḥ śatrunāmnā vidarbhitaḥ / anena balinā hṛṣṭo baṭukaḥ parasainyakam
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: छित्वा गणेभ्यो विभजेदामिषं क्रुद्धमानसः । अङ्कशो वह्निशिखरो लान्तदान्त इतीरितः
verses.transliteration: chitvā gaṇebhyo vibhajedāmiṣaṃ kruddhamānasaḥ / aṅkaśo vahniśikharo lāntadānta itīritaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: फडन्तश्चण्डमन्त्रो ऽयं त्रिवर्णात्मा समीरितः । अस्य त्रितो मुनिः प्रोक्तश्छन्दो ऽनुष्टुबुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: phaḍantaścaṇḍamantro 'yaṃ trivarṇātmā samīritaḥ / asya trito muniḥ proktaśchando 'nuṣṭubudāhṛtam
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: चण्डेशो देवता प्रोक्ता वक्ष्यतेंऽगप्रकल्पनम् । हृदयं दीप्तफट् प्रोक्तं ज्वलफट् शिर ईरितम्
verses.transliteration: caṇḍeśo devatā proktā vakṣyateṃ'gaprakalpanam / hṛdayaṃ dīptaphaṭ proktaṃ jvalaphaṭ śira īritam
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: शिखाज्वालिनि फट् प्रोक्ता वहफट् कवचं मतम् । हलफट् नेत्रमाख्यातं सर्वज्वानिनिफट् परम्
verses.transliteration: śikhājvālini phaṭ proktā vahaphaṭ kavacaṃ matam / halaphaṭ netramākhyātaṃ sarvajvāniniphaṭ param
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: विन्यस्यैवं षडङ्गानि ततो देवं विचिन्तयेत् । चण्डेश्वरं रक्ततनुन्त्र्यक्षं रक्तांबरावृतम्
verses.transliteration: vinyasyaivaṃ ṣaḍaṅgāni tato devaṃ vicintayet / caṇḍeśvaraṃ raktatanuntryakṣaṃ raktāṃbarāvṛtam
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: दधतं च त्रिशूलाक्षमालाटं ककमण्डलून् । वर्णलक्षं जपेन्मन्त्रं होमं कुर्याद्दशांशतः
verses.transliteration: dadhataṃ ca triśūlākṣamālāṭaṃ kakamaṇḍalūn / varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ homaṃ kuryāddaśāṃśataḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: मधुरत्रयसंयुक्तैर्विशुद्धैस्तिलतण्डुलैः । पञ्चाक्षरोदिते पीठे मूर्तिं मूलेन कल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: madhuratrayasaṃyuktairviśuddhaistilataṇḍulaiḥ / pañcākṣarodite pīṭhe mūrtiṃ mūlena kalpayet
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: कूर्मेशो बिन्दुसंयुक्तस्ततश्चण्डेश्वराय च । हृदयं मनुराख्यातश्चण्डेशस्य प्रपूजने
verses.transliteration: kūrmeśo bindusaṃyuktastataścaṇḍeśvarāya ca / hṛdayaṃ manurākhyātaścaṇḍeśasya prapūjane
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गैर्मातृभिराशेशैर्वज्राद्यैरावृतिर्भवेत् । शैवमन्त्रेषु निष्णातश्चण्डेश्वरमनुं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: aṅgairmātṛbhirāśeśairvajrādyairāvṛtirbhavet / śaivamantreṣu niṣṇātaścaṇḍeśvaramanuṃ japet
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति परत्रेह च नन्दति । शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि दिव्यं माहेश्वरं स्तवम्
verses.transliteration: sarvānkāmānavāpnoti paratreha ca nandati / śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi divyaṃ māheśvaraṃ stavam
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्य पाठेन पूजायां सिद्ध्यन्ति मनवो ऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: yasya pāṭhena pūjāyāṃ siddhyanti manavo 'khilāḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: धराम्ब्वग्निमरुव्द्योममखेशेन्द्वर्कमूर्तये । सर्वभूतान्तरस्थाय शङ्कराय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: dharāmbvagnimaruvdyomamakheśendvarkamūrtaye / sarvabhūtāntarasthāya śaṅkarāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्यं तकृतवासाय श्रुतये श्रुतिजन्मने । अतीन्द्रियाय महसे शाश्वताय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: śrutyaṃ takṛtavāsāya śrutaye śrutijanmane / atīndriyāya mahase śāśvatāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलसूक्ष्मविभागाभ्यामनिर्देश्याय शंभवे । भवाय भवसंभूतदुःखहन्त्रे नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: sthūlasūkṣmavibhāgābhyāmanirdeśyāya śaṃbhave / bhavāya bhavasaṃbhūtaduḥkhahantre namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: तर्कमार्गातिदूराय तपसां फलदायिने । चतुर्वर्गवदान्याय सर्वज्ञाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: tarkamārgātidūrāya tapasāṃ phaladāyine / caturvargavadānyāya sarvajñāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: आदिमध्यान्तशून्याय निरस्ताशेषभीतये । योगिध्येयाय महते निर्गुणाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: ādimadhyāntaśūnyāya nirastāśeṣabhītaye / yogidhyeyāya mahate nirguṇāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: विश्वात्मने विविक्ताय विलसच्चन्द्रमौलये । कन्दर्प्पदर्प्पनाशाय कालहॄन्त्रे नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: viśvātmane viviktāya vilasaccandramaulaye / kandarppadarppanāśāya kālahṝntre namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: विषाशनाय विहरद्वृषस्कन्धमुपेयुषे । सरिद्दामसमाबद्धकपदार्य नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: viṣāśanāya viharadvṛṣaskandhamupeyuṣe / sariddāmasamābaddhakapadārya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धाय शुद्धभावा शुद्धानामन्तरात्मने । पुरान्तकाय पूर्णाय पुण्यनाम्नो नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: śuddhāya śuddhabhāvā śuddhānāmantarātmane / purāntakāya pūrṇāya puṇyanāmno namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: भक्ताय निजभक्तानां भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायिने । विवाससे निवासाय विश्वेषां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: bhaktāya nijabhaktānāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyine / vivāsase nivāsāya viśveṣāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिमूर्तिमूलभूताय त्रिनेत्राय त्रिशूलिने । त्रिधाम्ने धामरूपाय जन्मदाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: trimūrtimūlabhūtāya trinetrāya triśūline / tridhāmne dhāmarūpāya janmadāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: देवासुरशिरोरत्नकिरीटारुणिताङ्घ्रये । कान्ताय निजकान्तायै दत्तार्द्धाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: devāsuraśiroratnakirīṭāruṇitāṅghraye / kāntāya nijakāntāyai dattārddhāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्स्तोत्रं महेशस्य प्रोक्तं सर्वाघनाशनम् । शिवसान्निध्यदं विप्र सर्पतन्त्रप्रकाशकम्
verses.transliteration: etatstotraṃ maheśasya proktaṃ sarvāghanāśanam / śivasānnidhyadaṃ vipra sarpatantraprakāśakam
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते सुमहत्तन्त्रें सर्वदेवप्रकाशकम् । लोकाभिलाषसंपूर्तिक्रियासाधनसंगतम्
verses.transliteration: etatte sumahattantreṃ sarvadevaprakāśakam / lokābhilāṣasaṃpūrtikriyāsādhanasaṃgatam
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: ये तु सामान्यतः प्रोक्तास्तन्त्रे ऽस्मिन्मनवो द्विज । ते तु लोकोपकाराय ज्ञातव्याः सिद्धिदायकाः
verses.transliteration: ye tu sāmānyataḥ proktāstantre 'sminmanavo dvija / te tu lokopakārāya jñātavyāḥ siddhidāyakāḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: विशेषतो वैष्णवा ये मन्त्राः सर्वोत्तमोत्तमाः । त एव साधनीयाः स्युश्चतुर्वर्गफलाप्तये
verses.transliteration: viśeṣato vaiṣṇavā ye mantrāḥ sarvottamottamāḥ / ta eva sādhanīyāḥ syuścaturvargaphalāptaye
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: राममन्त्राः कृष्णमन्त्राः सांगा रासेशिमन्त्रकाः । शाक्ताः सौराश्च गाणेशाः शैवाः प्रोक्ताः शुभावहाः
verses.transliteration: rāmamantrāḥ kṛṣṇamantrāḥ sāṃgā rāseśimantrakāḥ / śāktāḥ saurāśca gāṇeśāḥ śaivāḥ proktāḥ śubhāvahāḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: तेषु स्वात्मप्रकाशाय भजेन्मुक्तिफलप्रदान् । एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्त्वयाभ्यर्थितं मुने । देवताराधनं भक्त्या किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: teṣu svātmaprakāśāya bhajenmuktiphalapradān / etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yattvayābhyarthitaṃ mune / devatārādhanaṃ bhaktyā kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi
verses.translation: O sage, I have told you about the worship of deities with devotion. Now tell me what more you desire to know.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने तृतीयपादे महेशमन्त्रकथनं नामैकनवतितमो ऽध्यायः इति तृतीयः पादः सूत उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा नारदस्तु कुमारस्य वचो मुदा । पुनरप्याह सुप्रीतो जिज्ञासुः श्रेय उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne tṛtīyapāde maheśamantrakathanaṃ nāmaikanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ iti tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ sūta uvāca etacchrutvā nāradastu kumārasya vaco mudā / punarapyāha suprīto jijñāsuḥ śreya uttamam
verses.translation: Well done, O blessed one, Well done. The great sacred (Tantra) text, that is the most excellent among the (Tantric) scriptural texts has been narrated by vou It renders great benefit to all the worlds.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच साधु साधु महाभाग सर्वलोकोपकारकम् । महातन्त्रं त्वया प्रोक्तं सर्वतन्त्रोत्तमोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca sādhu sādhu mahābhāga sarvalokopakārakam / mahātantraṃ tvayā proktaṃ sarvatantrottamottamam
verses.translation: Now I wish to hear the excellent narration of Puranas. O sage, tell me whatever (i.e. all legendary episodes) is narrated in each of the different Puranas, since you are considered to be omniscient.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि पुराणाख्यानमुत्तमम् । यस्मिन्यस्मिन्पुराणे तु यद्यदाख्यानकं मुने । तत्सर्वं मे समाचक्ष्व सर्वज्ञस्त्वं यतो मतः
verses.transliteration: adhunā śrotumicchāmi purāṇākhyānamuttamam / yasminyasminpurāṇe tu yadyadākhyānakaṃ mune / tatsarvaṃ me samācakṣva sarvajñastvaṃ yato mataḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmana, on hearing those auspicious words of Narada, his enquiry regarding the stories in the Puranas Sanatkumara replied.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं विप्रा नारदस्य शुभावहम् । पुराणाख्यानसंप्रश्नं कुमारः प्रत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ viprā nāradasya śubhāvaham / purāṇākhyānasaṃpraśnaṃ kumāraḥ pratyuvāca ha
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the noble-souled Sanat- kumara, Narada bowed to Sanatana with great humility and submitted:
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमार उवाच पाराणाख्यानकं विप्र नानाकल्पसमुद्भवम् । नानाकथासमायुक्तमद्भुतं बहुविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāra uvāca pārāṇākhyānakaṃ vipra nānākalpasamudbhavam / nānākathāsamāyuktamadbhutaṃ bahuvistaram
verses.translation: Please reveal clearly the stories of the different laces and dynasties in the order of their creation. O Holy Lord, there is no one superior to you in the knowledge of the stories contained in the Puranas.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिः सनातनश्चायं यथा वेद तथापरः । न वेद तस्मात्पृच्छ त्वं बहुकल्पविदां वरम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiḥ sanātanaścāyaṃ yathā veda tathāparaḥ / na veda tasmātpṛccha tvaṃ bahukalpavidāṃ varam
verses.translation: O Lord, Lord of the chiefs of the Devas, the Creator and the annihilator of the worlds, O omniscient one, O presiding deity over all, obeisance be to you, who are gracious to all.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वेत्थं नारदो वाक्यं कुमारस्य महात्मनः । प्रणम्य विनयोपेतः सनातनमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: śrutvetthaṃ nārado vākyaṃ kumārasya mahātmanaḥ / praṇamya vinayopetaḥ sanātanamathābravīt
verses.translation: O father, I am desirous of hearing. Kindly tell me the core of the Puranas, their definition, their authority, the narrator and the inquirer.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: नारद उवाच ब्रह्मन्पुराणविच्छ्रेष्ठ ज्ञानविज्ञानतत्पर । पुराणानां विभागं मे साकल्ये नानुकीर्तय
verses.transliteration: nārada uvāca brahmanpurāṇavicchreṣṭha jñānavijñānatatpara / purāṇānāṃ vibhāgaṃ me sākalye nānukīrtaya
verses.translation: Listen, O dear child, I shall tell you the collective account of the Puranas. On knowing it, all the extant literature among the mobile and the immobile beings becomes known
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिञ् श्रुते श्रुतं सर्वं ज्ञातं कृते कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yasmiñ śrute śrutaṃ sarvaṃ jñātaṃ kṛte kṛtam
verses.translation: O bestower of honour, in all the Kalpas, there was only one Purina1 that was the very seed of the fourfold aims of life,- It extended to a hundred crores of verses.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाचारधर्मं साक्षात्कारमुपैष्यति । कियन्ति च पुराणानि कियत्संख्यानि मानतः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramācāradharmaṃ sākṣātkāramupaiṣyati / kiyanti ca purāṇāni kiyatsaṃkhyāni mānataḥ
verses.translation: With due respect to P.V. Kane (H.D. V. ii.P. 829), I believe that originally there was a single text of literature called the Purina, on account of the following reasons:
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: किङ्किमाख्यानयुक्तानि तद्वदस्व मम प्रभो । चातुर्वर्ण्याश्रया नानाव्रतादीनां कथास्तथा
verses.transliteration: kiṅkimākhyānayuktāni tadvadasva mama prabho / cāturvarṇyāśrayā nānāvratādīnāṃ kathāstathā
verses.translation: LP I. 2.3., Mt. P 53. 3-11, Pd. P V. 145-52, Va. P. I. 60-61. And They have a number of common verses. For example compare, NP 1.92.22-25 (our text) with the following from Mt. P. 53. 4-11.:
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टिक्रमेण वंशानां कथाः सम्यक्प्रकाशय । त्वत्तो ऽधिको न चान्यो ऽस्ति पुराणाख्यानवित्प्रभो
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭikrameṇa vaṃśānāṃ kathāḥ samyakprakāśaya / tvatto 'dhiko na cānyo 'sti purāṇākhyānavitprabho
verses.translation: He divides Purana into eighteen books and hands it over to the people of the Earth. Even today, original in the region of the Devas, the Purana extends to a hundred crores of verses.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादाख्याहि मह्यं त्वं सर्वसन्देहभञ्जनम् । सूत उवाच ततः सनातनो विप्राः श्रुत्वा नारदभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādākhyāhi mahyaṃ tvaṃ sarvasandehabhañjanam / sūta uvāca tataḥ sanātano viprāḥ śrutvā nāradabhāṣitam
verses.translation: The total number of verses in the extant Puranas as enumerated in Mt. P. & Va.P. comes to 400600 which is approximately the same as ''Four hundred thousand** as mentioned here and in other Puranas.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: नारायणं क्षणं ध्यात्वा प्रोवाचाथ विदां वरः । सनातन उवाच साधु साधु मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वलोकोपकारिका
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā provācātha vidāṃ varaḥ / sanātana uvāca sādhu sādhu muniśreṣṭha sarvalokopakārikā
verses.translation: 4-8, VP HI. 6.21.23, Mt. P. 53.11 ff Va. P. 104. 2-10, etc. But there is some difference in the serial order. For example, NP. records the Vdyu P as the 4th in the list, while a number of others substitute the Saioa as the 4th instead of Vdyu. A.D. Pusalkar has however, convincingly shown that the Vdyu is entided to be a Mahapurana and Not the Siva Purana ( Studies in the Epics & Puranas of India (SEP. Ch. 2 pp. 31-41) that the VP contains this list shows that these Puranas existed in the Gupta Age.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: पुराणाख्यानविज्ञाने यज्जाता नेष्ठिकी मतिः । तुभ्यं समभिधास्यामि यत्प्रोक्तं ब्रह्मणा पुरा
verses.transliteration: purāṇākhyānavijñāne yajjātā neṣṭhikī matiḥ / tubhyaṃ samabhidhāsyāmi yatproktaṃ brahmaṇā purā
verses.translation: Like the NP most Puranas give the Brahma the first place in their lists. But the Vdyu 104,3 and the Deoibhagaoata (13.3) put the Matsya as the first in their list, while the Skanda-Prabhdsa Khanda 2. 8-9 gives that honour to the Brahmaq (la.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: मरीच्यादिऋषिभ्यस्तु पुत्रस्नेहावृतात्मना । एकदा ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो मरीचिर्नाम विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: marīcyādiṛṣibhyastu putrasnehāvṛtātmanā / ekadā brahmaṇaḥ putro marīcirnāma viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: The Bh. P. XII. 13.4 agrees with the NP about the number of verses (viz 10000) in the Brahma P but AP. 272.1 credits it with 25000 verses while Mt. P. states 13000 as the total No. of verses therein. Actually
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायश्रुतसंपन्नो वेदवेदागपारगः । उपसृत्य स्वपितरं ब्रह्मणं लोकभावनम्
verses.transliteration: svādhyāyaśrutasaṃpanno vedavedāgapāragaḥ / upasṛtya svapitaraṃ brahmaṇaṃ lokabhāvanam
verses.translation: In the course of that narrative, the incarnation of the glorious Ramacandra* 1 has been recounted, Ramacandra of blissful form incarnating in four manifestations (vyuhas).2
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य भक्त्या पप्रच्छ इदमेव मुनिश्वर । पुराणाख्यानममलं यत्त्वं पृच्छसि मानद
verses.transliteration: praṇamya bhaktyā papraccha idameva muniśvara / purāṇākhyānamamalaṃ yattvaṃ pṛcchasi mānada
verses.translation: This story of Rama though included in the list of contents of the Brahma by the NP. is not found in the printed editions (both Anandasrama Poona and Gurumandal (GM) Calcutta.)
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिरुवाच भगवन्देवदेवेश लोकानां प्रभवाप्यय । सर्वज्ञ सर्वकल्याण सर्वाध्यक्ष नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: marīciruvāca bhagavandevadeveśa lokānāṃ prabhavāpyaya / sarvajña sarvakalyāṇa sarvādhyakṣa namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Obviously the Paficardtra doctrine of "Four Manifestations'* is implied here as Rama is an incarnation of Visnu (Vasudeva.)
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: पुराणबीजमाख्यहि मह्यं शुश्रूषवे पितः । लक्षणं च प्रमाणं च प्रमाणं चं वक्तारं पृच्छकं तथा
verses.transliteration: purāṇabījamākhyahi mahyaṃ śuśrūṣave pitaḥ / lakṣaṇaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ caṃ vaktāraṃ pṛcchakaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The description of Puru$ottama Ksetra and how king Indradyumna of Avanti carved out three wooden images (of Jagannatha, Balarama and Subhadra) is found in Chs. 44-51 of the Bd. P. This Purusottama Ksetra is Puri of Jagannatha Puri or Sr! Ksetra in Orissa. Puri is the ancient Buddhist
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणानां समुच्चयम् । यस्मिञ्ज्ञाते भवेज्ज्ञातं वाङ्मयं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi purāṇānāṃ samuccayam / yasmiñjñāte bhavejjñātaṃ vāṅmayaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: The duties of the different castes and stages of life have been described in detail. There is the narration of Visnu- Dharma and the Yugas as well as the Pralaya (dissolution of the world).
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: पुराणमेकमेवासीत्सर्वकल्पेषु मानद । चतुर्वर्गस्य बीजं च शतकोटिप्रविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: purāṇamekamevāsītsarvakalpeṣu mānada / caturvargasya bījaṃ ca śatakoṭipravistaram
verses.translation: Thus the Brahma Purana that consists of two parts has been described. It is destructive of all sins. It bestows all happiness.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिः सर्वशास्त्राणां पुराणादभवत्ततः । कालेनाग्रहणं दृष्ट्वा पुरामस्य महामतिः
verses.transliteration: pravṛttiḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇādabhavattataḥ / kālenāgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā purāmasya mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: He who, after getting copied this Purana consisting of the dialogue of Suta and Saunaka that yields worldly pleasure (here) and release from Samsara (hereafter), donates devoutly that manuscript on the full moon day in the month of Vaisakha, to a Brahmana well-versed in Puranas, alongwith gold, water and a cow, after propitiating him with garments, sweet dishes and ornaments, — (such a person) stays in the region of god Brahma as long as the sun, the moon and the stars shine.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: हरिर्व्यासस्वरूपेण जायते च युगे युगे । चतुर्लक्षप्रमाणेन द्वापरे द्वापरे सदा
verses.transliteration: harirvyāsasvarūpeṇa jāyate ca yuge yuge / caturlakṣapramāṇena dvāpare dvāpare sadā
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). But a number of chapters on sacred places and other important episodes which find a place in every Purana and as such cannot be branded as 'spurious', are not mentioned in the contents of the Bd. P- as summarised in the NP.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.transliteration: tadaṣṭādaśadhā kṛtvā bhūrloke nirddiśatyapi / adyāpi devaloke tu śatakoṭipravistaram
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). verses.sanskrit: अस्त्येव तस्य सारस्तु चतुर्लक्षेण वर्ण्यते । ब्राह्मं पाद्मं वैष्णवं च वायवीयं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: astyeva tasya sārastu caturlakṣeṇa varṇyate / brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca vāyavīyaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). verses.sanskrit: भागवतं नारदीयं मार्कण्डेयं च कीर्तितम् । आग्नेयं च भविष्यं च ब्रह्मवैवर्त्तलिङ्गके
verses.transliteration: bhāgavataṃ nāradīyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca kīrtitam / āgneyaṃ ca bhaviṣyaṃ ca brahmavaivarttaliṅgake
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). verses.sanskrit: वाराहं च तथा स्कान्दं वामनं कूर्मसंज्ञकम् । मात्स्यं च गारुडं तद्वद्ब्रह्माण्डाख्यमिति त्रिषट्
verses.transliteration: vārāhaṃ ca tathā skāndaṃ vāmanaṃ kūrmasaṃjñakam / mātsyaṃ ca gāruḍaṃ tadvadbrahmāṇḍākhyamiti triṣaṭ
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). verses.sanskrit: एकं कथानकं सूत्रं वक्तुः श्रोतुः समाह्वयम् । प्रवक्ष्यामि समासेन निशामय समाहितः
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ kathānakaṃ sūtraṃ vaktuḥ śrotuḥ samāhvayam / pravakṣyāmi samāsena niśāmaya samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मं पुराणं तत्रादौ सर्वलोकहिताय वै । व्यासेन वेदविदुषा समाख्यातं महात्मना
verses.transliteration: brahmaṃ purāṇaṃ tatrādau sarvalokahitāya vai / vyāsena vedaviduṣā samākhyātaṃ mahātmanā
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). verses.sanskrit: तद्वै सर्वपुराणाग्र्यं धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम् । नानाख्यानेतिहासाढ्यं दशसाहस्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tadvai sarvapurāṇāgryaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam / nānākhyānetihāsāḍhyaṃ daśasāhasramucyate
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). verses.sanskrit: देवानां च सुराणां च यत्रोत्पत्तिः प्रकीर्तिता । प्रजापतीनां च तथा दक्षादीनां मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca yatrotpattiḥ prakīrtitā / prajāpatīnāṃ ca tathā dakṣādīnāṃ munīśvara

P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). verses.transliteration: tato lokeśvarasyātra sūryasya paramātmanaḥ / vaṃśānukīrtanaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). verses.transliteration: yatrāvatāraḥ kathitaḥ paramānandarūpiṇaḥ / śrīmato rāmacandrasya caturvyūhāvatāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. verses.sanskrit: ततश्च सोमवंशस्यं कीर्तनं यत्र वर्णितम् । कृष्णस्य जगदीशस्य चरितं कल्मषापहम्
verses.transliteration: tataśca somavaṃśasyaṃ kīrtanaṃ yatra varṇitam / kṛṣṇasya jagadīśasya caritaṃ kalmaṣāpaham

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपानां चैव सर्वेषां वर्षाणां चाप्यशेषतः । वर्णनं यत्र पातालस्वर्गाणां च प्रदृश्यते
verses.transliteration: dvīpānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ varṣāṇāṃ cāpyaśeṣataḥ / varṇanaṃ yatra pātālasvargāṇāṃ ca pradṛśyate

verses.sanskrit: नरकाणां समाख्यानं सूर्यस्तुतिकथानकम् । पार्वत्याश्च तथा जन्म विवाहश्च निगद्यते
verses.transliteration: narakāṇāṃ samākhyānaṃ sūryastutikathānakam / pārvatyāśca tathā janma vivāhaśca nigadyate

verses.sanskrit: दक्षाख्यानं ततः प्रोक्तमेकाम्रक्षेत्रवर्णनम् । पूर्वभागो ऽयमुदितः पुराणस्यास्य नारद
verses.transliteration: dakṣākhyānaṃ tataḥ proktamekāmrakṣetravarṇanam / pūrvabhāgo 'yamuditaḥ purāṇasyāsya nārada

verses.sanskrit: अस्योत्तरे विभागे तु पुरुषोत्तमवर्णनम् । विस्तरेण समाख्यातं तीर्थयात्राविधानतः

verses.sanskrit: अत्रैव कृष्णचरितं विस्तरात्समुदीरितम् । वर्णनं यमलोकस्य पितृश्राद्धविधिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: atraiva kṛṣṇacaritaṃ vistarātsamudīritam / varṇanaṃ yamalokasya pitṛśrāddhavidhistathā
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). But a number of chapters on sacred places and other important episodes which find a place in every Purana and as such cannot be branded as 'spurious', are not mentioned in the contents of the Bd. P- as summarised in the NP.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्माश्च कीर्तिता यत्र विस्तरात् । विष्णुधर्मयुगाख्यानं प्रलयस्य च वर्णनम्
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramāṇāṃ dharmāśca kīrtitā yatra vistarāt / viṣṇudharmayugākhyānaṃ pralayasya ca varṇanam
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). But a number of chapters on sacred places and other important episodes which find a place in every Purana and as such cannot be branded as 'spurious', are not mentioned in the contents of the Bd. P- as summarised in the NP.

verses.sanskrit: योगानां च समाख्यानं सांख्यानां चापि वर्णनम् । ब्रह्मवादसमुद्देशः पुराणस्य प्रशंसनम्
verses.transliteration: yogānāṃ ca samākhyānaṃ sāṃkhyānāṃ cāpi varṇanam / brahmavādasamuddeśaḥ purāṇasya praśaṃsanam
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). P- as summarised in the NP.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्ब्रह्मपुराणं तु भागद्वयसमन्वितम् । वर्णितं सर्वपापघ्नं सर्वसौख्यप्रदायकम्
verses.transliteration: etadbrahmapurāṇaṃ tu bhāgadvayasamanvitam / varṇitaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyakam
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). P- as summarised in the NP.

verses.sanskrit: सूतशौनकसंवादं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् । लिखित्वेतत्पुराणं यो वैशाख्यां हेमसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: sūtaśaunakasaṃvādaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam / likhitvetatpurāṇaṃ yo vaiśākhyāṃ hemasaṃyutam
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). P- as summarised in the NP.

verses.sanskrit: जलधेनुयुतं चापि भक्त्या दद्याद्द्विजातये । पौराणिकाय संपूज्य वस्त्रभोज्यविभूषणैः
verses.transliteration: jaladhenuyutaṃ cāpi bhaktyā dadyāddvijātaye / paurāṇikāya saṃpūjya vastrabhojyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). But a number of chapters on sacred places and other important episodes which find a place in every Purana and as such cannot be branded as 'spurious', are not mentioned in the contents of the Bd. P- as summarised in the NP.

verses.sanskrit: स वसेद्ब्रह्मणो लोके यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम् । यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि ब्राह्मानुक्रमणीं द्विज
verses.transliteration: sa vasedbrahmaṇo loke yāvaccandrārkatārakam / yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi brāhmānukramaṇīṃ dvija
verses.translation: VV 40-42 give some of the main items in the Bd. P. such as the story of ICrsna (Chs. 180-211), description of the region of Yama (Chs. 214-216), PitrrSraddha (219-220), Varna sramadharma (Gh. 222), discussion of Yoga (Chs. 234, 238), Sahkhya (Chs. 235, 239) and eulogy of Puranas (Ch. 235). But a number of chapters on sacred places and other important episodes which find a place in every Purana and as such cannot be branded as 'spurious', are not mentioned in the contents of the Bd. P- as summarised in the NP.
