verses.sanskrit: नद्यारामतडागेषु चैत्यगोष्ठापणेषु च । समर्चनं तथा लक्ष्म्याः स्वर्णरौप्ये कृताकृते
verses.transliteration: nadyārāmataḍāgeṣu caityagoṣṭhāpaṇeṣu ca / samarcanaṃ tathā lakṣmyāḥ svarṇaraupye kṛtākṛte
verses.translation: O Brahmana, Kusas grow in the fields of gingelly seeds. In the afternoon of the new moon day in the month of Bhadrapada, the devotee repeats the Mantra of Virinci (god Brahma) and cuts those Kusa grasses saying 'Hum phat5. These grasses can be used always in all holy rites. But the other Kusa grasses can be used only once.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: द्यूतं च वर्षफलदं जये चापिपराजये । गवां पूजात्र विहिता शृङ्गाद्यङ्गानुरञ्जनैः
verses.transliteration: dyūtaṃ ca varṣaphaladaṃ jaye cāpiparājaye / gavāṃ pūjātra vihitā śṛṅgādyaṅgānurañjanaiḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmana, Kusas grow in the fields of gingelly seeds. In the afternoon of the new moon day in the month of Bhadrapada, the devotee repeats the Mantra of Virinci (god Brahma) and cuts those Kusa grasses saying 'Hum phat5. These grasses can be used always in all holy rites. But the other Kusa grasses can be used only once.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: यवसान्नादिदानैश्च नमस्कारप्रदक्षिणैः । मार्गे ऽपि पितृपूजा स्याच्छ्रद्धैर्ब्राह्मणभोजनैः
verses.transliteration: yavasānnādidānaiśca namaskārapradakṣiṇaiḥ / mārge 'pi pitṛpūjā syācchraddhairbrāhmaṇabhojanaiḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmana, Kusas grow in the fields of gingelly seeds. In the afternoon of the new moon day in the month of Bhadrapada, the devotee repeats the Mantra of Virinci (god Brahma) and cuts those Kusa grasses saying 'Hum phat5. These grasses can be used always in all holy rites. But the other Kusa grasses can be used only once.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यादि नियमैर्जपहोमार्चनादिभिः । पौषे माघे च विप्रेन्द्र पितृश्राद्धं फलाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryādi niyamairjapahomārcanādibhiḥ / pauṣe māghe ca viprendra pitṛśrāddhaṃ phalādhikam
verses.translation: O Brahmana, Kusas grow in the fields of gingelly seeds. In the afternoon of the new moon day in the month of Bhadrapada, the devotee repeats the Mantra of Virinci (god Brahma) and cuts those Kusa grasses saying 'Hum phat5. These grasses can be used always in all holy rites. But the other Kusa grasses can be used only once.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: अमायां कर्णपातार्कयुक्तायां तु गयाधिकम् । फआल्गुने केवलं श्राद्धं द्विजानां भोजनं तथा
verses.transliteration: amāyāṃ karṇapātārkayuktāyāṃ tu gayādhikam / phaālgune kevalaṃ śrāddhaṃ dvijānāṃ bhojanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O Brahmana, Kusas grow in the fields of gingelly seeds. In the afternoon of the new moon day in the month of Bhadrapada, the devotee repeats the Mantra of Virinci (god Brahma) and cuts those Kusa grasses saying 'Hum phat5. These grasses can be used always in all holy rites. But the other Kusa grasses can be used only once.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: दानादि सर्वफलदं दर्शे सोमे ऽधिकं फलम् । इत्थं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं तिथिकृत्यं मुने तव
verses.transliteration: dānādi sarvaphaladaṃ darśe some 'dhikaṃ phalam / itthaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ tithikṛtyaṃ mune tava
verses.translation: O Brahmana, Kusas grow in the fields of gingelly seeds. In the afternoon of the new moon day in the month of Bhadrapada, the devotee repeats the Mantra of Virinci (god Brahma) and cuts those Kusa grasses saying 'Hum phat5. These grasses can be used always in all holy rites. But the other Kusa grasses can be used only once.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्रापि विशेषो ऽस्ति स पुराणान्तरे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: sarvatrāpi viśeṣo 'sti sa purāṇāntare sthitaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmana, Kusas grow in the fields of gingelly seeds. In the afternoon of the new moon day in the month of Bhadrapada, the devotee repeats the Mantra of Virinci (god Brahma) and cuts those Kusa grasses saying 'Hum phat5. These grasses can be used always in all holy rites. But the other Kusa grasses can be used only once.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे पूर्वभागे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे द्वादशमासस्थितपौर्णमास्य मावास्याव्रतकथनं नाम चतुर्विंशत्यधिकशतमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच इत्येवमुक्त्वा मुनिना हि पृष्टास्ते वै कुमाराः किल नारदेन । संपूजिताः शास्त्रविदां वरिष्ठाः कृताह्निका जग्मुरुमेशलोकम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe pūrvabhāge bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde dvādaśamāsasthitapaurṇamāsya māvāsyāvratakathanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyadhikaśatamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca ityevamuktvā muninā hi pṛṣṭāste vai kumārāḥ kila nāradena / saṃpūjitāḥ śāstravidāṃ variṣṭhāḥ kṛtāhnikā jagmurumeśalokam
verses.translation: Having recounted thus (the matter in the foregone four Padas of this Purana) on being enquired (about it) by the sage Narada, it is reported that the (four) Kumaras (viz. Sanat, Sanaka, Sanandana and Sana tana) who were the most excellent ones among the knowers of the sacred lore (sastras) were worshipped by Narada. After performing their
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेशमग्र्यर्कनिभैर्मुनीन्द्रैः श्रीवामदेवादिभिरर्चिताङ्घ्रिम् । सुरासुरेन्द्रैरभिवन्द्यमुग्रं नत्वाज्ञया तस्य निषेदुरुर्व्याम्
verses.transliteration: tatreśamagryarkanibhairmunīndraiḥ śrīvāmadevādibhirarcitāṅghrim / surāsurendrairabhivandyamugraṃ natvājñayā tasya niṣedururvyām
verses.translation: There (in the region of god Siva) they bowed down to Ugra (i.e. Siva), Isa, whose feet have been worshipped by the leading sages like Srlvamadeva and others who resembled (in refulgence) the fire and the sun— Siva who is worthy of being adored by the leaders of the Devas and Asuras. At his behest, they sat on the bare ground.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वाथ तत्राखिलशास्त्रसारं शिवागमं ते पशुपाशमोक्षणम् । जग्मुस्ततो ज्ञानघनस्वरूपा नत्वा पुरारिं स्वपितुर्निकाशम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvātha tatrākhilaśāstrasāraṃ śivāgamaṃ te paśupāśamokṣaṇam / jagmustato jñānaghanasvarūpā natvā purāriṃ svapiturnikāśam
verses.translation: There, they heard the Saiva Agama which is the essence of all sacred lores, and which is conducive to the liberation of Pasu (individual soul) from Pasa (bondage ofSamsara). After bowing to Purari (Siva) those sages who were the very concrete embodiments of Pure knowledge, went to the presence of their father (god Brahma).
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्पादपद्मे प्रणतिं विधाय पित्रापि सत्कृत्य सभाजितास्ते । लब्ध्वाशिषो ऽद्यापि चरन्ति शश्वल्लोकेषु तीर्थानि च तीर्थभूताः
verses.transliteration: tatpādapadme praṇatiṃ vidhāya pitrāpi satkṛtya sabhājitāste / labdhvāśiṣo 'dyāpi caranti śaśvallokeṣu tīrthāni ca tīrthabhūtāḥ
verses.translation: They bowed down to his lotus feet. They were duly honoured and welcomed by their father. Receiving his blessings they became holy and sacred. From that time onwards, they who are the embodiments of holy places, are continuously moving about in the holy centres in all the three worlds.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: जग्मुस्ततो वै बदरीवनान्ते सुरेन्द्रवर्गैरुपसेव्यमानम् । दध्युश्चिरं विष्णुपदाब्जमव्ययं ध्यायन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः
verses.transliteration: jagmustato vai badarīvanānte surendravargairupasevyamānam / dadhyuściraṃ viṣṇupadābjamavyayaṃ dhyāyanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, they went to the. holy forest of Badari, where they meditated for a long time on the immutable lotus¬ like feet of Lord Visnu which are being resorted to by groups of leading Devas and on which the ascetics, devoid of passion, contemplate.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: नारदो ऽपि ततो विप्रा कुमारेभ्यः समीहितम् । लब्ध्वा ज्ञानं सविज्ञानं भृशं प्रीतमना ह्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: nārado 'pi tato viprā kumārebhyaḥ samīhitam / labdhvā jñānaṃ savijñānaṃ bhṛśaṃ prītamanā hyabhūt
verses.translation: After acquiring the spiritual knowledge along with sound wisdom and discrimination so longed for by him from those Kumaras (viz. Sanaka, Sanandana and others), Narada was highly pleased in his mind.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: स तस्मात्स्वर्णदीतीरादागत्य पितुरन्तिके । प्रणम्य सत्कृतः पित्रा ब्रह्मणा निषसाद च
verses.transliteration: sa tasmātsvarṇadītīrādāgatya piturantike / praṇamya satkṛtaḥ pitrā brahmaṇā niṣasāda ca
verses.translation: From the banks of that celestial river, he returned to his father's presence, where he was warmly welcomed by his father (god Brahma). After bowing to him he took his seat there.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: कुमारेभ्यः श्रुतं यच्च ज्ञानं विज्ञानसंयुतम् । वर्णयामास तत्त्वेन सो ऽपि श्रुत्वा मुमोद च
verses.transliteration: kumārebhyaḥ śrutaṃ yacca jñānaṃ vijñānasaṃyutam / varṇayāmāsa tattvena so 'pi śrutvā mumoda ca
verses.translation: He described factually the spiritual wisdom along with sound knowledge that he had heard from the Kumaras. On hearing that, he (i.e. Brahma) too rejoiced.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रणम्य शिरसा लब्धाशीर्मुनिसत्तमः । आजगाम च कैलासं मुनिसिद्धनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: atha praṇamya śirasā labdhāśīrmunisattamaḥ / ājagāma ca kailāsaṃ munisiddhaniṣevitam
verses.translation: Then the excellent sage (Narada) bowed down (to Brahma) with his head and received his blessings. He came over to Kailasa which is frequented by sages and Siddhas.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: नानाश्चर्यमयं शश्वत्सर्वर्त्तुकुसुमद्रुमैः । मन्दारैः पारिजातैश्च चंपकाशोकवञ्जुलैः
verses.transliteration: nānāścaryamayaṃ śaśvatsarvarttukusumadrumaiḥ / mandāraiḥ pārijātaiśca caṃpakāśokavañjulaiḥ
verses.translation: It removes the defects due to Kali's harrassment; it is conducive to the increase of all riches of men. This is liked by everyone. It illuminates all knowledge.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश्च विविधैर्वृक्षैर्नानापक्षिगणावृतैः । वातोद्धूतशिखैः पान्थानाह्वयद्भिरिवावृतम्
verses.transliteration: anyaiśca vividhairvṛkṣairnānāpakṣigaṇāvṛtaiḥ / vātoddhūtaśikhaiḥ pānthānāhvayadbhirivāvṛtam
verses.translation: It sheds light on the modes of austerities, holy rites and their benefits of the followers of Siva, Visnu, Sakti, the Sun god and Ganapati. It explains the duties of those who adhere to the system of disciplined life in accordance with the classification of various castes and stages of life. It throws light on the Mantras, Yantras and the ancillary subjects of the Vedas with their divisions. It is a brief digest of the Agamas, the Vedas and the Sarhkhya tenets. He who reads this devoutly or listens to it with great concentration, shall derive all cherished desires difficult of access, even to the Devas and others.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: नानामृगगणाकीर्णं सिद्धकिन्नरसंकुलम् । सरोभिः स्वच्छसलिलैर्लसत्काञ्चनपङ्कजैः
verses.transliteration: nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ siddhakinnarasaṃkulam / sarobhiḥ svacchasalilairlasatkāñcanapaṅkajaiḥ
verses.translation: I shall now go to my preceptor Vyasa, of unmeasured splendour. After saying this, Suta was worshipped bySaunaka and other noble souls.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: शोभितं सारसैर्हंसैश्चक्राह्वाद्यैर्निनादितम् । स्वर्द्धनीपातनिर् घृष्टं क्रीडद्भिश्चाप्सरोगणैः
verses.transliteration: śobhitaṃ sārasairhaṃsaiścakrāhvādyairnināditam / svarddhanīpātanir ghṛṣṭaṃ krīḍadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Permitted by all of them, he went his way to see his preceptor Vyasa.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: सलिले ऽलकनन्दायाः कुचकुङ्कुमपिङ्गले । आमोदमुदितैर्नागैः सलिलैः पुष्करोद्धृतैः
verses.transliteration: salile 'lakanandāyāḥ kucakuṅkumapiṅgale / āmodamuditairnāgaiḥ salilaiḥ puṣkaroddhṛtaiḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयद्भिः करेणूश्च कलभांश्च समाकुले । अथ श्वेताभ्रसदृशे शृङ्गे तस्य च भूभृतः
verses.transliteration: snāpayadbhiḥ kareṇūśca kalabhāṃśca samākule / atha śvetābhrasadṛśe śṛṅge tasya ca bhūbhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: वटं कालाभ्रसदृशं ददर्श शतयोजनम् । तस्याधस्तात्समासीनं योगिमण्डलमध्यगम्
verses.transliteration: vaṭaṃ kālābhrasadṛśaṃ dadarśa śatayojanam / tasyādhastātsamāsīnaṃ yogimaṇḍalamadhyagam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: कपर्दिनं विरूपाक्ष व्याघ्रचर्मांबरावृतम् । भूतिभूषितसर्वाङ्गं नागभूषणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: kapardinaṃ virūpākṣa vyāghracarmāṃbarāvṛtam / bhūtibhūṣitasarvāṅgaṃ nāgabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राक्षमालया शश्वच्छोभितं चन्द्रशेखरम् । तं दृष्ट्वा नारदो विप्रा भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः
verses.transliteration: rudrākṣamālayā śaśvacchobhitaṃ candraśekharam / taṃ dṛṣṭvā nārado viprā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: ननाम् शिरसा तस्य पादयोर्जगदीशितुः । ततः प्रसन्नमनसा स्तुत्वा वाग्भिर्वृषध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: nanām śirasā tasya pādayorjagadīśituḥ / tataḥ prasannamanasā stutvā vāgbhirvṛṣadhvajam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: निषसादाज्ञया स्थाणोः सत्कृतो योगिभिस्तदा । अथापृच्छच्च कुशलं नारदं जगतां गुरुः
verses.transliteration: niṣasādājñayā sthāṇoḥ satkṛto yogibhistadā / athāpṛcchacca kuśalaṃ nāradaṃ jagatāṃ guruḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: स च प्राह प्रसादेन भवतः सर्वमस्ति मे । सर्वेषां योगिवर्याणां शृण्वतां तत्र वाडवाः
verses.transliteration: sa ca prāha prasādena bhavataḥ sarvamasti me / sarveṣāṃ yogivaryāṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tatra vāḍavāḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छ शांभिवं ज्ञानं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम् । स शिवः सादरं तस्य भक्त्या संतुष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: papraccha śāṃbhivaṃ jñānaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam / sa śivaḥ sādaraṃ tasya bhaktyā saṃtuṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: योगमष्टाङ्गसंयुक्तं प्राह प्रणतवत्सलः । स लब्ध्वा शांभवं ज्ञानं शङ्कराल्लोकशङ्करात्
verses.transliteration: yogamaṣṭāṅgasaṃyuktaṃ prāha praṇatavatsalaḥ / sa labdhvā śāṃbhavaṃ jñānaṃ śaṅkarāllokaśaṅkarāt
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रसन्नमना नत्वा ययौ नारायणान्तिकम् । तत्रापि नारदो ऽभीक्ष्णं गतागतपरायणः
verses.transliteration: suprasannamanā natvā yayau nārāyaṇāntikam / tatrāpi nārado 'bhīkṣṇaṃ gatāgataparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: सेवितं योगिभिः सिद्धैर्नारायणमतोषयत् । एतद्वः कीर्तितं विप्रा नारदीयं महन्मया
verses.transliteration: sevitaṃ yogibhiḥ siddhairnārāyaṇamatoṣayat / etadvaḥ kīrtitaṃ viprā nāradīyaṃ mahanmayā
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: उपाख्यानं वेदसमं सर्वशास्त्रनिदर्शनम् । चतुष्पादसमायुक्तं शृण्वतां ज्ञानवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: upākhyānaṃ vedasamaṃ sarvaśāstranidarśanam / catuṣpādasamāyuktaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ jñānavarddhanam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: य एतत्कीर्तयेद्विप्रा नारदीयं शिवालये । समाजे द्विजमुख्यानां तथा केशवमन्दिरे
verses.transliteration: ya etatkīrtayedviprā nāradīyaṃ śivālaye / samāje dvijamukhyānāṃ tathā keśavamandire
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: मथुरायां प्रयागे च पुरुषोत्तमसन्निधौ । सेतौ काञ्च्यां कुशस्थल्यां गङ्गाद्वारे कुशस्थले
verses.transliteration: mathurāyāṃ prayāge ca puruṣottamasannidhau / setau kāñcyāṃ kuśasthalyāṃ gaṅgādvāre kuśasthale
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करेषु नदीतीरे यत्र कुत्रापि भक्तिमान् । स लभेत्सर्वय ज्ञानां तीर्थानां च फलं महत्
verses.transliteration: puṣkareṣu nadītīre yatra kutrāpi bhaktimān / sa labhetsarvaya jñānāṃ tīrthānāṃ ca phalaṃ mahat
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: दानानां चापि सर्वेषां तपसां वाप्यशेषतः । उपवासपरो वापि हविष्याशी जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: dānānāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ vāpyaśeṣataḥ / upavāsaparo vāpi haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोता चैव तथा वक्ता नारायणपरायणः । शिवभक्तिरतो वापि शृण्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: śrotā caiva tathā vaktā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ / śivabhaktirato vāpi śṛṇvan siddhimavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: अस्निन्नशेषपुण्यानां सिद्धीनां च समुद्भवः । कथितः सर्वपापघ्नः पठतां शृण्वतां सदा
verses.transliteration: asninnaśeṣapuṇyānāṃ siddhīnāṃ ca samudbhavaḥ / kathitaḥ sarvapāpaghnaḥ paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sadā
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: कलिदोषहरं पुंसां सर्वसंपत्तिवर्द्धनम् । सर्वेषामीप्सितं चेदं सर्वज्ञानप्रकाशकम्
verses.transliteration: kalidoṣaharaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvasaṃpattivarddhanam / sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ cedaṃ sarvajñānaprakāśakam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: शैवानां वैष्णवानां च शाक्तानां सूयसेविनाम् । तथैव गाणपत्यानां वर्णाश्रमवतां द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: śaivānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca śāktānāṃ sūyasevinām / tathaiva gāṇapatyānāṃ varṇāśramavatāṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसां च व्रतानां च फलानां संप्रकाशकम् । मन्त्राणां चैव यन्त्राणां वेदाङ्गानां विभागशः
verses.transliteration: tapasāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca phalānāṃ saṃprakāśakam / mantrāṇāṃ caiva yantrāṇāṃ vedāṅgānāṃ vibhāgaśaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: तथागमानां सांख्यानां वेदानां चैव संग्रहम् । य एतत्पठते भक्त्या शृणुयाद्वा समाहितः
verses.transliteration: tathāgamānāṃ sāṃkhyānāṃ vedānāṃ caiva saṃgraham / ya etatpaṭhate bhaktyā śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: स लभेद्वाञ्छितान्कामान्देवादिष्वपि दुर्लभान् । श्रुत्वेदं नारदीयं तु पुराणं वेदसंमितम्
verses.transliteration: sa labhedvāñchitānkāmāndevādiṣvapi durlabhān / śrutvedaṃ nāradīyaṃ tu purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: वाचकं पूजयेद्भक्त्या धनरत्नांशुकादिभिः । भूमिदानैर्गवां दानै रत्नदानैश्च संततम्
verses.transliteration: vācakaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā dhanaratnāṃśukādibhiḥ / bhūmidānairgavāṃ dānai ratnadānaiśca saṃtatam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: हस्त्यश्वरथदानैश्च प्रीणयेत्सततं गुरुम् । यस्तु व्याकुरुते विप्राः पुराणं धर्मसंग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: hastyaśvarathadānaiśca prīṇayetsatataṃ gurum / yastu vyākurute viprāḥ purāṇaṃ dharmasaṃgraham
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्वर्गप्रदं नॄणां को ऽन्यस्तत्सदृशो गुरुः । कायेन मनसा वाचा धनाद्यैरपि संततम्
verses.transliteration: caturvargapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ ko 'nyastatsadṛśo guruḥ / kāyena manasā vācā dhanādyairapi saṃtatam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रियं समाचरेत्तस्य गुरोर्द्धर्मोपदेशिनः । श्रुत्वा पुराणं विधिवद्धोमं कृत्वा सुरार्चनम्
verses.transliteration: priyaṃ samācarettasya gurorddharmopadeśinaḥ / śrutvā purāṇaṃ vidhivaddhomaṃ kṛtvā surārcanam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्पश्चाच्छतं मिष्टान्नपायसैः । दक्षिणां प्रददेच्छक्त्या भक्त्या प्रीयेत माधवः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścācchataṃ miṣṭānnapāyasaiḥ / dakṣiṇāṃ pradadecchaktyā bhaktyā prīyeta mādhavaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा श्रेष्ठा नदी गङ्गा पुष्करं च सरो यथा । काशी पुरी नगो मेरुर्देवो नारायणो हरिः
verses.transliteration: yathā śreṣṭhā nadī gaṅgā puṣkaraṃ ca saro yathā / kāśī purī nago merurdevo nārāyaṇo hariḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: कृतं युगं सामवेदो धेनुर्विप्रो ऽन्नमंबु च । मार्गो मृगेन्द्रः पुरुषो ऽश्वत्थः प्रह्लाद आननम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ yugaṃ sāmavedo dhenurvipro 'nnamaṃbu ca / mārgo mṛgendraḥ puruṣo 'śvatthaḥ prahlāda ānanam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: उच्चैः श्रवा वसंतश्च जपः शेषोर्ऽयमा धनुः । पावको विष्णुरिन्द्रश्च कपिलो वाक्पतिः कविः
verses.transliteration: uccaiḥ śravā vasaṃtaśca japaḥ śeṣor'yamā dhanuḥ / pāvako viṣṇurindraśca kapilo vākpatiḥ kaviḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनो हनुमान्दर्भश्चित्तं चित्ररथ्ॐऽबुजम् । उर्वशी काञ्चनं यद्वच्छ्रेष्टाश्चैते स्वजातिषु
verses.transliteration: arjuno hanumāndarbhaścittaṃ citrarathoṃ'bujam / urvaśī kāñcanaṃ yadvacchreṣṭāścaite svajātiṣu
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: तथैव नारदीयं तु पुराणेषु प्रकीर्तितम् । शान्तिरस्तु शिवं चास्तु सर्वेषां वो द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva nāradīyaṃ tu purāṇeṣu prakīrtitam / śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu sarveṣāṃ vo dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: गमिष्यामि गुरोः पार्ंश्वं व्यासस्यामिततेजसः । इत्युक्त्वाभ्यर्चितः सूतः शौनकाद्यैर्महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: gamiṣyāmi guroḥ pārṃśvaṃ vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ / ityuktvābhyarcitaḥ sūtaḥ śaunakādyairmahātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञप्तश्च पुनः सर्वैर्दर्शनार्थं गुरोर्ययौ । ते ऽपि सर्वे द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शौनकाद्याः समाहिताः । श्रुतं सम्यगनुष्ठाय तत्र तस्थुश्च सत्रिणः
verses.transliteration: ājñaptaśca punaḥ sarvairdarśanārthaṃ guroryayau / te 'pi sarve dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śaunakādyāḥ samāhitāḥ / śrutaṃ samyaganuṣṭhāya tatra tasthuśca satriṇaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
