verses.sanskrit: कलिकल्मषविषनाशनं हरिं यो जपपूजनविधिभेषजोपसेवी । स तु निर्विषमनसा समेत्य यागं लभते सतमभीप्सितं हि लोकम्
verses.transliteration: kalikalmaṣaviṣanāśanaṃ hariṃ yo japapūjanavidhibheṣajopasevī / sa tu nirviṣamanasā sametya yāgaṃ labhate satamabhīpsitaṃ hi lokam
verses.translation: He who takes (resorts) to meditating in the form of injunctions regarding the performance of Japa and worship of Hari, the destroyer of the poison of the sins of Kali, purges completely his mind of that poison (or Kali) and accomplishes Yoga and ultimately attains the ever-cherished region of Hari.
verses.hindi: आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं अमित तेजस्वी  ध्यानमें लगकर सदा मनोवाज्छित लोक प्राप्त व्यासजीके समीप जाऊँगा। करता है।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणे बृहदुपाख्याने चतुर्थपादे पुराणमहिमावर्णनं नाम पञ्चविंशोत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः समाप्तोयं बृहन्नारदीयपुराणस्य पूर्वभागः श्रीराधामदनमोहनो जयति तराम् उत्तरभागः श्रीगणेशाय नमः श्रीकृष्णाय नमः पान्तु वो जलदश्यामाः शार्ङ्गज्याघातकर्कशाः । त्रैलोक्यमण्डपस्तंभाश्चत्वारो हरिबाहवः
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇe bṛhadupākhyāne caturthapāde purāṇamahimāvarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptoyaṃ bṛhannāradīyapurāṇasya pūrvabhāgaḥ śrīrādhāmadanamohano jayati tarām uttarabhāgaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ pāntu vo jaladaśyāmāḥ śārṅgajyāghātakarkaśāḥ / trailokyamaṇḍapastaṃbhāścatvāro haribāhavaḥ
verses.translation: May the lotus-like pair of Hari's feet be the bestower of desires on us — the pair of feet refulgent with the brilliance of the polished crest jewels of Devas and Asuras (as they bow to him).
verses.hindi: महर्षि वसिष्ठका मान्धाताको एकादशीब्रतकी महिमा सुनाना

verses.sanskrit: सुरद सुरशिरोरत्ननिघृष्टमणिरञ्जितम् । हरिपादांबुजद्वन्द्वमभीष्टप्तदमस्तु नः
verses.transliteration: surada suraśiroratnanighṛṣṭamaṇirañjitam / haripādāṃbujadvandvamabhīṣṭaptadamastu naḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmana, It behoves your honour to tell me what that fire is that burns both dry and damp fuel of terrible sins.
verses.hindi: पान्तु वो जलदश्यामा: शार्डूज्याघातकर्कशा: ।

verses.sanskrit: मान्धातोवाच पापेन्धनस्य घोरस्य शुष्कार्द्रस्य द्विजोत्तम । कोवह्निर्दहते तस्य तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: māndhātovāca pāpendhanasya ghorasya śuṣkārdrasya dvijottama / kovahnirdahate tasya tadbhavānvaktumarhati
verses.translation: O sage, born of the four-faced deity (Brahma), there is nothing that is unknown to you in the three worlds. O prominent Brahmana, the three - fold things (of the past, present and future time) are precisely known to you.
verses.hindi: “जो मेघके समान श्यामवर्ण हैं, शार्ब्रधनुषकी प्रत्यज्चांके आघात (रगड़)-से कठोर हो गयी हैं तथा त्रिभुवनरूपी विशाल भवनको खड़े रखनेके लिये मानो खंभेके समान हैं, भगवान् विष्णुकी वे चारों भुजाएँ आप लोगोंकी रक्षा करें।'

verses.sanskrit: नाज्ञातं त्रिषु लोकेषु चतुर्मुखसमुद्भव । विद्यते तव विप्रेन्द्र त्रिविधस्य सुनिश्चितम्
verses.transliteration: nājñātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu caturmukhasamudbhava / vidyate tava viprendra trividhasya suniścitam
verses.translation: O king of kings, the fuel of sins even though accumulated ( lit. generated) in the course of hundred births, is reduced to ashes through the fire called EkadaSl.
verses.hindi: ' भगवान् श्रीहरिके वे युगल चरणारविन्द सा 3) 492! हमारे अभीष्ट मनोरथोंकी पूर्ति करें, जो देवताओं  फिर और असुरोंके मस्तकपर स्थित रत्रमय मुकुटकी    घिसी हुई मणियोंसे सदा अनुरझ्ित रहते हैं।' मान्धाताने ( वसिष्ठजीसे ) पूछा--द्विजोत्तम ! े जो भयंकर पापरूपी सूखे या गीले ईंधनको जला  बसिष्ठजी बोले--नृपश्रेष्ठ ! सुनो, जिस अग्रिसे

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञातं पातकं शुष्कं ज्ञातं चार्द्रमुदाहृतम् । भाव्यं वाप्यथवातीतं वर्तमान वदस्व नः
verses.transliteration: ajñātaṃ pātakaṃ śuṣkaṃ jñātaṃ cārdramudāhṛtam / bhāvyaṃ vāpyathavātītaṃ vartamāna vadasva naḥ
verses.translation: O ruler of men, sins remain in this body, only so long as the creature (i.e. man) does not observe fast on the auspi¬ cious day of Padmanabha.
verses.hindi: शुभदिवस--एकादशी तिथिको उपवासपूर्वक ब्रत नहीं करता, तभीतक इस शरीरमें पाप ठहर पाते हैं। सहस्नों अश्वमेध और सैकड़ों राजसूय यज्ञ एकादशीब्रतकी सोलहवीं कलाके बराबर भी

verses.sanskrit: वह्निनो केन तद्भस्म भवेदेतन्मतं मम । वसिष्टं उवाच श्रूयतां नृपशार्दूल वह्निना येन तद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vahnino kena tadbhasma bhavedetanmataṃ mama / vasiṣṭaṃ uvāca śrūyatāṃ nṛpaśārdūla vahninā yena tadbhavet
verses.translation: Thousands of horse-sacrifices and hundreds of Raj - asuya sacrifices do not deserve even a sixteenth part of the fast observed on the EkadasI day.
verses.hindi: नहीं हो सकते। प्रभो! एकादश इन्द्रियोंद्वारा जो पाप किया जाता है, वह सब-का-सब एकादशीके उपवाससे नष्ट हो जाता है। राजन्! यदि किसी दूसरे बहानेसे भी एकादशीको उपवास कर लिया

verses.sanskrit: भस्म शुष्कं तथार्द्रं च पापमस्य ह्येशेषतः
verses.transliteration: bhasma śuṣkaṃ tathārdraṃ ca pāpamasya hyeśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: O Lord, all the sins that have been committed by the eleven sense organs shall be dissolved, thanks to the fast on the EkadasI (eleventh) day.
verses.hindi: जाय तो वह यमराजका दर्शन नहीं होने देती। यह एकादशी स्वर्ग और मोक्ष देनेवाली है। राज्य और पुत्र प्रदान करनेवाली है। उत्तम स्त्रीकी प्राप्ति करानेवाली तथा शरीरको नीरोग बनानेवाली

verses.sanskrit: अवाप्य वासरं विष्णोर्यो नरः संयतेन्द्रियः । उपवासपरो भूत्वा पूजयेन्मधुसूदनम्
verses.transliteration: avāpya vāsaraṃ viṣṇoryo naraḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ / upavāsaparo bhūtvā pūjayenmadhusūdanam
verses.translation: It bestows heavently pleasure and salvation; it yields kingdom and sons; it grants good wives and freedom from ailments to the body.
verses.hindi: है। राजन्! एकादशीसे अधिक पवित्र न गड्जभा है, न गया; न काशी है, न पुष्कर। कुरुक्षेत्र, नर्मदा, देविका, यमुना तथा चन्द्रभागा भी एकादशीसे बढ़कर पुण्यमय नहीं हैं। राजन!

verses.sanskrit: स धात्रीस्नानसहितो रात्रौ जागरणान्वितः । विशोधयति पापानि कितवो हि यथा धनम्
verses.transliteration: sa dhātrīsnānasahito rātrau jāgaraṇānvitaḥ / viśodhayati pāpāni kitavo hi yathā dhanam
verses.translation: By observing fast during the day on the day of Hari and by keeping awake during the night, a man is liberated from sins and he goes direct to the region of Visnu.
verses.hindi: एकादशीका ब्रत करनेसे भगवान् विष्णुका धाम अनायास ही प्राप्त हो जाता है। एकादशीको उपवासपूर्वक रातमें जागरण करनेसे मनुष्य सब पापोंसे मुक्त हो भगवान् विष्णुके लोकमें जाता

verses.sanskrit: एकदाशीसमाख्येन वह्निना पातकेन्धनम् । भस्मतां याति राजेन्द्र अपि जन्मशतोद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: ekadāśīsamākhyena vahninā pātakendhanam / bhasmatāṃ yāti rājendra api janmaśatodbhavam
verses.translation: O leading king, it uplifts ten generations on the mother-side, ten generations on the father's side, and ten generations on the wife's side.
verses.hindi: है। राजेन्द्र ! एकादशीब्रत करनेवाला पुरुष मातृकुल,

verses.sanskrit: नेदृश पावनं किञ्चिन्नाराणां भूप विद्यते । यादृशं पद्मनाभस्य दिनं पातकहानिदम्
verses.transliteration: nedṛśa pāvanaṃ kiñcinnārāṇāṃ bhūpa vidyate / yādṛśaṃ padmanābhasya dinaṃ pātakahānidam
verses.translation: The southern portion of the rivpr Sarayu De. p- -
verses.hindi: पितृकुल तथा पत्रीकुलकी दस-दस पीढ़ियोंका उद्धार कर देता है। महाराज! वह अपनेको भी वैकुण्ठमें ले जाता है। एकादशी चिन्तामणि अथवा निधिके समान है। संकल्पसाधक कल्पवृक्ष

verses.sanskrit: तावत्पापानि देहे ऽस्मिंस्तिष्ठन्ति मनुजाधिप । यावन्नोपवसेज्जन्तुः पद्मनाभदिमं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tāvatpāpāni dehe 'smiṃstiṣṭhanti manujādhipa / yāvannopavasejjantuḥ padmanābhadimaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Thus the power of Dvadasi has been glorified by me, O king, it is called the fire that consumes the terrible fuel of sin.
verses.hindi: एवं वेदवाक्योंके समान है। नरश्रेष्ठ! जो मनुष्य ट्वादशशी (एकादशीयुक्त)-की शरण लेते हैं, वे चार भुजाओंसे युक्त हो गरुड़की पीठपर वनमाला और पीताम्बरसे सुशोभित हो भगवान् विष्णुके

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधसहस्राणि राजसूयशतानि च । एकादश्युपवासस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca / ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: Always the day of Hari should be observed as a day of fast by men, devoted to holiness and piety, who wish for abundant worldly pleasures as well as sons, grandsons etc.
verses.hindi: धाममें जाते हैं। महीपते! यह मैंने द्वादशी (एकादशीयुक्त ) -का प्रभाव बताया है। यह घोर पापरूपी ईंधनके लिये अग्निके समान है। पुत्र-

verses.sanskrit: एकादशेन्द्रियैः पापं यत्कृतं भवति प्रभो । एकादश्युपवासेन तत्सर्वं विलयं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: ekādaśendriyaiḥ pāpaṃ yatkṛtaṃ bhavati prabho / ekādaśyupavāsena tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: भोगोंकी इच्छा रखनेवाले धर्मपरायण मनुष्योंको सदा एकादशीके दिन उपवास करना चाहिए। नरश्रेष्ठडू जो मनुष्य आदरपूर्वक एकादशीक्रत करता है, वह माताके उदरमें प्रवेश नहीं करता

verses.sanskrit: एकादशीसमं किञ्चित्पापनाशं न विद्यते । व्याजेनापि कृता राजन्न दर्शयति भास्करिम्
verses.transliteration: ekādaśīsamaṃ kiñcitpāpanāśaṃ na vidyate / vyājenāpi kṛtā rājanna darśayati bhāskarim
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: (उसकी मुक्ति हो जाती है) । अनेक पापोंसे युक्त मनुष्य भी निष्काम या सकामभावसे यदि एकादशीका ब्रत करता है तो वह लोकनाथ भगवान् विष्णुके अनन्त पद (वैकुण्ठ धाम)-को

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदा ह्येषा राज्यपुत्रप्रदायिनी । सुकलत्रप्रदा ह्येषा शरीरारोग्यदायिनी
verses.transliteration: svargamokṣapradā hyeṣā rājyaputrapradāyinī / sukalatrapradā hyeṣā śarīrārogyadāyinī
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: तिथिके विषयमें अनेक ज्ञातव्य बातें तथा विद्धा तिथिका निषेध

verses.sanskrit: न गङ्गा न गया भूप न काशी न च पुष्करम् । न चापि कैरवं क्षेत्रं न रेवा न च देविका
verses.transliteration: na gaṅgā na gayā bhūpa na kāśī na ca puṣkaram / na cāpi kairavaṃ kṣetraṃ na revā na ca devikā
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठजी कहते हैं--राजन्! एकादशी तथा भगवान् विष्णुकी महिमासे सम्बन्ध रखनेवाले सूतपुत्रके उस वचनको जो समस्त पापराशियोंका निवारण करनेवाला था, सुनकर सम्पूर्ण श्रेष्ठ

verses.sanskrit: यमुना चन्द्रभागा च पुण्या भूप हरेर्दिनात् । अनायासेन राजेन्द्र प्राप्यते हरिमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: yamunā candrabhāgā ca puṇyā bhūpa harerdināt / anāyāsena rājendra prāpyate harimandiram
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंने पुन: निर्मल हृदयवाले पौराणिक सूतपुत्रसे पूछा-- मानद! आप व्यासजीकी कृपासे अठारह पुराण और महाभारतको भी जानते हैं। पुराणों और स्मृतियोंमें ऐसी कोई बात नहीं है, जिसे

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ जामरण कृत्वा समुपोष्य हरेर्दिनम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोके व्रजेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: rātrau jāmaraṇa kṛtvā samupoṣya harerdinam / sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke vrajennaraḥ
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: आप न जानते हों। हम लोगोंके हृदयमें एक संशय उत्पन्न हो गया है। आप ही विस्तारसे समझाकर यथार्थरूपसे उसका निवारण कर सकते हैं। तिथिके मूल भाग (प्रारम्भ)-में उपवास

verses.sanskrit: दशैव मातृके पक्षे दश राजेन्द्र पैतृके । भार्याया दश पक्षे च पुरुषानुद्धरेत्तथा
verses.transliteration: daśaiva mātṛke pakṣe daśa rājendra paitṛke / bhāryāyā daśa pakṣe ca puruṣānuddharettathā
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए या अन्तमें? देवकर्म हो या पितृकर्म उसमें तिथिके किस भागमें उपवास करना उचित है? यह बतानेकी कृपा करें। सौतिने कहा--महर्षियो ! देवताओंकी प्रसन्नताके

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानमपि राजेन्द्र स नयेद्वैष्णवं पुरम् । चिन्तामणिसमा ह्येषा अथवापि निधेः समा
verses.transliteration: ātmānamapi rājendra sa nayedvaiṣṇavaṃ puram / cintāmaṇisamā hyeṣā athavāpi nidheḥ samā
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: लिये तो तिथिके अन्तभागमें ही उपवास करना उचित है। वही उनकी प्रीति बढ़ानेवाला है। पितरोंको तिथिका मूलभाग ही प्रिय है-ऐसा कालज्ञ पुरुषोंका कथन है। अतः दसगुने फलकी

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पपादपप्रख्या वेदवाक्योपमाथवा । द्वादशीं ये प्रपन्ना हि नरा नरवरोत्तम
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpapādapaprakhyā vedavākyopamāthavā / dvādaśīṃ ye prapannā hi narā naravarottama
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: इच्छा रखनेवाले पुरुषोंको तिथिके अन्तभागमें ही उपवास करना चाहिए। धर्मकामी पुरुषोंको पितरोंकी तृप्तिक लिये तिथिके मूलभागको ही उत्तम मानना चाहिए। विप्रगण! धर्म, अर्थ तथा कामकी

verses.sanskrit: ते द्वन्द्वबाहवो जाता नागारिकृतवाहनाः । स्रग्विणः पीतवस्त्राश्च प्रयान्ति हरिमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: te dvandvabāhavo jātā nāgārikṛtavāhanāḥ / sragviṇaḥ pītavastrāśca prayānti harimandiram
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: इच्छावाले मनुष्योंको चाहिए कि द्वितीया, अष्टमी, षष्ठी और एकादशी तिथियाँ यदि पूर्वविद्धा हों अर्थात् पहलेवाली तिथिसे संयुक्त हों तो उस दिन ब्रत न करें। द्विजवरो! सप्तमी, अमावास्या,

verses.sanskrit: एष प्रभावो हि मया द्वादश्याः परिकीर्तितः । पापेन्धनस्य घोरस्य पावकाख्यो महीपते
verses.transliteration: eṣa prabhāvo hi mayā dvādaśyāḥ parikīrtitaḥ / pāpendhanasya ghorasya pāvakākhyo mahīpate
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: पूर्णिमा तथा पिताका वार्षिक श्राद्धदिन--इन दिनोंमें पूर्वविद्धा तिथि ही ग्रहण करनी चाहिए। सूर्योदयके समय यदि थोड़ी भी पूर्व तिथि हो तो उससे वर्तमान तिथिको पूर्वविद्धा माने, यदि

verses.sanskrit: हरेर्द्दिनं सदोपोष्यं नरैर्धर्मपरायणैः । इच्छद्भिर्विपुलान्योगान्पुत्रपौत्रादिकांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: harerddinaṃ sadopoṣyaṃ narairdharmaparāyaṇaiḥ / icchadbhirvipulānyogānputrapautrādikāṃstathā
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: उदयके पूर्वसे ही वर्तमान तिथि आ गयी हो तो उसे 'प्रभूता' समझे। पारण तथा मनुष्यके मरणमें तत्कालवर्तिनी तिथि ग्रहण करने योग्य मानी गयी है। पितृकार्यमें वही तिथि ग्राह्म है जो सूर्यास्तकालमें

verses.sanskrit: हरिदिनमिह मर्त्यो यः करोत्यादरेण नरवर स तु कुक्षिं मातुराप्नोति नैव । बहुवृजिनसमेतो ऽकामतः कामतो वा व्रजति पदमनन्तं लोकनाथस्य विष्णोः
verses.transliteration: haridinamiha martyo yaḥ karotyādareṇa naravara sa tu kukṣiṃ māturāpnoti naiva / bahuvṛjinasameto 'kāmataḥ kāmato vā vrajati padamanantaṃ lokanāthasya viṣṇoḥ
verses.translation: The man who observes the day of Hari (EkadasI) with great respect, O most excellent one among men, never enters the womb of a mother even if he has committed many sins or even if he observes the fast with or without intention. He goes to the endless region of Visnu, the Lord of the world.
verses.hindi: मौजूद रहे। विप्रवरो  तिथिका प्रमाण सूर्य और चन्द्रमाकी गतिपर निर्भर है। चन्द्रमा और सूर्यकी गतिका ज्ञान होनेसे कालवेत्ता विद्वान्ू तिथिके कालका मान समझते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीबृहन्नारदीयपुराणोत्तरभागे द्वादशीमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम प्रथमो ऽध्यायः वसिष्ट उवाच इममेवार्थमुद्दिश्य नैमिषारण्यवासिनः । पप्रच्छुर्मुनयः सूतं व्यासशिष्यं महामतिम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrībṛhannāradīyapurāṇottarabhāge dvādaśīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ vasiṣṭa uvāca imamevārthamuddiśya naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ / papracchurmunayaḥ sūtaṃ vyāsaśiṣyaṃ mahāmatim
verses.translation: Tithi b the period required by the moon to gain twelve degrees on the sun to the east ( Surya-siddhanta, Tithi Tattva p. 2.). Due to the irregular motion of the moon, the tithi varies between 67 to 50 ghafikas—a. finding recorded in the maxim.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद, अब में स्नान, पूजा आदिकी विधिका क्रम बताऊँगा, यदि दिन शुद्ध न मिले तो रातमें पूजा की जाती है। दिनका सारा कार्य प्रदोष (रात्रिके आरम्भकाल)-में पूर्ण करना

verses.sanskrit: स तु पृष्टो महाभाग एकादश्याः सुविस्तरम् । माहात्म्यं कथयामास उपवासविधिं तथा
verses.transliteration: sa tu pṛṣṭo mahābhāga ekādaśyāḥ suvistaram / māhātmyaṃ kathayāmāsa upavāsavidhiṃ tathā
verses.translation: On being asked, that highly pleased one recounted the greatness of EkadasI1 in detail and also the rules of procedure regarding the observance of fast.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। यह विधि ब्रत करनेवाले मनुष्योंके लिये बतायी गयी है। विप्रवरो! यदि अरुणोदयकालमें थोड़ी भी द्वादशी हो तो उसमें स्नान, पूजन, होम और दान आदि सारे कार्य करने चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वाक्यं सूतपुत्रस्य श्रुत्वा द्विजवरोत्तमाः । माहात्म्यं चक्रिणश्चापि सर्वपापौघ शान्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: tadvākyaṃ sūtaputrasya śrutvā dvijavarottamāḥ / māhātmyaṃ cakriṇaścāpi sarvapāpaugha śāntidam
verses.translation: A doubt is produced in our minds in the story of Raghunatha that is very extensive, containing hundred crores of verses. It behoves you to dispel it by means of factual and detailed explanation.
verses.hindi: द्वादशीमें त्रत करनेपर शुद्ध त्रयोदशीमें पारण हो तो पृथ्वीदानका फल मिलता है। अथवा वह मनुष्य सौ यज्ञोंके अनुष्ठानसे भी अधिक पुण्य

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पप्रच्छुरमलं सूतं पौराणिकं नृप । अष्टादश पुराणानि भवान् जानाति मानद
verses.transliteration: punaḥ papracchuramalaṃ sūtaṃ paurāṇikaṃ nṛpa / aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni bhavān jānāti mānada
verses.translation: In the previous Chs. IsT.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य स्नातक न बने तो वह सरस्वती उस विद्वानके धर्मका अपहरण करती है। क्षयमें, वृद्धिमें अथवा सूर्योदयकालमें भी पवित्र द्वादशी तिथि प्राप्त हो तो उसीमें उपवास करना चाहिए,

verses.sanskrit: कानीनस्य प्रसादेनः महाभारतमप्युत । तन्नास्ति यन्न वेत्सि त्वं पुराणेषु स्मृतिष्वपि
verses.transliteration: kānīnasya prasādenaḥ mahābhāratamapyuta / tannāsti yanna vetsi tvaṃ purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi
verses.translation: O king, he will be visited by misfortunes and loss of progeny. O Brahmanas this has been heard by me formerly fromKrsna Dvaipayana.
verses.hindi: किंतु पूर्व तिथिसे विद्ध होनेपर उसका अवश्य त्याग कर देना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: चरिते रघुनाथस्य शतकोटिप्रविस्तरे । अस्माकं संशयः कश्चिद्धृदये संप्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: carite raghunāthasya śatakoṭipravistare / asmākaṃ saṃśayaḥ kaściddhṛdaye saṃpravartate
verses.translation: In the rite of Parana (break-fast) and in the case of death of men, that Tithi is remembered which exists at that particular time. In the case of rites pertaining to Pitrs, if
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंने पूछा--सूतजी ! जब पहले दिनकी एकादशीमें द्वादशीका संयोग न प्रास होता हो तो मनुष्योंको किस प्रकार उपवास करना चाहिए? यह बतलाइये। उपवासका दिन जब पूर्व तिथिसे

verses.sanskrit: तं भवानर्हति च्छेत्तुं याथार्थ्येन सुविस्तरात् । तिथेः प्रान्तमुपोष्यं स्यादाहोस्विन्मूलमेव च
verses.transliteration: taṃ bhavānarhati cchettuṃ yāthārthyena suvistarāt / titheḥ prāntamupoṣyaṃ syādāhosvinmūlameva ca
verses.translation: In that case, the Tithi at the time of sunrise is not t en into account. But in the case of rites of the deities, the Tithi at the tune of sunrise must be taken into account. The in-
verses.hindi: विद्ध हो और दूसरे दिन जब थोड़ी भी एकादशी न हो तो उसमें किस प्रकार उपवास करनेका विधान है? इसे भी स्पष्ट कीजिये।

verses.sanskrit: दैवे पैत्र्ये समाख्याहि नावेद्यं विद्यते तवल । सौतिरुवाच तिथेः प्रान्तं सुराणां हि उपोष्यं प्रीतिवर्द्धनम्
verses.transliteration: daive paitrye samākhyāhi nāvedyaṃ vidyate tavala / sautiruvāca titheḥ prāntaṃ surāṇāṃ hi upoṣyaṃ prītivarddhanam
verses.translation: Due to the fault of the contact of the previous Tithi, these are not worthy of being taken up for worship. Those who know about this matter eschew them. O Brahmanas, they eschew all the four Yamas.
verses.hindi: सौतिने कहा--ब्राह्मणो! यदि पहले दिनकी एकादशीमें आधे सूर्योदयतक भी द्वादशीका संयोग न मिलता हो तो दूसरे दिन ही व्रत करना चाहिए। अनेक शास्त्रोंमें परस्पर विरुद्ध वचन

verses.sanskrit: मूलं तिथेः पितॄणां तु कालज्ञैः प्रियमीरितम् । अतः प्रान्तमुपोष्यं हि तिथेर्दशफलेप्सुभिः
verses.transliteration: mūlaṃ titheḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu kālajñaiḥ priyamīritam / ataḥ prāntamupoṣyaṃ hi titherdaśaphalepsubhiḥ
verses.translation: The breaking of the fast on a pure Trayodasi day is conducive to the attainment of benefit of (a grant of) land and performance more than a hundred of Yajnas. There is no doubt about it.
verses.hindi: देखे जाते हैं और ब्राह्मण लोग भी विवादमें ही पड़े रहते हैं। ऐसी दशामें कोई निर्णय होता न देख पवित्र द्वादशी तिथिमें ही उपवास करे और त्रयोदशीमें पारण कर ले। जब एकादशी दशमीसे

verses.sanskrit: मूलं हि पितृतृप्त्यर्थं विज्ञेयं धर्मकाङ्क्षिभिः । पूर्वविद्धा न कर्तव्या द्वितीया चाष्टमी तथा
verses.transliteration: mūlaṃ hi pitṛtṛptyarthaṃ vijñeyaṃ dharmakāṅkṣibhiḥ / pūrvaviddhā na kartavyā dvitīyā cāṣṭamī tathā
verses.translation: For this reason, O Brahmanas, the ablution is to be performed alongwith the rite of Pitr-Tarpana, early in the morning, without reckoning the day of Dvadasi.
verses.hindi: विद्ध हो और द्वादशीमें श्रवणका योग मिलता हो तो दोनों पक्षोंमें पवित्र द्वादशी तिथिको ही उपवास करना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठी चैकादशी भूप धर्मकामार्थलिप्सुभिः । पूर्वविद्धा द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कर्तव्या सप्तमी सदा
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhī caikādaśī bhūpa dharmakāmārthalipsubhiḥ / pūrvaviddhā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kartavyā saptamī sadā
verses.translation: This Dvadasi, if transgressed (?) by men causes great loss. Like the Sarasvati who is not washed, it dispels virtue and
verses.hindi: तिथियों तथा सूर्यसंक्रान्ति आदिमें किये जानेवाले पुण्य कर्मोकी विधिका यथावत् वर्णन कीजिये;

verses.sanskrit: दर्शश्च पौर्णमासश्च पितुः सांवत्सरं दिनम् । पूर्वविद्धानिमांस्त्यक्त्वा नरकं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: darśaśca paurṇamāsaśca pituḥ sāṃvatsaraṃ dinam / pūrvaviddhānimāṃstyaktvā narakaṃ pratipadyate
verses.translation: If there be a loss or increase in the period of Dvadasi orif it is available at the sunrise, Dvadasi should be taken ad¬ vantage of for the purpose of fasting. It is meritorious. One
verses.hindi: प्रात्त कर लेता है। विप्रगण ! यदि आगे द्वादशीयुक्त  क्योंकि आपसे कोई बात छिपी नहीं है।

verses.sanskrit: हानिं च संततेर्भूपदौर्भाग्यं समवाप्नुयात् । एतच्छ्रुतं मया विप्राः कृष्णद्वैपायनात्पुरा
verses.transliteration: hāniṃ ca saṃtaterbhūpadaurbhāgyaṃ samavāpnuyāt / etacchrutaṃ mayā viprāḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanātpurā
verses.translation: Just as one eschews the water of the Ganga if it is contaminated by even a drop of liquor, O leading Brahmana, one should avoid the EkadasI day even if there is the overlapping of Dasami by a single pala (a small unit of time).
verses.hindi: दिन न दिखायी दे तो (अर्थात् द्वादशीयुक्त त्रयोदशी न हो तो) प्रातःकाल ही स्रान करना

verses.sanskrit: आदित्योदयवेलायां यास्तोकापि तिथिर्भवेत् । पूर्वविद्धा तु मन्तव्या प्रभूता नोदयं विना
verses.transliteration: ādityodayavelāyāṃ yāstokāpi tithirbhavet / pūrvaviddhā tu mantavyā prabhūtā nodayaṃ vinā
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, just as one should throw away the Pancagavya if it is defiled by a dog, so one should do, if EkadasI in both the fortnights, is defiled by Dasami.
verses.hindi: सौतिने कहा--अयनका पुण्यकाल, जिस दिन अयनका आरम्भ हो, उस पूरे दिनतक

verses.sanskrit: पारणे मरणे नॄणां तिथिस्तात्कालिकी स्मृता । पित्र्ये ऽस्तमनवेलायां स्पर्शे पूर्णा निगद्यते
verses.transliteration: pāraṇe maraṇe nṝṇāṃ tithistātkālikī smṛtā / pitrye 'stamanavelāyāṃ sparśe pūrṇā nigadyate
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, the Purvaviddha EkadasI Tithi (i.e. the eleventh day with the overlapping of the tenth day) had been formerly given to the Danavas by the scion of the family of the Yadus (i.e. Visnu) for the propitiation of the noble souls.
verses.hindi: चाहिए और देवताओं तथा पितरोंका तर्पण करके मानना चाहिए। संक्रान्तिका पुण्यकाल सोलह

verses.sanskrit: न तत्रोदयिनी ग्राह्या दैवस्योदयिकी तिथिः । प्रत्यहं शोधयेत्प्राज्ञस्तिथिं दैवज्ञचिन्तकात्
verses.transliteration: na tatrodayinī grāhyā daivasyodayikī tithiḥ / pratyahaṃ śodhayetprājñastithiṃ daivajñacintakāt
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: द्वादशशीमें ही पारण कर लेना चाहिए। इस द्वादशीका यदि मनुष्य उल्लड्ून करे तो वह बहुत बड़ी हानि करनेवाली होती है। ठीक उसी प्रकार जैसे विद्याध्ययन करके समावर्तन-संस्कारद्वारा

verses.sanskrit: तिथिप्रमाणं विप्रेन्द्राः क्षपाकरदिवाकरौ । चन्द्रार्कचारविज्ञानात्कालं कालविदो विदुः
verses.transliteration: tithipramāṇaṃ viprendrāḥ kṣapākaradivākarau / candrārkacāravijñānātkālaṃ kālavido viduḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: घटीतक होता है। विषुवकालको अक्षय पुण्यजनक बताया गया है। द्विजश्रेष्ठटण! दोनों पक्षॉकी दशमीविद्धा एकादशीका अवश्य त्याग करना चाहिए। जैसे वृषली स्त्रीसे सम्बन्ध रखनेवाला

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वायाः संगदोषेण न योग्यास्ताः प्रपूजने । वर्जयन्ति नरास्तज्ज्ञा यामांश्च चतुरो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: pūrvāyāḥ saṃgadoṣeṇa na yogyāstāḥ prapūjane / varjayanti narāstajjñā yāmāṃśca caturo dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मण श्राद्धमें भोजन कर लेनेपर उस श्राद्धको  दान, जप, होम, स्नान तथा भगवत्पूजन आदि और श्राद्धकर्ताके पुण्यकृत पुण्यको भी नष्ट कर  कर्म सूर्योदयकालमें अन्धकारकी भाँति नष्ट हो देता है, उसी प्रकार पूर्वविद्धा तिथिमें किये हुए  जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: अत ऊर्द्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि स्नानपूजाविधिक्रमम् । न दिवा शुद्धिमाप्नोति तदा रात्रौ विधीयते
verses.transliteration: ata ūrddhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi snānapūjāvidhikramam / na divā śuddhimāpnoti tadā rātrau vidhīyate
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: रुक्‍्माड्गदके राज्यमें एकादशीत्रतके प्रभावसे सबका वैकुण्ठगमन, यमराज आदिका चिन्तित होना, नारदजीसे उनका

verses.sanskrit: दिनकार्यमशेषं हि कर्तव्यं शर्वरीमुखे । विधिरेष मया ख्यातो नराणामुपवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: dinakāryamaśeṣaṃ hi kartavyaṃ śarvarīmukhe / vidhireṣa mayā khyāto narāṇāmupavāsinām
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: ऋषि बोले--सूतजी ! अब भगवान् विष्णुके आराधनकर्मका विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन कीजिये, जिससे भगवान् संतुष्ट होते और अभीष्ट वस्तु प्रदान करते हैं। भगवान् लक्ष्मीपति सम्पूर्ण

verses.sanskrit: अल्पायामथ विप्रेन्द्रा द्वादश्यामरुणोदये । स्नानार्चनक्रिया कार्य्या दानहोमादिसंयुता
verses.transliteration: alpāyāmatha viprendrā dvādaśyāmaruṇodaye / snānārcanakriyā kāryyā dānahomādisaṃyutā
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: जगत्के स्वामी हैं। यह चराचर जगत उन्हींका स्वरूप है। वे समस्त पापराशियोंका नाश करनेवाले भगवान् श्रीहरि किस कर्मसे प्रसन्न होते हैं?

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदश्यां पारणे पृथिवीफलम् । शतयज्ञाधिकं वापि नरः प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम्
verses.transliteration: trayodaśyāṃ pāraṇe pṛthivīphalam / śatayajñādhikaṃ vāpi naraḥ prāpnotyasaṃśayam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: सौतिने कहा--ब्राह्मणो! धरणीधर भगवान् हषीकेश भक्तिसे ही वशमें होते हैं, धनसे नहीं। भक्तिभावसे पूजित होनेपर श्रीविष्णु सब मनोरथ पूर्ण कर देते हैं। अतः ब्राह्मणो! चक्रसुदर्शनधारी

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मात्कारणाद्विप्राः प्रत्यूषे स्नानमाचरेत् । पितृतर्पणसंयुक्तं न दृष्ट्वा द्वादशीदिनम्
verses.transliteration: etasmātkāraṇādviprāḥ pratyūṣe snānamācaret / pitṛtarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ na dṛṣṭvā dvādaśīdinam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: भगवान् श्रीहरिकी सदा भक्ति करनी चाहिए। जलसे भी पूजन करनेपर भगवान् जगन्नाथ सम्पूर्ण क्लेशोंका नाश कर देते हैं। जैसे प्यासा मनुष्य जलसे तृप्त होता है। उसी प्रकार उस

verses.sanskrit: महाहानिकरा ह्येषा द्वादशी लङ्घिता नृभिः । करोति धर्महरणमस्नातेव सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: mahāhānikarā hyeṣā dvādaśī laṅghitā nṛbhiḥ / karoti dharmaharaṇamasnāteva sarasvatī
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: पूजनसे भगवान् शीघ्र संतुष्ट होते हैं। ब्राह्मणो ! इस

verses.sanskrit: क्षये वाप्यथवा वृद्धौ संप्राप्ते वा दिनोदये । उपोष्या द्वादशी पुण्या पूर्वविद्धां विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: kṣaye vāpyathavā vṛddhau saṃprāpte vā dinodaye / upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā pūrvaviddhāṃ vivarjayet
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: जिसमें महर्षि गौतमके साथ राजा रुक्‍्माड्भदके संवादका वर्णन है। प्राचीन कालमें रुक्‍्माड्भद नामसे प्रसिद्ध एक सार्वभौम राजा हो गये हैं। वे सब प्राणियोंके प्रति क्षमाभाव रखते थे। क्षीरसागरमें

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण उवाच यदा च प्राप्यते सूत द्वादश्यां पूर्वसंभवा । तदोपवासो हि कथं कर्तव्यो मानवैर्वद
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa uvāca yadā ca prāpyate sūta dvādaśyāṃ pūrvasaṃbhavā / tadopavāso hi kathaṃ kartavyo mānavairvada
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: शयन करनेवाले भगवान् विष्णु उनके प्रिय आराध्यदेव थे। वे भगवद्धक्त तो थे ही, सदा एकादशीब्रतके पालनमें तत्पर रहते थे। राजा रुक्‍्माड्भद इस जगतूमें देवेश्वर भगवान् पद्मनाभके

verses.sanskrit: उपवासदिनं विद्धं यदा भवति पूर्वया । द्वितीये ऽह्नि यदा न स्यात्स्वल्पाप्येकादशी तिथिः
verses.transliteration: upavāsadinaṃ viddhaṃ yadā bhavati pūrvayā / dvitīye 'hni yadā na syātsvalpāpyekādaśī tithiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: सिवा और किसीको नहीं देखते थे। उनकी सर्वत्र भगवद्दृष्टि थी। वे एकादशीके दिन

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोपवासो विहितः कथं तद्वद सूतज । सौतिरुवाच यदा न प्राप्यते विप्रा द्वादश्यां पूर्वसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: tatropavāso vihitaḥ kathaṃ tadvada sūtaja / sautiruvāca yadā na prāpyate viprā dvādaśyāṃ pūrvasambhavam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: हाथीपर नगाड़ा रखकर बजवाते और सब ओर यह घोषणा कराते थे कि 'आज एकादशी तिथि है। आजके दिन आठ वर्षसे अधिक और पचासी वर्षसे कम आयुवाला जो मन्दबुद्धि मनुष्य भोजन

verses.sanskrit: रविचन्द्रार्कजाहं तु तदोपोष्यं परं दिनम् । बह्वा गमविरोधेषु ब्राह्मणेषु विवादिषु
verses.transliteration: ravicandrārkajāhaṃ tu tadopoṣyaṃ paraṃ dinam / bahvā gamavirodheṣu brāhmaṇeṣu vivādiṣu
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: करेगा, वह मेरे द्वारा दण्डनीय होगा, उसे नगरसे निर्वासित कर दिया जायगा। औरोंकी तो बात ही

verses.sanskrit: उपोष्या द्वादशी पुण्या त्रयोदश्यां तु पारणम् । एकादश्यां तु विद्धायां संप्राप्ते श्रवणे तथा
verses.transliteration: upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam / ekādaśyāṃ tu viddhāyāṃ saṃprāpte śravaṇe tathā
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: क्यों न हो, यदि वह एकादशीके दिन भोजन करेगा तो उसे कठोर दण्ड दिया जायगा। आज गड्डाजीके जलमें गोते लगाओ, श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणोंको दान दो।' द्विजवरो! राजाके इस प्रकार घोषणा

verses.sanskrit: उपोष्या द्वादशी पुण्या पक्षयोरुभयोरपि । एष वो निर्णयः प्रोक्तो मया शास्त्रविनिर्णयात्
verses.transliteration: upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā pakṣayorubhayorapi / eṣa vo nirṇayaḥ prokto mayā śāstravinirṇayāt
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
verses.hindi: करानेपर सब लोग एकादशीब्रत करके भगवान् विष्णुके लोकमें जाने लगे। ब्राह्मणो! इस प्रकार वैकुण्ठधामका मार्ग लोगोंसे भर गया। उस राजाके राज्यमें जो लोग भी मृत्युको प्राप्त होते थे,

verses.sanskrit: किमन्यच्छ्रोतुकामा हि तद्भवन्तो ब्रुवन्तु मे । ऋषय ऊचुः युगादीनां वदविधिं सौते सम्यग्यथातथम्
verses.transliteration: kimanyacchrotukāmā hi tadbhavanto bruvantu me / ṛṣaya ūcuḥ yugādīnāṃ vadavidhiṃ saute samyagyathātatham
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas the following gifts are no better than gifts offered to Asuras: the monetary gift given at the wrong time, the gift to the undeserving, what is given by the angry donor, what is given after dishonouring the recipient, the gift on a Tithi 'pierced by5 the previous Tithi; the gift offered by one who is defiled by ucchista (leavings of food), what is given unto the fallen ones, what is gifted to the hen¬ pecked ones, what is given without water offerings and what is offered with subsequent and frequent allusions to it. Hence, O Brahmanas, the EkadasI Tithi should not be observed if it is Viddha ( i.e. when Dasami overlaps it).
